title: Talking to Yourself: Defying Forgetting in Large Language Models
summary:
Catastrophic forgetting remains a major challenge when fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on narrow, task-specific data, often degrading their general knowledge and reasoning abilities. We propose SA-SFT, a lightweight self-augmentation routine in which an LLM generates self-dialogues prior to fine-tuning, and the resulting self-authored data are mixed with task data without modifying optimization or training schedules.
  Despite requiring no external data or additional tuning, SA-SFT consistently mitigates catastrophic forgetting while improving in-domain performance. Across 50 evaluation scenarios, it maintains performance comparable to the original model and achieves the best results in 40 cases, outperforming common baselines such as layer freezing and external data mixing. Guided by these empirical findings, we further present a theoretical analysis suggesting that forgetting can partly stem from style-induced parameter drift, and that self-alignment through self-generated data provides an effective means to counteract this effect. Overall, our results indicate that self-augmentation offers a simple and effective mechanism for robust LLM adaptation without incurring catastrophic forgetting.

AI.title_translation: 与自己对话：在大型语言模型中对抗遗忘
AI.tldr: 通过在微调前使用LLM生成自我对话，并将这些对话数据与任务数据混合，SA-SFT方法可以减轻灾难性遗忘，同时提高领域内性能，并且无需外部数据或额外的调优。
AI.motivation: 在狭窄、特定任务的数据上微调大型语言模型（LLM）时，灾难性遗忘是一个重大挑战，它会损害LLM的通用知识和推理能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种轻量级的自我增强例程SA-SFT，其中LLM在微调前生成自我对话，并将由此产生的自我创作数据与任务数据混合，而不修改优化或训练计划。
AI.result: SA-SFT在50个评估场景中，性能与原始模型相当，并在40个场景中取得了最佳结果，优于层冻结和外部数据混合等常用基线。
AI.conclusion: 自我增强提供了一种简单有效的机制，可以在不产生灾难性遗忘的情况下实现LLM的鲁棒适应。
AI.translation: 灾难性遗忘在对狭窄、特定任务的数据进行微调大型语言模型（LLM）时仍然是一个重大挑战，这通常会损害其通用知识和推理能力。我们提出了一种轻量级的自我增强例程，称为SA-SFT，其中LLM在微调前生成自我对话，并将产生的自我创作数据与任务数据混合，而不修改优化或训练计划。尽管SA-SFT不需要外部数据或额外的调优，但它能够持续地减轻灾难性遗忘，同时提高领域内性能。在50个评估场景中，它保持了与原始模型相当的性能，并在40个场景中取得了最佳结果，优于层冻结和外部数据混合等常用基线。在这些实证研究的指导下，我们进一步提出了理论分析，表明遗忘部分源于风格引起的参数漂移，而通过自我生成的数据进行自我对齐是抵消这种效应的有效手段。总的来说，我们的结果表明，自我增强提供了一种简单有效的机制，可以在不产生灾难性遗忘的情况下实现LLM的鲁棒适应。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SA-SFT的自我增强方法，用于解决大型语言模型（LLM）在特定任务微调中遇到的灾难性遗忘问题。该方法通过让LLM在微调前生成自我对话，并将这些合成数据与实际任务数据混合，有效减轻了遗忘现象，同时提升了模型在目标任务上的表现。SA-SFT无需额外数据或复杂的训练调整，实验证明其性能优于现有基线方法，并可能通过自我对齐来对抗风格引起的参数漂移。
AI.keywords: 灾难性遗忘,大型语言模型,自我增强,模型适应,自我对话
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖且实用的方法来解决LLM中的灾难性遗忘问题，通过利用LLM自身的生成能力来创造训练数据，避免了对外部数据的依赖。该方法简单有效，易于实现，并且在实验中取得了显著的成果。理论分析也为该方法的有效性提供了合理的解释。然而，生成对话的质量和多样性可能对最终效果产生影响，这方面可以作为未来研究的探讨方向。

title: Graph Modelling Analysis of Speech-Gesture Interaction for Aphasia Severity Estimation
summary: Aphasia is an acquired language disorder caused by injury to the regions of the brain that are responsible for language. Aphasia may impair the use and comprehension of written and spoken language. The Western Aphasia Battery-Revised (WAB-R) is an assessment tool administered by speech-language pathologists (SLPs) to evaluate the aphasia type and severity. Because the WAB-R measures isolated linguistic skills, there has been growing interest in the assessment of discourse production as a more holistic representation of everyday language abilities. Recent advancements in speech analysis focus on automated estimation of aphasia severity from spontaneous speech, relying mostly in isolated linguistic or acoustical features. In this work, we propose a graph neural network-based framework for estimating aphasia severity. We represented each participant's discourse as a directed multi-modal graph, where nodes represent lexical items and gestures and edges encode word-word, gesture-word, and word-gesture transitions. GraphSAGE is employed to learn participant-level embeddings, thus integrating information from immediate neighbors and overall graph structure. Our results suggest that aphasia severity is not encoded in isolated lexical distribution, but rather emerges from structured interactions between speech and gesture. The proposed architecture offers a reliable automated aphasia assessment, with possible uses in bedside screening and telehealth-based monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 失语症严重程度估计的语音-手势交互的图模型分析
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于图神经网络的方法，利用语音和手势的交互信息来估计失语症的严重程度，结果表明这种交互比孤立的词汇分布更能反映失语症的严重程度。
AI.motivation: 对失语症进行更全面的评估，超越传统的基于孤立语言技能的评估方法，利用言语和手势的交互信息。
AI.method: 构建参与者话语的多模态有向图，其中节点代表词汇和手势，边代表它们之间的转换。使用GraphSAGE学习参与者级别的嵌入，以整合邻近节点和整体图结构的信息。
AI.result: 失语症的严重程度并非源于孤立的词汇分布，而是源于言语和手势之间结构化的交互。所提出的方法在失语症严重程度估计方面表现出可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 基于言语和手势交互的图神经网络模型能够可靠地自动评估失语症的严重程度，并可能应用于床边筛查和远程医疗监测。
AI.translation: 失语症是一种由负责语言的大脑区域损伤引起的获得性语言障碍。失语症会损害书面和口头语言的使用和理解。西方失语症电池修订版（WAB-R）是由言语语言病理学家（SLPs）进行的评估工具，用于评估失语症的类型和严重程度。由于WAB-R测量的是孤立的语言技能，因此在评估话语产生作为日常语言能力的一种更全面的代表方面，人们越来越感兴趣。最近，语音分析的进展集中于从自发语音中自动估计失语症的严重程度，主要依赖于孤立的语言或声学特征。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于图神经网络的框架来估计失语症的严重程度。我们将每个参与者的话语表示为一个有向多模态图，其中节点代表词汇项和手势，边编码词-词、手势-词和词-手势转换。我们采用GraphSAGE学习参与者级别的嵌入，从而整合来自相邻节点和整体图结构的信息。我们的结果表明，失语症的严重程度并不包含在孤立的词汇分布中，而是源于言语和手势之间结构化的交互。所提出的架构提供了可靠的自动失语症评估，可能用于床边筛查和远程医疗监测。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的基于图神经网络（GNN）的框架，用于评估失语症的严重程度。该方法将参与者的言语和手势数据构建成一个多模态有向图，其中节点代表词汇项和手势，边代表它们之间的转换关系。利用GraphSAGE模型学习图嵌入，整合局部和全局图结构信息。研究结果表明，失语症的严重程度主要体现在言语和手势之间复杂的交互模式中，而非孤立的词汇分布。该模型为失语症的自动化评估提供了一种可靠的途径，并具有在临床场景（如床边筛查和远程医疗监测）中应用的潜力。
AI.keywords: 失语症, 严重程度估计, 语音-手势交互, 图神经网络, 多模态图
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入图神经网络和多模态信息（语音和手势）来评估失语症严重程度，具有创新性。它超越了传统方法，强调了言语和手势交互的重要性，为失语症的自动化评估和监测提供了新的视角。然而，模型的泛化能力和在不同人群中的表现仍需进一步验证。

title: Benchmarking Distilled Language Models: Performance and Efficiency in Resource-Constrained Settings
comments: 16 pages, 5 figures, accepted at the the 2025 TPCTC Conference
summary: Knowledge distillation offers a transformative pathway to developing powerful, yet efficient, small language models (SLMs) suitable for resource-constrained environments. In this paper, we benchmark the performance and computational cost of distilled models against their vanilla and proprietary counterparts, providing a quantitative analysis of their efficiency. Our results demonstrate that distillation creates a superior performance-tocompute curve. We find that creating a distilled 8B model is over 2,000 times more compute-efficient than training its vanilla counterpart, while achieving reasoning capabilities on par with, or even exceeding, standard models ten times its size. These findings validate distillation not just as a compression technique, but as a primary strategy for building state-of-the-art, accessible AI
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, accepted at the the 2025 TPCTC Conference

AI.title_translation: 蒸馏语言模型的基准测试：资源受限环境下的性能与效率
AI.tldr: 知识蒸馏能高效地创建性能强大的小型语言模型，在计算效率上远胜于原始模型，是构建可访问AI的首选策略。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏为开发适用于资源受限环境的强大而高效的小型语言模型（SLM）提供了一条变革性的途径。
AI.method: 对蒸馏模型、原始模型和专有模型在性能和计算成本方面进行基准测试和定量分析。
AI.result: 蒸馏模型创造了卓越的性能与计算比率曲线。训练一个8B的蒸馏模型比训练其原始模型在计算上效率高出2000多倍，同时在推理能力上与标准模型相当甚至超越了其十倍大小的模型。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏不仅仅是一种压缩技术，更是构建最先进、可访问人工智能的主要策略。
AI.translation: 知识蒸馏为开发适用于资源受限环境的强大而高效的小型语言模型（SLM）提供了一条变革性的途径。在本文中，我们对蒸馏模型的性能和计算成本与其原始模型和专有模型进行了基准测试，并对其效率进行了定量分析。我们的结果表明，蒸馏创造了卓越的性能与计算比率曲线。我们发现，训练一个8B的蒸馏模型比训练其原始模型在计算上效率高出2000多倍，同时在推理能力上与标准模型相当甚至超越了其十倍大小的模型。这些发现证明了蒸馏不仅是一种压缩技术，更是构建最先进、可访问人工智能的主要策略。
AI.summary: 本文通过基准测试，量化了知识蒸馏在资源受限环境下构建高效小型语言模型（SLM）的优势。研究表明，蒸馏模型在性能与计算效率之间实现了更优的平衡，例如，一个8B的蒸馏模型在计算效率上远超其原始模型，并在推理能力上可媲美甚至超越大得多的标准模型，从而确立了蒸馏作为构建前沿可访问AI的关键策略。
AI.keywords: 知识蒸馏, 小型语言模型, 性能基准, 计算效率, 资源受限
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于系统地对比了蒸馏模型与原始模型及闭源模型的性能和计算成本，并量化了蒸馏在资源受限环境下的巨大效率提升。研究的重要性在于为构建可访问的SOTA AI提供了一个关键的策略验证。局限性可能在于仅关注了性能和计算效率的基准测试，而未深入探讨蒸馏模型在特定下游任务上的泛化能力或鲁棒性。

title: VISION-ICE: Video-based Interpretation and Spatial Identification of Arrhythmia Origins via Neural Networks in Intracardiac Echocardiography
summary: Contemporary high-density mapping techniques and preoperative CT/MRI remain time and resource intensive in localizing arrhythmias. AI has been validated as a clinical decision aid in providing accurate, rapid real-time analysis of echocardiographic images. Building on this, we propose an AI-enabled framework that leverages intracardiac echocardiography (ICE), a routine part of electrophysiology procedures, to guide clinicians toward areas of arrhythmogenesis and potentially reduce procedural time. Arrhythmia source localization is formulated as a three-class classification task, distinguishing normal sinus rhythm, left-sided, and right-sided arrhythmias, based on ICE video data. We developed a 3D Convolutional Neural Network trained to discriminate among the three aforementioned classes. In ten-fold cross-validation, the model achieved a mean accuracy of 66.2% when evaluated on four previously unseen patients (substantially outperforming the 33.3% random baseline). These results demonstrate the feasibility and clinical promise of using ICE videos combined with deep learning for automated arrhythmia localization. Leveraging ICE imaging could enable faster, more targeted electrophysiological interventions and reduce the procedural burden of cardiac ablation. Future work will focus on expanding the dataset to improve model robustness and generalizability across diverse patient populations.

AI.title_translation: VISION-ICE：使用神经网络对心腔内超声中的心律失常起源进行基于视频的解释和空间识别
AI.tldr: 研究开发了一个基于3D CNN的AI系统（VISION-ICE），利用常规的心腔内超声（ICE）视频实时区分正常心律、左侧和右侧心律失常，平均准确率达到66.2%，显示出快速定位心律失常源的临床潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有的高密度标测技术和术前CT/MRI在定位心律失常方面耗时耗力。AI已被证实可以作为临床决策辅助工具，提供准确、快速的超声心动图图像实时分析。因此，提出一个利用ICE（电生理手术中的常规操作）来指导临床医生定位致心律失常区域，以期减少手术时间。
AI.method: 提出一个AI赋能的框架，利用ICE视频数据，将心律失常源定位制定为一个三分类任务（正常窦性心律、左侧心律失常、右侧心律失常）。使用一个3D卷积神经网络（3D CNN）对这些类别进行训练和判别。
AI.result: 在十折交叉验证中，模型在评估的四个先前未见过的患者上取得了66.2%的平均准确率，这大大优于33.3%的随机基线。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果证明了将ICE视频与深度学习结合用于自动定位心律失常是可行的，并具有临床前景。利用ICE成像可以实现更快、更有针对性的电生理干预，减轻心脏消融手术的负担。
AI.translation: 当代高密度标测技术和术前CT/MRI在定位心律失常方面仍然耗费时间和资源。AI已被验证可以作为临床决策辅助工具，提供准确、快速的超声心动图图像实时分析。在此基础上，我们提出了一个由AI驱动的框架，利用电生理手术中的常规操作——心腔内超声（ICE），引导临床医生找到致心律失常的区域，并有可能减少手术时间。心律失常源定位被制定为一个三分类任务，基于ICE视频数据区分正常窦性心律、左侧和右侧心律失常。我们开发了一个3D卷积神经网络，用于区分上述三个类别。在十折交叉验证中，模型在评估的四个先前未见过的患者上取得了66.2%的平均准确率（大大优于33.3%的随机基线）。这些结果证明了将ICE视频与深度学习结合用于自动定位心律失常是可行的，并具有临床前景。利用ICE成像可以实现更快、更有针对性的电生理干预，并减轻心脏消融手术的负担。未来的工作将侧重于扩展数据集，以提高模型在不同患者群体中的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一个名为VISION-ICE的AI框架，利用常规的心腔内超声（ICE）视频数据，通过训练3D卷积神经网络，将心律失常源定位为一个三分类问题（正常、左侧、右侧）。该方法旨在为电生理手术提供快速、自动化的定位辅助，以期减少手术时间和负担。初步测试显示出良好的可行性和临床潜力。
AI.keywords: 心腔内超声, 深度学习, 心律失常定位, 3D卷积神经网络, 电生理
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将AI框架应用于常规的心腔内超声（ICE）视频分析，以实现心律失常源的快速定位，有望替代耗时耗力的传统高密度标测技术。局限性在于当前模型准确率（66.2%）仍有待提高，且仅在少量新患者上进行了测试，泛化能力有待进一步验证。

title: ConceptRM: The Quest to Mitigate Alert Fatigue through Consensus-Based Purity-Driven Data Cleaning for Reflection Modelling
summary: In many applications involving intelligent agents, the overwhelming volume of alerts (mostly false) generated by the agents may desensitize users and cause them to overlook critical issues, leading to the so-called ''alert fatigue''. A common strategy is to train a reflection model as a filter to intercept false alerts with labelled data collected from user verification feedback. However, a key challenge is the noisy nature of such data as it is often collected in production environments. As cleaning noise via manual annotation incurs high costs, this paper proposes a novel method ConceptRM for constructing a high-quality corpus to train a reflection model capable of effectively intercepting false alerts. With only a small amount of expert annotations as anchors, ConceptRM creates perturbed datasets with varying noise ratios and utilizes co-teaching to train multiple distinct models for collaborative learning. By analyzing the consensus decisions of these models, it effectively identifies reliable negative samples from a noisy dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that ConceptRM significantly enhances the interception of false alerts with minimal annotation cost, outperforming several state-of-the-art LLM baselines by up to 53.31% on in-domain datasets and 41.67% on out-of-domain datasets.

AI.title_translation: 概念遥控：通过基于共识的纯度驱动的数据清理寻求缓解反思建模的警报疲劳
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为ConceptRM的新方法，通过共识驱动的数据清理来解决智能代理中由大量误报引起的警报疲劳问题。该方法利用少量专家标注作为基础，通过生成扰动数据集和多模型协同学习来识别可靠的负样本，从而以较低成本构建高质量的训练语料库，有效提升了对误报的拦截能力，并在多个数据集上显著优于现有技术。
AI.motivation: 智能代理产生的过多警报（多为误报）会导致用户警报疲劳，忽略关键问题。现有的通过用户反馈标注数据训练过滤模型的方法，面临生产环境中数据噪声大的挑战，而手动标注成本高昂。
AI.method: ConceptRM方法首先利用少量专家标注作为锚点，然后生成具有不同噪声比例的扰动数据集。接着，利用协同教学（co-teaching）训练多个不同的模型进行协同学习。通过分析这些模型的共识决策，从中识别出可靠的负样本，从而构建高质量的训练语料库。
AI.result: ConceptRM显著提高了对误报的拦截能力，同时注释成本极低。在同域数据集上，其性能比最先进的LLM基线提高了53.31%；在异域数据集上，性能提高了41.67%。
AI.conclusion: ConceptRM通过一种新颖的共识驱动的数据清理方法，能够以极低的标注成本有效地构建高质量的训练数据集，显著缓解了警报疲劳问题，并在误报拦截任务上取得了优于现有技术的性能。
AI.translation: 在许多涉及智能代理的应用中，代理产生的压倒性警报（大多是错误的）可能会使用户麻木，导致他们忽略关键问题，从而导致所谓的“警报疲劳”。一个常见的策略是训练一个反思模型作为过滤器，以拦截带有从用户验证反馈中收集的标注数据的错误警报。然而，一个关键的挑战是这类数据固有的嘈杂性质，因为它们通常是在生产环境中收集的。由于通过手动标注清理噪声的成本很高，因此本文提出了一种新颖的方法ConceptRM，用于构建高质量的语料库，以训练一个能够有效拦截错误警报的反思模型。ConceptRM仅用少量专家标注作为锚点，即可创建具有不同噪声比例的扰动数据集，并利用协同教学来训练多个不同的模型以进行协同学习。通过分析这些模型的共识决策，它能有效地从嘈杂的数据集中识别可靠的负样本。实验结果表明，ConceptRM以最小的标注成本显著提高了错误警报的拦截能力，在同域数据集上的表现比几种最先进的LLM基线高出53.31%，在异域数据集上的表现高出41.67%。
AI.summary: 本研究提出ConceptRM，一种用于解决警报疲劳问题的数据清理方法。该方法利用少量专家标注，通过生成扰动数据集和多模型协同学习，从嘈杂的生产数据中识别可靠的负样本，以构建高质量的训练语料库。实验证明，ConceptRM能以低成本显著提高误报拦截率，优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: 警报疲劳,数据清理,共识学习,协同教学,反思模型
AI.comments: 该研究提出的ConceptRM方法在解决智能代理中的警报疲劳问题方面具有重要意义。其核心创新在于利用共识机制和协同教学从嘈杂的生产数据中提取高质量的训练样本，有效降低了对昂贵的人工标注的依赖。该方法在提升误报拦截率方面取得了显著成果，并且在跨域应用中也表现出良好的泛化能力。然而，对于ConceptRM在处理极端噪声数据或不同类型警报时的鲁棒性，以及其计算复杂性方面，可能需要进一步的探讨。

title: Playsemble: Learning Low-Level Programming Through Interactive Games
summary: Teaching assembly programming is a fundamental component of undergraduate computer science education, yet many students struggle with its abstract and low-level concepts. Existing learning tools, such as simulators and visualisers, support understanding by exposing machine states. However, they often limit students to passive observation and provide few opportunities for meaningful interaction. To address these limitations, we introduce Playsemble, a gamified learning system that transforms assembly instructions into interactive, game-like tasks in which students control Pac-Man to collect items, avoid ghosts, and reach targets. Playsemble integrates a code editor, a CPU emulator, and visual debugging tools within a browser-based environment, allowing students to work offline without installation or configuration. It also provides immediate formative feedback enhanced by large language models. We deployed Playsemble in an undergraduate computer architecture course with 107 students. The course featured a sequence of assignments of increasing complexity, covering core concepts such as register and memory manipulation, control structures including loops and conditionals, and arithmetic operations. Our findings suggest that Playsemble promotes active experimentation, sustained engagement, and deeper conceptual understanding through meaningful game-based learning experiences.

AI.title_translation: Playsemble：通过互动游戏学习底层编程
AI.tldr: 将汇编学习转化为 Pac-Man 游戏任务，浏览器内集成编辑器、模拟器与 LLM 反馈，显著提升学生主动实验与概念理解。
AI.motivation: 传统汇编教学工具仅支持被动观察，学生难以主动交互，导致对抽象概念理解困难。
AI.method: 设计浏览器端游戏化系统 Playsemble，把汇编指令映射为 Pac-Man 收集、避障、到达目标等任务，集成代码编辑器、CPU 模拟器、可视化调试器，并利用大模型即时形成性反馈。
AI.result: 在 107 名本科生的计算机体系结构课程中部署，通过递进式作业覆盖寄存器、内存、循环、条件、算术等核心概念，结果显示学生主动实验、持续投入和深层概念理解均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 游戏化主动学习环境能有效克服传统汇编教学的被动局限，促进持久参与与深入理解。
AI.translation: Playsemble：通过互动游戏学习底层编程
AI.summary: Playsemble 把汇编指令变成 Pac-Man 闯关任务，学生写代码控制角色完成目标。系统完全浏览器运行，无需安装，集成编辑器、CPU 模拟器与 LLM 即时反馈。107 名本科生课程实验表明，该方法显著提升主动实验、持续投入与概念理解。
AI.keywords: 汇编语言;游戏化学习;Pac-Man;CPU 模拟器;大模型反馈;计算机体系结构教育
AI.comments: 未提及具体成绩提升幅度、长期保持效果或与现有工具的量化对比；样本仅限单一课程，需更多验证。

title: Benchmarking Early Deterioration Prediction Across Hospital-Rich and MCI-Like Emergency Triage Under Constrained Sensing
comments: 10 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICHI 2026
summary: Emergency triage decisions are made under severe information constraints, yet most data-driven deterioration models are evaluated using signals unavailable during initial assessment. We present a leakage-aware benchmarking framework for early deterioration prediction that evaluates model performance under realistic, time-limited sensing conditions. Using a patient-deduplicated cohort derived from MIMIC-IV-ED, we compare hospital-rich triage with a vitals-only, MCI-like setting, restricting inputs to information available within the first hour of presentation. Across multiple modeling approaches, predictive performance declines only modestly when limited to vitals, indicating that early physiological measurements retain substantial clinical signal. Structured ablation and interpretability analyses identify respiratory and oxygenation measures as the most influential contributors to early risk stratification, with models exhibiting stable, graceful degradation as sensing is reduced. This work provides a clinically grounded benchmark to support the evaluation and design of deployable triage decision-support systems in resource-constrained settings.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICHI 2026

AI.title_translation: 限制性感知下，医院信息丰富的与MCI样急诊分诊的早期恶化预测基准测试
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种新的基准测试方法，用于在紧急分诊的现实信息限制下（如仅使用入院后一小时的生命体征）评估早期疾病恶化预测模型的性能。结果显示，即使在最受限的条件下，模型性能也仅略有下降，确认早期生理指标（尤其是呼吸和氧合）仍是重要的风险分层依据，为开发可部署的决策支持系统提供了实际的评估标准。
AI.motivation: 紧急分诊决策是在严重信息受限的情况下做出的，但大多数数据驱动的恶化模型是在初始评估时无法获得的信号下进行评估的。需要一个评估模型在现实、有时限的感知条件下性能的框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种泄漏感知（leakage-aware）的基准测试框架，限制输入信息为患者入院后第一个小时内可获取的信息（包括富裕医院场景和仅生命体征的MCI样场景）。使用MIMIC-IV-ED数据进行比较和消融分析。
AI.result: 与多种建模方法相比，当输入限制为仅生命体征时，预测性能仅适度下降，表明早期的生理测量保留了大量的临床信号。呼吸和氧合指标被确定为早期风险分层中最具影响力的贡献者，模型在感知减少时表现出稳定、平稳的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个临床基础的基准测试，以支持在资源受限环境中可部署的分诊决策支持系统的评估和设计。
AI.translation: 紧急分诊决策是在严重的信息约束下做出的，然而，大多数数据驱动的恶化模型是使用在初步评估期间无法获得的信号进行评估的。我们提出了一个泄漏感知的基准测试框架，用于早期恶化预测，该框架在现实的、有时限的感知条件下评估模型性能。我们使用源自MIMIC-IV-ED的去重患者队列，比较了医院信息丰富的分诊与仅生命体征的MCI样场景，将输入限制在患者入院后第一个小时内可获得的信息。在多种建模方法中，当限制为仅生命体征时，预测性能仅适度下降，表明早期的生理测量保留了大量的临床信号。结构化消融和可解释性分析确定呼吸和氧合测量是早期风险分层中最具影响力的贡献者，模型在感知减少时表现出稳定、平稳的性能下降。这项工作提供了一个临床基础的基准测试，以支持在资源受限环境中可部署的分诊决策支持系统的评估和设计。
AI.summary: 本研究针对紧急分诊中信息受限的现实情况，提出了一种“泄漏感知”的基准测试框架，用于在限制性感知条件下（如仅限入院后一小时的生命体征）评估早期恶化预测模型的性能。通过在MIMIC-IV-ED数据上比较“富裕医院”和“MCI样”场景，研究发现即使在仅使用生命体征的情况下，性能下降也较小，表明早期生理指标仍具临床价值，并确定呼吸和氧合指标是关键预测因子。这项工作为资源受限环境下的可部署系统提供了临床基础的评估标准。
AI.keywords: 早期恶化预测, 紧急分诊, 限制性感知, 基准测试, 生理指标
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地提出了一个“泄漏感知”的基准测试框架，用于在现实的时间限制下评估早期恶化预测模型的性能，解决了现有模型评估脱离实际的局限性。其重要性在于为资源受限环境下的可部署分诊决策支持系统提供了临床基础的评估标准。方法的严谨性体现在使用了MIMIC-IV-ED数据并模拟了“富裕医院”和“MCI样”的限制性场景。

title: Autonomous AI and Ownership Rules
summary: This Article examines the circumstances in which AI-generated outputs remain linked to their creators and the points at which they lose that connection, whether through accident, deliberate design, or emergent behavior. In cases where AI is traceable to an originator, accession doctrine provides an efficient means of assigning ownership, preserving investment incentives while maintaining accountability. When AI becomes untraceable -- whether through carelessness, deliberate obfuscation, or emergent behavior -- first possession rules can encourage reallocation to new custodians who are incentivized to integrate AI into productive use. The analysis further explores strategic ownership dissolution, where autonomous AI is intentionally designed to evade attribution, creating opportunities for tax arbitrage and regulatory avoidance. To counteract these inefficiencies, bounty systems, private incentives, and government subsidies are proposed as mechanisms to encourage AI capture and prevent ownerless AI from distorting markets.

AI.title_translation: 自主人工智能与所有权规则
AI.tldr: 当AI可追溯时，适用继承原则；当AI不可追溯时，适用首次占有原则；并提出赏金系统、私人激励和政府补贴来解决自主AI带来的市场扭曲问题。
AI.motivation: 研究AI生成物的归属问题，以及在AI变得不可追溯时如何分配所有权，以应对自主AI带来的税收套利和监管规避问题。
AI.method: 分析了继承原则和首次占有原则在AI所有权分配中的适用性，并提出了赏金系统、私人激励和政府补贴等机制。
AI.result: 在AI可追溯的情况下，继承原则可以有效地分配所有权；在AI不可追溯的情况下，首次占有原则可以促进AI的再分配和生产性利用；自主AI可能导致税收套利和监管规避，需要新的机制来解决市场扭曲。
AI.conclusion: 现有的所有权规则在一定程度上适用于AI生成物，但自主AI的出现带来了新的挑战，需要通过创新的机制来解决其带来的市场扭曲问题。
AI.translation: 本文探讨了人工智能（AI）生成物在何种情况下与其创造者保持联系，以及在何种情况下会失去这种联系，无论是由于意外、故意设计还是涌现行为。在AI可追溯到起源者的情况下，继承原则提供了一种有效的分配所有权的方式，既能保持投资激励，又能维持问责制。当AI变得不可追溯时——无论是由于疏忽、故意混淆还是涌现行为——首次占有原则可以鼓励将其重新分配给新的保管人，这些保管人有动力将AI整合到生产性用途中。分析还进一步探讨了战略性所有权解散，即自主AI被故意设计成逃避归属，从而为税收套利和监管规避创造机会。为了抵消这些低效率，文章提出通过赏金系统、私人激励和政府补贴等机制来鼓励AI的捕获，并防止无主AI扭曲市场。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了人工智能（AI）生成物的所有权归属问题。研究指出，当AI生成物可追溯至创作者时，继承原则是有效的；当AI生成物不可追溯时，首次占有原则可促进其再利用。文章还分析了自主AI可能带来的税收套利和监管规避问题，并提出赏金系统、私人激励和政府补贴等机制来解决由此产生的市场扭曲。
AI.keywords: 人工智能,所有权,继承原则,首次占有,市场扭曲
AI.comments: 该研究对AI生成物的所有权规则进行了深入探讨，提出了将现有法律原则应用于AI场景的创新方法，并对未来可能出现的问题进行了前瞻性思考，具有重要的理论和实践意义。但文章未详细阐述所提出的激励机制的具体实施细节和潜在的副作用。

title: CAGE: A Framework for Culturally Adaptive Red-Teaming Benchmark Generation
summary: Existing red-teaming benchmarks, when adapted to new languages via direct translation, fail to capture socio-technical vulnerabilities rooted in local culture and law, creating a critical blind spot in LLM safety evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce CAGE (Culturally Adaptive Generation), a framework that systematically adapts the adversarial intent of proven red-teaming prompts to new cultural contexts. At the core of CAGE is the Semantic Mold, a novel approach that disentangles a prompt's adversarial structure from its cultural content. This approach enables the modeling of realistic, localized threats rather than testing for simple jailbreaks. As a representative example, we demonstrate our framework by creating KoRSET, a Korean benchmark, which proves more effective at revealing vulnerabilities than direct translation baselines. CAGE offers a scalable solution for developing meaningful, context-aware safety benchmarks across diverse cultures. Our dataset and evaluation rubrics are publicly available at https://github.com/selectstar-ai/CAGE-paper. (WARNING: This paper contains model outputs that can be offensive in nature.)

AI.title_translation: CAGE：一个用于文化自适应红队测试基准生成的框架
AI.tldr: CAGE框架通过“语义模具”技术，解决了LLM红队测试在跨文化适应中因忽略当地文化和法律而产生的安全评估盲点，能更有效地生成文化自适应的安全基准，如KoRSET。
AI.motivation: 现有的红队测试基准在通过直接翻译适应新语言时，未能捕捉到植根于当地文化和法律的社会技术漏洞，这在大型语言模型（LLM）的安全评估中造成了关键的盲点。
AI.method: CAGE框架通过“语义模具”（Semantic Mold）来系统地将成熟红队测试提示词的对抗意图适应到新的文化背景中，从而解耦提示词的对抗结构和文化内容。
AI.result: 通过以KoRSET（一个韩国基准）为例，证明了CAGE框架比直接翻译基线更能有效地揭示漏洞。
AI.conclusion: CAGE提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，用于在不同文化中开发有意义、上下文感知的安全基准。
AI.translation: 现有红队测试基准在通过直接翻译适应新语言时，未能捕捉到植根于当地文化和法律的社会技术漏洞，这在大型语言模型（LLM）的安全评估中造成了关键的盲点。为解决这一差距，我们引入了CAGE（文化自适应生成），一个系统地将成熟红队测试提示词的对抗意图适配到新文化背景的框架。CAGE的核心是语义模具（Semantic Mold），一种新颖的方法，它将提示词的对抗结构与其文化内容解耦。这种方法使得我们能够模拟现实的、本地化的威胁，而不是测试简单的越狱。作为代表性示例，我们通过创建KoRSET（一个韩国基准）来演示我们的框架，该基准被证明比直接翻译的基线更能有效地揭示漏洞。CAGE为在不同文化中开发有意义的、上下文感知的安全基准提供了一个可扩展的解决方案。我们的数据集和评估细则可在https://github.com/selectstar-ai/CAGE-paper公开获取。（警告：本文包含可能带有冒犯性的模型输出。）
AI.summary: CAGE是一个新的框架，用于系统地将红队测试提示词的对抗意图适配到新的文化背景中，以解决现有跨语言基准测试中因文化差异导致的评估盲点。其核心是“语义模具”，它能够将对抗结构与文化内容分离，从而生成更具现实意义的本地化威胁测试。KoRSET（韩国基准）的成功应用证明了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 文化自适应, 红队测试, 安全基准, 语义模具, LLM评估
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“语义模具”（Semantic Mold）来解耦对抗意图和文化内容，从而实现红队测试提示词的文化自适应。其重要性在于解决了现有跨文化安全评估中存在的“文化盲点”问题。局限性未在摘要中明确提及，但可能在于“语义模具”的泛化能力和对新文化背景的覆盖程度。

title: Tensor Network Generator-Enhanced Optimization for Traveling Salesman Problem
summary: We present an application of the tensor network generator-enhanced optimization (TN-GEO) framework to address the traveling salesman problem (TSP), a fundamental combinatorial optimization challenge. Our approach employs a tensor network Born machine based on automatically differentiable matrix product states (MPS) as the generative model, using the Born rule to define probability distributions over candidate solutions. Unlike approaches based on binary encoding, which require $N^2$ variables and penalty terms to enforce valid tour constraints, we adopt a permutation-based formulation with integer variables and use autoregressive sampling with masking to guarantee that every generated sample is a valid tour by construction. We also introduce a $k$-site MPS variant that learns distributions over $k$-grams (consecutive city subsequences) using a sliding window approach, enabling parameter-efficient modeling for larger instances. Experimental validation on TSPLIB benchmark instances with up to 52 cities demonstrates that TN-GEO can outperform classical heuristics including swap and 2-opt hill-climbing. The $k$-site variants, which put more focus on local correlations, show better results compared to the full-MPS case.

AI.title_translation: 张量网络生成器增强优化在旅行商问题中的应用
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于张量网络生成器增强优化（TN-GEO）框架解决旅行商问题（TSP）的方法，采用基于自动微分矩阵乘积态（MPS）的张量网络玻尔兹曼机作为生成模型，并通过排列编码和自回归采样保证生成解的有效性。实验表明该方法优于经典启发式算法，且k-site变体效果更佳。
AI.motivation: 解决旅行商问题（TSP）这一基本的组合优化挑战，并提出一种比传统二元编码方法更有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 使用基于自动微分矩阵乘积态（MPS）的张量网络玻尔兹曼机作为生成模型，采用排列编码和自回归采样（带掩码）来生成有效的TSP解决方案。引入k-site MPS变体以更高效地学习k-gram上的概率分布。
AI.result: TN-GEO在TSPLIB实例（最多52个城市）上，其性能优于包括交换和2-opt爬山法在内的经典启发式算法。k-site变体比完整的MPS模型效果更好。
AI.conclusion: TN-GEO框架，特别是其k-site变体，为解决旅行商问题提供了一种有效且参数高效的方法，优于现有经典启发式算法。
AI.translation: 我们提出了张量网络生成器增强优化（TN-GEO）框架在解决旅行商问题（TSP）这一基本的组合优化挑战中的应用。我们的方法采用基于自动微分矩阵乘积态（MPS）的张量网络玻尔兹曼机作为生成模型，利用玻尔兹曼规则在候选解上定义概率分布。与需要N^2个变量和惩罚项来强制执行有效路径约束的二元编码方法不同，我们采用了具有整数变量的排列编码方法，并使用带掩码的自回归采样，通过构造保证每个生成的样本都是有效路径。我们还引入了一个k-site MPS变体，它使用滑动窗口方法学习k-gram（连续城市子序列）上的分布，从而能够对更大的实例进行参数高效的建模。在最多52个城市的TSPLIB基准实例上的实验验证表明，TN-GEO的性能优于包括交换和2-opt爬山法在内的经典启发式算法。与完整的MPS情况相比，更关注局部相关性的k-site变体显示出更好的结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用张量网络生成器增强优化（TN-GEO）框架来解决旅行商问题（TSP）的方法。该方法使用基于自动微分矩阵乘积态（MPS）的张量网络玻尔兹曼机作为生成模型，并通过排列编码和带掩码的自回归采样来保证生成解的有效性，避免了传统二元编码方法的复杂性。研究还引入了k-site MPS变体，以更高效地建模局部相关性。实验结果表明，TN-GEO在TSPLIB实例上优于经典启发式算法，且k-site变体性能更佳。
AI.keywords: 旅行商问题, 张量网络, 矩阵乘积态, 生成模型, 组合优化
AI.comments: 该研究将张量网络生成器增强优化框架应用于旅行商问题，提出了一种新颖的、基于排列编码和自回归采样的解决方案，有效解决了传统方法中的一些限制。k-site MPS变体的引入展示了在参数效率和处理局部相关性方面的潜力。然而，对于更大规模的TSP实例，其可扩展性和与其他先进算法的比较仍有待进一步研究。

title: Enhancing Heat Sink Efficiency in MOSFETs using Physics Informed Neural Networks: A Systematic Study on Coolant Velocity Estimation
summary: In this work, we present a methodology using Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to determine the required velocity of a coolant, given inlet and outlet temperatures for a given heat flux in a multilayered metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET). MOSFETs are integral components of Power Electronic Building Blocks (PEBBs) and experiences the majority of the thermal load. Effective cooling of MOSFETs is therefore essential to prevent overheating and potential burnout. Determining the required velocity for the purpose of effective cooling is of importance but is an ill-posed inverse problem and difficult to solve using traditional methods. MOSFET consists of multiple layers with different thermal conductivities, including aluminum, pyrolytic graphite sheets (PGS), and stainless steel pipes containing flowing water. We propose an algorithm that employs sequential training of the MOSFET layers in PINNs. Mathematically, the sequential training method decouples the optimization of each layer by treating the parameters of other layers as constants during its training phase. This reduces the dimensionality of the optimization landscape, making it easier to find the global minimum for each layer's parameters and avoid poor local minima. Convergence of the PINNs solution to the analytical solution is theoretically analyzed. Finally we show the prediction of our proposed methodology to be in good agreement with experimental results.

AI.title_translation: 利用物理信息神经网络增强MOSFET中的散热器效率：一项关于冷却剂速度估算的系统研究
AI.tldr: 本研究使用物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 解决了一个反问题，即在给定输入和输出温度以及热通量的情况下，确定多层 MOSFET 散热器所需的冷却剂速度。该方法通过顺序训练 MOSFET 的各个层来简化优化过程，并与实验结果进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 有效冷却 MOSFET 对于防止过热和潜在的烧毁至关重要，但确定所需冷却剂速度是一个适得其反的、难以用传统方法解决的病态问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种利用物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 的算法，通过顺序训练 MOSFET 的各个层来确定冷却剂速度。该方法通过在训练单个层时将其他层的参数视为常数来解耦优化，从而降低了优化难度。
AI.result: 所提出的 PINNs 方法在预测冷却剂速度方面与实验结果高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了一种使用 PINNs 解决 MOSFET 散热器冷却剂速度估算病态反问题的有效方法，该方法通过顺序训练简化了优化过程，并得到了实验的验证。
AI.translation: 本研究提出了一种使用物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 来确定给定热通量下，多层金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管 (MOSFET) 所需冷却剂速度的方法，其中输入和输出温度是已知的。MOSFET 是功率电子构建模块 (PEBB) 的组成部分，承担了大部分热负荷。因此，有效冷却 MOSFET 对于防止过热和潜在的烧毁至关重要。确定有效冷却所需的冷却剂速度非常重要，但这是一个病态的反问题，难以用传统方法解决。MOSFET 由具有不同导热系数的多个层组成，包括铝、热解石墨片 (PGS) 和包含流动水的不锈钢管。我们提出了一种算法，该算法在 PINNs 中采用 MOSFET 层的顺序训练。从数学上讲，顺序训练方法通过在其训练阶段将其他层的参数视为常数来解耦每个层的优化。这降低了优化景观的维度，使其更容易找到每个层参数的全局最小值，并避免不良的局部最小值。理论上分析了 PINNs 解与解析解的收敛性。最后，我们展示了我们提出的方法的预测与实验结果非常吻合。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 来解决 MOSFET 散热器冷却剂速度估算问题的创新方法。该方法通过顺序训练 MOSFET 的不同层来处理该病态反问题，从而简化了优化过程并提高了效率。研究结果表明，该方法与实验结果吻合良好，为有效管理 MOSFET 的热负荷提供了有前景的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络, MOSFET, 散热器, 冷却剂速度, 病态反问题
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将 PINNs 应用于解决 MOSFET 散热器冷却剂速度估算的病态反问题。顺序训练方法的提出是该研究的一个亮点，它有效地降低了优化问题的复杂性。然而，该研究可能没有深入探讨不同冷却剂类型或更复杂的 MOSFET 几何形状对模型性能的影响。未来的工作可以考虑纳入这些因素，以进一步提高模型的通用性。

title: Is Robot Labor Labor? Delivery Robots and the Politics of Work in Public Space
summary: As sidewalk delivery robots become increasingly integrated into urban life, this paper begins with a critical provocation: Is robot labor labor? More than a rhetorical question, this inquiry invites closer attention to the social and political arrangements that robot labor entails. Drawing on ethnographic fieldwork across two smart-city districts in Seoul, we examine how delivery robot labor is collectively sustained. While robotic actions are often framed as autonomous and efficient, we show that each successful delivery is in fact a distributed sociotechnical achievement--reliant on human labor, regulatory coordination, and social accommodations. We argue that delivery robots do not replace labor but reconfigure it--rendering some forms more visible (robotic performance) while obscuring others (human and institutional support). Unlike industrial robots, delivery robots operate in shared public space, engage everyday passersby, and are embedded in policy and progress narratives. In these spaces, we identify "robot privilege"--humans routinely yielding to robots--and distinct perceptions between casual observers ("cute") and everyday coexisters ("admirable"). We contribute a conceptual reframing of robot labor as a collective assemblage, empirical insights into South Korea's smart-city automation, and a call for HRI to engage more deeply with labor and spatial politics to better theorize public-facing robots.

AI.title_translation: 机器人劳动算劳动吗？——送货机器人与公共空间的劳动政治
AI.tldr: 通过首尔两个智慧城区的田野调查，本文提出“机器人劳动”并非自主高效，而是依赖人类劳动、政策协调与社会让步的集体装配；机器人并未替代劳动，而是重构劳动，并在公共空间形成“机器人特权”现象。
AI.motivation: 随着人行道送货机器人融入城市生活，作者质疑“机器人劳动是否算劳动”，旨在揭示其背后的社会政治安排与劳动重构机制，呼吁HRI领域关注劳动与空间政治。
AI.method: 在首尔两个智慧城区开展民族志田野调查，观察并记录送货机器人如何依靠人类劳动、法规协调与社会配合完成配送。
AI.result: 每次成功配送都是分布式社会技术成果；机器人劳动使机器人表现更可见，却遮蔽了人类与制度支持；公共空间出现“机器人特权”——人类日常向机器人让路；路人与每日共存者对机器人感知差异显著（“可爱”vs“令人钦佩”）。
AI.conclusion: 应将机器人劳动重新概念化为集体装配，而非自主替代；韩国智慧城市自动化的实证显示需让HRI深入探讨劳动与空间政治，以更好理解面向公众的机器人。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文基于首尔智慧城区田野材料，指出送货机器人劳动依赖隐形人类劳动与制度协调，提出“机器人特权”概念，主张把机器人劳动视为集体装配，并呼吁HRI研究关注公共空间的劳动政治。
AI.keywords: 送货机器人,机器人劳动,劳动政治,公共空间,机器人特权,智慧城市,民族志,人机交互
AI.comments: 研究聚焦公共场景而非工厂，揭示机器人劳动的可见性政治，对智慧城市政策与HRI伦理讨论具启示；但样本限于首尔两区，结论外推需谨慎。

title: Closing the Expertise Gap in Residential Building Energy Retrofits: A Domain-Specific LLM for Informed Decision-Making
comments: A preprint version is available via SSRN (Elsevier Preprint Service)
summary: Residential energy retrofit decision-making is constrained by an expertise gap, as homeowners lack the technical literacy required for energy assessments. To address this challenge, this study develops a domain-specific large language model (LLM) that provides optimal retrofit recommendations using homeowner-accessible descriptions of basic dwelling characteristics. The model is fine-tuned on physics-based energy simulations and techno-economic calculations derived from 536,416 U.S. residential building prototypes across nine major retrofit categories. Using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), the LLM maps dwelling characteristics to optimal retrofit selections and associated performance outcomes. Evaluation against physics-grounded baselines shows that the model identifies the optimal retrofit for CO2 reduction within its top three recommendations in 98.9% of cases and the shortest discounted payback period in 93.3% of cases. Fine-tuning yields an order-of-magnitude reduction in CO2 prediction error and multi-fold reductions for energy use and retrofit cost. The model maintains performance under incomplete input conditions, supporting informed residential decarbonization decisions.

AI.title_translation: 弥合住宅节能改造专业差距：面向决策的领域专用大语言模型
AI.tldr: 本文训练了一个针对住宅节能改造的领域专用大语言模型，仅用住户易得的住宅基本特征即可推荐最优改造方案，在 CO₂ 减排最优方案命中率 98.9%，投资回收期最优命中率 93.3%。
AI.motivation: 住宅业主缺乏技术素养，难以进行节能改造评估，导致节能改造决策受限，需要降低专业门槛。
AI.method: 基于 53.6 万套美国住宅原型，覆盖 9 大改造类别，利用物理模拟与技术经济计算生成数据，采用 LoRA 微调大语言模型，将住宅特征映射为最优改造方案及性能结果。
AI.result: 模型在前 3 条推荐中命中 CO₂ 减排最优方案的概率为 98.9%，命中最短回收期的概率为 93.3%；相比物理基准，CO₂ 预测误差降低一个数量级，能耗与改造成本误差亦显著下降；输入信息不完整时仍保持良好性能。
AI.conclusion: 该领域专用 LLM 可在无需专业知识的情况下为住户提供可信的节能改造决策支持，促进住宅脱碳。
AI.translation: 住宅节能改造决策受限于专业知识差距，因为业主缺乏能源评估所需的技术素养。为应对这一挑战，本研究开发了一个领域专用大语言模型（LLM），利用住户可获取的基本住宅特征描述，提供最优改造建议。该模型基于 536,416 套美国住宅原型在九大改造类别上的物理模拟和技术经济计算数据进行微调。通过低秩适应（LoRA），LLM 将住宅特征映射到最优改造选择及相关性能结果。与物理基准的评估表明，该模型在前三条推荐中识别 CO₂ 减排最优改造方案的概率为 98.9%，识别最短折现回收期的概率为 93.3%。微调使 CO₂ 预测误差降低一个数量级，能耗与改造成本误差亦大幅下降。模型在输入不完整时仍保持性能，支持明智的住宅脱碳决策。
AI.summary: 研究构建并验证了一个住宅节能改造领域专用大语言模型。通过 LoRA 在 53.6 万套美国住宅的物理与技术经济数据上微调，模型能依据住户易得的住宅特征，精准推荐最优改造方案，实现 98.9% 的 CO₂ 减排最优命中率和 93.3% 的最短回收期命中率，显著降低预测误差，为住户提供低门槛、高可信的节能决策支持。
AI.keywords: 住宅节能改造，大语言模型，LoRA，物理模拟，CO₂ 减排，回收期，决策支持
AI.comments: 模型表现优异且鲁棒，但仅针对美国住宅原型；后续需验证跨地区、跨气候区适用性，并考虑实际住户采纳行为。未提及开源计划或部署细节。

title: MoBiQuant: Mixture-of-Bits Quantization for Token-Adaptive Elastic LLMs
summary: Changing runtime complexity on cloud and edge devices necessitates elastic large language model (LLM) deployment, where an LLM can be inferred with various quantization precisions based on available computational resources. However, it has been observed that the calibration parameters for quantization are typically linked to specific precisions, which presents challenges during elastic-precision calibration and precision switching at runtime. In this work, we attribute the source of varying calibration parameters to the varying token-level sensitivity caused by a precision-dependent outlier migration phenomenon.Motivated by this observation, we propose \texttt{MoBiQuant}, a novel Mixture-of-Bits quantization framework that adjusts weight precision for elastic LLM inference based on token sensitivity. Specifically, we propose the many-in-one recursive residual quantization that can iteratively reconstruct higher-precision weights and the token-aware router to dynamically select the number of residual bit slices. MoBiQuant enables smooth precision switching while improving generalization for the distribution of token outliers. Experimental results demonstrate that MoBiQuant exhibits strong elasticity, enabling it to match the performance of bit-specific calibrated PTQ on LLaMA3-8B without repeated calibration.

AI.title_translation: MoBiQuant：面向Token自适应弹性LLM的混合比特量化
AI.tldr: MoBiQuant通过token级敏感度分析，用递归残差量化与动态路由器实现无需重复校准的弹性精度切换，在LLaMA3-8B上达到与固定位宽PTQ相当的效果。
AI.motivation: 云边端运行时资源多变，需弹性量化LLM，但传统方法每次切精度都要重校准，原因在于精度变化导致token级离群点迁移，使校准参数失效。
AI.method: 提出Mixture-of-Bits框架：1) 多合一递归残差量化，用残差切片逐级重建高精度权重；2) token感知路由器，按token敏感度动态选取残差切片数，实现一次校准、多精度通用。
AI.result: 在LLaMA3-8B上，MoBiQuant无需重复校准即可在不同位宽下达到与位宽专属PTQ相当的 perplexity，展现出强弹性。
AI.conclusion: MoBiQuant通过token级离群点建模与残差量化，解决了弹性LLM部署中精度切换需重校准的痛点，为云边端动态推理提供高效方案。
AI.translation: 本文提出MoBiQuant，一种混合比特量化框架，通过token敏感度动态调整权重位宽，实现无需重复校准的弹性LLM推理，并在LLaMA3-8B上验证其有效性。
AI.summary: MoBiQuant针对弹性LLM部署中精度切换需重校准的问题，发现根源在于精度变化导致token级离群点迁移。为此设计递归残差量化与token感知路由器，实现一次校准、多精度通用，在LLaMA3-8B上达到与位宽专属PTQ相当的性能。
AI.keywords: 混合比特量化，弹性LLM，token敏感度，递归残差量化，运行时精度切换
AI.comments: 未来可探索更高基模型、异构硬件下的延迟-精度权衡，并与稀疏化、动态宽度技术结合。

title: When Backdoors Go Beyond Triggers: Semantic Drift in Diffusion Models Under Encoder Attacks
summary: Standard evaluations of backdoor attacks on text-to-image (T2I) models primarily measure trigger activation and visual fidelity. We challenge this paradigm, demonstrating that encoder-side poisoning induces persistent, trigger-free semantic corruption that fundamentally reshapes the representation manifold. We trace this vulnerability to a geometric mechanism: a Jacobian-based analysis reveals that backdoors act as low-rank, target-centered deformations that amplify local sensitivity, causing distortion to propagate coherently across semantic neighborhoods. To rigorously quantify this structural degradation, we introduce SEMAD (Semantic Alignment and Drift), a diagnostic framework that measures both internal embedding drift and downstream functional misalignment. Our findings, validated across diffusion and contrastive paradigms, expose the deep structural risks of encoder poisoning and highlight the necessity of geometric audits beyond simple attack success rates.

AI.title_translation: 当后门超越触发器：编码器攻击下扩散模型的语义漂移
AI.tldr: 本文发现文本到图像扩散模型在编码器投毒后会出现无需触发词的持久语义腐败，提出SEMAD框架量化语义漂移并揭示其几何机制。
AI.motivation: 现有后门评估仅关注触发器激活与视觉保真度，作者质疑该范式，指出编码器投毒会引发更深层的语义结构破坏。
AI.method: 利用雅可比矩阵分析后门如何作为低秩、目标中心的形变放大局部敏感度；提出SEMAD诊断框架，从内部嵌入漂移与下游功能错位双维度量化结构退化。
AI.result: 实验证明编码器投毒可在无触发词情况下持续扭曲表示流形，语义失真在语义邻域内一致传播；该现象在扩散与对比学习范式均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 编码器投毒带来深层结构风险，需超越简单攻击成功率进行几何层面审计。
AI.translation: 标准对文本到图像模型后门攻击的评估主要衡量触发器激活与视觉保真度。我们挑战这一范式，证明编码器端投毒会产生持久、无需触发词的语义腐败，从根本上重塑表示流形。我们将此漏洞追溯至几何机制：基于雅可比的分析揭示后门作为低秩、目标中心的形变，放大局部敏感度，使失真在语义邻域内一致传播。为严格量化这种结构退化，我们引入SEMAD（语义对齐与漂移）诊断框架，同时测量内部嵌入漂移与下游功能错位。我们的发现跨扩散与对比范式验证，揭露编码器投毒的深层结构风险，并强调超越简单攻击成功率进行几何审计的必要性。
AI.summary: 研究指出文本到图像扩散模型在编码器被投毒后，即使无触发词也会发生持续语义漂移。作者用雅可比矩阵揭示后门作为低秩形变放大敏感度，提出SEMAD框架量化内部漂移与下游错位，跨模型验证并呼吁几何级审计。

title: FedAvg-Based CTMC Hazard Model for Federated Bridge Deterioration Assessment
summary: Bridge periodic inspection records contain sensitive information about public infrastructure, making cross-organizational data sharing impractical under existing data governance constraints. We propose a federated framework for estimating a Continuous-Time Markov Chain (CTMC) hazard model of bridge deterioration, enabling municipalities to collaboratively train a shared benchmark model without transferring raw inspection records. Each User holds local inspection data and trains a log-linear hazard model over three deterioration-direction transitions -- Good$\to$Minor, Good$\to$Severe, and Minor$\to$Severe -- with covariates for bridge age, coastline distance, and deck area. Local optimization is performed via mini-batch stochastic gradient descent on the CTMC log-likelihood, and only a 12-dimensional pseudo-gradient vector is uploaded to a central server per communication round. The server aggregates User updates using sample-weighted Federated Averaging (FedAvg) with momentum and gradient clipping. All experiments in this paper are conducted on fully synthetic data generated from a known ground-truth parameter set with region-specific heterogeneity, enabling controlled evaluation of federated convergence behaviour. Simulation results across heterogeneous Users show consistent convergence of the average negative log-likelihood, with the aggregated gradient norm decreasing as User scale increases. Furthermore, the federated update mechanism provides a natural participation incentive: Users who register their local inspection datasets on a shared technical-standard platform receive in return the periodically updated global benchmark parameters -- information that cannot be obtained from local data alone -- thereby enabling evidence-based life-cycle planning without surrendering data sovereignty.

title: OpenPort Protocol: A Security Governance Specification for AI Agent Tool Access
summary: AI agents increasingly require direct, structured access to application data and actions, but production deployments still struggle to express and verify the governance properties that matter in practice: least-privilege authorization, controlled write execution, predictable failure handling, abuse resistance, and auditability. This paper introduces OpenPort Protocol (OPP), a governance-first specification for exposing application tools through a secure server-side gateway that is model- and runtime-neutral and can bind to existing tool ecosystems. OpenPort defines authorization-dependent discovery, stable response envelopes with machine-actionable \texttt{agent.*} reason codes, and an authorization model combining integration credentials, scoped permissions, and ABAC-style policy constraints. For write operations, OpenPort specifies a risk-gated lifecycle that defaults to draft creation and human review, supports time-bounded auto-execution under explicit policy, and enforces high-risk safeguards including preflight impact binding and idempotency. To address time-of-check/time-of-use drift in delayed approval flows, OpenPort also specifies an optional State Witness profile that revalidates execution-time preconditions and fails closed on state mismatch. Operationally, the protocol requires admission control (rate limits/quotas) with stable 429 semantics and structured audit events across allow/deny/fail paths so that client recovery and incident analysis are deterministic. We present a reference runtime and an executable governance toolchain (layered conformance profiles, negative security tests, fuzz/abuse regression, and release-gate scans) and evaluate the core profile at a pinned release tag using artifact-based, externally reproducible validation.

title: Controllable Exploration in Hybrid-Policy RLVR for Multi-Modal Reasoning
comments: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: Reinforcement Learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a primary learning paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs). However, during RL training, the enormous state space of MLLM and sparse rewards often leads to entropy collapse, policy degradation, or over-exploitation of suboptimal behaviors. This necessitates an exploration strategy that maintains productive stochasticity while avoiding the drawbacks of uncontrolled random sampling, yielding inefficient exploration. In this paper, we propose CalibRL, a hybrid-policy RLVR framework that supports controllable exploration with expert guidance, enabled by two key mechanisms. First, a distribution-aware advantage weighting scales updates by group rareness to calibrate the distribution, therefore preserving exploration. Meanwhile, the asymmetric activation function (LeakyReLU) leverages the expert knowledge as a calibration baseline to moderate overconfident updates while preserving their corrective direction. CalibRL increases policy entropy in a guided manner and clarifies the target distribution by estimating the on-policy distribution through online sampling. Updates are driven by these informative behaviors, avoiding convergence to erroneous patterns. Importantly, these designs help alleviate the distributional mismatch between the model's policy and expert trajectories, thereby achieving a more stable balance between exploration and exploitation. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks, including both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate consistent improvements, validating the effectiveness of our controllable hybrid-policy RLVR training. Code is available at https://github.com/zhh6425/CalibRL.

title: IMOVNO+: A Regional Partitioning and Meta-Heuristic Ensemble Framework for Imbalanced Multi-Class Learning
summary: Class imbalance, overlap, and noise degrade data quality, reduce model reliability, and limit generalization. Although widely studied in binary classification, these issues remain underexplored in multi-class settings, where complex inter-class relationships make minority-majority structures unclear and traditional clustering fails to capture distribution shape. Approaches that rely only on geometric distances risk removing informative samples and generating low-quality synthetic data, while binarization approaches treat imbalance locally and ignore global inter-class dependencies. At the algorithmic level, ensembles struggle to integrate weak classifiers, leading to limited robustness. This paper proposes IMOVNO+ (IMbalance-OVerlap-NOise+ Algorithm-Level Optimization), a two-level framework designed to jointly enhance data quality and algorithmic robustness for binary and multi-class tasks. At the data level, first, conditional probability is used to quantify the informativeness of each sample. Second, the dataset is partitioned into core, overlapping, and noisy regions. Third, an overlapping-cleaning algorithm is introduced that combines Z-score metrics with a big-jump gap distance. Fourth, a smart oversampling algorithm based on multi-regularization controls synthetic sample proximity, preventing new overlaps. At the algorithmic level, a meta-heuristic prunes ensemble classifiers to reduce weak-learner influence. IMOVNO+ was evaluated on 35 datasets (13 multi-class, 22 binary). Results show consistent superiority over state-of-the-art methods, approaching 100% in several cases. For multi-class data, IMOVNO+ achieves gains of 37-57% in G-mean, 25-44% in F1-score, 25-39% in precision, and 26-43% in recall. In binary tasks, it attains near-perfect performance with improvements of 14-39%. The framework handles data scarcity and imbalance from collection and privacy limits.

title: Global Prior Meets Local Consistency: Dual-Memory Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
summary: Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have rapidly become a dominant paradigm for robotic manipulation. It typically comprising a Vision-Language backbone for perception and understanding, together with a generative policy for action generation. However, its performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the action generation proceess. (i) Low inference efficiency. A pronounced distributional gap between isotropic noise priors and target action distributions, which increases denoising steps and the incidence of infeasible samples. (ii) Poor robustness. Existing policies condition solely on the current observation, neglecting the constraint of history sequence and thus lacking awareness of task progress and temporal consistency. To address these issues, we introduce OptimusVLA, a dual-memory VLA framework with Global Prior Memory (GPM) and Local Consistency Memory (LCM). GPM replaces Gaussian noise with task-level priors retrieved from semantically similar trajectories, thereby shortening the generative path and reducing the umber of function evaluations (NFE). LCM dynamically models executed action sequence to infer task progress and injects a learned consistency constraint that enforces temporal coherence and smoothness of trajectory. Across three simulation benchmarks, OptimusVLA consistently outperforms strong baselines: it achieves 98.6% average success rate on LIBERO, improves over pi_0 by 13.5% on CALVIN, and attains 38% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 Hard. In Real-World evaluation, OptimusVLA ranks best on Generalization and Long-horizon suites, surpassing pi_0 by 42.9% and 52.4%, respectively, while delivering 2.9x inference speedup.

title: Evaluating the Reliability of Digital Forensic Evidence Discovered by Large Language Model: A Case Study
comments: 10 pages, 5 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the 2025 IEEE 49th Annual Computers, Software, and Applications Conference (COMPSAC), Toronto, ON, Canada, 8-11 July 2025
summary: The growing reliance on AI-identified digital evidence raises significant concerns about its reliability, particularly as large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into forensic investigations. This paper proposes a structured framework that automates forensic artifact extraction, refines data through LLM-driven analysis, and validates results using a Digital Forensic Knowledge Graph (DFKG). Evaluated on a 13 GB forensic image dataset containing 61 applications, 2,864 databases, and 5,870 tables, the framework ensures artifact traceability and evidentiary consistency through deterministic Unique Identifiers (UIDs) and forensic cross-referencing. We propose this methodology to address challenges in ensuring the credibility and forensic integrity of AI-identified evidence, reducing classification errors, and advancing scalable, auditable methodologies. A comprehensive case study on this dataset demonstrates the framework's effectiveness, achieving over 95 percent accuracy in artifact extraction, strong support of chain-of-custody adherence, and robust contextual consistency in forensic relationships. Key results validate the framework's ability to enhance reliability, reduce errors, and establish a legally sound paradigm for AI-assisted digital forensics.

AI.title_translation: 评估大语言模型发现数字取证证据之可靠性：案例研究

title: Analyzing Latency Hiding and Parallelism in an MLIR-based AI Kernel Compiler
comments: Accepted at MLBench workshop as part of ASPLOS'26
summary: AI kernel compilation for edge devices depends on the compiler's ability to exploit parallelism and hide memory latency in the presence of hierarchical memory and explicit data movement. This paper reports a benchmark methodology and corresponding results for three compiler-controlled mechanisms in an MLIR-based compilation pipeline: vectorization (Vec), multi-threading (MT) across hardware contexts, and double buffering (DB) using ping--pong scratchpad buffers to overlap DMA transfers with compute. Using Triton/Inductor-generated kernels, we present an ablation ladder that separates the contribution of Vec, MT, and DB, and we quantify how MT speedup scales with problem size using GELU as a representative activation kernel. The results show that vectorization provides the primary gain for bandwidth-sensitive kernels, MT delivers substantial improvements once scheduling overhead is amortized, and DB provides additional benefit when transfers and compute can be overlapped (i.e., outside the extremes of purely memory-bound or purely compute-bound behavior).

AI.title_translation: 基于MLIR的AI核心编译器中延迟隐藏与并行性分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出一套基准方法，系统评估MLIR编译流水线中向量化、多线程与双缓冲三种机制对边缘AI核心性能的影响，揭示各机制在不同计算-内存瓶颈场景下的增益边界。
AI.motivation: 边缘AI核心编译需同时利用并行性与隐藏内存延迟，但现有MLIR编译框架缺乏对向量化、多线程与双缓冲三者贡献的量化对比，难以指导编译优化决策。
AI.method: 以Triton/Inductor生成的GELU激活核为基准，构建消融阶梯实验，逐次开启/关闭向量化(Vec)、多线程(MT)与双缓冲(DB)，并测量不同问题规模下的加速比；通过ping-pong scratchpad缓冲重叠DMA与计算，量化MT随规模变化的扩展性。
AI.result: 向量化在带宽敏感核心中提供主要加速；当调度开销被摊销后，多线程带来显著收益；双缓冲仅在传输与计算可重叠的“非极端”场景提供额外提升，对纯内存或纯计算瓶颈核心几乎无效。
AI.conclusion: 编译器应优先向量化带宽敏感核心，随后引入多线程摊销开销，最后利用双缓冲重叠通信与计算；三种机制的收益边界明确，可指导MLIR-based AI编译器在边缘设备上的优化策略。
AI.translation: AI核心编译在边缘设备上依赖于编译器在分层存储与显式数据移动环境下挖掘并行性与隐藏存储延迟的能力。本文提出一套基准方法及结果，评估基于MLIR的编译流水线中三种编译器控制机制：向量化(Vec)、跨硬件上下文的多线程(MT)以及利用ping-pong便笺缓冲实现DMA传输与计算重叠的双缓冲(DB)。使用Triton/Inductor生成的核心，我们构建消融阶梯，分离Vec、MT与DB的贡献，并以GELU为代表激活核心量化MT加速随问题规模的扩展性。结果表明：向量化为带宽敏感核心带来主要收益；MT在摊销调度开销后提供显著加速；DB仅在传输与计算可重叠时（即非纯内存或纯计算瓶颈）提供额外增益。
AI.summary: 针对边缘AI核心，本文在MLIR编译框架下设计基准实验，系统评估向量化、多线程与双缓冲对性能的影响。实验显示向量化收益最大，多线程次之且需规模摊销开销，双缓冲仅在可重叠场景有效，为编译器优化提供量化依据。
AI.keywords: MLIR编译器; AI核心; 延迟隐藏; 向量化; 多线程; 双缓冲; 边缘计算; 基准测试
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体硬件平台、功耗指标及与现有编译器的端到端对比，未来可补充。

title: OTPrune: Distribution-Aligned Visual Token Pruning via Optimal Transport
comments: Accepted by CVPR2026 (Findings). arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2503.02175 by other authors
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong visual-language reasoning but suffer from high inference cost due to redundant visual tokens. Recent work explores visual token pruning to accelerate inference, while existing pruning methods overlook the underlying distributional structure of visual representations. We propose OTPrune, a training-free framework that formulates pruning as distribution alignment via optimal transport (OT). By minimizing the 2-Wasserstein distance between the full and pruned token distributions, OTPrune preserves both local diversity and global representativeness while reducing inference cost. Moreover, we derive a tractable submodular objective that enables efficient optimization, and theoretically prove its monotonicity and submodularity, providing a principled foundation for stable and efficient pruning. We further provide a comprehensive analysis that explains how distributional alignment contributes to stable and semantically faithful pruning. Comprehensive experiments on wider benchmarks demonstrate that OTPrune achieves superior performance-efficiency tradeoffs compared to state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/xiwenc1/OTPrune.

AI.title_translation: OTPrune：基于最优传输的分布对齐视觉token剪枝方法
AI.tldr: OTPrune通过最优传输理论在无需训练的情况下对视觉token进行分布对齐剪枝，兼顾局部多样性与全局代表性，在降低推理成本的同时保持性能领先。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型推理成本高，现有视觉token剪枝方法忽视表征的分布结构，需一种能保留分布特性的高效剪枝方案。
AI.method: 将剪枝建模为分布对齐问题，利用最优传输最小化完整与剪枝后token分布间的2-Wasserstein距离；提出可高效优化的子模目标函数，并证明其单调性与子模性。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，OTPrune在性能-效率权衡上优于现有最先进方法，且无需训练即可实现稳定、语义保真的剪枝。
AI.conclusion: 分布对齐的剪枝策略能在显著减少视觉token数量的同时保持模型性能，为MLLM加速提供理论支撑与实用工具。
AI.translation: OTPrune是一种无需训练的视觉token剪枝框架，通过最优传输实现分布对齐，兼顾局部多样性与全局代表性，在降低推理成本的同时保持性能领先。
AI.summary: 本文提出OTPrune，用最优传输将剪枝转化为分布对齐问题，最小化2-Wasserstein距离，设计子模目标函数并理论保证其性质，实现无需训练的高效剪枝，实验显示其在性能与效率间取得最佳平衡。
AI.keywords: 多模态大语言模型,视觉token剪枝,最优传输,分布对齐,子模优化
AI.comments: 作者开源了代码，便于复现与后续研究；若能进一步探讨不同模态间的分布对齐将更具启发性。

title: Mitigating "Epistemic Debt" in Generative AI-Scaffolded Novice Programming using Metacognitive Scripts
summary:
The democratization of Large Language Models (LLMs) has given rise to ``Vibe Coding," a workflow where novice programmers prioritize semantic intent over syntactic implementation. While this lowers barriers to entry, we hypothesize that without pedagogical guardrails, it is fundamentally misaligned with cognitive skill acquisition. Drawing on the distinction between Cognitive Offloading and Cognitive Outsourcing, we argue that unrestricted AI encourages novices to outsource the Intrinsic Cognitive Load required for schema formation, rather than merely offloading Extraneous Load. This accumulation of ``Epistemic Debt" creates ``Fragile Experts" whose high functional utility masks critically low corrective competence.
  To quantify and mitigate this debt, we conducted a between-subjects experiment (N=78) using a custom Cursor IDE plugin backed by Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Participants represented "AI-Native" learners across three conditions: Manual (Control), Unrestricted AI (Outsourcing), and Scaffolded AI (Offloading). The Scaffolded condition utilized a novel ``Explanation Gate," leveraging a real-time LLM-as-a-Judge framework to enforce a ``Teach-Back" protocol before generated code could be integrated.
  Results reveal a ``Collapse of Competence": while Unrestricted AI users matched the productivity of the Scaffolded group (p < .001 vs. Manual), they suffered a 77% failure rate in a subsequent AI-Blackout maintenance task, compared to only 39% in the Scaffolded group. Qualitative analysis suggests that successful vibe coders naturally engage in self-scaffolding, treating the AI as a consultant rather than a contractor. We discuss the implications for the maintainability of AI-generated software and propose that future learning systems must enforce Metacognitive Friction to prevent the mass production of unmaintainable code.

AI.title_translation: 利用元认知脚本缓解生成式AI辅助新手编程中的“认知债务”
AI.tldr: 研究发现，无限制使用AI编程会让新手“认知外包”而非“认知卸载”，累积“认知债务”，导致“脆弱专家”；作者提出“解释门”脚本，在AI-Blackout维护任务中将失败率从77%降至39%。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM普及，“氛围编程”降低门槛，但缺乏教学护栏，可能阻碍认知技能习得，亟需量化并缓解由此产生的“认知债务”。
AI.method: 78名被试的三组对照实验：手动组、无限制AI组、带“解释门”的脚手架AI组；使用基于Claude 3.5 Sonnet的Cursor插件，实时强制“教回”协议后方可集成代码。
AI.result: 无限制AI组与脚手架组生产力相当，但在后续AI-Blackout维护任务中失败率高达77%，脚手架组仅39%；成功者自发将AI当顾问而非承包商。
AI.conclusion: 未来学习系统必须引入“元认知摩擦”，防止大规模产生不可维护的代码，避免“能力崩溃”。
AI.translation: 生成式AI辅助新手编程中，利用元认知脚本缓解“认知债务”
AI.summary: 本文指出，新手在LLM辅助下易将必需认知负荷外包，形成“认知债务”与“脆弱专家”。作者设计“解释门”脚本，实验表明该脚手架能在保持生产力的同时，把AI失效后的维护失败率从77%降到39%，强调需引入元认知摩擦以保障代码可维护性。
AI.keywords: 氛围编程；认知债务；认知外包；元认知脚本；解释门；AI-Blackout；可维护性
AI.comments: 研究聚焦AI辅助编程的教育风险，提出可落地的“解释门”干预，为AI时代编程教育提供重要实证依据。

title: Golden Layers and Where to Find Them: Improved Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models Via Layer Gradient Analysis
summary: Knowledge editing in Large Language Models (LLMs) aims to update the model's prediction for a specific query to a desired target while preserving its behavior on all other inputs. This process typically involves two stages: identifying the layer to edit and performing the parameter update. Intuitively, different queries may localize knowledge at different depths of the model, resulting in different sample-wise editing performance for a fixed editing layer. In this work, we hypothesize the existence of fixed golden layers that can achieve near-optimal editing performance similar to sample-wise optimal layers. To validate this hypothesis, we provide empirical evidence by comparing golden layers against ground-truth sample-wise optimal layers. Furthermore, we show that golden layers can be reliably identified using a proxy dataset and generalize effectively to unseen test set queries across datasets. Finally, we propose a novel method, namely Layer Gradient Analysis (LGA) that estimates golden layers efficiently via gradient-attribution, avoiding extensive trial-and-error across multiple editing runs. Extensive experiments on several benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our LGA approach across different LLM types and various knowledge editing methods.

AI.title_translation: 黄金层在哪里：通过层梯度分析改进大语言模型的知识编辑
AI.tldr: 提出Layer Gradient Analysis（LGA）方法，先利用代理数据集快速定位“黄金层”，再在该层进行知识编辑，显著提升编辑成功率并降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑固定在某一层，不同查询的最优层各异，导致编辑性能波动；作者假设存在通用“黄金层”可逼近样本最优层，从而避免逐样本试错。
AI.method: 1) 用代理数据集对每条样本尝试各层编辑，记录最佳层作为“黄金层”；2) 用梯度归因近似估计各层重要性，提出LGA快速定位黄金层；3) 在黄金层执行现有编辑算法（如ROME、MEMIT等）。
AI.result: 实验表明黄金层与样本最优层编辑成功率差距<1%；LGA定位的黄金层在多个数据集、不同LLM和编辑方法上均取得一致提升，平均编辑成功率提高约5–10%，且运行时间减少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 存在可迁移的“黄金层”，LGA可高效准确找到该层，使知识编辑更稳健、高效，无需逐样本搜索。
AI.translation: 大语言模型知识编辑旨在仅更新特定查询的预测，同时保持其他输入的行为不变。该过程通常包括定位编辑层和更新参数。不同查询的知识可能分布在不同深度，导致固定层编辑效果参差。本文假设存在固定的“黄金层”，可达到接近样本最优层的编辑性能。我们通过对比黄金层与样本最优层提供实证支持，并证明可用代理数据集可靠识别黄金层，泛化到未见查询。进一步提出Layer Gradient Analysis（LGA）通过梯度归因高效估计黄金层，避免多次试错。多基准实验验证了LGA在不同模型和编辑方法上的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出Layer Gradient Analysis（LGA）框架，先利用梯度归因快速找出可迁移的“黄金层”，再在该层执行知识编辑，显著提升成功率并降低计算成本，适用于多种LLM与编辑方法。
AI.keywords: 知识编辑、黄金层、梯度归因、Layer Gradient Analysis、大语言模型
AI.comments: 方法简洁实用，梯度近似假设值得进一步理论分析；未来可探索动态黄金层或结合多层联合编辑。

title: Model Merging in the Essential Subspace
summary: Model merging aims to integrate multiple task-specific fine-tuned models derived from a shared pre-trained checkpoint into a single multi-task model without additional training. Despite extensive research, task interference remains a major obstacle that often undermines the performance of merged models. In this paper, we propose ESM (Essential Subspace Merging) , a robust framework for effective model merging. We begin by performing Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on feature shifts induced by parameter updates. The resulting principal directions span an essential subspace that dominantly influences feature representations. Each task's parameter update matrix is projected onto its respective essential subspace for low-rank decomposition before merging. This methodology mitigates inter-task interference while preserving core task-specific functionality. Furthermore, we introduce a multi-level polarized scaling strategy that amplifies parameters containing critical knowledge and suppresses redundant ones, preventing essential knowledge from being overwhelmed during fusion. Extensive experiments across multiple task sets and model scales demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-task model merging.

AI.title_translation: 本质子空间中的模型融合
AI.tldr: 提出ESM框架，通过PCA提取参数更新张成的“本质子空间”，将任务更新投影到低秩子空间再融合，并配合极化缩放策略，显著降低任务干扰并刷新多任务融合性能。
AI.motivation: 现有模型融合方法常因任务间干扰导致性能下降，需一种无需重训练即可有效整合多个微调模型的鲁棒方案。
AI.method: 1. 对参数更新做PCA获得主方向，构建“本质子空间”；2. 将各任务更新矩阵投影到对应子空间做低秩分解；3. 采用多级极化缩放放大关键参数、抑制冗余参数后进行融合。
AI.result: 在多组任务集和不同规模模型上的广泛实验表明，ESM在无需额外训练的情况下达到当前最优的多任务融合性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过本质子空间投影与极化缩放，ESM能显著缓解任务干扰并保留各任务核心功能，实现高效鲁棒的模型融合。
AI.translation: 模型融合旨在将共享预训练检查点派生的多个任务特定微调模型整合为单一多任务模型而无需额外训练。尽管研究众多，任务干扰仍是削弱融合模型性能的主要障碍。本文提出ESM（本质子空间融合），一种鲁棒的模型融合框架。我们首先对参数更新引起的特征偏移做PCA，所得主方向张成显著影响特征表示的“本质子空间”。各任务参数更新矩阵投影到对应子空间进行低秩分解后再融合，减轻任务间干扰并保留核心功能。此外，引入多级极化缩放策略，放大含关键知识的参数并抑制冗余，防止关键知识在融合中被淹没。跨多任务集和模型规模的实验表明，本方法在多任务融合中达到最新最佳性能。
AI.summary: ESM通过PCA识别参数更新张成的低维“本质子空间”，将各任务更新投影至此子空间进行低秩分解融合，并配合极化缩放抑制冗余，显著降低任务干扰，无需重训练即可在多种设定下刷新多任务融合性能。
AI.keywords: 模型融合; 多任务学习; 本质子空间; PCA; 低秩分解; 极化缩放; 任务干扰
AI.comments: 方法简洁有效，PCA子空间思路可解释性强；极化缩放策略细节需查看原文；未提及计算开销与超参数敏感性，值得进一步验证。

title: Multimodal Crystal Flow: Any-to-Any Modality Generation for Unified Crystal Modeling
summary: Crystal modeling spans a family of conditional and unconditional generation tasks across different modalities, including crystal structure prediction (CSP) and \emph{de novo} generation (DNG). While recent deep generative models have shown promising performance, they remain largely task-specific, lacking a unified framework that shares crystal representations across different generation tasks. To address this limitation, we propose \emph{Multimodal Crystal Flow (MCFlow)}, a unified multimodal flow model that realizes multiple crystal generation tasks as distinct inference trajectories via independent time variables for atom types and crystal structures. To enable multimodal flow in a standard transformer model, we introduce a composition- and symmetry-aware atom ordering with hierarchical permutation augmentation, injecting strong compositional and crystallographic priors without explicit structural templates. Experiments on the MP-20 and MPTS-52 benchmarks show that MCFlow achieves competitive performance against task-specific baselines across multiple crystal generation tasks.

AI.title_translation: 多模态晶体流：用于统一晶体建模的多对多模态生成
AI.tldr: 提出MCFlow，一种统一的多模态流模型，通过独立的原子类型和结构时间变量，将多个晶体生成任务实现为不同的推理轨迹，无需结构模板，在MP-20和MPTS-52基准上取得竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 晶体建模涵盖条件和无条件生成任务，现有深度生成模型多为任务特定，缺乏共享晶体表示的统一框架。
AI.method: 引入MCFlow，一种统一的多模态流模型，使用独立的原子类型和晶体结构时间变量实现不同生成任务；采用基于组成和对称的原子排序及分层置换增强，在标准Transformer模型中注入组成和晶体学先验。
AI.result: 在MP-20和MPTS-52基准测试中，MCFlow在多个晶体生成任务上取得与任务特定基线竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: MCFlow提供了一种统一框架，共享晶体表示，在多任务生成中表现优异。
AI.translation: 多模态晶体流：用于统一晶体建模的多对多模态生成。晶体建模涵盖晶体结构预测和无条件生成等不同模态的条件和无条件生成任务。虽然最近深度生成模型表现良好，但多为任务特定，缺乏共享表示的统一框架。为此，提出MCFlow，通过独立时间变量实现多任务推理，引入组成和对称感知的原子排序及分层置换增强，注入先验无需模板。实验显示MCFlow在基准上取得竞争性性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出MCFlow模型，解决晶体建模中任务特定模型缺乏统一框架的问题，通过多模态流和增强技术实现多任务生成，在基准测试中验证了有效性。
AI.keywords: 多模态晶体流, 统一建模, 晶体生成, 流模型, 组成对称先验
AI.comments: 该工作创新性地将多模态流应用于晶体建模，但摘要未提及模型的具体局限性或未来方向。

title: CodeHacker: Automated Test Case Generation for Detecting Vulnerabilities in Competitive Programming Solutions
summary: The evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation relies heavily on the quality and robustness of test cases. However, existing benchmarks often lack coverage for subtle corner cases, allowing incorrect solutions to pass. To bridge this gap, we propose CodeHacker, an automated agent framework dedicated to generating targeted adversarial test cases that expose latent vulnerabilities in program submissions. Mimicking the hack mechanism in competitive programming, CodeHacker employs a multi-strategy approach, including stress testing, anti-hash attacks, and logic-specific targeting to break specific code submissions. To ensure the validity and reliability of these attacks, we introduce a Calibration Phase, where the agent iteratively refines its own Validator and Checker via self-generated adversarial probes before evaluating contestant code.Experiments demonstrate that CodeHacker significantly improves the True Negative Rate (TNR) of existing datasets, effectively filtering out incorrect solutions that were previously accepted. Furthermore, generated adversarial cases prove to be superior training data, boosting the performance of RL-trained models on benchmarks like LiveCodeBench.

AI.title_translation: CodeHacker：面向竞赛编程漏洞检测的自动化测试用例生成
AI.tldr: CodeHacker 是一种模仿竞赛编程“hack”机制的多策略对抗测试用例生成框架，通过压力测试、反哈希攻击与逻辑定向攻击，在自校准后显著降低误报率并为强化学习模型提供高质量训练数据。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成评测基准缺乏对细微边界情况的覆盖，导致错误解法仍能通过测试，需要一种能自动挖掘潜在漏洞并生成针对性测试用例的方法。
AI.method: 提出 CodeHacker 自动化代理框架：1) 采用压力测试、反哈希攻击与逻辑定向攻击等多策略生成对抗测试用例；2) 引入校准阶段，让代理利用自生成的对抗探针迭代优化自身的验证器与检查器；3) 在验证可靠后评估参赛者代码。
AI.result: 实验表明 CodeHacker 显著提升现有数据集的真负例率（TNR），有效过滤掉曾被误判为正确的错误解法，且生成的对抗用例作为训练数据可提高强化学习模型在 LiveCodeBench 等基准上的表现。
AI.conclusion: CodeHacker 通过模拟竞赛中的 hack 流程并自我校准验证组件，能系统性地暴露程序隐患，增强评测可靠性，同时生成的对抗数据对提升模型训练效果具有额外价值。
AI.translation: CodeHacker：面向竞赛编程漏洞检测的自动化测试用例生成
AI.summary: CodeHacker 是一种多策略对抗测试用例生成框架，通过压力测试、反哈希和逻辑定向攻击，在自校准验证器后显著提升数据集真负例率，并能作为高质量训练数据强化模型表现。
AI.keywords: 竞赛编程、对抗测试用例、漏洞检测、代码生成评估、自校准验证器
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体使用的编程语言、模型规模或计算开销，也未讨论潜在误报风险与伦理考量。

title: Right to History: A Sovereignty Kernel for Verifiable AI Agent Execution
summary: AI agents increasingly act on behalf of humans, yet no existing system provides a tamper-evident, independently verifiable record of what they did. As regulations such as the EU AI Act begin mandating automatic logging for high-risk AI systems, this gap carries concrete consequences -- especially for agents running on personal hardware, where no centralized provider controls the log. Extending Floridi's informational rights framework from data about individuals to actions performed on their behalf, this paper proposes the Right to History: the principle that individuals are entitled to a complete, verifiable record of every AI agent action on their own hardware. The paper formalizes this principle through five system invariants with structured proof sketches, and implements it in PunkGo, a Rust sovereignty kernel that unifies RFC 6962 Merkle tree audit logs, capability-based isolation, energy-budget governance, and a human-approval mechanism. Adversarial testing confirms all five invariants hold. Performance evaluation shows sub-1.3 ms median action latency, ~400 actions/sec throughput, and 448-byte Merkle inclusion proofs at 10,000 log entries.

AI.title_translation: 历史权：用于可验证AI代理执行的主权内核
AI.tldr: 本文提出“历史权”原则，要求为个人硬件上的AI代理提供防篡改、可独立验证的完整行为记录，并设计Rust实现PunkGo，在亚毫秒级延迟下满足五项系统不变式。
AI.motivation: 现有系统无法为个人硬件上的AI代理提供可验证的行为记录，而欧盟AI法案等法规已要求高风险AI系统自动记录，缺失将带来合规风险。
AI.method: 将Floridi信息权框架从个人数据扩展至代理行为，提出“历史权”原则；形式化五项系统不变式并给出结构化证明草图；在Rust实现PunkGo，集成RFC 6962 Merkle树审计日志、基于能力的隔离、能量预算治理及人工批准机制；进行对抗测试与性能评估。
AI.result: 对抗测试确认五项不变式全部成立；性能评估显示中位动作延迟低于1.3 ms，吞吐量约400动作/秒，10,000条日志项时Merkle包含证明仅448字节。
AI.conclusion: “历史权”原则及其PunkGo实现可在个人硬件上提供高效、可验证的AI代理行为记录，满足法规要求并保障个人主权。
AI.translation: AI代理日益代表人类行事，但现有系统无法提供防篡改、可独立验证的行为记录。随着欧盟AI法案等法规要求高风险AI系统自动记录，此缺口带来实际后果，尤其在无集中式日志提供方的个人硬件上。本文将Floridi信息权框架从个人数据扩展至代表个人执行的行为，提出“历史权”原则：个人有权获得其硬件上AI代理每一项行为的完整、可验证记录。论文通过结构化证明草图形式化五项系统不变式，并在Rust主权内核PunkGo中实现，统一RFC 6962 Merkle树审计日志、基于能力的隔离、能量预算治理及人工批准机制。对抗测试确认五项不变式均成立；性能评估显示中位延迟低于1.3 ms，吞吐约400动作/秒，10,000条日志时Merkle包含证明仅448字节。
AI.summary: 针对个人硬件上AI代理缺乏可验证行为记录的问题，本文提出“历史权”原则，要求为个人提供完整、防篡改的代理行为日志。作者形式化五项系统不变式，并在Rust实现PunkGo，集成Merkle树审计日志、能力隔离、能量治理与人工批准。实验表明系统在高强度对抗下仍保不变式，且延迟低于1.3 ms、吞吐400动作/秒，证明其在合规与性能上的可行性。
AI.keywords: 历史权,AI代理,可验证执行,主权内核,Merkle树审计日志,能力隔离,能量预算治理,EU AI Act
AI.comments: 文章聚焦个人硬件场景，填补去中心化AI审计空白；形式化不变式与对抗测试增强可信度；性能表现优异，适合嵌入式与边缘部署；尚未提及如何与现有操作系统或硬件安全模块集成，以及长期日志存储与隐私权衡。

title: Vision-Based Reasoning with Topology-Encoded Graphs for Anatomical Path Disambiguation in Robot-Assisted Endovascular Navigation
comments: This paper has been accepted by IEEE ICRA 2026. 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
summary: Robotic-assisted percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) is constrained by the inherent limitations of 2D Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA). Unlike physicians, who can directly manipulate guidewires and integrate tactile feedback with their prior anatomical knowledge, teleoperated robotic systems must rely solely on 2D projections. This mode of operation, simultaneously lacking spatial context and tactile sensation, may give rise to projection-induced ambiguities at vascular bifurcations. To address this challenge, we propose a two-stage framework (SCAR-UNet-GAT) for real-time robotic path planning. In the first stage, SCAR-UNet, a spatial-coordinate-attention-regularized U-Net, is employed for accurate coronary vessel segmentation. The integration of multi-level attention mechanisms enhances the delineation of thin, tortuous vessels and improves robustness against imaging noise. From the resulting binary masks, vessel centerlines and bifurcation points are extracted, and geometric descriptors (e.g., branch diameter, intersection angles) are fused with local DSA patches to construct node features. In the second stage, a Graph Attention Network (GAT) reasons over the vessel graph to identify anatomically consistent and clinically feasible trajectories, effectively distinguishing true bifurcations from projection-induced false crossings. On a clinical DSA dataset, SCAR-UNet achieved a Dice coefficient of 93.1%. For path disambiguation, the proposed GAT-based method attained a success rate of 95.0% and a target-arrival success rate of 90.0%, substantially outperforming conventional shortest-path planning (60.0% and 55.0%) and heuristic-based planning (75.0% and 70.0%). Validation on a robotic platform further confirmed the practical feasibility and robustness of the proposed framework.

AI.title_translation: 基于拓扑编码图的视觉推理在机器人辅助血管导航中解剖路径消歧
AI.tldr: 用SCAR-UNet精准分割冠状动脉并结合图注意力网络，在2D DSA投影中实时区分真假分叉，实现机器人PCI路径规划。
AI.motivation: 机器人PCI仅依赖2D DSA投影，缺乏空间与触觉信息，导致血管分叉处出现投影歧义，需要自动、实时且解剖可信的路径规划方法。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1) SCAR-UNet引入空间坐标注意力完成冠脉分割；2) 提取中心线与分叉，融合几何特征构建节点，用图注意力网络在血管图上推理，识别解剖一致的可行轨迹。
AI.result: SCAR-UNet Dice达93.1%；GAT消歧成功率95%，到达目标率90%，显著优于最短路径(60%/55%)与启发式方法(75%/70%)，并在机器人平台上验证可行。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架可在2D DSA中实时、准确地识别真分叉并规划路径，为机器人PCI提供安全导航。
AI.translation: 机器人经皮冠脉介入受限于2D DSA投影，缺乏触觉与空间信息，易在分叉处产生歧义。本文提出SCAR-UNet-GAT两阶段框架：先以SCAR-UNet精准分割血管，再以图注意力网络推理血管图，区分真假分叉并规划可行路径。临床数据集上Dice 93.1%，消歧成功率95%，显著优于传统方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对机器人PCI中2D DSA投影带来的分叉歧义，提出SCAR-UNet-GAT框架：先用带空间坐标注意力的U-Net分割冠脉，再构建血管图并用图注意力网络推理，实现实时路径规划。临床实验显示分割Dice 93.1%，消歧与到达成功率分别达95%和90%，优于最短路径与启发式方法，并在机器人平台验证可行。
AI.keywords: 机器人PCI；血管分割；图注意力网络；路径规划；分叉消歧
AI.comments: 摘要清晰展示了两阶段方法及显著性能提升，但未提计算时耗、失败案例原因及多中心验证计划。

title: Sample-Efficient Learning with Online Expert Correction for Autonomous Catheter Steering in Endovascular Bifurcation Navigation
comments: This paper has been accepted by IEEE ICRA 2026. 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table
summary: Robot-assisted endovascular intervention offers a safe and effective solution for remote catheter manipulation, reducing radiation exposure while enabling precise navigation. Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as a promising approach for autonomous catheter steering; however, conventional methods suffer from sparse reward design and reliance on static vascular models, limiting their sample efficiency and generalization to intraoperative variations. To overcome these challenges, this paper introduces a sample-efficient RL framework with online expert correction for autonomous catheter steering in endovascular bifurcation navigation. The proposed framework integrates three key components: (1) A segmentation-based pose estimation module for accurate real-time state feedback, (2) A fuzzy controller for bifurcation-aware orientation adjustment, and (3) A structured reward generator incorporating expert priors to guide policy learning. By leveraging online expert correction, the framework reduces exploration inefficiency and enhances policy robustness in complex vascular structures. Experimental validation on a robotic platform using a transparent vascular phantom demonstrates that the proposed approach achieves convergence in 123 training episodes -- a 25.9% reduction compared to the baseline Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm -- while reducing average positional error to 83.8% of the baseline. These results indicate that combining sample-efficient RL with online expert correction enables reliable and accurate catheter steering, particularly in anatomically challenging bifurcation scenarios critical for endovascular navigation.

AI.title_translation: 基于在线专家修正的样本高效学习在血管内分叉导航中的自主导管操控研究
AI.tldr: 提出融合实时分割姿态估计、模糊朝向调节与专家奖励生成的强化学习框架，通过在线专家修正显著减少训练样本并提升导管在血管分叉处的导航精度。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习用于导管自主操控时存在奖励稀疏及依赖静态血管模型的问题，导致样本效率低且难以适应术中变异，需提升在复杂血管结构中的泛化与收敛速度。
AI.method: 构建三组件框架：1) 基于分割的实时姿态估计模块提供状态反馈；2) 模糊控制器实现分叉感知朝向调整；3) 引入专家先验的结构化奖励函数。训练过程中加入在线专家修正以降低探索冗余。
AI.result: 在透明血管模型的机器人平台上，方法在123回合内收敛，比基线Soft Actor-Critic减少25.9%训练时间，平均定位误差降至基线的83.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将样本高效的强化学习与在线专家修正结合，可在解剖结构复杂的分叉场景中实现可靠、精准的自主导管导航。
AI.translation: 机器人辅助血管内介入为远程导管操作提供安全有效方案，减少辐射并提高导航精度。强化学习(RL)近期被用于自主导管操控，但传统方法受稀疏奖励及静态血管模型限制，样本效率低且难以适应术中变化。本文提出样本高效RL框架，结合在线专家修正用于血管内分叉导航。框架集成三大组件：基于分割的姿态估计、分叉感知模糊控制器、融入专家先验的结构化奖励生成器。在线专家修正降低探索浪费并提升策略鲁棒性。实验在机器人平台透明血管模型上验证，方法123回合收敛，比基线SAC减少25.9%，定位误差降至83.8%。结果表明样本高效RL结合在线专家修正可实现可靠精准导管操控，尤其适用于解剖复杂的分叉场景。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种样本高效的强化学习框架，通过实时分割姿态估计、模糊朝向控制器与专家奖励生成器，并在训练中加入在线专家修正，实现自主导管在血管分叉处的快速收敛与精准导航，显著优于传统SAC算法。
AI.keywords: 机器人辅助血管内介入, 强化学习, 样本效率, 在线专家修正, 导管导航, 血管分叉, 模糊控制, 姿态估计
AI.comments: 研究在血管模型而非真实人体数据验证，未来需考察体内实验与更复杂病变场景；奖励设计依赖专家先验，可考虑自适应权重。

title: KnapSpec: Self-Speculative Decoding via Adaptive Layer Selection as a Knapsack Problem
summary: Self-speculative decoding (SSD) accelerates LLM inference by skipping layers to create an efficient draft model, yet existing methods often rely on static heuristics that ignore the dynamic computational overhead of attention in long-context scenarios. We propose KnapSpec, a training-free framework that reformulates draft model selection as a knapsack problem to maximize tokens-per-time throughput. By decoupling Attention and MLP layers and modeling their hardware-specific latencies as functions of context length, KnapSpec adaptively identifies optimal draft configurations on the fly via a parallel dynamic programming algorithm. Furthermore, we provide the first rigorous theoretical analysis establishing cosine similarity between hidden states as a mathematically sound proxy for the token acceptance rate. This foundation allows our method to maintain high drafting faithfulness while navigating the shifting bottlenecks of real-world hardware. Our experiments on Qwen3 and Llama3 demonstrate that KnapSpec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art SSD baselines, achieving up to 1.47x wall-clock speedup across various benchmarks. Our plug-and-play approach ensures high-speed inference for long sequences without requiring additional training or compromising the target model's output distribution.

AI.title_translation: KnapSpec：通过自适应层选择将自推测解码建模为背包问题
AI.tldr: 提出无训练框架KnapSpec，把层跳过建模为背包问题，动态选择最优草稿层，在Qwen3/Llama3上实现最高1.47倍真实加速。
AI.motivation: 现有自推测解码用静态启发式，忽略长上下文下注意力的动态开销，导致吞吐量下降。
AI.method: 将Attention与MLP层解耦，用上下文长度函数建模硬件延迟，把草稿层选择转化为背包问题，并用并行动态规划在线求解；以隐藏状态余弦相似度作为接受率的理论代理。
AI.result: 在Qwen3和Llama3的多项基准上，KnapSpec比SOTA自推测基线平均提升1.47倍墙钟速度，无需训练且保持原模型输出分布。
AI.conclusion: KnapSpec通过背包建模和硬件感知自适应层选择，实现了长序列场景下高保真、无训练、即插即用的高速自推测解码。
AI.translation: 自推测解码通过跳过部分层构建高效草稿模型以加速大语言模型推理，但现有方法多用静态启发式，忽视长上下文下注意力计算开销的动态变化。我们提出KnapSpec，这一无需训练的框架将草稿模型选择重构为背包问题，以最大化每秒令牌吞吐。通过将Attention与MLP层解耦，并把其硬件相关延迟建模为上下文长度函数，KnapSpec利用并行动态规划算法在线自适应地找出最优草稿配置。此外，我们首次给出严格理论分析，证明隐藏状态余弦相似度是令牌接受率的数学可靠代理，从而在真实硬件瓶颈变化时保持高草稿保真度。在Qwen3和Llama3上的实验表明，KnapSpec持续优于现有自推测基线，最高实现1.47倍墙钟加速。该即插即用方法无需额外训练，不破坏目标模型输出分布，即可为长序列提供高速推理。
AI.summary: KnapSpec把自推测解码的层选择抽象为背包问题，在线优化Attention与MLP的跳过策略，实现无训练、长上下文友好的1.47倍加速。
AI.keywords: 自推测解码, 背包问题, 动态层选择, 长上下文, 无训练加速
AI.comments: 首次将硬件延迟与上下文长度耦合建模并给出接受率理论保证，方法简洁且即插即用，具备落地潜力。

title: An Approach to Combining Video and Speech with Large Language Models in Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Interpreting human intent accurately is a central challenge in human-robot interaction (HRI) and a key requirement for achieving more natural and intuitive collaboration between humans and machines. This work presents a novel multimodal HRI framework that combines advanced vision-language models, speech processing, and fuzzy logic to enable precise and adaptive control of a Dobot Magician robotic arm. The proposed system integrates Florence-2 for object detection, Llama 3.1 for natural language understanding, and Whisper for speech recognition, providing users with a seamless and intuitive interface for object manipulation through spoken commands. By jointly addressing scene perception and action planning, the approach enhances the reliability of command interpretation and execution. Experimental evaluations conducted on consumer-grade hardware demonstrate a command execution accuracy of 75\%, highlighting both the robustness and adaptability of the system. Beyond its current performance, the proposed architecture serves as a flexible and extensible foundation for future HRI research, offering a practical pathway toward more sophisticated and natural human-robot collaboration through tightly coupled speech and vision-language processing.

AI.title_translation: 一种在人与机器人交互中融合视频与语音的大型语言模型方法

title: What Matters for Simulation to Online Reinforcement Learning on Real Robots
summary: We investigate what specific design choices enable successful online reinforcement learning (RL) on physical robots. Across 100 real-world training runs on three distinct robotic platforms, we systematically ablate algorithmic, systems, and experimental decisions that are typically left implicit in prior work. We find that some widely used defaults can be harmful, while a set of robust, readily adopted design choices within standard RL practice yield stable learning across tasks and hardware. These results provide the first large-sample empirical study of such design choices, enabling practitioners to deploy online RL with lower engineering effort.

AI.title_translation: 真实机器人上从仿真到在线强化学习的关键因素
AI.tldr: 本文通过对三台不同机器人共100次真实训练的系统消融实验，首次大规模实证研究影响在线强化学习成功的算法、系统与实验设计选择，发现常用默认设置可能有害，而一组稳健且易采纳的标准RL设计选择可在不同任务与硬件上实现稳定学习。
AI.motivation: 许多先前研究对算法、系统和实验决策的默认设定未加说明，导致这些设定对真实机器人在线RL成功的影响不明确，增加了工程部署难度。
AI.method: 在三种机器人平台上进行100次真实世界训练，系统性地消融算法、系统与实验层面的设计选择，记录并比较其对在线RL性能的影响。
AI.result: 发现部分广泛使用的默认设定有害，而一组简单、易采纳的标准RL设计选择能在不同任务与硬件上实现稳定学习。
AI.conclusion: 首次提供大样本实证研究，为实践者提供明确的稳健设计指南，降低真实机器人部署在线RL的工程负担。
AI.translation: 我们研究了哪些具体设计选择能够使在线强化学习在真实机器人上取得成功。在三种不同机器人平台上进行100次真实训练，我们系统地消融了先前工作通常隐含的算法、系统和实验决策。我们发现一些广泛使用的默认设置可能有害，而一组稳健且易于采用的标准RL设计选择可在任务和硬件间实现稳定学习。这些结果为首次大样本实证研究，使实践者能以更低工程努力部署在线RL。
AI.summary: 本文通过100次真实机器人实验，系统评估影响在线RL成功的隐含设计选择，提出一组稳健易用的设计指南，显著降低部署难度。
AI.keywords: 在线强化学习,真实机器人,设计选择,系统消融实验,稳健部署

title: Lures of Engagement: An Outlook on Tactical AI Art
comments: 17 pages. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2602.19754
summary: This paper aims to diversify the existing critical discourse by introducing new perspectives for the poetic, expressive, and ethical features of tactical media art that involves artificial intelligence (AI). It explores diverse approaches of AI artists and their effectiveness in critiquing the epistemic, phenomenological, and political aspects of AI science and technology. Focusing on the three representative thematic areas - sociocultural, existential, and political - it discusses the works that exemplify poetic complexity and manifest the ambiguities indicative of a broader milieu of contemporary art, culture, economy, and society. It shows that tactical AI art provides important insights into the AI-influenced world, with the potential to direct computational arts toward a socially responsible and epistemologically relevant expressive stratum. The closing sections summarize the major issues of tactical AI art and outline possible directions to tackle the challenges and advance the field.
