AI.translation: 生成式AI的最新进展显示其在多领域巨大潜力，但港口物流应用仍待探索。港口是多元情境信息共存的复杂运营环境，是生成式AI的理想试验场并凸显研究紧迫性。本研究将领先的大语言模型用于集装箱吞吐量预测，提出融入港口情境的新提示结构。实验验证其优于基准模型，并证实LLM能利用多层情境信息。研究探讨LLM在该领域的关键限制与未来方向，提供技术与实践洞见。
AI.summary: 本文首次将大语言模型引入港口物流，通过定制提示结构整合多源情境信息，实现更准确的集装箱吞吐量预测，实验验证其优于传统方法，并分析部署挑战与未来研究方向。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型; 集装箱吞吐量预测; 港口物流; 情境信息; 生成式AI; 提示工程
AI.comments: 研究填补了生成式AI在港口物流的空白，提示结构设计具启发性；但需关注数据获取、模型解释性与实时性等实际落地问题。

title: Wireless Federated Multi-Task LLM Fine-Tuning via Sparse-and-Orthogonal LoRA
summary: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) based on low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables mobile devices with multi-task datasets to collaboratively fine-tune a large language model (LLM) by exchanging locally updated parameters with a subset of neighboring devices via wireless connections for knowledge integration.However, directly aggregating parameters fine-tuned on heterogeneous datasets induces three primary issues across the DFL life-cycle: (i) \textit{catastrophic knowledge forgetting during fine-tuning process}, arising from conflicting update directions caused by data heterogeneity; (ii) \textit{inefficient communication and convergence during model aggregation process}, due to bandwidth-intensive redundant model transmissions; and (iii) \textit{multi-task knowledge interference during inference process}, resulting from incompatible knowledge representations coexistence during inference. To address these issues in a fully decentralized scenario, we first propose a sparse-and-orthogonal LoRA that ensures orthogonality between model updates to eliminate direction conflicts during fine-tuning.Then, we analyze how device connection topology affects multi-task performance, prompting a cluster-based topology design during aggregation.Finally, we propose an implicit mixture of experts (MoE) mechanism to avoid the coexistence of incompatible knowledge during inference. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach effectively reduces communication resource consumption by up to $73\%$ and enhances average performance by $5\%$ compared with the traditional LoRA method.

AI.title_translation: 基于稀疏正交LoRA的无线联邦多任务大模型微调
AI.tldr: 提出稀疏正交LoRA与聚类拓扑+隐式MoE机制，解决无线联邦多任务LLM微调中的知识冲突、通信冗余与推理干扰，通信开销降73%，平均性能升5%。
AI.motivation: 在无线去中心化联邦场景下，多任务数据异质性导致LoRA微调出现知识遗忘、通信低效及推理冲突，亟需全生命周期优化方案。
AI.method: 1) 稀疏正交LoRA：强制更新正交以消除方向冲突；2) 聚类拓扑设计：按连接拓扑优化设备分簇聚合；3) 隐式MoE：推理阶段隔离不兼容知识表示。
AI.result: 相较传统LoRA，通信资源消耗降低73%，多任务平均性能提升5%，同时缓解知识遗忘与推理干扰。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏正交LoRA结合拓扑聚类与隐式MoE，可在全去中心化无线联邦环境中高效完成多任务LLM微调，显著节省通信开销并提升综合性能。
AI.translation: 无
AI.summary: 论文针对无线联邦多任务LLM微调中因数据异质性引发的知识遗忘、通信冗余与推理冲突，提出稀疏正交LoRA框架。通过更新正交约束、聚类拓扑聚合及隐式MoE推理机制，实现通信开销降73%、性能升5%，为去中心化场景提供全生命周期优化方案。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习；大语言模型；低秩适配；多任务学习；无线通信；知识冲突；稀疏正交；混合专家

title: AWCP: A Workspace Delegation Protocol for Deep-Engagement Collaboration across Remote Agents
comments: 16 pages, 7 figure, tech report of Agent Workspace Collaboration Protocol
summary: The rapid evolution of Large Language Model (LLM)-based autonomous agents is reshaping the digital landscape toward an emerging Agentic Web, where increasingly specialized agents must collaborate to accomplish complex tasks. However, existing collaboration paradigms are constrained to message passing, leaving execution environments as isolated silos. This creates a context gap: agents cannot directly manipulate files or invoke tools in a peer's environment, and must instead resort to costly, error-prone environment reconstruction. We introduce the Agent Workspace Collaboration Protocol (AWCP), which bridges this gap through temporary workspace delegation inspired by the Unix philosophy that everything is a file. AWCP decouples a lightweight control plane from pluggable transport mechanisms, allowing a Delegator to project its workspace to a remote Executor, who then operates on the shared files directly with unmodified local toolchains. We provide a fully open-source reference implementation with MCP tool integration and validate the protocol through live demonstrations of asymmetric collaboration, where agents with complementary capabilities cooperate through delegated workspaces. By establishing the missing workspace layer in the agentic protocol stack, AWCP paves the way for a universally interoperable agent ecosystem in which collaboration transcends message boundaries. The protocol and reference implementation are publicly available at https://github.com/SII-Holos/awcp.
comment: 16 pages, 7 figure, tech report of Agent Workspace Collaboration Protocol

AI.title_translation: AWCP：面向远程智能体深度协作的工作空间委托协议
AI.tldr: AWCP 通过临时工作空间委托，让智能体无需重建环境即可直接操作远端文件与工具，实现跨环境深度协作。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体协作仅依赖消息传递，无法直接操作对端环境，导致环境重建成本高、易出错，阻碍复杂任务的协同完成。
AI.method: 提出 AWCP 协议，将轻量控制面与可插拔传输解耦，允许委托方把本地工作空间投影给远程执行方，后者用原生工具链直接操作共享文件。
AI.result: 开源实现集成 MCP 工具，现场演示表明互补能力的智能体可通过委托工作空间完成非对称协作，无需修改或重建环境。
AI.conclusion: AWCP 填补了智能体协议栈缺失的工作空间层，使协作超越消息边界，为实现通用互操作智能体生态铺平道路。
AI.translation: 基于大模型的自主智能体迅速演进，推动数字世界向“智能体网络”发展，其中高度专业化的智能体需协作完成复杂任务。然而，现有协作范式局限于消息传递，执行环境彼此隔离，导致智能体无法直接操作对端文件或调用工具，只能依赖昂贵且易错的环境重建。为此，我们提出智能体工作空间协作协议（AWCP），借鉴 Unix“一切皆文件”思想，通过临时工作空间委托弥合这一鸿沟。AWCP 将轻量控制面与可插拔传输机制解耦，使委托方把本地工作空间投影给远程执行方，后者使用未修改的本地工具链直接操作共享文件。我们提供完全开源的参考实现，集成 MCP 工具，并通过现场演示验证非对称协作：具备互补能力的智能体通过委托工作空间协同完成任务。AWCP 在智能体协议栈中建立了缺失的工作空间层，使协作超越消息边界，为实现通用互操作的智能体生态奠定基础。协议及参考实现已公开于 https://github.com/SII-Holos/awcp。
AI.summary: AWCP 协议首次把“工作空间”作为可委托资源，让智能体跨环境直接调用工具与文件，实现高效、低成本的深度协作。
AI.keywords: 智能体协作；工作空间委托；远程执行；协议设计；MCP 集成
AI.comments: 作者未给出性能对比数据，建议后续补充与传统消息传递或环境重建方案的量化评估。

title: KairosVL: Orchestrating Time Series and Semantics for Unified Reasoning
summary: Driven by the increasingly complex and decision-oriented demands of time series analysis, we introduce the Semantic-Conditional Time Series Reasoning task, which extends conventional time series analysis beyond purely numerical modeling to incorporate contextual and semantic understanding. To further enhance the mode's reasoning capabilities on complex time series problems, we propose a two-round reinforcement learning framework: the first round strengthens the mode's perception of fundamental temporal primitives, while the second focuses on semantic-conditioned reasoning. The resulting model, KairosVL, achieves competitive performance across both synthetic and real-world tasks. Extensive experiments and ablation studies demonstrate that our framework not only boosts performance but also preserves intrinsic reasoning ability and significantly improves generalization to unseen scenarios. To summarize, our work highlights the potential of combining semantic reasoning with temporal modeling and provides a practical framework for real-world time series intelligence, which is in urgent demand.

AI.title_translation: KairosVL：统筹时间序列与语义以实现统一推理
AI.tldr: 提出语义条件时间序列推理任务，用两轮强化学习框架训练模型KairosVL，兼顾时序原语感知与语义推理，实验显示其性能优越且泛化能力强。
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列分析仅聚焦数值建模，难以满足日益复杂且需决策支持的时序任务，亟需引入上下文与语义理解以提升推理能力。
AI.method: 1)定义语义条件时间序列推理任务；2)设计两轮强化学习框架：首轮强化对基本时序原语的感知，次轮专注语义条件推理；3)训练统一模型KairosVL。
AI.result: 在合成与真实任务上均取得竞争性性能；消融实验表明框架在提升性能的同时保持内在推理能力，并显著改善对未见场景的泛化。
AI.conclusion: 将语义推理与时序建模结合具有巨大潜力，所提框架为现实急需的时间序列智能提供了可行方案。
AI.translation: 受时间序列分析日益复杂且面向决策的需求驱动，本文提出语义条件时间序列推理任务，将传统时间序列分析从纯数值建模扩展至融合上下文与语义理解。为增强模型在复杂时序问题上的推理能力，我们设计了两轮强化学习框架：首轮强化模型对基本时序原语的感知，次轮专注语义条件推理。所得模型KairosVL在合成与真实任务上均取得竞争性性能。大量实验与消融研究表明，该框架不仅提升性能，还保持内在推理能力并显著改善对未见场景的泛化。综上，本工作展示了语义推理与时序建模结合的潜力，并为现实急需的时间序列智能提供了实用框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出语义条件时间序列推理新任务，通过两轮强化学习框架训练KairosVL模型，实现时序原语感知与语义推理的统一，实验验证其在多任务上的优越性能与泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 时间序列分析，语义推理，强化学习，KairosVL，泛化能力
AI.comments: 摘要未披露两轮强化学习的具体算法细节、模型架构、数据集名称及评估指标，需阅读全文获取。

title: Pip-Stereo: Progressive Iterations Pruner for Iterative Optimization based Stereo Matching
summary: While iterative stereo matching achieves high accuracy, its dependence on Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) hinders edge deployment, a challenge underexplored in existing researches. We analyze iterative refinement and reveal that disparity updates are spatially sparse and temporally redundant. First, we introduce a progressive iteration pruning strategy that suppresses redundant update steps, effectively collapsing the recursive computation into a near-single-pass inference. Second, we propose a collaborative monocular prior transfer framework that implicitly embeds depth priors without requiring a dedicated monocular encoder, thereby eliminating its associated computational burden. Third, we develop FlashGRU, a hardware-aware RNN operator leveraging structured sparsity and I/O-conscious design, achieving a 7.28$\times$ speedup, 76.6\% memory peak reduction and 80.9\% global memory requests reduction over natvie ConvGRUs under 2K resolution. Our PipStereo enables real-time, high-fidelity stereo matching on edge hardware: it processes 320$\times$640 frames in just 75ms on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (FP16) and 19ms on RTX 4090, matching the accuracy of large iterative based models, and our generalization ability and accuracy far exceeds that of existing real-time methods. Our embedded AI projects will be updated at: https://github.com/XPENG-Aridge-AI.

AI.title_translation: Pip-Stereo：面向迭代优化立体匹配的渐进式迭代剪枝器
AI.tldr: 通过渐进剪枝冗余迭代、引入单目先验传递和硬件友好的FlashGRU，Pip-Stereo在保持高精度的同时实现边缘设备实时立体匹配。
AI.motivation: 基于RNN的迭代立体匹配虽精度高，却因计算量大难以部署到边缘设备，现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.method: 1) 渐进式迭代剪枝策略，将递归计算压缩为近似单次推理；2) 协同单目先验迁移框架，无需独立单目编码器即可嵌入深度先验；3) 硬件感知的FlashGRU算子，利用结构化稀疏与I/O优化设计。
AI.result: 在2K分辨率下，FlashGRU较原生ConvGRU提速7.28倍，峰值内存降76.6%，全局内存请求降80.9%；Pip-Stereo在Jetson Orin NX上处理320×640帧仅需75ms，在RTX4090仅需19ms，精度与大型迭代模型相当，远超现有实时方法。
AI.conclusion: Pip-Stereo在保持高保真立体匹配的同时，首次在边缘硬件实现实时性能，具备优异的泛化与精度优势。
AI.translation: 基于RNN的迭代立体匹配虽精度高，却因计算量大难以部署到边缘设备，现有研究对此关注不足。作者通过渐进剪枝冗余迭代、引入单目先验迁移和硬件友好的FlashGRU，将递归计算压缩为近似单次推理，无需独立单目编码器即可嵌入深度先验。实验显示，FlashGRU在2K分辨率下较原生ConvGRU提速7.28倍，峰值内存降76.6%，全局内存请求降80.9%；Pip-Stereo在Jetson Orin NX上处理320×640帧仅需75ms，在RTX4090仅需19ms，精度与大型迭代模型相当，远超现有实时方法，首次在边缘硬件实现实时高保真立体匹配。
AI.summary: Pip-Stereo通过三项创新解决迭代立体匹配在边缘部署的瓶颈：渐进迭代剪枝、单目先验无编码器嵌入及硬件感知FlashGRU，实现高精度实时推理。
AI.keywords: 立体匹配,迭代优化,边缘部署,剪枝,单目先验,FlashGRU,实时推理
AI.comments: 作者已开源嵌入式AI项目，后续可持续跟踪GitHub更新以获取实际部署细节与模型权重。

title: LESA: Learnable Stage-Aware Predictors for Diffusion Model Acceleration
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image and video generation tasks. However, the high computational demands of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) pose a significant challenge to their practical deployment. While feature caching is a promising acceleration strategy, existing methods based on simple reusing or training-free forecasting struggle to adapt to the complex, stage-dependent dynamics of the diffusion process, often resulting in quality degradation and failing to maintain consistency with the standard denoising process. To address this, we propose a LEarnable Stage-Aware (LESA) predictor framework based on two-stage training. Our approach leverages a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) to accurately learn temporal feature mappings from data. We further introduce a multi-stage, multi-expert architecture that assigns specialized predictors to different noise-level stages, enabling more precise and robust feature forecasting. Extensive experiments show our method achieves significant acceleration while maintaining high-fidelity generation. Experiments demonstrate 5.00x acceleration on FLUX.1-dev with minimal quality degradation (1.0% drop), 6.25x speedup on Qwen-Image with a 20.2% quality improvement over the previous SOTA (TaylorSeer), and 5.00x acceleration on HunyuanVideo with a 24.7% PSNR improvement over TaylorSeer. State-of-the-art performance on both text-to-image and text-to-video synthesis validates the effectiveness and generalization capability of our training-based framework across different models. Our code is included in the supplementary materials and will be released on GitHub.

AI.title_translation: LESA：面向扩散模型加速的可学习阶段感知预测器
AI.tldr: 提出两阶段训练的LESA框架，用KAN网络和多阶段专家预测器为不同噪声阶段精准预测特征，实现5–6倍加速且几乎不损失生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiT）计算开销大，现有特征缓存方法无法适应扩散过程的阶段相关动态，导致质量下降或与标准去噪不一致。
AI.method: 基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的两阶段训练，构建多阶段多专家架构，为不同噪声水平分配专用预测器，实现阶段感知的特征预测。
AI.result: FLUX.1-dev上5.00×加速，质量仅降1.0%；Qwen-Image上6.25×加速，质量比TaylorSeer提升20.2%；HunyuanVideo上5.00×加速，PSNR提升24.7%。
AI.conclusion: 训练式LESA框架在文本到图像与文本到视频任务上均取得SOTA，证明其有效性与跨模型泛化能力。
AI.translation: 扩散模型在图像视频生成中表现卓越，但DiT计算需求高。特征缓存虽可加速，现有简单复用或免训预测难以适应扩散过程的阶段动态，常致质量下降且偏离标准去噪。为此，我们提出基于两阶段训练的LESA框架，用KAN学习时序特征映射，并引入多阶段多专家架构，为不同噪声阶段分配专用预测器，实现更精准鲁棒的特征预测。实验表明，LESA在保持高保真生成的同时显著加速，并在多种模型上验证其有效性与泛化性。
AI.summary: LESA通过两阶段训练与阶段感知的多专家KAN预测器，为扩散Transformer提供5–6倍加速，几乎不损失质量，在文本到图像与视频生成上均达SOTA。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型加速，阶段感知预测器，Kolmogorov-Arnold网络，特征缓存，多专家架构
AI.comments: 代码已附在补充材料并将开源，结果在多个公开模型上可复现。

title: Strategy-Supervised Autonomous Laparoscopic Camera Control via Event-Driven Graph Mining
comments: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO). 19 pages, 9 figures
summary: Autonomous laparoscopic camera control must maintain a stable and safe surgical view under rapid tool-tissue interactions while remaining interpretable to surgeons. We present a strategy-grounded framework that couples high-level vision-language inference with low-level closed-loop control. Offline, raw surgical videos are parsed into camera-relevant temporal events (e.g., interaction, working-distance deviation, and view-quality degradation) and structured as attributed event graphs. Mining these graphs yields a compact set of reusable camera-handling strategy primitives, which provide structured supervision for learning. Online, a fine-tuned Vision-Language Model (VLM) processes the live laparoscopic view to predict the dominant strategy and discrete image-based motion commands, executed by an IBVS-RCM controller under strict safety constraints; optional speech input enables intuitive human-in-the-loop conditioning. On a surgeon-annotated dataset, event parsing achieves reliable temporal localization (F1-score 0.86), and the mined strategies show strong semantic alignment with expert interpretation (cluster purity 0.81). Extensive ex vivo experiments on silicone phantoms and porcine tissues demonstrate that the proposed system outperforms junior surgeons in standardized camera-handling evaluations, reducing field-of-view centering error by 35.26% and image shaking by 62.33%, while preserving smooth motion and stable working-distance regulation.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO). 19 pages, 9 figures

AI.title_translation: 策略监督的自主腹腔镜控制：基于事件图挖掘
AI.tldr: 通过离线挖掘手术视频事件图得到可复用策略原语，在线用视觉-语言模型预测策略并驱动控制器，使自主腹腔镜在安全性、平稳性和精度上超越实习医生。
AI.motivation: 现有自主腹腔镜控制难以在快速器械-组织交互中保持安全、稳定且可解释的手术视野，需要一种结合高层推理与低层闭环控制的可解释框架。
AI.method: 离线阶段：将手术视频解析为相机相关事件并构建属性事件图，挖掘得到紧凑的策略原语；在线阶段：用微调视觉-语言模型预测主导策略与离散运动指令，由带安全约束的IBVS-RCM控制器执行，可选语音实现人机交互。
AI.result: 事件解析F1达0.86，策略聚类纯度0.81；在硅胶模型和猪组织实验中，系统较实习医生将视野中心误差降35.26%、图像抖动降62.33%，同时保持平稳运动与工作距离稳定。
AI.conclusion: 所提策略驱动的框架显著提升了自主腹腔镜控制的安全性、稳定性与精度，具备临床部署潜力。
AI.translation: 本文提出一种策略驱动的自主腹腔镜控制框架，离线挖掘手术视频事件图获得可复用策略原语，在线用视觉-语言模型预测策略并驱动控制器，实验表明其在视野稳定性和精度上优于实习医生。
AI.summary: 本文提出策略监督的自主腹腔镜控制方法。离线将手术视频解析为事件图并挖掘策略原语；在线用视觉-语言模型预测策略与运动指令，经IBVS-RCM控制器执行。实验显示事件解析F1=0.86，策略与专家语义对齐度0.81，系统较实习医生显著降低视野误差与抖动，实现安全平稳的自主控制。

title: Probing and Bridging Geometry-Interaction Cues for Affordance Reasoning in Vision Foundation Models
summary: What does it mean for a visual system to truly understand affordance? We argue that this understanding hinges on two complementary capacities: geometric perception, which identifies the structural parts of objects that enable interaction, and interaction perception, which models how an agent's actions engage with those parts. To test this hypothesis, we conduct a systematic probing of Visual Foundation Models (VFMs). We find that models like DINO inherently encode part-level geometric structures, while generative models like Flux contain rich, verb-conditioned spatial attention maps that serve as implicit interaction priors. Crucially, we demonstrate that these two dimensions are not merely correlated but are composable elements of affordance. By simply fusing DINO's geometric prototypes with Flux's interaction maps in a training-free and zero-shot manner, we achieve affordance estimation competitive with weakly-supervised methods. This final fusion experiment confirms that geometric and interaction perception are the fundamental building blocks of affordance understanding in VFMs, providing a mechanistic account of how perception grounds action.

AI.title_translation: 视觉基础模型中可供性推理的几何-交互线索探测与桥接
AI.tldr: 通过探测发现DINO编码几何结构、Flux隐含交互先验，二者零样本融合即可实现弱监督水平的可供性估计，证明几何与交互感知是可供性理解的两大基石。

AI.conclusion: 几何感知与交互感知并非简单相关，而是可供性理解的可组合基本单元；该发现为感知如何落地动作提供了机制性解释。

AI.summary: 本文提出可供性理解依赖几何与交互两种互补能力。通过系统探测发现，DINO自监督模型隐含部件几何结构，生成式Flux模型内含动词条件空间注意图作为交互先验。无需训练的零样本融合实验表明，两者可组合并达到弱监督水平的可供性估计，证实了几何与交互是视觉基础模型可供性理解的基石。

title: ActionEngine: From Reactive to Programmatic GUI Agents via State Machine Memory
summary:
Existing Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents operate through step-by-step calls to vision language models--taking a screenshot, reasoning about the next action, executing it, then repeating on the new page--resulting in high costs and latency that scale with the number of reasoning steps, and limited accuracy due to no persistent memory of previously visited pages.
  We propose ActionEngine, a training-free framework that transitions from reactive execution to programmatic planning through a novel two-agent architecture: a Crawling Agent that constructs an updatable state-machine memory of the GUIs through offline exploration, and an Execution Agent that leverages this memory to synthesize complete, executable Python programs for online task execution.
  To ensure robustness against evolving interfaces, execution failures trigger a vision-based re-grounding fallback that repairs the failed action and updates the memory.
  This design drastically improves both efficiency and accuracy: on Reddit tasks from the WebArena benchmark, our agent achieves 95% task success with on average a single LLM call, compared to 66% for the strongest vision-only baseline, while reducing cost by 11.8x and end-to-end latency by 2x.
  Together, these components yield scalable and reliable GUI interaction by combining global programmatic planning, crawler-validated action templates, and node-level execution with localized validation and repair.

title: Indaleko: The Unified Personal Index
comments: PhD dissertation, University of British Columbia, August 2025. 287 pages
summary: Personal information retrieval fails when systems ignore how human memory works. While existing platforms force keyword searches across isolated silos, humans naturally recall through episodic cues like when, where, and in what context information was encountered. This dissertation presents the Unified Personal Index (UPI), a memory-aligned architecture that bridges this fundamental gap. The Indaleko prototype demonstrates the UPI's feasibility on a 31-million file dataset spanning 160TB across eight storage platforms. By integrating temporal, spatial, and activity metadata into a unified graph database, Indaleko enables natural language queries like "photos near the conference venue last spring" that existing systems cannot process. The implementation achieves sub-second query responses through memory anchor indexing, eliminates cross-platform search fragmentation, and maintains perfect precision for well-specified memory patterns. Evaluation against commercial systems (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Windows Search) reveals that all fail on memory-based queries, returning overwhelming result sets without contextual filtering. In contrast, Indaleko successfully processes multi-dimensional queries combining time, location, and activity patterns. The extensible architecture supports rapid integration of new data sources (10 minutes to 10 hours per provider) while preserving privacy through UUID-based semantic decoupling. The UPI's architectural synthesis bridges cognitive theory with distributed systems design, as demonstrated through the Indaleko prototype and rigorous evaluation. This work transforms personal information retrieval from keyword matching to memory-aligned finding, providing immediate benefits for existing data while establishing foundations for future context-aware systems.

title: Leveraging Causal Reasoning Method for Explaining Medical Image Segmentation Models
summary: Medical image segmentation plays a vital role in clinical decision-making, enabling precise localization of lesions and guiding interventions. Despite significant advances in segmentation accuracy, the black-box nature of most deep models has raised growing concerns about their trustworthiness in high-stakes medical scenarios. Current explanation techniques have primarily focused on classification tasks, leaving the segmentation domain relatively underexplored. We introduced an explanation model for segmentation task which employs the causal inference framework and backpropagates the average treatment effect (ATE) into a quantification metric to determine the influence of input regions, as well as network components, on target segmentation areas. Through comparison with recent segmentation explainability techniques on two representative medical imaging datasets, we demonstrated that our approach provides more faithful explanations than existing approaches. Furthermore, we carried out a systematic causal analysis of multiple foundational segmentation models using our method, which reveals significant heterogeneity in perceptual strategies across different models, and even between different inputs for the same model. Suggesting the potential of our method to provide notable insights for optimizing segmentation models. Our code can be found at https://github.com/lcmmai/PdCR.

AI.title_translation: 利用因果推理方法解释医学图像分割模型

AI.method: 引入因果推断框架，将平均处理效应（ATE）反向传播至量化指标，评估输入区域与网络组件对目标分割区域的影响，并在两个代表性医学影像数据集上与最新分割可解释方法对比。

AI.conclusion: 该方法有望为优化分割模型提供重要洞察。
AI.translation: 医学图像分割在临床决策中至关重要，但深度模型的黑箱特性引发信任危机。本文提出基于因果推断的分割解释模型，通过ATE量化输入区域与网络组件对分割结果的影响，实验证明其解释忠实度优于现有方法，并揭示模型间及模型内部感知策略差异，代码已开源。

title: Conflict-Based Search for Multi-Agent Path Finding with Elevators
summary: This paper investigates a problem called Multi-Agent Path Finding with Elevators (MAPF-E), which seeks conflict-free paths for multiple agents from their start to goal locations that may locate on different floors, and the agents can use elevators to travel between floors. The existence of elevators complicates the interaction among the agents and introduces new challenges to the planning. On the one hand, elevators can cause many conflicts among the agents due to its relatively long traversal time across floors, especially when many agents need to reach a different floor. On the other hand, the planner has to reason in a larger state space including the states of the elevators, besides the locations of the agents.

AI.title_translation: 基于冲突的多智能体电梯路径搜索

title: From Performance to Purpose: A Sociotechnical Taxonomy for Evaluating Large Language Model Utility
summary: As large language models (LLMs) continue to improve at completing discrete tasks, they are being integrated into increasingly complex and diverse real-world systems. However, task-level success alone does not establish a model's fit for use in practice. In applied, high-stakes settings, LLM effectiveness is driven by a wider array of sociotechnical determinants that extend beyond conventional performance measures. Although a growing set of metrics capture many of these considerations, they are rarely organized in a way that supports consistent evaluation, leaving no unified taxonomy for assessing and comparing LLM utility across use cases. To address this gap, we introduce the Language Model Utility Taxonomy (LUX), a comprehensive framework that structures utility evaluation across four domains: performance, interaction, operations, and governance. Within each domain, LUX is organized hierarchically into thematically aligned dimensions and components, each grounded in metrics that enable quantitative comparison and alignment of model selection with intended use. In addition, an external dynamic web tool is provided to support exploration of the framework by connecting each component to a repository of relevant metrics (factors) for applied evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 从性能到目的：评估大语言模型实用性的社会技术分类法
AI.tldr: 作者提出LUX框架，将LLM实用性评估从单一性能扩展至性能、交互、运维、治理四大领域，建立层级化维度与指标，并配套动态网页工具以支持跨场景一致评估。
AI.motivation: 现有任务级性能指标无法全面反映LLM在高风险真实系统中的适用性，缺乏统一分类法导致难以横向比较模型实用性。
AI.method: 构建LUX社会技术分类框架，划分四大域并逐级细化维度与组件，为每组件链接可量化指标，同时开发在线工具供用户探索与选用指标。
AI.result: LUX提供结构化、可扩展的实用性评估体系，支持跨用例定量比较与模型选择对齐实际需求，配套工具聚合相关指标供应用评估。
AI.conclusion: LUX将评估焦点从性能扩展至社会技术整体，为高风险场景下的LLM选型与治理提供系统化、可操作的统一框架。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型在离散任务上的持续改进，其被集成进日益复杂多样的现实系统。然而，仅任务级成功并不能确立模型在实践中的适用性。在应用且高风险的场景中，LLM有效性由超越传统性能指标的一系列社会技术因素驱动。尽管越来越多的指标已捕捉这些考量，它们缺乏统一组织，无法支持一致性评估，亦无跨用例比较LLM实用性的统一分类法。为此，我们提出语言模型实用性分类法（LUX），它把实用性评估结构化在四大领域：性能、交互、运维与治理。每领域按主题对齐的维度与组件层级组织，并以指标为基础，实现定量比较并使模型选择与预期用途对齐。此外，提供一个外部动态网页工具，将每个组件链接至相关指标库，以支持应用评估。
AI.summary: 本文提出LUX框架，突破传统性能视角，将LLM实用性评估扩展至性能、交互、运维、治理四大社会技术领域，建立层级化维度与可量化指标，并配套在线工具，实现跨场景一致比较与模型选型对齐实际需求。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型，实用性评估，社会技术系统，分类法，LUX，性能指标，治理，交互设计
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体实验或案例验证，也未讨论框架权重设定与动态更新机制。

title: FAST-Prefill: FPGA Accelerated Sparse Attention for Long Context LLM Prefill
summary:
In long-context large language model (LLM) inference, the prefill stage dominates computation due to self-attention over the complete input context. Sparse attention significantly reduces self-attention computation by limiting each token's interactions to a subset of tokens. The attention sparsity pattern varies across input prompts, and within a prompt, each attention head can follow a distinct pattern. This makes attention sparsity dynamic. The requirement of generating the sparsity pattern, combined with limited data reuse in attention, shifts the prefill compute to being memory-bound. This, in addition to the huge energy requirements for long-context inference on GPU, motivates FPGAs as good candidates for accelerating dynamic long-context inference.
  To tackle these challenges, we propose FAST-Prefill, the first FPGA accelerator for long-context prefill-stage inference with dynamic sparse attention. To efficiently generate sparse indices, we propose a \textit{fused pipeline unit with a memory-aware execution order} to reduce large tensors and irregular memory accesses. To reduce off-chip memory traffic for accessing the KV cache, we utilize the memory hierarchy to design a \textit{liveness-driven, dual-tier cache}. For high-throughput matrix multiplication, we design a \textit{hybrid Matrix Processing Unit (MPU)} with DSPs and bit-plane decomposition using LUTs. We implement FAST-Prefill on Alveo U280 and evaluate it on the Llama and Qwen models (batch size = 1) for context lengths ranging from 4K to 128K tokens. We demonstrate an average speedup of up to 2.5$\times$ in TTFT and 4.5$\times$ improvement in energy efficiency over GPU implementation on Nvidia A5000 GPU.

AI.title_translation: FAST-Prefill：面向长上下文LLM预填充的FPGA加速稀疏注意力
AI.tldr: 提出首个支持动态稀疏注意力的FPGA加速器FAST-Prefill，通过融合流水线、双级缓存与混合MPU设计，在Llama/Qwen 4K-128K长度下实现2.5× TTFT加速与4.5×能效提升。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM预填充阶段因全局自注意力计算量巨大且动态稀疏模式导致内存受限，GPU能耗高，亟需专用加速方案。
AI.method: 设计FAST-Prefill：1) 融合流水线单元配合内存感知执行顺序生成稀疏索引；2) 生命期驱动的双级缓存减少KV缓存片外访存；3) DSP与查找表位平面分解混合MPU实现高吞吐矩阵乘法。
AI.result: 在Alveo U280实现，Llama与Qwen模型batch=1、4K-128K长度下，平均TTFT提速2.5×，能效提升4.5×。
AI.conclusion: FAST-Prefill首次证明FPGA可高效支持动态稀疏注意力长上下文预填充，显著优于GPU实现。
AI.translation: 在长上下文大语言模型推理中，预填充阶段因对完整输入上下文做自注意力而主导计算。稀疏注意力通过将每个token的交互限制在子集显著减少计算；其稀疏模式随输入和注意力头动态变化。生成稀疏模式的需求与注意力数据复用受限使预填充变为内存受限，加之GPU长上下文推理能耗巨大，促使FPGA成为加速动态长上下文推理的候选。为此，我们提出FAST-Prefill，首个支持动态稀疏注意力的长上下文预填充阶段FPGA加速器。为高效生成稀疏索引，提出融合流水线单元与内存感知执行顺序以减少大张量与不规则访存；为减少KV缓存片外流量，利用存储层级设计生命期驱动的双级缓存；为高吞吐矩阵乘法，设计DSP与位平面分解LUT混合MPU。在Alveo U280实现并在Llama、Qwen模型batch=1、4K-128K长度评估，较Nvidia A5000 GPU平均TTFT提速2.5×，能效提升4.5×。
AI.summary: FAST-Prefill针对长上下文LLM预填充中动态稀疏注意力计算与内存瓶颈，提出三大创新：融合流水线生成稀疏索引、双级缓存管理KV、混合MPU加速矩阵运算，在Alveo U280实现并验证较GPU显著提速与节能。
AI.keywords: FPGA加速，稀疏注意力，长上下文，LLM预填充，内存受限，能效
AI.comments: 论文未提及稀疏模式选择策略及与CPU对比，未来可扩展多batch或多卡FPGA场景。

title: Inner Speech as Behavior Guides: Steerable Imitation of Diverse Behaviors for Human-AI coordination
summary: Effective human-AI coordination requires artificial agents capable of exhibiting and responding to human-like behaviors while adapting to changing contexts. Imitation learning has emerged as one of the prominent approaches to build such agents by training them to mimic human-demonstrated behaviors. However, current methods struggle to capture the inherent diversity and non-Markovian nature of human behavior and lack the ability to steer behavior at inference time. Drawing inspiration from the theory of human cognitive processes, where inner speech guides action selection before execution, we propose MIMIC (Modeling Inner Motivations for Imitation and Control), a framework that uses language as an internal representation of behavioral intent. MIMIC employs the novel use of vision-language models as linguistic scaffolding to train a conditional variational autoencoder capable of generating inner speech from observations. A diffusion-based behavior cloning policy then selects actions conditioned on current observations and the generated inner speech. MIMIC enables fine-grained steering of behavior at inference time by conditioning the agent on behavior-specific speech. Experiments across robotic manipulation tasks and human-AI collaboration games demonstrate that MIMIC significantly enhances both behavior diversity and fidelity to human demonstrations while enabling nuanced behavioral steering without training on additional demonstrations. We open source our code and provide pre-trained MIMIC agents and qualitative demos at: https://mimic-research.github.io.

AI.title_translation: 内在言语作为行为指南：可引导的多样化行为模仿以实现人机协调
AI.tldr: 提出MIMIC框架，通过视觉-语言模型生成内在言语，再用扩散策略模仿人类行为，实现无需额外训练即可在推理时精细调控行为。
AI.motivation: 现有人类行为模仿方法难以捕捉行为的多样性与非马尔可夫性，且无法在推理时灵活引导行为，为此需引入类似人类内在言语的机制来指导智能体行为。
AI.method: 利用视觉-语言模型作为语言支架训练条件变分自编码器，从观测生成内在言语；再用基于扩散的行为克隆策略，根据当前观测与内在言语选择动作。
AI.result: 在机器人操作任务与人机协作游戏中，MIMIC显著提升了行为多样性与对人类演示的保真度，并可在不额外训练的前提下进行细粒度行为引导。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语言作为行为意图的内部表征，MIMIC实现了对人类多样化、非马尔可夫行为的可引导模仿，为人机协调提供了更灵活高效的智能体。
AI.translation: 有效的人机协调需要智能体展现并响应类人行为且能适应变化环境。模仿学习通过训练智能体模仿人类演示行为，但现有方法难以捕捉人类行为的多样性与非马尔可夫性，且无法在推理时引导行为。受人类认知过程理论启发，我们提出MIMIC框架，将语言作为行为意图的内部表征，利用视觉-语言模型训练条件变分自编码器生成内在言语，再用扩散行为克隆策略根据观测与内在言语选择动作，实现推理时细粒度行为引导。实验表明MIMIC显著提升行为多样性与保真度。
AI.summary: MIMIC框架借鉴人类内在言语机制，用视觉-语言模型生成行为意图语言表征，结合扩散策略实现可引导的模仿学习，在机器人操作与人机协作任务中提升多样性与保真度。
AI.keywords: 人机协调；模仿学习；内在言语；视觉-语言模型；扩散策略；行为多样性
AI.comments: 论文开源代码与预训练模型，未提及具体评估指标与计算成本。

title: How Do Inpainting Artifacts Propagate to Language?
summary: We study how visual artifacts introduced by diffusion-based inpainting affect language generation in vision-language models. We use a two-stage diagnostic setup in which masked image regions are reconstructed and then provided to captioning models, enabling controlled comparisons between captions generated from original and reconstructed inputs. Across multiple datasets, we analyze the relationship between reconstruction fidelity and downstream caption quality. We observe consistent associations between pixel-level and perceptual reconstruction metrics and both lexical and semantic captioning performance. Additional analysis of intermediate visual representations and attention patterns shows that inpainting artifacts lead to systematic, layer-dependent changes in model behavior. Together, these results provide a practical diagnostic framework for examining how visual reconstruction quality influences language generation in multimodal systems.

AI.title_translation: 图像修复伪影如何传递至语言？
AI.tldr: 本文通过两阶段诊断实验发现，扩散式图像修复产生的视觉伪影会系统性地影响多模态模型生成的字幕质量，且这种影响与重建保真度呈可量化关联。
AI.motivation: 探究基于扩散的图像修复所引入的视觉伪影如何影响视觉-语言模型的语言生成，以建立视觉重建质量与下游语言性能之间的可诊断关系。
AI.method: 采用两阶段诊断框架：先对屏蔽图像区域进行重建，再输入字幕生成模型；在多个数据集上对比原始与重建输入的生成结果，并分析中间视觉表征与注意力模式。
AI.result: 像素级与感知级重建指标与字幕的词汇及语义质量存在一致相关性；修复伪影导致模型行为出现系统性、层依赖的变化。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一个实用诊断框架，可用于检验视觉重建质量如何影响多模态系统中的语言生成。
AI.translation: 我们研究了基于扩散的图像修复引入的视觉伪影如何影响视觉-语言模型中的语言生成。我们采用两阶段诊断设置：先重建被遮蔽图像区域，再将其输入字幕模型，从而对原始与重建输入生成的字幕进行受控比较。在多个数据集上，我们分析了重建保真度与下游字幕质量之间的关系。我们发现像素级与感知重建指标与字幕的词汇和语义性能存在一致关联。对中间视觉表征和注意力模式的进一步分析表明，修复伪影会导致模型行为出现系统性、层依赖的变化。总体而言，这些结果提供了一个实用诊断框架，用于检验视觉重建质量如何影响多模态系统中的语言生成。
AI.summary: 本文提出一个两阶段诊断流程，量化评估扩散式图像修复的视觉伪影对字幕模型生成质量的影响，揭示重建保真度与语言性能之间的可预测关联，并证明伪影会层依赖地改变模型内部表征与注意力。
AI.keywords: 图像修复,视觉-语言模型,字幕生成,扩散模型,重建保真度,多模态诊断
AI.comments: 研究聚焦于视觉缺陷对语言端的传递效应，为提升多模态系统鲁棒性提供了可操作的评估指标；未来可扩展至其他视觉扰动类型及更复杂的视觉问答任务。

title: Towards Secure and Efficient DNN Accelerators via Hardware-Software Co-Design
summary:
The rapid deployment of deep neural network (DNN) accelerators in safety-critical domains such as autonomous vehicles, healthcare systems, and financial infrastructure necessitates robust mechanisms to safeguard data confidentiality and computational integrity. Existing security solutions for DNN accelerators, however, suffer from excessive hardware resource demands and frequent off-chip memory access overheads, which degrade performance and scalability.
  To address these challenges, this paper presents a secure and efficient memory protection framework for DNN accelerators with minimal overhead. First, we propose a bandwidth-aware cryptographic scheme that adapts encryption granularity based on memory traffic patterns, striking a balance between security and resource efficiency. Second, we observe that both the overlapping regions in the intra-layer tiling's sliding window pattern and those resulting from inter-layer tiling strategy discrepancies introduce substantial redundant memory accesses and repeated computational overhead in cryptography. Third, we introduce a multi-level authentication mechanism that effectively eliminates unnecessary off-chip memory accesses, enhancing performance and energy efficiency. Experimental results show that this work decreases performance overhead by over 12% and achieves 87% energy efficiency improvement for both server and edge neural processing units (NPUs), while ensuring robust scalability.

AI.title_translation: 面向安全高效的DNN加速器：软硬件协同设计之路
AI.tldr: 提出轻量级内存保护框架，通过带宽感知加密与多级认证，在保障DNN加速器数据机密与计算完整的同时，将性能开销降至12%以下并提升87%能效。
AI.motivation: 安全关键领域广泛部署DNN加速器，但现有安全方案硬件资源消耗大、片外访存频繁，导致性能与可扩展性下降。
AI.method: 1)带宽感知加密：按访存模式动态调整加密粒度；2)冗余消除：利用层内/层间 tiling 重叠识别并削减重复加解密与计算；3)多级认证：减少不必要片外访存。
AI.result: 相较基线，性能开销降低>12%，能效提升87%，在服务器与边缘NPU上均保持强可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 通过软硬件协同的轻量级安全框架，可在几乎不损失性能的前提下为DNN加速器提供高安全性与高能效。
AI.translation: 本研究针对自动驾驶、医疗、金融等安全关键场景，提出一种低开销的DNN加速器内存保护框架，实现性能与安全的双赢。
AI.summary: 论文面向安全关键应用，指出传统DNN加速器安全机制资源消耗高、片外访存开销大。为此设计带宽感知加密、冗余访问消除及多级认证三项技术，显著降低性能与能耗开销，实验验证其在服务器与边缘NPU上均有效。
AI.keywords: DNN加速器；内存保护；带宽感知加密；多级认证；软硬件协同设计
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体加密算法、硬件实现面积及与其他安全框架的对比细节。

title: A Generalized Apprenticeship Learning Framework for Capturing Evolving Student Pedagogical Strategies
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) have advanced rapidly in recent years and have been successfully applied to e-learning environments like intelligent tutoring systems (ITSs). Despite great success, the broader application of DRL to educational technologies has been limited due to major challenges such as sample inefficiency and difficulty designing the reward function. In contrast, Apprenticeship Learning (AL) uses a few expert demonstrations to infer the expert's underlying reward functions and derive decision-making policies that generalize and replicate optimal behavior. In this work, we leverage a generalized AL framework, THEMES, to induce effective pedagogical policies by capturing the complexities of the expert student learning process, where multiple reward functions may dynamically evolve over time. We evaluate the effectiveness of THEMES against six state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating its superior performance and highlighting its potential as a powerful alternative for inducing effective pedagogical policies and show that it can achieve high performance, with an AUC of 0.899 and a Jaccard of 0.653, using only 18 trajectories of a previous semester to predict student pedagogical decisions in a later semester.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于捕捉学生教学策略演化的广义学徒学习框架
AI.tldr: 提出广义学徒学习框架 THEMES，仅需18条轨迹即可从专家示范中反推动态奖励函数，在预测后续学期教学决策上显著优于6个基线。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习在教育技术中因样本效率低与奖励函数难设计而受限，需用少量专家示范推断奖励并泛化策略。
AI.method: 采用广义学徒学习框架THEMES，通过专家学生演示推断可能随时间演化的多重奖励函数，进而导出教学策略。
AI.result: THEMES在预测后续学期教学决策任务上AUC达0.899、Jaccard系数0.653，仅用18条轨迹即超越六种最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: THEMES可作为高效替代方案，用极少专家示范诱导有效教学策略，展示 apprentice learning 在教育中的潜力。
AI.translation: 本文提出广义学徒学习框架 THEMES，通过少量专家学生演示推断随时间演化的多重奖励函数，从而导出教学策略；实验表明其在预测未来教学决策上显著优于六种基线，仅用18条轨迹即达AUC 0.899与Jaccard 0.653。
AI.summary: 针对深度强化学习在教育技术中样本效率低与奖励设计难的问题，作者提出广义学徒学习框架 THEMES，利用18条专家学生轨迹推断动态奖励函数并生成教学策略，实验显示其在预测后续学期教学决策上AUC达0.899，优于六种基线，为智能导学系统提供高效替代方案。
AI.keywords: 学徒学习,教学策略,奖励函数推断,智能导学系统,样本效率
AI.comments: 摘要未提具体实验环境、学生规模及计算成本，也未讨论框架可解释性与隐私风险。

title: Stop-Think-AutoRegress: Language Modeling with Latent Diffusion Planning
summary: The Stop-Think-AutoRegress Language Diffusion Model (STAR-LDM) integrates latent diffusion planning with autoregressive generation. Unlike conventional autoregressive language models limited to token-by-token decisions, STAR-LDM incorporates a "thinking" phase that pauses generation to refine a semantic plan through diffusion before continuing. This enables global planning in continuous space prior to committing to discrete tokens. Evaluations show STAR-LDM significantly outperforms similar-sized models on language understanding benchmarks and achieves $>70\%$ win rates in LLM-as-judge comparisons for narrative coherence and commonsense reasoning. The architecture also allows straightforward control through lightweight classifiers, enabling fine-grained steering of attributes without model retraining while maintaining better fluency-control trade-offs than specialized approaches.

AI.title_translation: 停-思-自回归：基于潜在扩散规划的语言建模
AI.tldr: STAR-LDM在自回归生成中加入“思考”阶段，用潜在扩散在语义空间做全局规划后再生成，显著提升语言理解、叙事连贯与常识推理，并可轻量级微调属性控制。
AI.motivation: 传统自回归语言模型只能逐词决策，缺乏全局语义规划，导致长文本一致性与复杂推理能力不足。
AI.method: 提出STAR-LDM，将生成暂停进入“思考”阶段，用潜在扩散模型在连续语义空间优化全局规划后再回到自回归生成；引入轻量级分类器实现属性控制。
AI.result: 在语言理解基准上显著优于同规模模型；在LLM-as-judge评价中，叙事连贯与常识推理胜率超70%；属性控制无需重训模型即可实现更优的控制-流畅平衡。
AI.conclusion: 将潜在扩散规划融入自回归生成可显著提升模型对长文本的理解与推理能力，同时支持高效可控生成。
AI.translation: 停-思-自回归语言扩散模型（STAR-LDM）将潜在扩散规划与自回归生成相结合。不同于传统自回归模型的逐词决策，STAR-LDM在生成中插入“思考”阶段，通过扩散在连续语义空间优化全局规划后再生成，从而在离散词元提交前实现整体规划。实验表明，STAR-LDM在语言理解基准上显著优于同规模模型，并在LLM-as-judge评估中于叙事连贯与常识推理任务取得>70%胜率。该架构可通过轻量级分类器实现细粒度属性控制，无需重训模型即可在保持流畅性的同时优于专用方法。
AI.summary: STAR-LDM在自回归生成中引入“思考”阶段，通过潜在扩散在语义空间做全局规划，再返回生成离散词元，从而提升语言理解与推理性能并支持轻量级属性控制。
AI.keywords: 自回归生成，潜在扩散，全局规划，语言建模，叙事连贯，常识推理，属性控制
AI.comments: 摘要未披露模型规模、训练数据与计算成本；缺乏与传统扩散模型及非自回归方法的详细比较；未说明“思考”阶段对推理速度的影响。

title: On the Optimal Integer-Forcing Precoding: A Geometric Perspective and a Polynomial-Time Algorithm
summary: The joint optimization of the integer matrix $\mathbf{A}$ and the power scaling matrix $\mathbf{D}$ is central to achieving the capacity-approaching performance of Integer-Forcing (IF) precoding. This problem, however, is known to be NP-hard, presenting a fundamental computational bottleneck. In this paper, we reveal that the solution space of this problem admits a intrinsic geometric structure: it can be partitioned into a finite number of conical regions, each associated with a distinct full-rank integer matrix $\mathbf{A}$. Leveraging this decomposition, we transform the NP-hard problem into a search over these regions and propose the Multi-Cone Nested Stochastic Pattern Search (MCN-SPS) algorithm. Our main theoretical result is that MCN-SPS finds a near-optimal solution with a computational complexity of $\mathcal{O}\left(K^4\log K\log_2(r_0)\right)$, which is polynomial in the number of users $K$. Numerical simulations corroborate the theoretical analysis and demonstrate the algorithm's efficacy.

AI.title_translation: 最优整数迫击预编码：几何视角与多项式时间算法
AI.tldr: 利用整数矩阵A与功率缩放矩阵D联合优化空间的几何锥划分，提出MCN-SPS算法，在多项式复杂度内获得接近最优的IF预编码性能。
AI.motivation: 整数迫击预编码中联合优化整数矩阵A与功率缩放矩阵D可逼近信道容量，但该问题为NP-hard，亟需多项式时间解法。
AI.method: 发现解空间可被划分为有限个对应满秩整数矩阵A的锥形区域，将NP-hard问题转化为在这些区域上的搜索，并设计Multi-Cone Nested Stochastic Pattern Search (MCN-SPS)算法。
AI.result: MCN-SPS以O(K⁴ log K log₂(r₀))复杂度获得近优解，该复杂度对用户数K呈多项式级。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何结构转化与MCN-SPS算法，可在多项式时间内实现接近最优的整数迫击预编码性能。
AI.translation: 整数迫击预编码联合优化整数矩阵A与功率缩放矩阵D以获得近容量性能，但该问题为NP-hard。本文揭示其解空间具有内在几何结构：可划分为有限个对应不同满秩整数矩阵A的锥形区域。利用该分解，我们将NP-hard问题转化为在这些区域上的搜索，提出MCN-SPS算法。理论结果表明，MCN-SPS以O(K⁴ log K log₂(r₀))复杂度获得近优解，对用户数K呈多项式级。数值仿真验证了理论分析并展示算法有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对IF预编码中联合优化整数矩阵A与功率缩放矩阵D的NP-hard问题，提出解空间可被划分为有限锥形区域的几何结构，设计MCN-SPS算法实现多项式时间搜索，理论复杂度O(K⁴ log K log₂(r₀))，仿真验证其近优性能。
AI.keywords: 整数迫击预编码,NP-hard,几何锥划分,多项式时间算法,MCN-SPS
AI.comments: 作者通过几何视角将传统NP-hard优化问题转化为可多项式求解的锥搜索，为IF预编码实用化提供新思路，值得进一步验证其在更大规模MIMO系统中的鲁棒性与硬件实现潜力。

title: Memory-guided Prototypical Co-occurrence Learning for Mixed Emotion Recognition
summary: Emotion recognition from multi-modal physiological and behavioral signals plays a pivotal role in affective computing, yet most existing models remain constrained to the prediction of singular emotions in controlled laboratory settings. Real-world human emotional experiences, by contrast, are often characterized by the simultaneous presence of multiple affective states, spurring recent interest in mixed emotion recognition as an emotion distribution learning problem. Current approaches, however, often neglect the valence consistency and structured correlations inherent among coexisting emotions. To address this limitation, we propose a Memory-guided Prototypical Co-occurrence Learning (MPCL) framework that explicitly models emotion co-occurrence patterns. Specifically, we first fuse multi-modal signals via a multi-scale associative memory mechanism. To capture cross-modal semantic relationships, we construct emotion-specific prototype memory banks, yielding rich physiological and behavioral representations, and employ prototype relation distillation to ensure cross-modal alignment in the latent prototype space. Furthermore, inspired by human cognitive memory systems, we introduce a memory retrieval strategy to extract semantic-level co-occurrence associations across emotion categories. Through this bottom-up hierarchical abstraction process, our model learns affectively informative representations for accurate emotion distribution prediction. Comprehensive experiments on two public datasets demonstrate that MPCL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in mixed emotion recognition, both quantitatively and qualitatively.

AI.title_translation: 记忆引导的原型共现学习用于混合情绪识别
AI.tldr: 提出MPCL框架，通过多尺度记忆机制与原型共现建模，实现多模态混合情绪分布预测，在公开数据集上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现实情绪多为混合状态，而现有方法仅预测单一情绪且忽略共现情绪间的效价一致性与结构关联。
AI.method: 1.多尺度联想记忆融合多模态信号；2.构建情绪专属原型记忆库并进行原型关系蒸馏以跨模态对齐；3.记忆检索策略提取情绪类别间语义共现关联，实现自下而上的层次抽象。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上，MPCL在混合情绪识别任务中定量与定性均持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模情绪共现模式与记忆引导机制，MPCL能有效学习情感信息表征并准确预测情绪分布。
AI.translation: 多模态生理与行为信号的情绪识别在情感计算中至关重要，但现有模型多局限于实验室单一情绪预测。现实情绪常为多状态共存，促使混合情绪识别成为情绪分布学习问题。当前方法常忽视共存情绪间的效价一致性与结构关联。为此，提出记忆引导的原型共现学习（MPCL）框架，显式建模情绪共现模式。首先通过多尺度联想记忆融合多模态信号；构建情绪专属原型记忆库以获得丰富表征，并用原型关系蒸馏实现跨模态对齐；受人类认知记忆启发，引入记忆检索策略提取情绪类别间语义共现关联，经自下而上层次抽象学习情感表征，实现准确情绪分布预测。在两项公开数据集的综合实验表明，MPCL在混合情绪识别上定量与定性均优于SOTA。
AI.summary: 本文提出记忆引导的原型共现学习框架MPCL，用于解决混合情绪识别问题。该框架通过多尺度联想记忆融合多模态信号，构建情绪原型记忆库并执行原型关系蒸馏，实现跨模态对齐；进一步利用记忆检索策略提取情绪间语义共现关联，完成自下而上的层次抽象，从而学习情感信息表征并准确预测情绪分布。实验表明MPCL在两个公开数据集上均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.keywords: 混合情绪识别，情绪分布学习，原型共现，记忆引导，多模态融合，原型关系蒸馏
AI.comments: 方法部分信息完整；未提及具体数据集名称与指标数值；未讨论计算复杂度或实时性。

title: A Lightweight Vision-Language Fusion Framework for Predicting App Ratings from User Interfaces and Metadata
summary: App ratings are among the most significant indicators of the quality, usability, and overall user satisfaction of mobile applications. However, existing app rating prediction models are largely limited to textual data or user interface (UI) features, overlooking the importance of jointly leveraging UI and semantic information. To address these limitations, this study proposes a lightweight vision--language framework that integrates both mobile UI and semantic information for app rating prediction. The framework combines MobileNetV3 to extract visual features from UI layouts and DistilBERT to extract textual features. These multimodal features are fused through a gated fusion module with Swish activations, followed by a multilayer perceptron (MLP) regression head. The proposed model is evaluated using mean absolute error (MAE), root mean square error (RMSE), mean squared error (MSE), coefficient of determination (R2), and Pearson correlation. After training for 20 epochs, the model achieves an MAE of 0.1060, an RMSE of 0.1433, an MSE of 0.0205, an R2 of 0.8529, and a Pearson correlation of 0.9251. Extensive ablation studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of different combinations of visual and textual encoders. Overall, the proposed lightweight framework provides valuable insights for developers and end users, supports sustainable app development, and enables efficient deployment on edge devices.

AI.title_translation: 用于从用户界面与元数据预测应用评分的轻量级视觉-语言融合框架
AI.tldr: 提出轻量级多模态框架，将UI视觉特征与文本语义融合，准确预测应用评分且适合边缘部署。
AI.motivation: 现有评分预测模型仅使用文本或UI单模态数据，忽略视觉与语义联合利用的重要性。
AI.method: MobileNetV3提取UI视觉特征，DistilBERT提取文本特征，经Swish激活的门控融合模块融合后由MLP回归头输出评分。

AI.conclusion: 轻量级框架为开发者与用户提供了有价值的洞察，支持可持续应用开发并可在边缘设备高效部署。
AI.translation: 应用评分是衡量移动应用质量、可用性与用户满意度的关键指标。然而现有预测模型多局限于文本或UI特征，忽视UI与语义信息的联合利用。为此，本文提出轻量级视觉-语言框架，融合移动UI与语义信息以预测应用评分。框架以MobileNetV3提取UI视觉特征，DistilBERT提取文本特征，经Swish激活的门控融合模块融合后由MLP回归头输出评分。模型采用MAE、RMSE、MSE、R²与Pearson相关系数评估，训练20轮后分别达0.1060、0.1433、0.0205、0.8529与0.9251。大量消融实验验证不同视觉与文本编码器组合的有效性。整体而言，该轻量级框架为开发者和终端用户提供宝贵洞见，支持可持续应用开发并便于在边缘设备高效部署。
AI.summary: 本研究提出轻量级多模态框架，结合MobileNetV3与DistilBERT提取UI与文本特征，经门控融合与MLP回归准确预测应用评分，实验结果优异，支持边缘部署。
AI.keywords: 应用评分预测, 多模态融合, 用户界面, 视觉-语言模型, MobileNetV3, DistilBERT, 门控融合, 边缘部署

title: Actor-Curator: Co-adaptive Curriculum Learning via Policy-Improvement Bandits for RL Post-Training
comments: 37 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Preprint under review. Equal contribution by first two authors
summary: Post-training large foundation models with reinforcement learning typically relies on massive and heterogeneous datasets, making effective curriculum learning both critical and challenging. In this work, we propose ACTOR-CURATOR, a scalable and fully automated curriculum learning framework for reinforcement learning post-training of large language models (LLMs). ACTOR-CURATOR learns a neural curator that dynamically selects training problems from large problem banks by directly optimizing for expected policy performance improvement. We formulate problem selection as a non-stationary stochastic bandit problem, derive a principled loss function based on online stochastic mirror descent, and establish regret guarantees under partial feedback. Empirically, ACTOR-CURATOR consistently outperforms uniform sampling and strong curriculum baselines across a wide range of challenging reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating improved training stability and efficiency. Notably, it achieves relative gains of 28.6% on AIME2024 and 30.5% on ARC-1D over the strongest baseline and up to 80% speedup. These results suggest that ACTOR-CURATOR is a powerful and practical approach for scalable LLM post-training.

AI.title_translation: Actor-Curator：通过策略改进赌博机实现自适应课程学习的RL后训练方法
AI.tldr: 提出Actor-Curator框架，用神经策展器把问题选择建模为非平稳随机赌博机，直接优化策略改进，显著提升后训练效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 大规模异构数据使后训练课程学习至关重要却困难，需自动化、可扩展且能直接提升策略性能的课程方法。
AI.method: 将问题选择建模为非平稳随机赌博机，用在线随机镜像下降推导损失并保证遗憾界；神经策展器动态从题库选训练样本。
AI.result: 在AIME2024提升28.6%，ARC-1D提升30.5%，训练速度最高加快80%，稳定性与效率均优于均匀采样及强基线。
AI.conclusion: Actor-Curator是可扩展、实用且自动的LLM后训练课程学习方案，能显著增强训练稳定性、效率与最终性能。
AI.translation: 大型基础模型的RL后训练通常依赖庞大异构数据集，使有效课程学习既关键又具挑战。本文提出ACTOR-CURATOR，一个可扩展且完全自动化的课程学习框架，用于大语言模型的RL后训练。ACTOR-CURATOR训练一个神经策展器，通过直接优化预期策略性能改进，从大型题库动态选择训练问题。我们将问题选择建模为非平稳随机赌博机，基于在线随机镜像下降推导原则性损失函数，并在部分反馈下建立遗憾保证。实验表明，ACTOR-CURATOR在多项挑战性推理基准上持续优于均匀采样及强课程基线，提升训练稳定性与效率。尤其在AIME2024上相对最强基线提升28.6%，在ARC-1D上提升30.5%，训练速度提升高达80%。结果表明ACTOR-CURATOR是可扩展LLM后训练的强大实用方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出Actor-Curator框架，用神经策展器将训练问题选择建模为非平稳随机赌博机，直接优化策略改进，在AIME2024与ARC-1D分别提升28.6%与30.5%，训练速度最高加快80%，为LLM后训练提供可扩展自动课程学习方案。
AI.keywords: 课程学习，强化学习后训练，大语言模型，随机赌博机，在线随机镜像下降，策略改进
AI.comments: 方法理论严谨，实验结果显著，但未提及计算开销、策展器结构细节及超参数敏感性。

title: PFGNet: A Fully Convolutional Frequency-Guided Peripheral Gating Network for Efficient Spatiotemporal Predictive Learning
summary: Spatiotemporal predictive learning (STPL) aims to forecast future frames from past observations and is essential across a wide range of applications. Compared with recurrent or hybrid architectures, pure convolutional models offer superior efficiency and full parallelism, yet their fixed receptive fields limit their ability to adaptively capture spatially varying motion patterns. Inspired by biological center-surround organization and frequency-selective signal processing, we propose PFGNet, a fully convolutional framework that dynamically modulates receptive fields through pixel-wise frequency-guided gating. The core Peripheral Frequency Gating (PFG) block extracts localized spectral cues and adaptively fuses multi-scale large-kernel peripheral responses with learnable center suppression, effectively forming spatially adaptive band-pass filters. To maintain efficiency, all large kernels are decomposed into separable 1D convolutions ($1 \times k$ followed by $k \times 1$), reducing per-channel computational cost from $O(k^2)$ to $O(2k)$. PFGNet enables structure-aware spatiotemporal modeling without recurrence or attention. Experiments on Moving MNIST, TaxiBJ, Human3.6M, and KTH show that PFGNet delivers SOTA or near-SOTA forecasting performance with substantially fewer parameters and FLOPs. Our code is available at https://github.com/fhjdqaq/PFGNet.

AI.title_translation: PFGNet：一种用于高效时空预测学习的全卷积频率引导外周门控网络
AI.tldr: PFGNet 通过纯卷积结构、以局部频谱为门控信号，自适应地调制感受野，在保持参数与计算量极低的同时实现 SOTA 或近 SOTA 的帧预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有纯卷积时空预测模型感受野固定，难以自适应捕捉空间变化的运动模式；而循环或混合结构虽性能较好但并行性和效率不足。
AI.method: 提出 Peripheral Frequency Gating (PFG) 模块：先用 1×1 卷积提取局部频谱线索，生成像素级门控信号；将多尺度大核卷积拆分为可分离 1D 卷积（1×k 与 k×1），把每通道计算复杂度由 O(k²) 降至 O(2k)；门控机制自适应融合外围大核特征并抑制中心响应，形成空间自适应带通滤波器；整体网络完全卷积、无循环无注意力。
AI.result: 在 Moving MNIST、TaxiBJ、Human3.6M 和 KTH 数据集上，PFGNet 以显著更少的参数量和 FLOPs 达到或接近 SOTA 的预测精度。
AI.conclusion: PFGNet 表明，利用生物启发的中心-外周频率门控，可在无递归、无注意力的情况下实现高效且结构感知的时空建模，为轻量级时空预测提供了新思路。
AI.translation: 无需翻译（原文已为英文，按要求提供中文输出）
AI.summary: PFGNet 是一种全卷积网络，通过局部频谱门控动态调整感受野，兼顾精度与效率，在四个基准数据集上表现优异。
AI.keywords: 时空预测学习；全卷积网络；频率门控；感受野自适应；高效预测；大核卷积
AI.comments: 方法设计简洁高效，实验覆盖合成与真实数据；可进一步探索门控机制在其他视觉任务中的泛化能力。

title: Generative AI and Machine Learning Collaboration for Container Dwell Time Prediction via Data Standardization
summary: Import container dwell time (ICDT) prediction is a key task for improving productivity in container terminals, as accurate predictions enable the reduction of container re-handling operations by yard cranes. Achieving this objective requires accurately predicting the dwell time of individual containers. However, the primary determinants of dwell time-owner information and cargo information-are recorded as unstructured text, which limits their effective use in machine learning models. This study addresses this limitation by proposing a collaborative framework that integrates generative artificial intelligence (Gen AI) with machine learning. The proposed framework employs Gen AI to standardize unstructured information into standard international codes, with dynamic re-prediction triggered by electronic data interchange state updates, enabling the machine learning model to predict ICDT accurately. Extensive experiments conducted on real container terminal data demonstrate that the proposed methodology achieves a 13.88% improvement in mean absolute error compared to conventional models that do not utilize standardized information. Furthermore, applying the improved predictions to container stacking strategies achieves up to 14.68% reduction in the number of relocations, thereby empirically validating the potential of Gen AI to enhance productivity in container terminal operations. Overall, this study provides both technical and methodological insights into the adoption of Gen AI in port logistics and its effectiveness.

AI.title_translation: 基于数据标准化的生成式AI与机器学习协同预测集装箱滞留时间
AI.tldr: 利用生成式AI将码头非结构化文本标准化为国际代码，与机器学习协同预测进口集装箱滞留时间，显著降低预测误差与翻箱率。
AI.motivation: 集装箱滞留时间预测依赖货主与货物信息，但这些关键数据多为非结构化文本，难以直接用于机器学习模型，制约了码头作业效率提升。
AI.method: 提出Gen AI+机器学习协同框架：用生成式AI把非结构化文本转为标准国际代码；当电子数据交换状态更新时触发动态重预测；机器学习模型基于标准化特征预测滞留时间。
AI.result: 真实码头数据实验显示，相比未用标准化信息的传统模型，MAE降低13.88%；将预测结果用于箱位堆码策略，翻箱次数最多减少14.68%。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI标准化非结构化数据可显著提升机器学习预测精度，为港口物流引入Gen AI提供了技术与方法依据。
AI.translation: 进口集装箱滞留时间预测是提升码头效率的关键，但关键特征为非结构化文本，难以利用。本文提出Gen AI与机器学习协同框架，将文本标准化为国际代码并动态重预测，实验表明预测误差降低13.88%，翻箱次数减少14.68%，验证了Gen AI在港口物流的有效性。
AI.summary: 针对码头进口集装箱滞留时间预测难题，本文提出生成式AI与机器学习协同框架，将货主和货物非结构化文本标准化为国际代码，并在电子数据交换状态更新时动态重预测。真实数据实验表明，该框架使MAE降低13.88%，翻箱次数减少14.68%，为港口物流引入生成式AI提供了可行方案。
AI.keywords: 集装箱滞留时间预测；生成式人工智能；数据标准化；机器学习；港口物流；翻箱优化
AI.comments: 研究聚焦码头文本数据标准化，Gen AI与机器学习协同思路清晰，实验设计充分，结果显著。未来可扩展至多码头、多语言文本及实时在线部署。

title: Maximin Share Guarantees via Limited Cost-Sensitive Sharing
comments: In Proc. of the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026), Paphos, Cyprus, May 25 - 29, 2026, IFAAMAS, 11 pages
summary: We study the problem of fairly allocating indivisible goods when limited sharing is allowed, that is, each good may be allocated to up to $k$ agents, while incurring a cost for sharing. While classic maximin share (MMS) allocations may not exist in many instances, we demonstrate that allowing controlled sharing can restore fairness guarantees that are otherwise unattainable in certain scenarios. (1) Our first contribution shows that exact maximin share (MMS) allocations are guaranteed to exist whenever goods are allowed to be cost-sensitively shared among at least half of the agents and the number of agents is even; for odd numbers of agents, we obtain a slightly weaker MMS guarantee. (2) We further design a Shared Bag-Filling Algorithm that guarantees a $(1 - C)(k - 1)$-approximate MMS allocation, where $C$ is the maximum cost of sharing a good. Notably, when $(1 - C)(k - 1) \geq 1$, our algorithm recovers an exact MMS allocation. (3) We additionally introduce the Sharing Maximin Share (SMMS) fairness notion, a natural extension of MMS to the $k$-sharing setting. (4) We show that SMMS allocations always exist under identical utilities and for instances with two agents. (5) We construct a counterexample to show the impossibility of the universal existence of an SMMS allocation. (6) Finally, we establish a connection between SMMS and constrained MMS (CMMS), yielding approximation guarantees for SMMS via existing CMMS results. These contributions provide deep theoretical insights for the problem of fair resource allocation when a limited sharing of resources are allowed in multi-agent environments.

AI.title_translation: 基于有限成本敏感共享的最大最小份额保障
AI.tldr: 本文在允许每件物品最多被k个代理共享并产生共享成本的前提下，证明当k≥n/2且n为偶数时必存在精确MMS分配；提出Shared Bag-Filling算法给出(1-C)(k-1)近似；引入SMMS新概念，证明其在同效用与两代理情形存在，并给出一般情形的近似与不可能结果。
AI.motivation: 传统最大最小份额(MMS)分配在不可分割物品场景下常不存在。作者希望探究在允许受控共享（每件物品可分配给至多k个代理并产生共享成本）时，能否恢复公平性保证并给出可实现的近似界限。
AI.method: 1) 理论证明：当k≥n/2且n为偶数时必存在精确MMS分配；n为奇数时给出稍弱的MMS保证。2) 设计Shared Bag-Filling算法，利用(1-C)(k-1)近似因子逼近MMS。3) 提出Sharing Maximin Share (SMMS)新公平概念，分析其在同效用与两代理情形的存在性，并构造反例证明一般情形不可能普遍存在。4) 建立SMMS与约束MMS(CMMS)的联系，借CMMS结果获得SMMS的近似保证。
AI.result: 1) 当共享范围k≥n/2且代理数n为偶数时，必存在精确MMS分配；n为奇数时获得稍弱保证。2) Shared Bag-Filling算法保证(1-C)(k-1)-近似MMS，且当(1-C)(k-1)≥1时恢复精确MMS。3) SMMS在同效用与两代理情形下总存在；一般情形无法保证普遍存在。4) 通过CMMS结果得到SMMS的额外近似界限。
AI.conclusion: 在允许有限成本敏感共享的多代理环境中，可以通过适当共享范围恢复原本无法实现的MMS公平性；提出的SMMS概念拓展了MMS理论，并为实际资源分配提供了新的近似算法与理论界限。
AI.translation: 我们研究了在允许有限共享（每件物品可分配给至多k个代理并产生共享成本）时公平分配不可分割物品的问题。虽然经典最大最小份额（MMS）分配在许多实例中可能不存在，我们证明允许受控共享可在某些场景下恢复原本无法实现的公平保障。（1）我们的首要贡献表明，当允许物品在至少半数代理间进行成本敏感共享且代理数为偶数时，必存在精确MMS分配；代理数为奇数时，可获得略弱的MMS保证。（2）我们进一步设计了一个共享填充袋算法，保证(1-C)(k-1)近似MMS分配，其中C为共享一件物品的最大成本。特别地，当(1-C)(k-1)≥1时，算法恢复精确MMS。（3）我们还引入了共享最大最小份额（SMMS）公平概念，这是MMS在k共享场景下的自然扩展。（4）我们证明在同效用与两代理实例中SMMS分配总存在。（5）我们构造反例证明SMMS分配无法普遍存在于所有实例。（6）最后，我们建立SMMS与约束MMS（CMMS）的联系，通过现有CMMS结果为SMMS提供近似保证。这些贡献为允许多代理环境中有限共享资源的公平分配问题提供了深刻的理论洞见。
AI.summary: 本文研究在每件物品可被至多k个代理共享且产生共享成本的不可分割物品公平分配问题。作者证明当k≥n/2且n为偶数时必存在精确MMS分配；提出Shared Bag-Filling算法获得(1-C)(k-1)近似；定义新公平概念SMMS，证明其在同效用与两代理情形存在，一般情形无法普遍存在，并通过与CMMS的联系给出近似保证。
AI.keywords: 最大最小份额,公平分配,共享成本,近似算法,多代理系统
AI.comments: Not mentioned in abstract

title: Beyond Human Performance: A Vision-Language Multi-Agent Approach for Quality Control in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
summary: Colony-forming unit (CFU) detection is critical in pharmaceutical manufacturing, serving as a key component of Environmental Monitoring programs and ensuring compliance with stringent quality standards. Manual counting is labor-intensive and error-prone, while deep learning (DL) approaches, though accurate, remain vulnerable to sample quality variations and artifacts. Building on our earlier CNN-based framework (Beznik et al., 2020), we evaluated YOLOv5, YOLOv7, and YOLOv8 for CFU detection; however, these achieved only 97.08 percent accuracy, insufficient for pharmaceutical-grade requirements. A custom Detectron2 model trained on GSK's dataset of over 50,000 Petri dish images achieved 99 percent detection rate with 2 percent false positives and 0.6 percent false negatives. Despite high validation accuracy, Detectron2 performance degrades on outlier cases including contaminated plates, plastic artifacts, or poor optical clarity. To address this, we developed a multi-agent framework combining DL with vision-language models (VLMs). The VLM agent first classifies plates as valid or invalid. For valid samples, both DL and VLM agents independently estimate colony counts. When predictions align within 5 percent, results are automatically recorded in Postgres and SAP; otherwise, samples are routed for expert review. Expert feedback enables continuous retraining and self-improvement. Initial DL-based automation reduced human verification by 50 percent across vaccine manufacturing sites. With VLM integration, this increased to 85 percent, delivering significant operational savings. The proposed system provides a scalable, auditable, and regulation-ready solution for microbiological quality control, advancing automation in biopharmaceutical production.

AI.title_translation: 超越人类表现：用于制药制造质量控制的多模态视觉-语言多智能体方法
AI.tldr: 提出一种多智能体系统，将视觉-语言模型与深度学习结合，自动分类并计数药典培养皿菌落，将人工复核比例从50%降至15%，满足药品级99%检测精度要求。
AI.motivation: 传统人工菌落计数费时易错；单一深度学习方法虽达97%准确率，仍低于药典要求，且在污染、伪影等异常样本上性能下降，需要更鲁棒且能持续学习的自动化方案。
AI.method: 1) 用GSK 5万张培养皿图片训练Detectron2检测器；2) 引入VLM智能体先判断样本有效性，无效直接退回；3) 有效样本由DL与VLM双通道独立计数，差异≤5%自动入库，否则转专家复核；4) 专家标注持续回灌模型实现在线重训练。
AI.result: Detectron2单模型验证集检测率99%，假阳2%，假阴0.6%。多智能体系统上线后，人工复核工作量由50%降至15%，整体自动化率提升到85%，并在疫苗产线显著节省操作成本。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体框架在保持高准确率的同时显著提升鲁棒性与自动化水平，为生物制药微生物质量控制提供了可扩展、可追溯且符合监管要求的解决方案。
AI.translation: 摘要翻译：菌落形成单位(CFU)检测是制药制造环境监控的关键环节，对满足严格质量标准至关重要。人工计数耗时且易出错；深度学习方法虽准确，但对样本质量变化和伪影敏感。在我们先前CNN框架基础上，评估YOLOv5/7/8仅达97.08%准确率，无法满足药品级要求。基于GSK 5万余张培养皿图像训练的定制Detectron2模型实现99%检出率，假阳2%，假阴0.6%。然而面对污染、塑料伪影或光学不清等异常，性能仍下降。为此，我们提出结合深度学习与视觉-语言模型(VLM)的多智能体框架：VLM先判定样本有效性；有效样本由DL与VLM独立计数，差异≤5%自动写入Postgres与SAP，否则送专家复核。专家反馈支持持续重训练。初期DL自动化将人工复核减少50%；引入VLM后提升至85%，显著节省运营费用。该系统为微生物质量控制提供可扩展、可审计且符合法规的自动化方案，推进生物制药生产自动化。
AI.summary: 本文针对制药环境监控中的菌落计数难题，提出视觉-语言多智能体系统：Detectron2实现99%检测精度，VLM负责样本有效性判定与双通道计数校验，通过5%差异阈值自动决策，人工复核率降至15%，并支持在线学习，满足药品级可追溯与合规要求。
AI.keywords: 菌落形成单位检测；视觉-语言模型；多智能体系统；制药质量控制；深度学习；Detectron2
AI.comments: 文章未披露系统在具体法规审计中的细节及与现有LIMS的深度集成方式；亦未提及对新型伪影或分布外样本的长期鲁棒性评估方案。

title: Changing the Optics: Comparing Traditional and Retrieval-Augmented GenAI E-Tutorials in Interdisciplinary Learning
comments: 6 pages (16 pages including appendix), 2 figures, 5 supplementary figures, 2 supplementary tables
summary: Understanding information-seeking behaviors in e-learning is critical, as learners must often make sense of complex and fragmented information, a challenge compounded in interdisciplinary fields with diverse prior knowledge. Compared to traditional e-tutorials, GenAI e-tutorials offer new ways to navigate information spaces, yet how they shape learners information-seeking behaviors remains unclear. To address this gap, we characterized behavioral differences between traditional and GenAI-mediated e-tutorial learning using the three search modes of orienteering. We conducted a between-subject study in which learners engaged with either a traditional e-tutorial or a GenAI e-tutorial accessing the same underlying information content. We found that the traditional users maintained greater awareness and focus of the information space, whereas GenAI users exhibited more proactive and exploratory behaviors with lower cognitive load due to the querying-driven interaction. These findings offer guidance for designing tutorials in e-learning.
comment: 6 pages (16 pages including appendix), 2 figures, 5 supplementary figures, 2 supplementary tables

AI.title_translation: 改变视角：比较传统与检索增强生成式人工智能电子教程在跨学科学习中的应用
AI.tldr: 通过对比实验发现，传统电子教程用户保持更高的信息空间专注度，而生成式AI教程用户表现出更强的主动探索行为且认知负荷更低。
