title: Vision-Language Models for Ergonomic Assessment of Manual Lifting Tasks: Estimating Horizontal and Vertical Hand Distances from RGB Video
summary: Manual lifting tasks are a major contributor to work-related musculoskeletal disorders, and effective ergonomic risk assessment is essential for quantifying physical exposure and informing ergonomic interventions. The Revised NIOSH Lifting Equation (RNLE) is a widely used ergonomic risk assessment tool for lifting tasks that relies on six task variables, including horizontal (H) and vertical (V) hand distances; such distances are typically obtained through manual measurement or specialized sensing systems and are difficult to use in real-world environments. We evaluated the feasibility of using innovative vision-language models (VLMs) to non-invasively estimate H and V from RGB video streams. Two multi-stage VLM-based pipelines were developed: a text-guided detection-only pipeline and a detection-plus-segmentation pipeline. Both pipelines used text-guided localization of task-relevant regions of interest, visual feature extraction from those regions, and transformer-based temporal regression to estimate H and V at the start and end of a lift. For a range of lifting tasks, estimation performance was evaluated using leave-one-subject-out validation across the two pipelines and seven camera view conditions. Results varied significantly across pipelines and camera view conditions, with the segmentation-based, multi-view pipeline consistently yielding the smallest errors, achieving mean absolute errors of approximately 6-8 cm when estimating H and 5-8 cm when estimating V. Across pipelines and camera view configurations, pixel-level segmentation reduced estimation error by approximately 20-30% for H and 35-40% for V relative to the detection-only pipeline. These findings support the feasibility of VLM-based pipelines for video-based estimation of RNLE distance parameters.

AI.title_translation: 基于视觉-语言模型的手工抬举任务人体工学评估：从RGB视频估算水平与垂直手部距离
AI.tldr: 提出两种多阶段视觉-语言模型流程，可从普通RGB视频非侵入式估算抬举任务中的水平与垂直手部距离，平均误差约5-8厘米，验证了用深度学习替代人工测量的可行性。
AI.motivation: 手工抬举是工作相关肌肉骨骼疾病的主要来源，现行NIOSH抬举公式需测量水平与垂直手部距离，但人工或专用传感器难以在真实工作场景使用，亟需非接触、低成本的视频估算方案。
AI.method: 开发两种VLM流程：①仅检测流程；②检测+分割流程。两者均用文本提示定位关键区域，提取视觉特征，并以Transformer回归时序，估算抬举起止点的H/V距离；采用留一被试交叉验证，比较七种相机视角。
AI.result: 分割+多视角流程误差最小，H平均绝对误差约6-8 cm，V约5-8 cm；引入像素级分割可使H误差降20-30%，V误差降35-40%。不同视角与流程组合下结果差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 基于视觉-语言模型的视频估算可较准确获得NIOSH抬举公式的距离参数，为现场人体工学风险评估提供了一种非侵入、低成本的新途径。
AI.translation: 手工抬举任务是工作相关肌肉骨骼疾病的主要原因，有效的工效学风险评估对量化身体暴露和指导干预至关重要。修订版NIOSH抬举方程(RNLE)是广泛使用的评估工具，依赖六个任务变量，包括水平(H)和垂直(V)手部距离；这些距离通常需人工或专用传感系统测量，难以用于真实环境。我们评估了用创新视觉-语言模型(VLM)从RGB视频流非侵入式估算H和V的可行性。开发了两个多阶段VLM流程：文本引导的仅检测流程和检测+分割流程。两者均用文本引导定位任务相关区域，提取视觉特征，并以Transformer时序回归估算抬举起止点的H和V。对多种抬举任务进行留一被试验证，比较两种流程和七种相机视角。结果在流程和视角间差异显著，基于分割的多视角流程误差最小，H平均绝对误差约6-8 cm，V约5-8 cm。像素级分割使H误差降约20-30%，V误差降35-40%。研究支持VLM流程用于视频估算RNLE距离参数的可行性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出两种视觉-语言模型流程，通过普通RGB视频估算抬举任务中的水平与垂直手部距离，平均误差控制在5-8厘米，显著优于仅检测方法，为现场工效学风险评估提供了非接触、低成本的新工具。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型；抬举任务；人体工学评估；NIOSH抬举方程；手部距离估算；RGB视频；深度学习
AI.comments: 研究仅基于留一被试交叉验证，样本量和多样性未在摘要中说明；实际部署需验证复杂背景、遮挡及多人场景下的稳健性；误差虽较传统方法降低，但仍需结合不确定度量化以指导安全决策。

title: Recursive Belief Vision Language Model
summary: Current vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle with long-horizon manipulation under partial observability. Most existing approaches remain observation-driven, relying on short context windows or repeated queries to vision-language models (VLMs). This leads to loss of task progress, action repetition under perceptual aliasing, and high inference latency. Semantic reasoning alone is not the primary bottleneck in long-horizon manipulation. Instead, VLAs lack persistent, action-conditioned state representations and exhibit limited temporal and physical reasoning, making them ill-suited for multi-stage control. This paper introduces RB-VLA, a belief-centric architecture trained with self-supervised world-model objectives that maintains a compact latent state encoding task-relevant history, dynamics, and object interactions. Queried once for high-level intent, the VLM provides task specification, while the belief tracks task progress and enables phase-aware, causally grounded control under partial observability without storing raw observations or scaling memory with time. The belief and intent jointly condition a diffusion policy for robust closed-loop execution. RB-VLA outperforms prior VLAs on long-horizon benchmarks, achieving 52.5% and 37.5% higher success on multi-stage pick-and-place and stacking tasks, respectively, compared to π0. It also reduces inference latency by up to 5x relative to baselines and eliminates memory growth across timesteps observed in existing VLAs. Ablations show that the belief module is the primary driver of performance, increasing success rates from 32.5% to 77.5%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of belief-based state representations for long-horizon VLA policies.

AI.title_translation: 递归信念视觉语言模型
AI.tldr: 提出RB-VLA架构，用自监督世界模型维护隐式信念状态，解决部分可观下的长程操作难题，无需存储原始观测即可实现阶段感知控制，推理延迟降低5倍，成功率提升显著。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在长程操控中因缺乏持久状态表示，导致任务进度丢失、动作重复、推理延迟高，亟需一种能在部分可观环境下持续跟踪任务进展的方法。
AI.method: 构建以信念为中心的RB-VLA：自监督训练世界模型生成紧凑隐状态，融合VLM一次性高层意图，信念与意图共同条件扩散策略，实现闭环执行，无需随时间扩展内存。
AI.result: RB-VLA在多阶段拾取放置与堆叠任务上分别比π0提高52.5%和37.5%成功率，推理延迟最高降低5倍，且内存不随时间步增长；消融显示信念模块将成功率从32.5%提升至77.5%。
AI.conclusion: 基于信念的状态表示显著增强长程VLA策略的性能与效率，验证了信念模块在长程操控中的关键作用。
AI.translation: 当前视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在部分可观条件下难以完成长程操控。大多数方法仍依赖观测驱动，使用短上下文窗口或反复查询视觉语言模型(VLM)，导致任务进度丢失、感知混淆下动作重复及高推理延迟。语义推理并非长程操控的主要瓶颈；相反，VLA缺乏持久的动作条件状态表示，时序与物理推理有限，难以进行多阶段控制。本文提出RB-VLA，一种以信念为中心的架构，通过自监督世界模型目标训练，维护紧凑的隐状态，编码任务相关历史、动力学与物体交互。VLM仅一次性查询以提供高层意图，信念则跟踪任务进度，实现部分可观下的阶段感知、因果控制，无需存储原始观测或随时间扩展内存。信念与意图共同条件扩散策略，实现鲁棒闭环执行。RB-VLA在长程基准上优于先前VLA，多阶段拾取放置与堆叠任务成功率分别比π0提高52.5%和37.5%，推理延迟相对基线降低最高5倍，并消除现有VLA随时间步增长的内存开销。消融实验表明信念模块是性能提升主因，成功率从32.5%升至77.5%。结果证明基于信念的状态表示对长程VLA策略的有效性。
AI.summary: RB-VLA通过自监督世界模型维护隐式信念状态，一次性融合VLM高层意图，实现部分可观环境下的长程操控，显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言动作模型,信念状态,长程操控,部分可观,自监督世界模型,扩散策略
AI.comments: 信念模块的引入巧妙解决了VLA的内存与推理瓶颈，实验设计充分，未来可探索更复杂的动态环境及多智能体协作场景。

title: TOM: A Ternary Read-only Memory Accelerator for LLM-powered Edge Intelligence
summary: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) for real-time intelligence on edge devices is rapidly growing. However, conventional hardware architectures face a fundamental memory wall challenge, where limited on-device memory capacity and bandwidth severely constrain the size of deployable models and their inference speed, while also limiting on-device adaptation. To address this challenge, we propose TOM, a hybrid ROM-SRAM accelerator co-designed with ternary quantization, which balances extreme density with on-device tunability. TOM exploits the synergy between ternary quantization and ROM to achieve extreme memory density and bandwidth, while preserving flexibility through a hybrid ROM-SRAM architecture designed for QLoRA-based tunability. Specifically, we introduce: (1) a sparsity-aware ROM architecture that synthesizes ternary weights as standard-cell logic, eliminating area overhead from zero-valued bits; (2) a distributed processing architecture that co-locates high-density ROM banks with flexible SRAM-based QLoRA adapters and compute units; and (3) a workload-aware dynamic power gating scheme that exploits the logic-based nature of ROM to power down inactive banks, minimizing dynamic energy consumption. TOM achieves an inference throughput of 3,306 TPS using BitNet-2B model, demonstrating its effectiveness in delivering real-time, energy-efficient edge intelligence.

AI.title_translation: TOM：面向大模型边缘智能的三值只读存储加速器
AI.tldr: TOM 通过将三值量化权重直接综合为标准单元逻辑，在 ROM 中实现超高密度存储，同时用 SRAM 缓存 QLoRA 适配器，实现边缘端大模型高效推理与微调。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备内存容量与带宽严重限制大语言模型部署规模、推理速度及本地微调能力，需突破传统内存墙。
AI.method: 提出混合 ROM-SRAM 加速器 TOM：1) 将三值权重中零值位直接综合为逻辑消除存储开销；2) 高密度 ROM 与 SRAM 缓存的 QLoRA 适配器及计算单元共置；3) 基于逻辑的 ROM 动态电源门控降低能耗。
AI.result: 在 BitNet-2B 模型上实现 3,306 TPS 推理吞吐，验证其在实时、高能效边缘智能中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TOM 通过三值量化与 ROM-SRAM 协同设计，在极高存储密度下仍保留本地微调灵活性，显著突破边缘内存墙。
AI.translation: TOM：面向大模型边缘智能的三值只读存储加速器
AI.summary: TOM 将三值量化权重直接映射为 ROM 逻辑，消除零值位面积开销，并用 SRAM 缓存 QLoRA 适配器，实现高密度、可微调的边缘大模型加速器，在 BitNet-2B 上达 3,306 TPS。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型；边缘智能；三值量化；只读存储；内存墙；QLoRA；加速器

title: ICSSPulse: A Modular LLM-Assisted Platform for Industrial Control System Penetration Testing
summary: It is well established that industrial control systems comprise the operational backbone of modern critical infrastructures, yet their increasing connectivity exposes them to cyber threats that are difficult to study and remedy safely under real-time operational conditions. In this paper, we present ICSSPulse, an open-source, modular, and extensible penetration testing platform designed for the security assessment of ICS communication protocols. To the best of our knowledge, ICSSPulse is the first web-based platform that unifies network scanning, protocol-aware Modbus and OPC~UA interaction, and Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted reporting within a single, lightweight ecosystem. Our platform provides a user-friendly graphical interface that orchestrates enumeration, exploitation, and reporting activities over simulated industrial services, enabling safe and reproducible experimentation. It supports protocol-level discovery, asset enumeration, and controlled read/write interactions, while preserving protocol fidelity and operational transparency. Experimental evaluation using synthetic Modbus test servers, a Factory I/O water treatment scenario, and a custom OPC~UA production-line model demonstrated ICSSPulse's potential to discover active industrial services, enumerate process-relevant assets, and manipulate process variables. A key contribution of this work lies in the integration of an LLM-assisted reporting module that automatically translates technical findings into structured executive and technical reports, with mitigation guidance informed by the ICS MITRE ATT&CK ICS matrix.

AI.title_translation: ICSSPulse：面向工业控制系统渗透测试的模块化大语言模型辅助平台
AI.tldr: 首个开源、模块化、Web 端的 ICS 渗透测试平台，集成网络扫描、Modbus/OPC UA 协议交互与 LLM 自动报告，可在仿真环境中安全评估工控安全。
AI.motivation: 工业控制系统作为关键基础设施的骨干，其日益增长的互联性使其面临难以在生产环境中安全研究的网络威胁，亟需可重复、安全的测试平台。
AI.method: 提出 ICSSPulse 平台：采用模块化、Web 架构，统一实现网络扫描、协议感知 Modbus 与 OPC UA 交互、LLM 辅助报告生成，并在模拟的工业服务（Modbus 测试服务器、Factory I/O 水处场景、自定义 OPC UA 产线模型）上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验表明平台能发现活跃工业服务、枚举过程相关资产并读写过程变量；LLM 模块可自动将技术发现转化为含缓解建议的执行与技术报告，且符合 MITRE ATT&CK for ICS。
AI.conclusion: ICSSPulse 为工控安全评估提供了轻量、可扩展、可重现的一站式解决方案，其 LLM 报告功能显著降低后期分析门槛，有助于提升关键基础设施安全。
AI.translation: 本文提出 ICSSPulse——一个开源、模块化、基于 Web 的工业控制系统渗透测试平台，首次将网络扫描、协议感知 Modbus 与 OPC UA 交互及大语言模型辅助报告整合于轻量级生态。平台通过图形界面在仿真工业服务上协调枚举、利用与报告，支持协议级发现、资产枚举与受控读写，保持协议保真与操作透明。实验验证其能在合成 Modbus 服务器、Factory I/O 水处场景及自定义 OPC UA 产线模型中发现服务、枚举资产并操控过程变量；LLM 模块自动输出符合 MITRE ATT&CK for ICS 的结构化报告与缓解建议。
AI.summary: ICSSPulse 是首个融合 LLM 的 Web 端 ICS 渗透测试平台，提供网络扫描、Modbus/OPC UA 协议交互与自动报告功能，可在仿真环境中安全、可重复地评估工控安全，实验验证其有效发现资产并操控变量，LLM 自动生成含缓解建议的报告。

title: AnimeAgent: Is the Multi-Agent via Image-to-Video models a Good Disney Storytelling Artist?
summary: Custom Storyboard Generation (CSG) aims to produce high-quality, multi-character consistent storytelling. Current approaches based on static diffusion models, whether used in a one-shot manner or within multi-agent frameworks, face three key limitations: (1) Static models lack dynamic expressiveness and often resort to "copy-paste" pattern. (2) One-shot inference cannot iteratively correct missing attributes or poor prompt adherence. (3) Multi-agents rely on non-robust evaluators, ill-suited for assessing stylized, non-realistic animation. To address these, we propose AnimeAgent, the first Image-to-Video (I2V)-based multi-agent framework for CSG. Inspired by Disney's "Combination of Straight Ahead and Pose to Pose" workflow, AnimeAgent leverages I2V's implicit motion prior to enhance consistency and expressiveness, while a mixed subjective-objective reviewer enables reliable iterative refinement. We also collect a human-annotated CSG benchmark with ground-truth. Experiments show AnimeAgent achieves SOTA performance in consistency, prompt fidelity, and stylization.

AI.title_translation: AnimeAgent：基于图像到视频的多智能体能否成为优秀的迪士尼故事讲述者？
AI.tldr: 提出首个基于图像到视频（I2V）的多智能体框架AnimeAgent，用于生成高质量、多角色一致的自定义故事板，通过混合主客观评审迭代优化，克服静态扩散模型在动态表达、属性修正和风格化评估上的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有静态扩散模型在自定义故事板生成中存在三大缺陷：缺乏动态表达、一次性推理无法迭代修正、多智能体评估器对非真实动画不可靠，亟需利用I2V动态先验并引入更鲁棒的评估机制。
AI.method: 构建AnimeAgent多智能体系统，借鉴迪士尼“ Straight Ahead 与 Pose to Pose 结合”流程，利用I2V隐式运动先验提升一致性与表现力，并设计混合主客观评审器实现迭代精修，同时建立带人工标注的CSG基准。
AI.result: 实验表明，AnimeAgent在一致性、提示忠实度和风格化指标上均达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 将I2V引入多智能体故事板生成，配合混合评审迭代，可显著突破静态模型的动态与评估瓶颈，实现高质量动画故事创作。
AI.translation: 将I2V动态先验与多智能体协作结合，通过混合评审迭代优化，首次在CSG任务中实现媲美迪士尼水准的动画故事生成。
AI.summary: 本文提出AnimeAgent，首个基于图像到视频的多智能体框架，用于生成多角色一致的动画故事板。该方法利用I2V隐式运动先验增强动态表达，并引入混合主客观评审器进行迭代修正，克服静态扩散模型在动态性、属性修正与风格评估上的不足。实验在自建人工标注基准上验证其SOTA性能。
AI.keywords: 自定义故事板生成；图像到视频；多智能体；动画生成；迭代优化；风格化评估
AI.comments: 摘要未提及运行效率、计算开销及用户交互细节，未来可探索实时性与更细粒度的角色控制。

title: BoxSplitGen: A Generative Model for 3D Part Bounding Boxes in Varying Granularity
summary: Human creativity follows a perceptual process, moving from abstract ideas to finer details during creation. While 3D generative models have advanced dramatically, models specifically designed to assist human imagination in 3D creation -- particularly for detailing abstractions from coarse to fine -- have not been explored. We propose a framework that enables intuitive and interactive 3D shape generation by iteratively splitting bounding boxes to refine the set of bounding boxes. The main technical components of our framework are two generative models: the box-splitting generative model and the box-to-shape generative model. The first model, named BoxSplitGen, generates a collection of 3D part bounding boxes with varying granularity by iteratively splitting coarse bounding boxes. It utilizes part bounding boxes created through agglomerative merging and learns the reverse of the merging process -- the splitting sequences. The model consists of two main components: the first learns the categorical distribution of the box to be split, and the second learns the distribution of the two new boxes, given the set of boxes and the indication of which box to split. The second model, the box-to-shape generative model, is trained by leveraging the 3D shape priors learned by an existing 3D diffusion model while adapting the model to incorporate bounding box conditioning. In our experiments, we demonstrate that the box-splitting generative model outperforms token prediction models and the inpainting approach with an unconditional diffusion model. Also, we show that our box-to-shape model, based on a state-of-the-art 3D diffusion model, provides superior results compared to a previous model.

AI.title_translation: BoxSplitGen：面向可变粒度三维部件包围盒的生成模型
AI.tldr: 提出BoxSplitGen框架，通过迭代分割包围盒实现从粗到细的三维部件生成，并配合box-to-shape模型将包围盒转为精细形状，优于token预测与无条件扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 现有三维生成模型未专门支持人类“由抽象到细节”的创作流程，缺乏可交互、可逐步细化的三维生成工具。
AI.method: 1) 构建BoxSplitGen：用聚合合并生成训练数据，学习其逆过程（分裂序列），分两阶段网络预测被分割盒及新盒分布；2) 构建box-to-shape模型：在现成三维扩散模型基础上引入包围盒条件进行微调。
AI.result: BoxSplitGen在部件包围盒生成任务上优于token预测基线与无条件扩散修复方法；box-to-shape模型在形状生成质量上超越先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过“分步分割包围盒+条件扩散”策略，可有效模拟人类由粗到细的创造过程，实现交互式三维建模。
AI.translation: 人类创作遵循从抽象到细节的感知过程。尽管三维生成模型已显著进步，但专门支持三维创作中“由粗到细”想象的模型尚未被探索。我们提出一个框架，通过迭代分割包围盒来细化部件盒，实现直观交互的三维形状生成。核心包括两个生成模型：BoxSplitGen通过迭代分割粗盒生成多粒度部件盒；box-to-shape模型在现有三维扩散模型基础上加入盒条件。实验表明BoxSplitGen优于token预测与无条件扩散修复，box-to-shape模型也优于前人工作。
AI.summary: BoxSplitGen框架模拟人类创作流程，先由BoxSplitGen迭代分割包围盒生成不同粒度部件，再由条件扩散模型将盒转为精细形状，实验验证其在部件与形状生成上均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 三维生成，包围盒分割，生成模型，扩散模型，交互式建模
AI.comments: 摘要未披露代码、数据集与具体评价指标，亦未讨论计算开销与交互细节。

title: CAMEL: Confidence-Gated Reflection for Reward Modeling
summary: Reward models play a fundamental role in aligning large language models with human preferences. Existing methods predominantly follow two paradigms: scalar discriminative preference models, which are efficient but lack interpretability, and generative judging models, which offer richer reasoning at the cost of higher computational overhead. We observe that the log-probability margin between verdict tokens strongly correlates with prediction correctness, providing a reliable proxy for instance difficulty without additional inference cost. Building on this insight, we propose CAMEL, a confidence-gated reflection framework that performs a lightweight single-token preference decision first and selectively invokes reflection only for low-confidence instances. To induce effective self-correction, we train the model via reinforcement learning with counterfactual prefix augmentation, which exposes the model to diverse initial verdicts and encourages genuine revision. Empirically, CAMEL achieves state-of-the-art performance on three widely used reward-model benchmarks with 82.9% average accuracy, surpassing the best prior model by 3.2% and outperforming 70B-parameter models using only 14B parameters, while establishing a strictly better accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier.

AI.title_translation: CAMEL：基于置信度门控的奖励模型反思机制
AI.tldr: 提出CAMEL框架，先做单令牌偏好判断，仅对低置信度样本触发反思，用反事实前缀增强的强化学习训练，在14B参数下达到82.9%平均准确率，超越70B模型。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励模型要么高效但不可解释（标量判别），要么可解释但计算昂贵（生成式评判），需要一种兼顾准确率与效率的新方法。
AI.method: 利用判决令牌间对数概率差作为实例难度代理；先做单令牌偏好决策，置信度低时再触发反思；通过反事实前缀增强的强化学习训练模型进行自我修正。
AI.result: 在三个主流奖励模型基准上平均准确率达82.9%，比之前最佳模型高3.2%；仅用14B参数就超越70B模型，构建出更优的准确率–效率帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: CAMEL通过置信度门控反思，在几乎不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升奖励模型性能，实现更小模型超越大模型的效果。
AI.translation: 奖励模型在将大语言模型与人类偏好对齐中起核心作用。现有方法主要分两类：标量判别式偏好模型高效但缺乏可解释性；生成式评判模型提供丰富推理却计算开销大。我们发现判决令牌间的对数概率差与预测正确性强相关，可在无需额外推理成本的情况下可靠反映实例难度。基于此，我们提出CAMEL——置信度门控反思框架：先进行轻量级单令牌偏好决策，仅对低置信度实例触发反思。为诱导有效自纠，我们采用反事实前缀增强的强化学习训练，使模型接触多样初始判决并鼓励真实修正。实验显示，CAMEL在三大奖励模型基准上达82.9%平均准确率，比之前最佳模型高3.2%，以14B参数超越70B模型，建立更优的准确率–效率帕累托前沿。
AI.summary: CAMEL框架通过单令牌置信度判断+低置信度反思的两级策略，在14B参数规模下实现超越70B模型的奖励模型性能，刷新准确率–效率权衡纪录。
AI.keywords: 奖励模型，偏好对齐，置信度门控，反思机制，强化学习，反事实增强
AI.comments: 未提及具体使用的强化学习算法细节及反事实前缀的构造方式。

title: Bikelution: Federated Gradient-Boosting for Scalable Shared Micro-Mobility Demand Forecasting
summary: The rapid growth of dockless bike-sharing systems has generated massive spatio-temporal datasets useful for fleet allocation, congestion reduction, and sustainable mobility. Bike demand, however, depends on several external factors, making traditional time-series models insufficient. Centralized Machine Learning (CML) yields high-accuracy forecasts but raises privacy and bandwidth issues when data are distributed across edge devices. To overcome these limitations, we propose Bikelution, an efficient Federated Learning (FL) solution based on gradient-boosted trees that preserves privacy while delivering accurate mid-term demand forecasts up to six hours ahead. Experiments on three real-world BSS datasets show that Bikelution is comparable to its CML-based variant and outperforms the current state-of-the-art. The results highlight the feasibility of privacy-aware demand forecasting and outline the trade-offs between FL and CML approaches.

AI.title_translation: Bikelution：面向共享微出行需求预测的可扩展联邦梯度提升方法
AI.tldr: 提出联邦梯度提升树框架Bikelution，在不集中原始数据的前提下实现6小时内高精度的共享单车需求预测。
AI.motivation: 无桩共享单车产生海量时空数据，但需求受多因素影响，传统时序模型不足；集中式机器学习虽准却带来隐私与带宽问题，需要一种兼顾隐私与预测性能的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用基于梯度提升树的联邦学习架构，各客户端本地训练并仅上传模型参数，中央服务器聚合更新，实现隐私保护的联合建模。
AI.result: 在三个真实共享单车系统数据集上，Bikelution的预测精度与集中式版本相当，并优于现有最佳方法，验证了隐私感知需求预测的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明联邦学习与集中式学习在需求预测任务上可取得相近性能，为隐私敏感场景提供了可行方案，并揭示了两种范式在精度、通信与隐私间的权衡。
AI.translation: 无桩共享单车系统迅速扩张，产生海量可用于车队调配、缓解拥堵与可持续出行的时空数据。然而单车需求受多种外部因素影响，传统时序模型难以胜任。集中式机器学习预测准确却带来隐私与带宽问题。为此，我们提出Bikelution——一种基于梯度提升树的高效联邦学习方案，在保护隐私的同时实现最多提前六小时的准确中期需求预测。在三个真实共享单车数据集的实验表明，Bikelution性能与集中式版本相当，并优于现有最佳方法，结果凸显了隐私感知需求预测的可行性，并勾勒出联邦与集中式方法的权衡。
AI.summary: Bikelution将联邦梯度提升树应用于共享单车需求预测，可在6小时内提供高精度预测，无需集中原始数据，实验显示其与集中式模型精度相当并超越现有最佳方法，为隐私敏感的大规模微出行预测提供可行方案。
AI.keywords: 共享单车，需求预测，联邦学习，梯度提升树，隐私保护
AI.comments: 摘要未提及通信开销、客户端异构处理及实际部署细节。

title: BBQ-to-Image: Numeric Bounding Box and Qolor Control in Large-Scale Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image models have rapidly advanced in realism and controllability, with recent approaches leveraging long, detailed captions to support fine-grained generation. However, a fundamental parametric gap remains: existing models rely on descriptive language, whereas professional workflows require precise numeric control over object location, size, and color. In this work, we introduce BBQ, a large-scale text-to-image model that directly conditions on numeric bounding boxes and RGB triplets within a unified structured-text framework. We obtain precise spatial and chromatic control by training on captions enriched with parametric annotations, without architectural modifications or inference-time optimization. This also enables intuitive user interfaces such as object dragging and color pickers, replacing ambiguous iterative prompting with precise, familiar controls. Across comprehensive evaluations, BBQ achieves strong box alignment and improves RGB color fidelity over state-of-the-art baselines. More broadly, our results support a new paradigm in which user intent is translated into an intermediate structured language, consumed by a flow-based transformer acting as a renderer and naturally accommodating numeric parameters.

AI.title_translation: BBQ-to-Image：大规模文本到图像模型中的数值边界框与颜色控制
AI.tldr: 提出BBQ模型，直接在统一结构化文本框架内以数值边界框和RGB三元组为条件，实现无需架构改动的精准空间与颜色控制。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型依赖描述性语言，无法满足专业工作流对物体位置、尺寸及颜色的精确数值控制需求。
AI.method: 通过在描述文本中注入参数化标注进行训练，使模型在统一结构化文本框架内直接以数值边界框和RGB三元组为条件生成图像。
AI.result: BBQ在边界框对齐与RGB颜色保真度上均优于现有最佳基线，并支持拖拽物体和取色器等直观界面。
AI.conclusion: 将用户意图转化为中间结构化语言并由流式Transformer渲染的新范式，可自然容纳数值参数，实现精准控制。
AI.translation: 文本到图像模型在逼真度和可控性上迅速提升，但现有方法依赖描述性语言，而专业流程需对物体位置、大小和颜色进行精确数值控制。本文提出BBQ，在统一结构化文本框架内直接以数值边界框和RGB三元组为条件，无需修改架构或推理优化即可实现精准空间与颜色控制，并支持拖拽和取色器等直观界面，显著提升边界框对齐和颜色保真度。
AI.summary: BBQ模型通过在描述文本中嵌入数值边界框和RGB值，实现专业级的精准空间与颜色控制，无需改动模型架构或推理优化，支持直观交互界面，并在对齐与色彩保真度上超越现有最佳方法。
AI.keywords: 文本到图像生成，边界框控制，颜色控制，结构化文本，精确参数控制
AI.comments: 该工作展示了将数值参数直接融入语言模型条件输入的可行性，为专业设计场景提供了高效、精准的图像生成方案。

title: GA-Drive: Geometry-Appearance Decoupled Modeling for Free-viewpoint Driving Scene Generatio
summary: A free-viewpoint, editable, and high-fidelity driving simulator is crucial for training and evaluating end-to-end autonomous driving systems. In this paper, we present GA-Drive, a novel simulation framework capable of generating camera views along user-specified novel trajectories through Geometry-Appearance Decoupling and Diffusion-Based Generation. Given a set of images captured along a recorded trajectory and the corresponding scene geometry, GA-Drive synthesizes novel pseudo-views using geometry information. These pseudo-views are then transformed into photorealistic views using a trained video diffusion model. In this way, we decouple the geometry and appearance of scenes. An advantage of such decoupling is its support for appearance editing via state-of-the-art video-to-video editing techniques, while preserving the underlying geometry, enabling consistent edits across both original and novel trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GA-Drive substantially outperforms existing methods in terms of NTA-IoU, NTL-IoU, and FID scores.

AI.title_translation: GA-Drive：用于自由视角驾驶场景生成的几何-外观解耦建模
AI.tldr: GA-Drive通过将几何与外观解耦，先用几何信息合成伪视角，再用视频扩散模型生成真实视图，实现可编辑、高保真的自由视角驾驶模拟。
AI.motivation: 训练与评估端到端自动驾驶系统亟需可自由视角、可编辑且高保真的驾驶模拟器，但现有方法在视角一致性与编辑灵活性上不足。
AI.method: 1) 利用输入图像与对应场景几何合成新伪视角；2) 用训练好的视频扩散模型将伪视角转化为真实视图；3) 通过几何-外观解耦支持视频到视频编辑，保持几何一致。
AI.result: 在NTA-IoU、NTL-IoU和FID指标上，GA-Drive显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 几何-外观解耦策略可在保持场景几何一致的同时实现外观编辑，GA-Drive为自动驾驶仿真提供了高保真、可编辑的自由视角生成方案。
AI.translation: 我们提出GA-Drive，它通过几何-外观解耦与基于扩散的生成，沿用户指定轨迹合成新视角，实现可编辑的高保真驾驶场景模拟。
AI.summary: GA-Drive先利用几何信息生成伪视角，再用视频扩散模型转为真实视图，实现自由视角、可编辑的驾驶场景生成，性能优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 自由视角生成；驾驶模拟；几何-外观解耦；视频扩散模型；自动驾驶仿真；外观编辑
AI.comments: 摘要未披露训练数据规模、扩散模型细节及实时性能，未来可探索更高效的神经渲染或压缩策略以提升速度。

title: PRECTR-V2:Unified Relevance-CTR Framework with Cross-User Preference Mining, Exposure Bias Correction, and LLM-Distilled Encoder Optimization
comments: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2503.18395
summary: In search systems, effectively coordinating the two core objectives of search relevance matching and click-through rate (CTR) prediction is crucial for discovering users' interests and enhancing platform revenue. In our prior work PRECTR, we proposed a unified framework to integrate these two subtasks,thereby eliminating their inconsistency and leading to mutual benefit.However, our previous work still faces three main challenges. First, low-active users and new users have limited search behavioral data, making it difficult to achieve effective personalized relevance preference modeling. Second, training data for ranking models predominantly come from high-relevance exposures, creating a distribution mismatch with the broader candidate space in coarse-ranking, leading to generalization bias. Third, due to the latency constraint, the original model employs an Emb+MLP architecture with a frozen BERT encoder, which prevents joint optimization and creates misalignment between representation learning and CTR fine-tuning. To solve these issues, we further reinforce our method and propose PRECTR-V2. Specifically, we mitigate the low-activity users' sparse behavior problem by mining global relevance preferences under the specific query, which facilitates effective personalized relevance modeling for cold-start scenarios. Subsequently, we construct hard negative samples through embedding noise injection and relevance label reconstruction, and optimize their relative ranking against positive samples via pairwise loss, thereby correcting exposure bias. Finally, we pretrain a lightweight transformer-based encoder via knowledge distillation from LLM and SFT on the text relevance classification task. This encoder replaces the frozen BERT module, enabling better adaptation to CTR fine-tuning and advancing beyond the traditional Emb+MLP paradigm.

AI.title_translation: PRECTR-V2：融合跨用户偏好挖掘、曝光偏差校正和LLM蒸馏编码器优化的统一相关性-点击率框架
AI.tldr: PRECTR-V2是一个统一的相关性-点击率框架，通过挖掘跨用户偏好解决冷启动问题，通过构造难负样本校正曝光偏差，并通过LLM蒸馏的轻量级编码器优化文本表示和CTR微调，克服了PRECTR的三个主要挑战。
AI.motivation: 在搜索系统中，有效协调搜索相关性匹配和点击率（CTR）预测这两个核心目标对于发现用户兴趣和提升平台收入至关重要。之前的PRECTR框架面临三个挑战：低活跃/新用户数据稀疏导致个性化相关性偏好建模困难；训练数据主要来自高相关性曝光，造成与粗排候选空间分布不匹配的泛化偏差；原始模型采用Frozen BERT的Emb+MLP架构，阻碍联合优化并导致表示学习与CTR微调之间的错位。
AI.method: PRECTR-V2通过以下方法强化：1. 通过挖掘特定查询下的全局相关性偏好来缓解低活跃用户的稀疏行为问题，从而促进冷启动场景下的个性化相关性建模。2. 通过嵌入噪声注入和相关性标签重构构建难负样本，并通过成对损失优化其与正样本的相对排序，从而校正曝光偏差。3. 通过LLM知识蒸馏和文本相关性分类任务上的SFT预训练一个轻量级transformer编码器，取代Frozen BERT模块，以更好地适应CTR微调，并超越传统的Emb+MLP范式。
AI.result: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 在搜索系统中，有效协调搜索相关性匹配和点击率（CTR）预测这两个核心目标对于发现用户兴趣和增强平台收入至关重要。在我们之前的工作PRECTR中，我们提出了一个统一的框架来整合这两个子任务，从而消除它们的不一致性并实现互利。然而，我们之前的工作仍然面临三个主要挑战。首先，低活跃用户和新用户搜索行为数据有限，难以实现有效的个性化相关性偏好建模。其次，排序模型的训练数据主要来自高相关性曝光，这与粗排中更广泛的候选空间存在分布不匹配，导致泛化偏差。第三，由于延迟限制，原始模型采用了带有Frozen BERT编码器的Emb+MLP架构，这阻碍了联合优化，并造成表示学习与CTR微调之间的错位。为了解决这些问题，我们进一步强化了我们的方法并提出了PRECTR-V2。具体来说，我们通过挖掘特定查询下的全局相关性偏好来缓解低活跃用户的稀疏行为问题，这有助于冷启动场景下的有效个性化相关性建模。随后，我们通过嵌入噪声注入和相关性标签重构构建难负样本，并通过成对损失优化其与正样本的相对排序，从而校正曝光偏差。最后，我们通过LLM知识蒸馏和文本相关性分类任务上的SFT预训练一个轻量级transformer编码器。该编码器取代了Frozen BERT模块，使其能够更好地适应CTR微调，并超越传统的Emb+MLP范式。
AI.summary: PRECTR-V2是一个统一的相关性-点击率（CTR）框架，旨在解决搜索系统中相关性匹配和CTR预测的协调问题。它通过三个关键创新改进了先前的PRECTR框架：1) 针对冷启动用户，通过挖掘特定查询下的全局相关性偏好来增强个性化相关性建模；2) 通过构建难负样本和成对损失来校正曝光偏差；3) 用一个通过LLM知识蒸馏和SFT预训练的轻量级Transformer编码器替换了传统的Frozen BERT，以实现表示学习与CTR微调的更好对齐和联合优化，从而超越了传统的Emb+MLP范式。
AI.keywords: 相关性-CTR, 跨用户偏好, 曝光偏差校正, LLM蒸馏, Transformer编码器
AI.comments: PRECTR-V2在统一相关性-CTR框架方面迈出了重要一步，通过解决冷启动、曝光偏差和模型架构优化这三个实际挑战，显著提升了搜索系统的性能潜力。其创新点在于结合了跨用户偏好挖掘、难负样本构造和LLM蒸馏的轻量级编码器，为解决搜索推荐系统中的核心问题提供了全面的解决方案。特别是引入LLM蒸馏来优化编码器，体现了利用大型模型知识提升下游任务性能的趋势，具有重要的工程和研究价值。

title: UrbanFM: Scaling Urban Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models
summary: Urban systems, as dynamic complex systems, continuously generate spatio-temporal data streams that encode the fundamental laws of human mobility and city evolution. While AI for Science has witnessed the transformative power of foundation models in disciplines like genomics and meteorology, urban computing remains fragmented due to "scenario-specific" models, which are overfitted to specific regions or tasks, hindering their generalizability. To bridge this gap and advance spatio-temporal foundation models for urban systems, we adopt scaling as the central perspective and systematically investigate two key questions: what to scale and how to scale. Grounded in first-principles analysis, we identify three critical dimensions: heterogeneity, correlation, and dynamics, aligning these principles with the fundamental scientific properties of urban spatio-temporal data. Specifically, to address heterogeneity through data scaling, we construct WorldST. This billion-scale corpus standardizes diverse physical signals, such as traffic flow and speed, from over 100 global cities into a unified data format. To enable computation scaling for modeling correlations, we introduce the MiniST unit, a novel split mechanism that discretizes continuous spatio-temporal fields into learnable computational units to unify representations of grid-based and sensor-based observations. Finally, addressing dynamics via architecture scaling, we propose UrbanFM, a minimalist self-attention architecture designed with limited inductive biases to autonomously learn dynamic spatio-temporal dependencies from massive data. Furthermore, we establish EvalST, the largest-scale urban spatio-temporal benchmark to date. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UrbanFM achieves remarkable zero-shot generalization across unseen cities and tasks, marking a pivotal first step toward large-scale urban spatio-temporal foundation models.

AI.title_translation: UrbanFM：扩展城市时空基础模型
AI.tldr: UrbanFM通过数据、计算和架构扩展，构建了一个城市时空基础模型，解决了城市计算中模型通用性差的问题，并在未见过的城市和任务上实现了显著的零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 当前的城市计算模型大多是“场景特定”的，过度拟合特定区域或任务，导致通用性差。为了弥合这一差距，推进城市系统的时空基础模型发展，需要解决如何扩展以及扩展什么的问题。
AI.method: 该研究以扩展为核心视角，系统性地探讨了数据、计算和架构扩展。具体方法包括：1. **数据扩展**：构建了WorldST，一个十亿级语料库，将来自100多个全球城市的交通流、速度等多样物理信号标准化为统一格式，以解决异构性问题。2. **计算扩展**：引入了MiniST单元，一种新颖的分割机制，将连续时空场离散化为可学习的计算单元，以统一基于网格和传感器的观测表示，用于建模相关性。3. **架构扩展**：提出了UrbanFM，一个极简的自注意力架构，具有有限的归纳偏置，能够自主学习大规模数据中的动态时空依赖关系，以解决动态性问题。此外，还建立了迄今为止最大规模的城市时空基准EvalST。
AI.result: UrbanFM在未见过的城市和任务上实现了显著的零样本泛化。
AI.conclusion: UrbanFM是迈向大规模城市时空基础模型的关键第一步。
AI.translation: 城市系统作为动态复杂系统，不断产生时空数据流，这些数据流编码了人类移动和城市演变的基本规律。虽然人工智能科学在基因组学和气象学等领域见证了基础模型的变革力量，但城市计算仍然因“场景特定”模型而碎片化，这些模型过度拟合特定区域或任务，阻碍了它们的通用性。为了弥合这一差距，推进城市系统的时空基础模型发展，我们以扩展为核心视角，系统性地研究了两个关键问题：扩展什么以及如何扩展。基于第一性原理分析，我们确定了三个关键维度：异构性、相关性和动态性，并将这些原则与城市时空数据的基本科学特性对齐。具体而言，为了通过数据扩展解决异构性问题，我们构建了WorldST。这个十亿级语料库将来自100多个全球城市的交通流和速度等多样物理信号标准化为统一数据格式。为了通过计算扩展实现相关性建模，我们引入了MiniST单元，这是一种新颖的分割机制，将连续时空场离散化为可学习的计算单元，以统一基于网格和传感器的观测表示。最后，为了通过架构扩展解决动态性问题，我们提出了UrbanFM，一个极简的自注意力架构，其归纳偏置有限，旨在自主学习大规模数据中的动态时空依赖关系。此外，我们建立了迄今为止最大规模的城市时空基准EvalST。大量实验表明，UrbanFM在未见过的城市和任务上实现了显著的零样本泛化，标志着迈向大规模城市时空基础模型的关键第一步。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了UrbanFM，一个用于城市时空数据的基础模型，旨在解决现有城市计算模型通用性差的问题。通过系统性地进行数据、计算和架构扩展，UrbanFM构建了WorldST语料库处理数据异构性，引入MiniST单元统一计算表示以处理相关性，并设计了极简自注意力架构以捕捉动态性。实验证明，UrbanFM在未见过的城市和任务上展现出卓越的零样本泛化能力，为大规模城市时空基础模型奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: UrbanFM, 时空基础模型, 城市计算, 零样本泛化, 扩展
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次系统性地将基础模型理念应用于城市时空领域，并提出了全面的“扩展”策略来解决城市数据的固有挑战。通过构建大规模数据集（WorldST）、设计统一计算单元（MiniST）和轻量级架构（UrbanFM），它有效地提升了模型在复杂城市系统中的通用性和泛化能力，尤其是在零样本场景下的表现令人印象深刻。这是城市计算领域一个重要的里程碑。

title: Implicit-explicit all-speed schemes for compressible Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes equations
summary:
We propose a second-order implicit-explicit (IMEX) time-stepping scheme for the isentropic, compressible Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes equations in the low Mach number regime.
  The method is based on finite differences on staggered grids and is specifically designed to handle the challenges posed by the low Mach number limit, where the system approaches to an incompressible behavior.
  In this regime, standard explicit schemes suffer from severe time-step restrictions due to fourth-order diffusion terms and the stiffness induced by fast acoustic waves.
  To overcome this, we employ an IMEX strategy which splits the governing equations into stiff and non-stiff components.
  The stiff terms, arising from pressure, viscous forces and fourth-order Cahn-Hilliard contributions, are treated implicitly, while the remaining are dealt explicitly.

AI.title_translation: 可压缩Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes方程的隐式-显式全速方案
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于低马赫数可压缩Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes方程的二阶隐式-显式（IMEX）时间步进方案，通过隐式处理刚性项来克服传统显式方案的时间步长限制。
AI.motivation: 在低马赫数状态下，可压缩Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes方程系统趋近于不可压缩行为，导致标准显式方案由于四阶扩散项和快速声波引起的刚度而面临严重的时间步长限制。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种二阶隐式-显式（IMEX）时间步进方案，用于处理等熵、可压缩Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes方程。该方法基于交错网格上的有限差分，并将控制方程分解为刚性项和非刚性项。其中，由压力、粘性力和四阶Cahn-Hilliard贡献产生的刚性项被隐式处理，而其余项则显式处理。

AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对低马赫数状态下可压缩Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes方程的二阶隐式-显式（IMEX）时间步进方案。该方案采用交错网格上的有限差分法，旨在解决低马赫数极限下标准显式方案因刚性和扩散项导致的时间步长限制问题。通过将方程分解为刚性（压力、粘性力、Cahn-Hilliard贡献）和非刚性部分，并对刚性项进行隐式处理，该方法克服了传统方案的挑战。
AI.keywords: 隐式-显式方案, Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes方程, 低马赫数, 时间步进, 有限差分

title: Vanishing Watermarks: Diffusion-Based Image Editing Undermines Robust Invisible Watermarking
summary: Robust invisible watermarking schemes aim to embed hidden information into images such that the watermark survives common manipulations. However, powerful diffusion-based image generation and editing techniques now pose a new threat to these watermarks. In this paper, we present a comprehensive theoretical and empirical analysis demonstrating that diffusion models can effectively erase robust watermarks even when those watermarks were designed to withstand conventional distortions. We show that a diffusion-driven image regeneration process, which leverages generative models to recreate an image, can remove embedded watermarks while preserving the image's perceptual content. Furthermore, we introduce a guided diffusion-based attack that explicitly targets the embedded watermark signal during generation, significantly degrading watermark detectability. Theoretically, we prove that as an image undergoes sufficient diffusion transformations, the mutual information between the watermarked image and the hidden payload approaches zero, leading to inevitable decoding failure. Experimentally, we evaluate multiple state-of-the-art watermarking methods (including deep learning-based schemes like StegaStamp, TrustMark, and VINE) and demonstrate that diffusion edits yield near-zero watermark recovery rates after attack, while maintaining high visual fidelity of the regenerated images. Our findings reveal a fundamental vulnerability in current robust watermarking techniques against generative model-based edits, underscoring the need for new strategies to ensure watermark resilience in the era of powerful diffusion models.

AI.title_translation: 水印消失：基于扩散的图像编辑破坏了鲁棒隐形水印
AI.tldr: 扩散模型可以有效擦除鲁棒的隐形水印，对现有水印技术构成严重威胁。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒的隐形水印方案旨在将隐藏信息嵌入图像中，使其能经受常见操作。然而，强大的基于扩散的图像生成和编辑技术对这些水印构成了新的威胁，本研究旨在分析并证明这种威胁。
AI.method: 本文进行了全面的理论和实证分析。理论上，证明了图像经过足够扩散变换后，带水印图像与隐藏载荷之间的互信息趋近于零。实证上，提出了扩散驱动的图像再生过程和引导式扩散攻击，并评估了多种最先进的水印方法（包括StegaStamp、TrustMark和VINE等深度学习方案）。
AI.result: 研究表明，扩散模型即使在水印设计用于抵抗传统失真时也能有效擦除鲁棒水印。扩散驱动的图像再生过程可以在保留图像感知内容的同时移除嵌入水印。引导式扩散攻击能显著降低水印可检测性。实验结果显示，攻击后水印恢复率接近零，同时再生图像保持高视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 当前鲁棒水印技术在面对基于生成模型的编辑时存在根本性漏洞，凸显了在强大扩散模型时代确保水印弹性的新策略的需求。
AI.translation: 鲁棒的隐形水印方案旨在将隐藏信息嵌入图像中，使得水印能够在常见的操作中幸存下来。然而，强大的基于扩散的图像生成和编辑技术现在对这些水印构成了新的威胁。在本文中，我们提出了全面的理论和实证分析，证明了扩散模型可以有效擦除鲁棒水印，即使这些水印被设计用于抵抗传统失真。我们展示了利用生成模型重新创建图像的扩散驱动图像再生过程，可以在保留图像感知内容的同时移除嵌入的水印。此外，我们引入了一种引导式扩散攻击，在生成过程中明确针对嵌入的水印信号，显著降低了水印的可检测性。理论上，我们证明了随着图像经历足够的扩散变换，带水印图像和隐藏载荷之间的互信息趋近于零，导致不可避免的解码失败。实验上，我们评估了多种最先进的水印方法（包括StegaStamp、TrustMark和VINE等基于深度学习的方案），并证明扩散编辑在攻击后产生接近零的水印恢复率，同时保持再生图像的高视觉保真度。我们的发现揭示了当前鲁棒水印技术在面对基于生成模型的编辑时的根本性漏洞，强调了在强大扩散模型时代确保水印弹性的新策略的需求。
AI.summary: 本研究全面分析了扩散模型对鲁棒隐形水印的威胁。理论和实验均证明，扩散驱动的图像再生和引导式扩散攻击能有效擦除现有水印，导致水印恢复率接近零，同时保持图像视觉质量。这揭示了当前水印技术在面对生成模型编辑时的根本性漏洞，强调了开发新水印策略的必要性。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 隐形水印, 鲁棒性, 图像编辑, 生成模型
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了现有鲁棒水印技术在面对先进扩散模型时的根本性脆弱性，具有重要的现实意义。它强调了在生成式AI时代重新思考水印设计和安全策略的紧迫性，对于数字版权保护和内容溯源领域具有警示作用。

title: Grid-Mind: An LLM-Orchestrated Multi-Fidelity Agent for Automated Connection Impact Assessment
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable tool-use capabilities, yet their application to power system operations remains largely unexplored. This paper presents Grid-Mind, a domain-specific LLM agent that interprets natural-language interconnection requests and autonomously orchestrates multi-fidelity power system simulations. The LLM-first architecture positions the language model as the central decision-making entity, employing an eleven-tool registry to execute Connection Impact Assessment (CIA) studies spanning steadystate power flow, N-1 contingency analysis, transient stability, and electromagnetic transient screening. A violation inspector grounds every decision in quantitative simulation outputs, while a three-layer anti-hallucination defence mitigates numerical fabrication risk through forced capacity-tool routing and post-response grounding validation. A prompt-level self-correction mechanism extracts distilled lessons from agent failures, yielding progressive accuracy improvements without model retraining. End-to-end evaluation on 50 IEEE 118-bus scenarios (DeepSeek-V3, 2026-02-23) achieved 84.0% tool-selection accuracy and 100% parsing accuracy. A separate 56-scenario self-correction suite passed 49 of 56 cases (87.5%) with a mean score of 89.3. These results establish a reproducible baseline for continued refinement while maintaining auditable, simulation-grounded decision support.

AI.title_translation: Grid-Mind：一个由大型语言模型编排的多精度智能体，用于自动化并网影响评估
AI.tldr: Grid-Mind是一个基于LLM的智能体，它能解释自然语言的并网请求，并自主编排多精度电力系统仿真，以进行并网影响评估，并通过反幻觉和自校正机制提高了准确性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的工具使用能力已得到显著展示，但在电力系统操作中的应用仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 本文提出了Grid-Mind，一个领域特定的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体。它采用LLM优先的架构，将语言模型作为核心决策实体，利用一个包含十一个工具的注册表来执行并网影响评估（CIA）研究，涵盖稳态潮流、N-1偶发事故分析、暂态稳定性和电磁暂态筛选。一个违规检查器将每个决策基于定量的仿真输出，而三层反幻觉防御通过强制容量工具路由和响应后接地验证来减轻数值捏造的风险。一个提示层面的自校正机制从智能体故障中提取经验，在不重新训练模型的情况下逐步提高准确性。
AI.result: 在50个IEEE 118节点场景（DeepSeek-V3，2026-02-23）的端到端评估中，工具选择准确率达到84.0%，解析准确率达到100%。在一个包含56个场景的独立自校正套件中，通过了56个案例中的49个（87.5%），平均得分为89.3。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为持续改进建立了一个可复现的基线，同时保持了可审计的、基于仿真的决策支持。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已展示出卓越的工具使用能力，但其在电力系统运行中的应用仍未被充分探索。本文提出了Grid-Mind，一个领域特定的大型语言模型智能体，它能解释自然语言的并网请求并自主编排多精度电力系统仿真。LLM优先的架构将语言模型定位为核心决策实体，利用一个包含十一个工具的注册表来执行并网影响评估（CIA）研究，涵盖稳态潮流、N-1偶发事故分析、暂态稳定性和电磁暂态筛选。一个违规检查器将每个决策基于定量的仿真输出，而三层反幻觉防御通过强制容量工具路由和响应后接地验证来减轻数值捏造的风险。一个提示层面的自校正机制从智能体故障中提取经验，在不重新训练模型的情况下逐步提高准确性。在50个IEEE 118节点场景（DeepSeek-V3，2026-02-23）的端到端评估中，实现了84.0%的工具选择准确率和100%的解析准确率。一个包含56个场景的独立自校正套件通过了56个案例中的49个（87.5%），平均得分为89.3。这些结果为持续改进建立了一个可复现的基线，同时保持了可审计的、基于仿真的决策支持。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Grid-Mind，一个将大型语言模型（LLM）应用于电力系统并网影响评估的智能体。该系统以LLM为核心决策者，通过编排多精度仿真工具（包括稳态、暂态分析等）来处理自然语言的并网请求。Grid-Mind包含违规检查器、三层反幻觉防御机制和提示级自校正功能，以确保决策的准确性和可靠性。实验结果显示，在IEEE 118节点场景中，其工具选择准确率达84.0%，解析准确率达100%，并且自校正机制有效提升了性能，为LLM在电力系统领域的应用提供了可审计且基于仿真的决策支持。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 电力系统, 并网影响评估, 智能体, 多精度仿真
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次将LLM作为核心决策实体应用于复杂的电力系统操作，特别是并网影响评估。其多精度仿真编排能力、强大的反幻觉防御机制以及无需模型重训练的自校正机制，显著提升了LLM在专业领域应用的可靠性和准确性，为电力系统自动化和智能化提供了新的思路和可行的解决方案。

title: Agile V: A Compliance-Ready Framework for AI-Augmented Engineering -- From Concept to Audit-Ready Delivery
summary: Current AI-assisted engineering workflows lack a built-in mechanism to maintain task-level verification and regulatory traceability at machine-speed delivery. Agile V addresses this gap by embedding independent verification and audit artifact generation into each task cycle. The framework merges Agile iteration with V-Model verification into a continuous Infinity Loop, deploying specialized AI agents for requirements, design, build, test, and compliance, governed by mandatory human approval gates. We evaluate three hypotheses: (H1) audit-ready artifacts emerge as a by-product of development, (H2) 100% requirement-level verification is achievable with independent test generation, and (H3) verified increments can be delivered with single-digit human interactions per cycle. A feasibility case study on a Hardware-in-the-Loop system (about 500 LOC, 8 requirements, 54 tests) supports all three hypotheses: audit-ready documentation was generated automatically (H1), 100% requirement-level pass rate was achieved (H2), and only 6 prompts per cycle were required (H3), yielding an estimated 10-50x cost reduction versus a COCOMO II baseline (sensitivity range from pessimistic to optimistic assumptions). We invite independent replication to validate generalizability.

AI.title_translation: Agile V：一个合规就绪的AI增强工程框架——从概念到审计就绪交付
AI.tldr: Agile V框架通过将独立验证和审计工件生成嵌入每个任务周期，解决了AI辅助工程工作流中缺乏任务级验证和监管可追溯性的问题，实现了审计就绪、100%需求级验证和显著的成本降低。
AI.motivation: 当前的AI辅助工程工作流缺乏内置机制，无法在机器速度交付下维持任务级验证和监管可追溯性。
AI.method: Agile V框架通过将敏捷迭代与V模型验证融合到持续的“无限循环”中，解决了这一问题。它在每个任务周期嵌入独立的验证和审计工件生成，并部署专门的AI代理负责需求、设计、构建、测试和合规性，由强制性人工审批门控管。
AI.result: 一项针对硬件在环系统的可行性案例研究（约500行代码，8个需求，54个测试）支持了所有三个假设：自动生成了审计就绪文档（H1），实现了100%的需求级通过率（H2），每个周期仅需6次人工交互（H3），估计相对于COCOMO II基线可降低10-50倍的成本。
AI.conclusion: Agile V框架能够作为AI增强工程流程中生成审计就绪工件、实现高水平需求验证并显著降低成本的有效方案。作者邀请独立复现以验证其通用性。

AI.keywords: Agile V, AI增强工程, 合规性, 验证, 审计就绪

title: RAYNOVA: 3D-Geometry-Free Auto-Regressive Driving World Modeling with Unified Spatio-Temporal Representation
comments: Accepted by CVPR 2026; Project website: http://yichen928.github.io/raynova
summary: World foundation models aim to simulate the evolution of the real world with physically plausible behavior. Unlike prior methods that handle spatial and temporal correlations separately, we propose RAYNOVA, a geometry-free world model that employs a dual-causal autoregressive framework. It follows both scale-wise and temporal topological orders in the autoregressive process, and leverages global attention for unified 4D spatio-temporal reasoning. Different from existing works that impose strong 3D geometric priors, RAYNOVA constructs an isotropic spatio-temporal representation across views, frames, and scales based on relative Plücker-ray positional encoding, enabling robust generalization to diverse camera setups and ego motions. We further introduce a recurrent training paradigm to alleviate distribution drift in long-horizon video generation. RAYNOVA achieves state-of-the-art multi-view video generation results on nuScenes, while offering higher throughput and strong controllability under diverse input conditions, generalizing to novel views and camera configurations without explicit 3D scene representation. Our code will be released at http://yichen928.github.io/raynova.
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026; Project website: http://yichen928.github.io/raynova

AI.title_translation: RAYNOVA：无3D几何的自回归驾驶世界建模与统一时空表示
AI.tldr: RAYNOVA是一个无需3D几何的世界模型，它使用双因果自回归框架和统一的4D时空表示，在nuScenes上实现了最先进的多视角视频生成，具有高吞吐量和强可控性，并能泛化到新的视角和相机配置。
AI.motivation: 世界基础模型旨在模拟真实世界的演变，并具有物理上合理行为。现有方法将空间和时间相关性分开处理，这限制了其性能和泛化能力。
AI.method: RAYNOVA提出了一种无几何的世界模型，采用双因果自回归框架。它在自回归过程中遵循尺度和时间拓扑顺序，并利用全局注意力进行统一的4D时空推理。与现有依赖3D几何先验的工作不同，RAYNOVA基于相对普吕克射线位置编码构建了跨视角、帧和尺度的各向同性时空表示，实现了对不同相机设置和自我运动的鲁棒泛化。此外，引入了循环训练范式以缓解长程视频生成中的分布漂移。
AI.result: RAYNOVA在nuScenes上取得了最先进的多视角视频生成结果。它提供了更高的吞吐量和在不同输入条件下的强大可控性，并且在没有明确3D场景表示的情况下，泛化到新颖的视角和相机配置。
AI.conclusion: RAYNOVA通过其无几何的统一时空表示和双因果自回归框架，成功地实现了领先的多视角视频生成，并展现了出色的泛化能力和效率，为世界建模提供了一个新的方向。
AI.translation: 世界基础模型旨在模拟真实世界的演变，并具有物理上合理行为。与以往分别处理空间和时间相关性的方法不同，我们提出了RAYNOVA，一个无几何的世界模型，它采用双因果自回归框架。它在自回归过程中遵循尺度和时间拓扑顺序，并利用全局注意力进行统一的4D时空推理。与现有强加3D几何先验的工作不同，RAYNOVA基于相对普吕克射线位置编码构建了跨视角、帧和尺度的各向同性时空表示，从而能够鲁棒地泛化到不同的相机设置和自我运动。我们进一步引入了循环训练范式，以缓解长程视频生成中的分布漂移。RAYNOVA在nuScenes上取得了最先进的多视角视频生成结果，同时提供了更高的吞吐量和在不同输入条件下的强大可控性，在没有明确3D场景表示的情况下，泛化到新颖的视角和相机配置。我们的代码将发布在http://yichen928.github.io/raynova。
AI.summary: RAYNOVA提出了一种无3D几何的自回归世界模型，用于驾驶场景建模。它通过双因果自回归框架和基于相对普吕克射线位置编码的统一各向同性4D时空表示，克服了传统方法对3D几何先验的依赖以及时空分离处理的问题。该模型在nuScenes数据集上实现了最先进的多视角视频生成，展现了高吞吐量、强可控性以及对新颖视角和相机配置的泛化能力，无需显式3D场景表示。
AI.keywords: RAYNOVA, 世界建模, 自回归模型, 时空表示, 多视角视频生成
AI.comments: RAYNOVA的创新点在于其无3D几何的设计和统一的4D时空表示，这使得模型能够更好地泛化并提高效率。相对普吕克射线位置编码是一个关键技术，它允许模型在不依赖显式3D结构的情况下进行鲁棒的空间推理。循环训练范式也有效地解决了长程视频生成中的分布漂移问题。该工作为未来世界模型的构建提供了一个有前景的方向，特别是在对3D几何信息获取困难或计算成本高的场景中。

title: How Foundational Skills Influence VLM-based Embodied Agents:A Native Perspective
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise for human-level embodied intelligence. However, existing benchmarks for VLM-driven embodied agents often rely on high-level commands or discretized action spaces, which are non-native settings that differ markedly from real-world control. In addition, current benchmarks focus primarily on high-level tasks and lack joint evaluation and analysis at both low and high levels. To address these limitations, we present NativeEmbodied, a challenging benchmark for VLM-driven embodied agents that uses a unified, native low-level action space. Built on diverse simulated scenes, NativeEmbodied includes three representative high-level tasks in complex scenarios to evaluate overall performance. For more detailed analysis, we further decouple the skills required by complex tasks and construct four types of low-level tasks, each targeting a fundamental embodied skill. This joint evaluation across task and skill granularities enables fine-grained assessment of embodied agents. Experiments with state-of-the-art VLMs reveal clear deficiencies in several fundamental embodied skills, and further analysis shows that these bottlenecks significantly limit performance on high-level tasks. NativeEmbodied highlights key challenges for current VLM-driven embodied agents and provides insights to guide future research.

AI.title_translation: 基础技能如何影响基于VLM的具身智能体：一种原生视角
AI.tldr: 现有VLM具身智能体基准依赖非原生的高级命令和离散动作空间，缺乏低高层联合评估。本文提出NativeEmbodied基准，使用统一的原生低层动作空间，包含复杂场景下的高层任务和解耦的基础低层技能任务，以进行细粒度评估。实验发现当前VLM在基础技能上存在明显缺陷，并限制高层任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM驱动的具身智能体基准依赖非原生的高级命令或离散动作空间，与真实世界控制存在显著差异；此外，当前基准主要关注高级任务，缺乏低层和高层任务的联合评估与分析。
AI.method: 本文提出了NativeEmbodied基准，该基准使用统一的原生低层动作空间。它建立在多样化的模拟场景之上，包含复杂场景中的三个代表性高层任务以评估整体性能。为进行更详细分析，进一步解耦复杂任务所需的技能，构建了四种针对基本具身技能的低层任务，以实现跨任务和技能粒度的联合评估。
AI.result: 对最先进的VLM进行的实验揭示了它们在几种基本具身技能上的明显缺陷。进一步分析表明，这些瓶颈显著限制了它们在高层任务上的表现。
AI.conclusion: NativeEmbodied揭示了当前VLM驱动具身智能体面临的关键挑战，并为指导未来研究提供了见解。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展已显示出实现人类水平具身智能的潜力。然而，现有VLM驱动具身智能体的基准通常依赖于高级命令或离散动作空间，这些都是非原生设置，与真实世界控制显著不同。此外，当前基准主要关注高级任务，缺乏低层和高层任务的联合评估与分析。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了NativeEmbodied，这是一个用于VLM驱动具身智能体的具有挑战性的基准，它采用统一的原生低层动作空间。NativeEmbodied建立在多样化的模拟场景之上，包含复杂场景中的三个代表性高层任务以评估整体性能。为进行更详细分析，我们进一步解耦了复杂任务所需的技能，并构建了四种针对基本具身技能的低层任务。这种跨任务和技能粒度的联合评估能够对具身智能体进行细粒度评估。对最先进的VLM进行的实验揭示了它们在几种基本具身技能上的明显缺陷，并且进一步分析表明，这些瓶颈显著限制了它们在高层任务上的表现。NativeEmbodied突出了当前VLM驱动具身智能体面临的关键挑战，并为指导未来研究提供了见解。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有VLM驱动具身智能体基准的局限性，提出了NativeEmbodied基准。该基准采用统一的原生低层动作空间，并在多样化的模拟场景中设置了复杂的高层任务和解耦的基础低层技能任务，以实现对智能体的联合细粒度评估。实验结果表明，当前VLM在基础具身技能上存在明显缺陷，这些缺陷是限制高层任务性能的关键瓶颈。NativeEmbodied为未来VLM具身智能体的研究指明了方向。
AI.keywords: VLM, 具身智能体, 基准, 基础技能, 低层动作空间
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入NativeEmbodied基准，创新性地解决了现有VLM驱动具身智能体基准在原生性、低高层任务联合评估方面的不足。其强调基础技能对整体性能的影响，为具身智能体的未来发展提供了重要的研究方向和评估工具。

title: MatchED: Crisp Edge Detection Using End-to-End, Matching-based Supervision
summary: Generating crisp, i.e., one-pixel-wide, edge maps remains one of the fundamental challenges in edge detection, affecting both traditional and learning-based methods. To obtain crisp edges, most existing approaches rely on two hand-crafted post-processing algorithms, Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) and skeleton-based thinning, which are non-differentiable and hinder end-to-end optimization. Moreover, all existing crisp edge detection methods still depend on such post-processing to achieve satisfactory results. To address this limitation, we propose \MethodLPP, a lightweight, only $\sim$21K additional parameters, and plug-and-play matching-based supervision module that can be appended to any edge detection model for joint end-to-end learning of crisp edges. At each training iteration, \MethodLPP performs one-to-one matching between predicted and ground-truth edges based on spatial distance and confidence, ensuring consistency between training and testing protocols. Extensive experiments on four popular datasets demonstrate that integrating \MethodLPP substantially improves the performance of existing edge detection models. In particular, \MethodLPP increases the Average Crispness (AC) metric by up to 2--4$\times$ compared to baseline models. Under the crispness-emphasized evaluation (CEval), \MethodLPP further boosts baseline performance by up to 20--35\% in ODS and achieves similar gains in OIS and AP, achieving SOTA performance that matches or surpasses standard post-processing for the first time. Code is available at https://cvpr26-matched.github.io.

AI.title_translation: MatchED：使用端到端、基于匹配的监督的清晰边缘检测
AI.tldr: 现有清晰边缘检测方法依赖于不可微分的后处理，阻碍了端到端优化。本文提出了MatchED，一个轻量级、即插即用的基于匹配的监督模块，可实现清晰边缘的端到端学习，并在多个数据集上首次达到了与标准后处理相媲美或超越的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 生成清晰（即单像素宽）的边缘图是边缘检测中的一个基本挑战。大多数现有方法依赖于不可微分的NMS和骨架细化等手工后处理算法，这阻碍了模型的端到端优化。
AI.method: 本文提出了MatchED，一个轻量级（约21K额外参数）且即插即用的基于匹配的监督模块。该模块可以附加到任何边缘检测模型上，实现清晰边缘的联合端到端学习。在每次训练迭代中，MatchED根据空间距离和置信度在预测边缘和真实边缘之间执行一对一匹配，确保训练和测试协议的一致性。
AI.result: 在四个流行数据集上的大量实验表明，集成MatchED显著提高了现有边缘检测模型的性能。特别是，MatchED将平均清晰度（AC）指标提高了2-4倍。在强调清晰度的评估（CEval）下，MatchED将基线性能在ODS上提升了20-35%，并在OIS和AP上取得了类似增益，首次实现了与标准后处理匹配或超越的SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: MatchED通过引入端到端、基于匹配的监督模块，成功解决了清晰边缘检测对传统不可微分后处理的依赖，并显著提升了模型的性能，首次实现了SOTA结果。
AI.translation: 生成清晰的（即单像素宽的）边缘图仍然是边缘检测中的一个基本挑战，影响着传统和基于学习的方法。为了获得清晰的边缘，大多数现有方法依赖于两种手工设计的后处理算法：非极大值抑制（NMS）和基于骨架的细化，它们是不可微分的，阻碍了端到端优化。此外，所有现有的清晰边缘检测方法仍然依赖于这种后处理才能达到满意的结果。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了MatchED，一个轻量级（仅约21K额外参数）且即插即用的基于匹配的监督模块，可以附加到任何边缘检测模型上，用于清晰边缘的联合端到端学习。在每次训练迭代中，MatchED根据空间距离和置信度在预测边缘和真实边缘之间执行一对一匹配，确保训练和测试协议之间的一致性。在四个流行数据集上的大量实验表明，集成MatchED显著提高了现有边缘检测模型的性能。特别是，MatchED将平均清晰度（AC）指标提高了2-4倍，相比基线模型。在强调清晰度的评估（CEval）下，MatchED进一步将基线性能在ODS上提升了20-35%，并在OIS和AP上取得了类似增益，首次实现了与标准后处理匹配或超越的SOTA性能。代码可在https://cvpr26-matched.github.io获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MatchED，一个轻量级且即插即用的基于匹配的监督模块，旨在解决清晰边缘检测中对不可微分后处理的依赖。通过在训练过程中对预测边缘和真实边缘进行一对一匹配，MatchED实现了清晰边缘的端到端学习，并能集成到任何现有边缘检测模型中。实验结果表明，MatchED显著提升了模型的清晰度性能，并在多个评估指标上首次达到了与传统后处理相媲美或超越的SOTA水平。
AI.keywords: 边缘检测, 清晰边缘, 端到端学习, 匹配监督, 后处理
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个可微分的、基于匹配的监督模块MatchED，成功替代了传统清晰边缘检测中不可微分的NMS和骨架细化等后处理步骤。这使得边缘检测模型能够实现真正的端到端优化，对于提升模型的训练效率、性能上限和泛化能力具有重要意义。其即插即用的特性也增加了其实用性。

title: PromptCD: Test-Time Behavior Enhancement via Polarity-Prompt Contrastive Decoding
summary: Reliable AI systems require large language models (LLMs) to exhibit behaviors aligned with human preferences and values. However, most existing alignment approaches operate at training time and rely on additional high-quality data, incurring significant computational and annotation costs. While recent work has shown that contrastive decoding can leverage a model's internal distributions to improve specific capabilities, its applicability remains limited to narrow behavioral scopes and scenarios. In this work, we introduce Polarity-Prompt Contrastive Decoding (PromptCD), a test-time behavior control method that generalizes contrastive decoding to broader enhancement settings. PromptCD constructs paired positive and negative guiding prompts for a target behavior and contrasts model responses-specifically token-level probability distributions in LLMs and visual attention patterns in VLMs-to reinforce desirable outcomes. This formulation extends contrastive decoding to a wide range of enhancement objectives and is applicable to both LLMs and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) without additional training. For LLMs, experiments on the "3H" alignment objectives (helpfulness, honesty, and harmlessness) demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements, indicating that post-trained models can achieve meaningful self-enhancement purely at test time. For VLMs, we further analyze contrastive effects on visual attention, showing that PromptCD significantly improves VQA performance by reinforcing behavior-consistent visual grounding. Collectively, these results highlight PromptCD as a simple, general, and cost-efficient strategy for reliable behavior control across modalities.

AI.title_translation: PromptCD: 通过极性提示对比解码实现测试时行为增强
AI.tldr: PromptCD是一种在测试时通过极性提示对比解码来增强大型语言模型和视觉语言模型行为的方法，无需额外训练，成本高效。
AI.motivation: 可靠的AI系统需要LLM表现出符合人类偏好和价值观的行为。然而，现有对齐方法多在训练时进行，依赖额外高质量数据，导致高昂的计算和标注成本。对比解码虽能利用模型内部分布提升特定能力，但其适用范围有限。
AI.method: PromptCD引入极性提示对比解码（Polarity-Prompt Contrastive Decoding, PromptCD），这是一种测试时行为控制方法。它为目标行为构建成对的正向和负向引导提示，并通过对比模型响应（LLM中的token级概率分布和VLM中的视觉注意力模式）来强化期望结果。这种方法无需额外训练，适用于LLM和VLM。
AI.result: 对于LLM，在“3H”对齐目标（有用性、诚实性、无害性）上的实验表明，模型在测试时纯粹通过自我增强实现了持续且显著的改进。对于VLM，分析视觉注意力上的对比效应表明，PromptCD通过强化行为一致的视觉基础显著提高了VQA性能。
AI.conclusion: PromptCD是一种简单、通用且成本高效的跨模态可靠行为控制策略，可以在测试时实现大型语言模型和视觉语言模型的行为增强，而无需额外训练。
AI.translation: 可靠的AI系统要求大型语言模型（LLM）表现出与人类偏好和价值观一致的行为。然而，大多数现有的对齐方法在训练时操作，并依赖于额外的高质量数据，从而产生显著的计算和标注成本。虽然最近的工作表明对比解码可以利用模型的内部分布来提高特定能力，但其适用性仍然局限于狭窄的行为范围和场景。在这项工作中，我们引入了极性提示对比解码（PromptCD），这是一种测试时行为控制方法，它将对比解码推广到更广泛的增强设置。PromptCD为目标行为构建成对的正向和负向引导提示，并对比模型响应——特别是LLM中的token级概率分布和VLM中的视觉注意力模式——以强化期望结果。这种公式将对比解码扩展到广泛的增强目标，并且适用于LLM和视觉语言模型（VLM），无需额外训练。对于LLM，在“3H”对齐目标（有用性、诚实性和无害性）上的实验表明持续且显著的改进，这表明经过训练的模型可以在测试时纯粹实现有意义的自我增强。对于VLM，我们进一步分析了视觉注意力上的对比效应，表明PromptCD通过强化行为一致的视觉基础显著提高了VQA性能。总的来说，这些结果突出了PromptCD作为一种简单、通用且成本高效的跨模态可靠行为控制策略。
AI.summary: PromptCD提出了一种名为“极性提示对比解码”的测试时行为增强方法，旨在解决现有对齐方法在训练时成本高昂和对比解码适用范围有限的问题。该方法通过构建正负引导提示并对比模型响应（LLM的token分布和VLM的视觉注意力）来强化期望行为。实验证明，PromptCD能有效提升LLM在“3H”对齐目标上的表现，并显著改善VLM的VQA性能，是一种无需额外训练、成本高效的通用跨模态行为控制策略。
AI.keywords: PromptCD, 对比解码, 测试时增强, LLM, VLM, 行为控制
AI.comments: PromptCD的创新之处在于它提出了一种纯粹在测试时进行行为增强的方法，避免了传统训练时对齐方法所需的大量计算和标注成本。其通过构建极性提示并对比模型内部响应的机制，巧妙地将对比解码推广到更广泛的行为增强场景，并成功应用于LLM和VLM，展现了其通用性和高效性。这对于快速、灵活地调整AI系统行为具有重要意义。

title: Reduced-order computational homogenization for hyperelastic media using gradient based sensitivity analysis of microstructures
summary: We propose an algorithm for the computational homogenization of locally periodic hyperelastic structures undergoing large deformations due to external quasi-static loading. The algorithm performs clustering of macroscopic deformations into subsets called "centroids", and, as a new ingredient, approximates the homogenized coefficients using sensitivity analysis of micro-configurations with respect to the macroscopic deformation. The novel "model-order reduction" approach significantly reduces the number of microscopic problems that must be solved in nonlinear simulations, thereby accelerating the overall computational process. The degree of reduction can be controlled by a user-defined error tolerance parameter. The algorithm is implemented in the finite element framework SfePy, and its performance effectiveness is demonstrated using two-dimensional test examples, when compared with solutions obtained by the proper orthogonal decomposition method, and by the full "FE-square" simulations. Extensions beyond the present implementations and the scope of tractable problems are discussed.

AI.title_translation: 基于梯度微观结构灵敏度分析的超弹性介质降阶计算均匀化方法
AI.tldr: 提出一种通过宏观变形聚类与微观构型灵敏度分析来加速非线性超弹性材料计算均匀化的降阶算法，显著减少微观问题求解次数。
AI.motivation: 传统“FE平方”计算均匀化在每次宏观积分点都需完整求解微观问题，计算量巨大，亟需降阶策略以提升大规模非线性模拟效率。
AI.method: 1) 将宏观变形聚类为若干“质心”子集；2) 对每一质心仅求解一次微观问题；3) 利用微观构型对宏观变形的梯度灵敏度，快速插值其余点的均匀化系数；4) 用用户给定误差容限控制降阶程度；5) 在SfePy有限元框架实现并与POD及全阶模型对比。
AI.result: 二维算例表明，该方法在保持可控误差的同时显著减少微观求解次数，加速整体计算，其效率优于POD与全阶“FE平方”模拟。
AI.conclusion: 所提降阶均匀化算法通过灵敏度插值有效平衡精度与效率，为大规模非线性超弹性材料模拟提供可行加速途径，且易通过误差容限参数调节。
AI.translation: 本文提出一种针对受准静态外载产生大变形的局部周期超弹性结构的计算均匀化算法。该算法将宏观变形聚类为若干“质心”，并引入新思路：利用微观构型对宏观变形的灵敏度近似均匀化系数。这一新颖的“模型降阶”方法显著减少非线性仿真中需求解的微观问题数量，从而加速整体计算。降阶程度可由用户定义的误差容限参数控制。算法在有限元框架SfePy中实现，并通过二维算例验证其相较于本征正交分解法和完整“FE平方”模拟的效能。文中还讨论了超越当前实现范围的可扩展性与适用问题。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种面向大变形局部周期超弹性材料的降阶计算均匀化算法。核心思想是将宏观变形空间聚类为质心，仅对质心求解微观问题，再利用微观构型对宏观变形的梯度灵敏度插值获得其余点的均匀化系数，从而显著减少计算量。算法在SfePy中实现，通过二维算例验证其相较POD与全阶模拟的效率优势，并可通过误差容限灵活控制精度与速度权衡。
AI.keywords: 计算均匀化；降阶建模；超弹性材料；灵敏度分析；微观结构；大变形；有限元
AI.comments: 摘要未提及算法在三维或更复杂材料模型上的验证，也未讨论聚类数目与误差的具体量化关系及参数选取准则。

title: High-Dimensional Robust Mean Estimation with Untrusted Batches
summary:
We study high-dimensional mean estimation in a collaborative setting where data is contributed by $N$ users in batches of size $n$. In this environment, a learner seeks to recover the mean $μ$ of a true distribution $P$ from a collection of sources that are both statistically heterogeneous and potentially malicious. We formalize this challenge through a double corruption landscape: an $\varepsilon$-fraction of users are entirely adversarial, while the remaining ``good'' users provide data from distributions that are related to $P$, but deviate by a proximity parameter $α$.
  Unlike existing work on the untrusted batch model, which typically measures this deviation via total variation distance in discrete settings, we address the continuous, high-dimensional regime under two natural variants for deviation: (1) good batches are drawn from distributions with a mean-shift of $\sqrtα$, or (2) an $α$-fraction of samples within each good batch are adversarially corrupted. In particular, the second model presents significant new challenges: in high dimensions, unlike discrete settings, even a small fraction of sample-level corruption can shift empirical means and covariances arbitrarily.
  We provide two Sum-of-Squares (SoS) based algorithms to navigate this tiered corruption. Our algorithms achieve the minimax-optimal error rate $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon/n} + \sqrt{d/nN} + \sqrtα)$, demonstrating that while heterogeneity $α$ represents an inherent statistical difficulty, the influence of adversarial users is suppressed by a factor of $1/\sqrt{n}$ due to the internal averaging afforded by the batch structure.

AI.title_translation: 基于不可信批次的高维鲁棒均值估计
AI.tldr: 在异构且含恶意用户的批次数据环境下，提出基于Sum-of-Squares的算法，实现高维均值估计的极小化最优误差率。
AI.motivation: 现实协作学习中，数据由多个用户以批次形式提供，既存在统计异构性，又可能遭遇恶意投毒，需要理论保证的鲁棒估计方法。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为双重腐败模型：ε比例用户完全对抗，其余“好”用户数据与真实分布P的偏离用均值漂移√α或批次内α比例样本腐败刻画；设计两种Sum-of-Squares算法并利用批次内平均抑制对抗影响。
AI.result: 算法达到极小化最优误差O(√(ε/n)+√(d/nN)+√α)，显示异构α为固有统计难度，而对抗用户影响被1/√n因子抑制。
AI.conclusion: 在含不可信批次的高维连续空间中，通过SoS方法可有效分离异构与对抗腐败，实现统计最优鲁棒估计。
AI.translation: 本文研究协作环境下高维均值估计，其中N个用户各提供大小为n的批次数据。学习者需从统计异构且可能恶意的数据源中恢复真实分布P的均值μ。我们提出双重腐败模型：ε比例用户完全对抗，剩余“好”用户数据与P的偏离用均值漂移√α或批次内α比例样本腐败描述。针对连续高维场景，给出两种基于Sum-of-Squares的算法，达到极小化最优误差率O(√(ε/n)+√(d/nN)+√α)，表明批次结构可将对抗影响降低1/√n倍。
AI.summary: 本文针对高维连续空间中不可信批次均值估计问题，建立双重腐败模型，提出Sum-of-Squares算法，证明其误差率极小化最优，并揭示批次内平均对对抗鲁棒的增益。
AI.keywords: 高维均值估计;鲁棒统计;不可信批次;Sum-of-Squares;双重腐败;极小化最优率
AI.comments: 未提及具体计算复杂度及大规模实验验证，摘要亦未讨论参数ε,α的先验知识或估计方法。

title: NGL-Prompter: Training-Free Sewing Pattern Estimation from a Single Image
summary: Estimating sewing patterns from images is a practical approach for creating high-quality 3D garments. Due to the lack of real-world pattern-image paired data, prior approaches fine-tune large vision language models (VLMs) on synthetic garment datasets generated by randomly sampling from a parametric garment model GarmentCode. However, these methods often struggle to generalize to in-the-wild images, fail to capture real-world correlations between garment parts, and are typically restricted to single-layer outfits. In contrast, we observe that VLMs are effective at describing garments in natural language, yet perform poorly when asked to directly regress GarmentCode parameters from images. To bridge this gap, we propose NGL (Natural Garment Language), a novel intermediate language that restructures GarmentCode into a representation more understandable to language models. Leveraging this language, we introduce NGL-Prompter, a training-free pipeline that queries large VLMs to extract structured garment parameters, which are then deterministically mapped to valid GarmentCode. We evaluate our method on the Dress4D, CloSe and a newly collected dataset of approximately 5,000 in-the-wild fashion images. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard geometry metrics and is strongly preferred in both human and GPT-based perceptual evaluations compared to existing baselines. Furthermore, NGL-prompter can recover multi-layer outfits whereas competing methods focus mostly on single-layer garments, highlighting its strong generalization to real-world images even with occluded parts. These results demonstrate that accurate sewing pattern reconstruction is possible without costly model training. Our code and data will be released for research use.

AI.title_translation: NGL-Prompter：无需训练的单张图像制版估算
AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的NGL-Prompter，通过自然语言中间层NGL把大视觉语言模型输出的结构化服装参数映射为GarmentCode，实现单张照片到缝纫纸样的3D服装重建。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖合成数据微调大模型，难以泛化到真实场景且只能处理单层服装；作者发现大模型擅长自然语言描述却难以直接回归GarmentCode参数，因此需要一种无需训练即可利用大模型先验的新方法。
AI.method: 构建自然服装语言（NGL）将GarmentCode重构成更易被语言模型理解的中间表示；设计NGL-Prompter无训练流程，用提示词驱动大视觉语言模型输出结构化服装参数，再确定性映射回GarmentCode生成纸样。
AI.result: 在Dress4D、CloSe及约5,000张真实街拍新数据集上达到SOTA几何指标；在人类与GPT感知评价中显著优于基线；能重建多层服装并处理遮挡，证明无训练也能准确恢复纸样。
AI.conclusion: 通过NGL中间语言无需训练即可利用大模型先验，实现真实图像的高质量多层服装纸样重建，为低成本3D服装生成提供了可行方案。
AI.translation: 从图像估算纸样是制作高质量3D服装的实用途径。由于缺乏真实配对数据，先前方法在GarmentCode合成数据上微调大视觉语言模型，但泛化差、无法捕捉部件真实关联且仅限单层服装。作者观察到VLMs擅用语言描述却难以直接回归GarmentCode，于是提出自然服装语言NGL重构GarmentCode为模型易懂的表示，并设计无训练NGL-Prompter提示大模型提取结构化参数再映射为纸样。实验表明该方法在标准几何指标与感知评价均优于现有方法，可处理多层与遮挡，证明无需昂贵训练即可准确重建纸样。
AI.summary: 本文提出无训练框架NGL-Prompter，通过自然语言中间层NGL让大视觉语言模型输出结构化服装参数并映射为GarmentCode，实现单张图像到多层服装纸样的高质量重建，在真实数据集上取得SOTA表现。
AI.keywords: 缝纫纸样估算，单图像3D服装，大视觉语言模型，无训练学习，自然服装语言，多层服装重建，GarmentCode
AI.comments: 方法新颖地利用语言中间层避免训练，实验规模较大且覆盖真实街拍；若能补充消融实验与运行效率分析，以及对复杂纹理/褶皱细节的重建评估，将进一步增强说服力。

title: IntRR: A Framework for Integrating SID Redistribution and Length Reduction
summary: Generative Recommendation (GR) has emerged as a transformative paradigm that reformulates the traditional cascade ranking system into a sequence-to-item generation task, facilitated by the use of discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs). However, current SIDs are suboptimal as the indexing objectives (Stage 1) are misaligned with the actual recommendation goals (Stage 2). Since these identifiers remain static (Stage 2), the backbone model lacks the flexibility to adapt them to the evolving complexities of user interactions. Furthermore, the prevailing strategy of flattening hierarchical SIDs into token sequences leads to sequence length inflation, resulting in prohibitive computational overhead and inference latency. To address these challenges, we propose IntRR, a novel framework that integrates objective-aligned SID Redistribution and structural Length Reduction. By leveraging item-specific Unique IDs (UIDs) as collaborative anchors, this approach dynamically redistributes semantic weights across hierarchical codebook layers. Concurrently, IntRR handles the SID hierarchy recursively, eliminating the need to flatten sequences. This ensures a fixed cost of one token per item. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that IntRR yields substantial improvements over representative generative baselines, achieving superior performance in both recommendation accuracy and efficiency.

AI.title_translation: IntRR：融合SID重分配与长度压缩的统一框架
AI.tldr: IntRR通过动态重分配语义ID权重并保持层级结构，使每个物品仅用1个token，显著提升生成式推荐的精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐将层级SID展平为序列，导致序列过长、计算开销大，且SID的索引目标与推荐目标不一致且静态，难以适应用户行为演化。
AI.method: 提出IntRR框架：1)以物品唯一ID为协同锚点，动态在各层codebook重分配语义权重；2)递归处理SID层级，避免展平，保持每物品仅1个token的固定开销。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上，IntRR相较代表性生成式基线在推荐准确率与效率均取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过目标对齐的SID重分配与结构长度压缩，IntRR解决了静态SID与序列膨胀问题，实现更准更快的生成式推荐。
AI.translation: 生成式推荐（GR）将传统级联排序转化为序列到物品生成任务，借助离散语义ID（SID）。然而现有SID在索引阶段与推荐阶段目标不一致且静态，难以适应用户交互演化；同时展平层级SID导致序列过长、计算与延迟剧增。为此提出IntRR，融合目标对齐的SID重分配与结构长度压缩，用物品唯一ID作协同锚点动态重分配语义权重，并递归处理层级，使每物品仅需1个token。实验表明IntRR在准确率与效率上均优于主流生成基线。
AI.summary: IntRR针对生成式推荐中静态SID目标错位与序列膨胀问题，提出以物品唯一ID为锚点的动态语义重分配机制，并递归保留层级结构，实现每物品仅1 token，兼顾精度与效率。
AI.keywords: 生成式推荐，语义ID，SID重分配，序列长度压缩，层级结构
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体数据集、指标增幅、代码开源与计算复杂度分析。

title: The Careless Coupon Collector's Problem
summary: We initiate the study of the Careless Coupon Collector's Problem (CCCP), a novel variation of the classical coupon collector, that we envision as a model for information systems such as web crawlers, dynamic caches, and fault-resilient networks. In CCCP, a collector attempts to gather $n$ distinct coupon types by obtaining one coupon type uniformly at random in each discrete round, however the collector is \textit{careless}: at the end of each round, each collected coupon type is independently lost with probability $p$. We analyze the number of rounds required to complete the collection as a function of $n$ and $p$. In particular, we show that it transitions from $Θ(n \ln n)$ when $p = o\big(\frac{\ln n}{n^2}\big)$ up to $Θ\big((\frac{np}{1-p})^n\big)$ when $p=ω\big(\frac{1}{n}\big)$ in multiple distinct phases. Interestingly, when $p=\frac{c}{n}$, the process remains in a metastable phase, where the fraction of collected coupon types is concentrated around $\frac{1}{1+c}$ with probability $1-o(1)$, for a time window of length $e^{Θ(n)}$. Finally, we give an algorithm that computes the expected completion time of CCCP in $O(n^2)$ time.

AI.title_translation: 粗心的优惠券收集者问题
AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了“粗心的优惠券收集者问题”（CCCP），其中收集到的优惠券每轮会以概率p丢失，系统表现出多阶段行为，包括亚稳态，并给出O(n²)计算期望完成时间的算法。
AI.motivation: 将优惠券收集模型扩展为信息检索系统（如网络爬虫、动态缓存、容错网络）的抽象，以研究在随机丢失情境下完成收集的效率与阶段行为。
AI.method: 定义CCCP模型：每轮随机获得一个优惠券类型，随后每个已收集类型独立以概率p丢失；通过概率分析和随机过程理论推导完成时间对n与p的依赖；设计动态规划算法计算期望完成时间。
AI.result: 证明完成时间随p增大从Θ(n ln n)过渡到Θ((np/(1-p))^n)；当p=c/n时，系统进入亚稳态，收集比例集中在1/(1+c)持续e^{Θ(n)}轮；算法可在O(n²)时间内求出期望完成时间。
AI.conclusion: CCCP揭示了随机丢失导致的多阶段收集行为，为信息系统中数据丢失与恢复提供了理论基准。
AI.translation: 我们提出并研究“粗心的优惠券收集者问题”（CCCP），这是经典优惠券收集问题的新变体，可作为网络爬虫、动态缓存和容错网络等信息系统的模型。在CCCP中，收集者每轮均匀随机获得一种优惠券类型，但每轮结束时，每种已收集类型独立地以概率p丢失。我们分析完成收集所需的轮数与n和p的关系，显示其从p=o(ln n/n²)时的Θ(n ln n)过渡到p=ω(1/n)时的Θ((np/(1-p))^n)。当p=c/n时，过程处于亚稳态，收集比例集中在1/(1+c)并持续e^{Θ(n)}轮。最后，我们给出O(n²)时间计算期望完成时间的算法。
AI.summary: 本文研究CCCP，揭示随机丢失使收集时间呈多阶段变化，并在p=c/n时进入亚稳态，提供O(n²)计算期望完成时间的算法。
AI.keywords: 优惠券收集问题，随机丢失，亚稳态，随机过程，网络爬虫，动态缓存

title: Online Algorithms with Unreliable Guidance
summary:
This paper introduces a new model for ML-augmented online decision making, called online algorithms with unreliable guidance (OAG). This model completely separates between the predictive and algorithmic components, thus offering a single well-defined analysis framework that relies solely on the considered problem. Formulated through the lens of request-answer games, an OAG algorithm receives, with each incoming request, a piece of guidance which is taken from the problem's answer space; ideally, this guidance is the optimal answer for the current request, however with probability $β$, the guidance is adversarially corrupted. The goal is to develop OAG algorithms that admit good competitiveness when $β= 0$ (a.k.a. consistency) as well as when $β= 1$ (a.k.a. robustness); the appealing notion of smoothness, that in most prior work required a dedicated loss function, now arises naturally as $β$ shifts from $0$ to $1$.
  We then describe a systematic method, called the drop or trust blindly (DTB) compiler, which transforms any online algorithm into a learning-augmented online algorithm in the OAG model. Given a prediction-oblivious online algorithm, its learning-augmented counterpart produced by applying the DTB compiler either follows the incoming guidance blindly or ignores it altogether and proceeds as the initial algorithm would have; the choice between these two alternatives is based on the outcome of a (biased) coin toss. As our main technical contribution, we prove (rigorously) that although remarkably simple, the class of algorithms produced via the DTB compiler includes algorithms with attractive consistency-robustness guarantees for three classic online problems: for caching and uniform metrical task systems our algorithms are optimal, whereas for bipartite matching (with adversarial arrival order), our algorithm outperforms the state-of-the-art.

AI.title_translation: 基于不可靠指导的在线算法
AI.tldr: 提出“不可靠指导在线算法(OAG)”模型，将预测与算法彻底解耦；设计极简的DTB编译器，把任意在线算法转化为具备一致性-鲁棒性保证的学习增强版本，并在缓存、均匀度量任务系统与二分匹配问题上达到最优或超越现有最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 现有ML增强在线算法缺乏统一分析框架，且通常需专门设计损失函数才能衡量平滑性。作者希望建立一个仅依赖问题本身、无需假设预测质量的通用模型，并同时实现一致性、鲁棒性与平滑性。
AI.method: 1) 定义OAG模型：每步请求附带来自答案空间的指导，以概率β被敌对破坏；2) 提出DTB编译器：以有偏硬币决定是否“完全信任并跟随指导”或“丢弃指导并复现原算法行为”；3) 对缓存、均匀度量任务系统、二分匹配进行理论分析与竞争比证明。
AI.result: DTB编译器生成的算法在β=0时达到一致性，在β=1时保持鲁棒性；对缓存与均匀度量任务系统获得最优竞争比，对敌对到达顺序的二分匹配超越现有最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 极简的DTB框架即可在无需预测质量假设下，为经典在线问题提供可证明的一致性-鲁棒性-平滑性保证，显示出广泛适用潜力。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新的ML增强在线决策模型——不可靠指导在线算法(OAG)。该模型将预测组件与算法组件完全分离，为所考虑的问题提供了单一且定义明确的分析框架。通过请求-回答博弈形式化，OAG算法在每个请求到达时获得一条取自问题答案空间的指导；理想情况下该指导为当前请求的最优答案，但会以概率β受到敌对破坏。目标是设计在β=0时具有良好竞争性（一致性）且在β=1时仍保持竞争性（鲁棒性）的OAG算法；当β从0变化到1时，平滑性自然出现，而无需专门设计损失函数。作者进一步提出一种称为“盲目丢弃或信任(DTB)”的系统方法，可将任意在线算法转化为OAG模型下的学习增强在线算法。对给定的无预测在线算法，DTB编译器产生的算法要么盲目跟随指导，要么完全忽略指导并按原算法执行；两种选择通过有偏硬币决定。尽管极其简单，DTB生成的算法类在缓存、均匀度量任务系统上达到最优竞争比，在二分匹配（敌对到达顺序）上超越现有最佳结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出OAG模型，将在线算法的预测与决策彻底分离，并以概率β刻画指导被破坏程度。设计的DTB编译器通过随机选择“信任或丢弃”指导，把任意在线算法升级为学习增强版本，在一致性、鲁棒性与平滑性上提供可证明保证，并在缓存、均匀度量任务系统与二分匹配问题上实现最优或超越现有最佳竞争比。
AI.keywords: 在线算法; 机器学习增强; 不可靠指导; 一致性; 鲁棒性; 平滑性; DTB编译器; 缓存; 度量任务系统; 二分匹配
AI.comments: 文中仅给出高阶思路与竞争比结果，未披露具体算法细节与实验评估；实际部署时的硬币偏差选择、计算开销与经验性能仍需进一步研究。

title: ICON: Indirect Prompt Injection Defense for Agents based on Inference-Time Correction
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are susceptible to Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) attacks, where malicious instructions in retrieved content hijack the agent's execution. Existing defenses typically rely on strict filtering or refusal mechanisms, which suffer from a critical limitation: over-refusal, prematurely terminating valid agentic workflows. We propose ICON, a probing-to-mitigation framework that neutralizes attacks while preserving task continuity. Our key insight is that IPI attacks leave distinct over-focusing signatures in the latent space. We introduce a Latent Space Trace Prober to detect attacks based on high intensity scores. Subsequently, a Mitigating Rectifier performs surgical attention steering that selectively manipulate adversarial query key dependencies while amplifying task relevant elements to restore the LLM's functional trajectory. Extensive evaluations on multiple backbones show that ICON achieves a competitive 0.4% ASR, matching commercial grade detectors, while yielding a over 50% task utility gain. Furthermore, ICON demonstrates robust Out of Distribution(OOD) generalization and extends effectively to multi-modal agents, establishing a superior balance between security and efficiency.

AI.title_translation: ICON：基于推理时纠偏的智能体间接提示注入防御方法
AI.tldr: 提出ICON框架，通过潜在空间痕迹探针检测攻击、缓解矫正器进行注意力引导，在不中断任务的前提下将攻击成功率降至0.4%，并提升任务效用超50%。

title: Onboard-Targeted Segmentation of Straylight in Space Camera Sensors
comments: Submitted to Aerospace Science and Technology
summary: This study details an artificial intelligence (AI)-based methodology for the semantic segmentation of space camera faults. Specifically, we address the segmentation of straylight effects induced by solar presence around the camera's Field of View (FoV). Anomalous images are sourced from our published dataset. Our approach emphasizes generalization across diverse flare textures, leveraging pre-training on a public dataset (Flare7k++) including flares in various non-space contexts to mitigate the scarcity of realistic space-specific data. A DeepLabV3 model with MobileNetV3 backbone performs the segmentation task. The model design targets deployment in spacecraft resource-constrained hardware. Finally, based on a proposed interface between our model and the onboard navigation pipeline, we develop custom metrics to assess the model's performance in the system-level context.
comment: Submitted to Aerospace Science and Technology

title: Counterfactual Simulation Training for Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
summary: Inspecting Chain-of-Thought reasoning is among the most common means of understanding why an LLM produced its output. But well-known problems with CoT faithfulness severely limit what insights can be gained from this practice. In this paper, we introduce a training method called Counterfactual Simulation Training (CST), which aims to improve CoT faithfulness by rewarding CoTs that enable a simulator to accurately predict a model's outputs over counterfactual inputs. We apply CST in two settings: (1) CoT monitoring with cue-based counterfactuals, to detect when models rely on spurious features, reward hack, or are sycophantic, and (2) counterfactual simulation over generic model-based counterfactuals, to encourage models to produce more faithful, generalizable reasoning in the CoT. Experiments with models up to 235B parameters show that CST can substantially improve monitor accuracy on cue-based counterfactuals (by 35 accuracy points) as well as simulatability over generic counterfactuals (by 2 points). We further show that: (1) CST outperforms prompting baselines, (2) rewriting unfaithful CoTs with an LLM is 5x more efficient than RL alone, (3) faithfulness improvements do not generalize to dissuading cues (as opposed to persuading cues), and (4) larger models do not show more faithful CoT out of the box, but they do benefit more from CST. These results suggest that CST can improve CoT faithfulness in general, with promising applications for CoT monitoring. Code for experiments in this paper is available at https://github.com/peterbhase/counterfactual-simulation-training

AI.conclusion: CST能有效提升思维链忠实度，为CoT监测与可解释性提供实用新工具。

title: WeirNet: A Large-Scale 3D CFD Benchmark for Geometric Surrogate Modeling of Piano Key Weirs
summary: Reliable prediction of hydraulic performance is challenging for Piano Key Weir (PKW) design because discharge capacity depends on three-dimensional geometry and operating conditions. Surrogate models can accelerate hydraulic-structure design, but progress is limited by scarce large, well-documented datasets that jointly capture geometric variation, operating conditions, and functional performance. This study presents WeirNet, a large 3D CFD benchmark dataset for geometric surrogate modeling of PKWs. WeirNet contains 3,794 parametric, feasibility-constrained rectangular and trapezoidal PKW geometries, each scheduled at 19 discharge conditions using a consistent free-surface OpenFOAM workflow, resulting in 71,387 completed simulations that form the benchmark and with complete discharge coefficient labels. The dataset is released as multiple modalities compact parametric descriptors, watertight surface meshes and high-resolution point clouds together with standardized tasks and in-distribution and out-of-distribution splits. Representative surrogate families are benchmarked for discharge coefficient prediction. Tree-based regressors on parametric descriptors achieve the best overall accuracy, while point- and mesh-based models remain competitive and offer parameterization-agnostic inference. All surrogates evaluate in milliseconds per sample, providing orders-of-magnitude speedups over CFD runtimes. Out-of-distribution results identify geometry shift as the dominant failure mode compared to unseen discharge values, and data-efficiency experiments show diminishing returns beyond roughly 60% of the training data. By publicly releasing the dataset together with simulation setups and evaluation pipelines, WeirNet establishes a reproducible framework for data-driven hydraulic modeling and enables faster exploration of PKW designs during the early stages of hydraulic planning.

title: IG-RFT: An Interaction-Guided RL Framework for VLA Models in Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated significant potential for generalist robotic policies; however, they struggle to generalize to long-horizon complex tasks in novel real-world domains due to distribution shifts and the scarcity of high-quality demonstrations. Although reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising avenue for policy improvement, applying it to real-world VLA fine-tuning faces challenges regarding exploration efficiency, training stability, and sample cost. To address these issues, we propose IG-RFT, a novel Interaction-Guided Reinforced Fine-Tuning system designed for flow-based VLA models. Firstly, to facilitate effective policy optimization, we introduce Interaction-Guided Advantage Weighted Regression (IG-AWR), an RL algorithm that dynamically modulates exploration intensity based on the robot's interaction status. Furthermore, to address the limitations of sparse or task-specific rewards, we design a novel hybrid dense reward function that integrates the trajectory-level reward and the subtask-level reward. Finally, we construct a three-stage RL system comprising SFT, Offline RL, and Human-in-the-Loop RL for fine-tuning VLA models. Extensive real-world experiments on four challenging long-horizon tasks demonstrate that IG-RFT achieves an average success rate of 85.0%, significantly outperforming SFT (18.8%) and standard Offline RL baselines (40.0%). Ablation studies confirm the critical contributions of IG-AWR and hybrid reward shaping. In summary, our work establishes and validates a novel reinforced fine-tuning system for VLA models in real-world robotic manipulation.

AI.title_translation: IG-RFT：面向长时程机器人操作的交互引导强化微调框架
AI.tldr: 提出IG-RFT，用交互引导的强化学习微调VLA模型，解决长时程任务泛化难题，在真实实验中把成功率从18.8%提升到85%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在新场景长时程任务上因分布偏移与高质量演示稀缺而泛化失败，传统RL微调又面临探索效率低、训练不稳定与样本成本高等问题。
AI.method: 设计IG-AWR算法，根据机器人交互状态动态调整探索强度；提出融合轨迹级与子任务级的混合密集奖励；构建SFT→离线RL→人在回路RL的三阶段微调系统。
AI.result: 在四项挑战性长时程真实任务中，IG-RFT平均成功率达85.0%，显著优于SFT（18.8%）与标准离线RL基线（40.0%）；消融实验验证IG-AWR与混合奖励的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: IG-RFT为真实机器人VLA模型提供了一种高效、稳定且可扩展的强化微调范式，显著提升长时程操作任务的成功率与泛化能力。
AI.translation: IG-RFT：面向长时程机器人操作的交互引导强化微调框架
AI.summary: IG-RFT针对VLA模型在长时程任务上的泛化瓶颈，提出交互引导的强化微调系统。核心创新包括：1) IG-AWR算法依据机器人交互状态动态调节探索强度，提升样本效率；2) 混合密集奖励融合轨迹与子任务反馈，缓解稀疏奖励问题；3) 三阶段训练流程（SFT→离线RL→人在回路RL）保障稳定收敛。真实世界四项长时程任务实验显示，IG-RFT将平均成功率从18.8%大幅提高到85%，显著超越现有方法。
