AI.title_translation: 多分辨率三维网格上的高效分层任意角度路径规划
AI.tldr: 提出一种分层任意角度路径规划算法，利用多分辨率体素地图，在保持最优性与完备性的同时显著优于传统搜索与采样方法。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模高分辨率地图中，采样与轨迹优化方法未利用体素地图显式连通信息，而A*等搜索方法可扩展性差，需要兼顾路径最优性与计算效率。
AI.method: 基于多分辨率体素地图构建分层结构，将任意角度规划（以直线连接障碍物角点）与分层搜索结合，仅在必要时进入更高分辨率，保持最优性和完备性。
AI.result: 在真实与合成环境的大量实验中，该方法在路径质量与计算速度上均优于传统搜索与采样方法，并公开源代码。
AI.conclusion: 利用多分辨率表示的分层任意角度规划能在保持最优性与完备性的同时解决搜索方法的计算瓶颈，适用于大规模复杂环境导航。
AI.translation: 多分辨率体素映射被广泛用于表示大型复杂环境，但主流路径规划方法未能利用其显式连通信息，搜索方法又面临扩展性难题。本文提出的分层任意角度规划在保持最优性和完备性的同时显著提速，实验验证其优于采样方法并已开源。
AI.summary: 本文针对大规模高分辨率体素地图的路径规划难题，提出一种分层任意角度规划方法。算法利用多分辨率结构，仅在必要时细化网格，通过直线连接障碍物角点寻找欧氏最短路径，兼顾最优性与计算效率。实验表明其路径质量与速度均优于A*及采样方法，并已开源供社区使用。
AI.keywords: 任意角度路径规划，多分辨率网格，分层搜索，最优性，完备性，机器人导航
AI.comments: 摘要未提及算法具体实现细节（如分层策略、剪枝规则）及与最优解的误差界限；未给出具体速度提升倍数或内存占用数据。

title: Seeing Through Words: Controlling Visual Retrieval Quality with Language Models
summary: Text-to-image retrieval is a fundamental task in vision-language learning, yet in real-world scenarios it is often challenged by short and underspecified user queries. Such queries are typically only one or two words long, rendering them semantically ambiguous, prone to collisions across diverse visual interpretations, and lacking explicit control over the quality of retrieved images. To address these issues, we propose a new paradigm of quality-controllable retrieval, which enriches short queries with contextual details while incorporating explicit notions of image quality. Our key idea is to leverage a generative language model as a query completion function, extending underspecified queries into descriptive forms that capture fine-grained visual attributes such as pose, scene, and aesthetics. We introduce a general framework that conditions query completion on discretized quality levels, derived from relevance and aesthetic scoring models, so that query enrichment is not only semantically meaningful but also quality-aware. The resulting system provides three key advantages: 1) flexibility, it is compatible with any pretrained vision-language model (VLMs) without modification; 2) transparency, enriched queries are explicitly interpretable by users; and 3) controllability, enabling retrieval results to be steered toward user-preferred quality levels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed approach significantly improves retrieval results and provides effective quality control, bridging the gap between the expressive capacity of modern VLMs and the underspecified nature of short user queries. Our code is available at https://github.com/Jianglin954/QCQC.

AI.title_translation: 透过文字看本质：用语言模型控制视觉检索质量
AI.tldr: 提出一种质量可控的文本到图像检索范式，用生成式语言模型将短查询扩展为包含质量等级条件的描述性查询，实现无需改动VLM、可解释且可控的高质量检索。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中用户查询通常仅一两词，语义模糊且缺乏对图像质量的显式控制，导致检索结果不佳。
AI.method: 利用生成式语言模型作为查询补全函数，将不明确的短查询扩展为包含姿态、场景、美感等细节的描述，并以离散质量等级（由相关性和美感评分模型得出）为条件进行查询丰富，形成兼容任意预训练VLM的通用框架。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著提升检索效果，实现用户偏好质量水平的有效控制，弥合现代VLM表达力与短查询不足之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过质量感知的查询扩展，可在无需修改VLM的前提下提供灵活、透明且可控的视觉检索体验。
AI.translation: 文本到图像检索是视觉-语言学习的基础任务，但在现实中常受限于简短且不规范的用户查询。这类查询通常仅一两个词，语义模糊，易在不同视觉解释间产生冲突，且无法显式控制检索图像质量。为此，我们提出质量可控检索的新范式，在丰富短查询上下文细节的同时引入图像质量显式概念。核心思路是利用生成式语言模型作为查询补全函数，将不明确的查询扩展为包含姿态、场景、美感等细粒度视觉属性的描述形式。我们提出通用框架，将查询补全条件化为离散质量等级（源自相关性与美感评分模型），使查询丰富既语义有意义又质量感知。该系统具备三大优势：1）灵活，无需修改即可兼容任何预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）；2）透明，扩展后的查询用户可显式解读；3）可控，可将检索结果导向用户偏好的质量等级。大量实验表明所提方法显著提升检索效果并实现有效质量控制，弥合现代VLM表达力与短查询不足之间的差距。代码已开源。
AI.summary: 本文针对短查询导致的图像检索质量不佳问题，提出质量可控检索框架，用生成式语言模型按质量等级扩展查询，实现无需修改VLM、可解释且可控的精准检索。
AI.keywords: 文本到图像检索;查询扩展;生成式语言模型;质量可控;视觉语言模型
AI.comments: 代码已开源；方法通用性强，可直接用于现有VLM；未来可探索更多质量维度与用户交互方式。

title: XMorph: Explainable Brain Tumor Analysis Via LLM-Assisted Hybrid Deep Intelligence
comments: Accepted in ICCABS 2026: The 14th International Conference on Computational Advances in Bio and Medical Sciences
summary: Deep learning has significantly advanced automated brain tumor diagnosis, yet clinical adoption remains limited by interpretability and computational constraints. Conventional models often act as opaque ''black boxes'' and fail to quantify the complex, irregular tumor boundaries that characterize malignant growth. To address these challenges, we present XMorph, an explainable and computationally efficient framework for fine-grained classification of three prominent brain tumor types: glioma, meningioma, and pituitary tumors. We propose an Information-Weighted Boundary Normalization (IWBN) mechanism that emphasizes diagnostically relevant boundary regions alongside nonlinear chaotic and clinically validated features, enabling a richer morphological representation of tumor growth. A dual-channel explainable AI module combines GradCAM++ visual cues with LLM-generated textual rationales, translating model reasoning into clinically interpretable insights. The proposed framework achieves a classification accuracy of 96.0%, demonstrating that explainability and high performance can co-exist in AI-based medical imaging systems. The source code and materials for XMorph are all publicly available at: https://github.com/ALSER-Lab/XMorph.
comment: Accepted in ICCABS 2026: The 14th International Conference on Computational Advances in Bio and Medical Sciences

AI.title_translation: XMorph：基于大语言模型辅助混合深度智能的可解释脑肿瘤分析
AI.tldr: 提出可解释且高效的XMorph框架，通过边界加权归一化与双通道可解释模块，实现胶质瘤、脑膜瘤、垂体瘤精细分类，准确率达96.0%。
AI.motivation: 临床需要可解释且计算高效的AI系统，以突破现有黑盒模型无法量化恶性脑肿瘤复杂边界的局限，提升自动化诊断可信度与采用率。
AI.method: 设计信息加权边界归一化(IWBN)突出诊断关键边界；构建双通道可解释模块，融合GradCAM++视觉热力图与大语言模型生成的文本理由，输出临床易懂的决策依据。
AI.result: 在三类主要脑肿瘤分类任务上，XMorph取得96.0%的准确率，证明可解释性与高性能可共存。
AI.conclusion: XMorph在保持高准确率的同时提供临床可解释洞察，为AI医学影像进入实际诊疗提供可行路径。
AI.translation: 深度学习虽显著推进脑肿瘤自动诊断，却因可解释性与计算限制难以落地。常规模型如黑箱，无法量化恶性增殖的不规则边界。本文提出可解释且高效的XMorph框架，对胶质瘤、脑膜瘤、垂体瘤进行细分类。我们设计信息加权边界归一化(IWBN)突出诊断相关边界及非线性混沌特征，实现更丰富的肿瘤形态表示。双通道可解释AI模块结合GradCAM++视觉提示与大语言模型文本理由，将模型推理转化为临床可解释洞见。该框架分类准确率达96.0%，证明AI医学影像可同时具备可解释性与高性能。源码与材料已公开。
AI.summary: XMorph通过IWBN机制强化肿瘤边界特征，并以GradCAM++与LLM生成文本理由提供可视化与语言双重解释，在三大常见脑肿瘤分类任务上实现96%准确率，兼顾性能与可解释性。
AI.keywords: 脑肿瘤分类,可解释AI,GradCAM++,大语言模型,信息加权边界归一化
AI.comments: 摘要未提及模型计算效率具体指标、数据集规模及与现有方法的详细对比，也未见前瞻性临床验证计划。

title: Mask-HybridGNet: Graph-based segmentation with emergent anatomical correspondence from pixel-level supervision
summary: Graph-based medical image segmentation represents anatomical structures using boundary graphs, providing fixed-topology landmarks and inherent population-level correspondences. However, their clinical adoption has been hindered by a major requirement: training datasets with manually annotated landmarks that maintain point-to-point correspondences across patients rarely exist in practice. We introduce Mask-HybridGNet, a framework that trains graph-based models directly using standard pixel-wise masks, eliminating the need for manual landmark annotations. Our approach aligns variable-length ground truth boundaries with fixed-length landmark predictions by combining Chamfer distance supervision and edge-based regularization to ensure local smoothness and regular landmark distribution, further refined via differentiable rasterization. A significant emergent property of this framework is that predicted landmark positions become consistently associated with specific anatomical locations across patients without explicit correspondence supervision. This implicit atlas learning enables temporal tracking, cross-slice reconstruction, and morphological population analyses. Beyond direct segmentation, Mask-HybridGNet can extract correspondences from existing segmentation masks, allowing it to generate stable anatomical atlases from any high-quality pixel-based model. Experiments across chest radiography, cardiac ultrasound, cardiac MRI, and fetal imaging demonstrate that our model achieves competitive results against state-of-the-art pixel-based methods, while ensuring anatomical plausibility by enforcing boundary connectivity through a fixed graph adjacency matrix. This framework leverages the vast availability of standard segmentation masks to build structured models that maintain topological integrity and provide implicit correspondences.

AI.title_translation: Mask-HybridGNet：基于图的分割通过像素级监督实现解剖对应
AI.tldr: Mask-HybridGNet 用像素级掩码训练固定拓扑图模型，无需手工标记点即可在跨受试者间自动建立解剖对应，实现分割与隐式图谱学习。
AI.motivation: 临床缺乏带逐点对应的手工标记训练集，阻碍基于图的医学图像分割落地；需利用现成像素掩码实现图模型训练并保留跨受试者对应。
AI.method: 用 Chamfer 距离与边正则化将可变长真值边界对齐到固定长图节点预测，经可微栅格化保持局部平滑与均匀分布；图邻接矩阵固定以保证拓扑连通。
AI.result: 在胸片、心超、心脏 MRI 与胎儿成像上，与最新像素方法相比分割性能相当，且节点自动与特定解剖位置一致，支持追踪、重建与群体分析。
AI.conclusion: 框架可直接用像素掩码训练图模型，无需标记点即可隐式学习解剖对应，生成稳定图谱并保持拓扑完整，可利用任何高质量像素模型提取对应。
AI.translation: 图式医学图像分割用边界图表示解剖结构，提供固定拓扑标志点和群体对应，但需跨受试者手工标记点训练集，临床难获取。我们提出 Mask-HybridGNet，用像素掩码训练图模型，无需手工标志。Chamfer 距离与边正则化对齐可变真值边界与固定节点预测，经可微栅格化保持平滑与均匀。节点自动与特定解剖位置对应，无需显式监督，实现追踪、重建与群体分析。本框架可从像素掩码提取对应，生成稳定图谱。多模态实验表明，与像素方法性能相当且保持拓扑合理。
AI.summary: Mask-HybridGNet 通过 Chamfer 距离与边正则化，将像素级掩码用于训练固定拓扑图模型，无需手工标志即可实现分割并自动建立跨受试者解剖对应，支持隐式图谱学习与群体分析。
AI.keywords: 图分割；医学图像；像素监督；解剖对应；Chamfer 距离；拓扑保持；隐式图谱
AI.comments: 方法对可变长对齐与栅格化细节未展开；未报告具体分割指标与统计显著性；跨域泛化及计算开销待验证。

title: Memory Undone: Between Knowing and Not Knowing in Data Systems
summary: Machine learning and data systems increasingly function as infrastructures of memory: they ingest, store, and operationalize traces of personal, political, and cultural life. Yet contemporary governance demands credible forms of forgetting, from GDPR-backed deletion to harm-mitigation and the removal of manipulative content, while technical infrastructures are optimized to retain, replicate, and reuse. This work argues that "forgetting" in computational systems cannot be reduced to a single operation (e.g., record deletion) and should instead be treated as a sociotechnical practice with distinct mechanisms and consequences. We clarify a vocabulary that separates erasure (removing or disabling access to data artifacts), unlearning (interventions that bound or remove a data point influence on learned parameters and outputs), exclusion (upstream non-collection and omission), and forgetting as an umbrella term spanning agency, temporality, reversibility, and scale. Building on examples from machine unlearning, semantic dependencies in data management, participatory data modeling, and manipulation at scale, we show how forgetting can simultaneously protect rights and enable silencing. We propose reframing unlearning as a first-class capability in knowledge infrastructures, evaluated not only by compliance or utility retention, but by its governance properties: transparency, accountability, and epistemic justice.

AI.title_translation: 记忆消解：数据系统中的知与未知之间
AI.tldr: 论文指出“遗忘”在计算系统中不应简化为删除，而应视为涵盖擦除、反学习、排除等机制的社会技术实践，并主张将反学习作为知识基础设施的核心能力，以透明度、问责与认知正义为治理目标。
AI.motivation: 现有数据系统以保留和复用为优化目标，而法规与社会需求却要求可信的遗忘机制；二者之间存在结构性张力，需重新定义“遗忘”并建立治理框架。
AI.method: 通过界定擦除、反学习、排除与遗忘等概念，结合机器反学习、语义依赖、参与式建模与大规模操纵的案例分析，提出以治理属性评估知识基础设施的反学习能力。
AI.result: 论证了遗忘机制可同时保护权利与造成沉默风险，提出将反学习提升为知识基础设施的一级能力，并以透明度、问责与认知正义作为评估维度。
AI.conclusion: “遗忘”是社会技术实践而非单一技术操作，需将反学习纳入系统核心并建立以治理属性为核心的评估体系，以平衡保留与遗忘的张力。
AI.translation: 机器学习与数据系统日益成为记忆的基础设施，但治理要求可信遗忘，而系统却优化保留。本文提出遗忘是社会技术实践，区分擦除、反学习、排除等机制，并主张以透明度、问责与认知正义评估反学习能力。
AI.summary: 作者指出数据系统以保留为中心与法规遗忘需求冲突，提出将遗忘视为涵盖擦除、反学习、排除的社会技术实践，强调反学习应成为知识基础设施的核心能力，并以透明度、问责与认知正义为治理评估标准。
AI.keywords: 遗忘，反学习，擦除，排除，数据治理，GDPR，知识基础设施，认知正义，透明度，问责
AI.comments: 未提及实验或定量评估，主要贡献为概念框架与治理视角，未来需具体实现与政策落地研究。

title: Circumventing the CAP Theorem with Open Atomic Ethernet
summary: The CAP theorem is routinely treated as a systems law: under network partition, a replicated service must sacrifice either consistency or availability. The theorem is correct within its standard asynchronous network model, but operational practice depends on where partition-like phenomena become observable and on how lower layers discard or preserve semantic information about message fate. This paper argues that Open Atomic Ethernet (OAE) shifts the engineering regime in which CAP tradeoffs become application-visible by (i) replacing fire-and-forget link semantics with bounded-time bilateral reconciliation of endpoint state -- the property we call bisynchrony -- and (ii) avoiding Clos funnel points via an octavalent mesh in which each node can act as the root of a locally repaired spanning tree. The result is not the elimination of hard graph cuts, but a drastic reduction in the frequency and duration of application-visible "soft partitions" by detecting and healing dominant fabric faults within hundreds of nanoseconds. We connect this view to Brewer's original CAP framing, the formalization by Gilbert and Lynch, the CAL theorem of Lee et al., which replaces binary partition tolerance with a quantitative measure of apparent latency, and Abadi's PACELC extension.

AI.title_translation: 用开放原子以太网绕过CAP定理
AI.tldr: 本文提出开放原子以太网（OAE），通过 bisynchrony 和八价网格拓扑，将应用可见的“软分区”频率和持续时间降至纳秒级，从而在工程层面规避CAP定理的权衡。
AI.motivation: 尽管CAP定理在理论上成立，但实际系统中网络分区何时可见、低层如何保留消息语义信息，决定了其影响；作者希望降低应用层感知的分区代价。
AI.method: 引入OAE：1) 用bisynchrony（有界双向状态协调）替代链路“发后不理”语义；2) 采用八价网格，避免Clos汇聚点，实现本地快速修复生成树。
AI.result: 未消除硬图割，但将主要结构故障的检测与愈合时间压缩至数百纳秒，显著减少应用可见软分区的频率与持续时间。
AI.conclusion: OAE改变了CAP权衡显现的工程机制，使系统在出现网络故障时更接近“既一致又可用”。
AI.translation: CAP定理常被奉为系统铁律：网络分区下，副本系统必须牺牲一致性或可用性。该定理在标准异步网络模型中成立，但运维实践取决于分区现象何时可见及低层如何丢弃或保留消息命运语义。本文认为开放原子以太网（OAE）通过(i)以有界双向端状态调和（bisynchrony）替代链路“发后不理”语义，(ii)经八价网格避免Clos汇聚点，使每节点可充当本地修复生成树的根，从而改变CAP权衡在应用层可见的工程条件。结果并非消除硬图割，而是将主要结构故障的检测与愈合压缩至数百纳秒，显著减少应用可见“软分区”的频率与持续时间。本文联系Brewer原始CAP表述、Gilbert与Lynch形式化、Lee等人以可感知延迟量化替代二分分区容忍的CAL定理，以及Abadi的PACELC扩展。
AI.summary: 开放原子以太网通过bisynchrony与八价网格，把分区检测与修复推进到纳秒级，显著降低应用可见分区，从而在实践中绕过CAP定理的限制。
AI.keywords: CAP定理,开放原子以太网,bisynchrony,网络分区,软分区,八价网格
AI.comments: 摘要未给出实验规模、评估指标或真实部署案例；需查阅全文验证纳秒级修复对上层应用的实际影响。

title: 823-OLT @ BUET DL Sprint 4.0: Context-Aware Windowing for ASR and Fine-Tuned Speaker Diarization in Bengali Long Form Audio
summary: Bengali, despite being one of the most widely spoken languages globally, remains underrepresented in long form speech technology, particularly in systems addressing transcription and speaker attribution. We present frameworks for long form Bengali speech intelligence that address automatic speech recognition using a Whisper Medium based model and speaker diarization using a finetuned segmentation model. The ASR pipeline incorporates vocal separation, voice activity detection, and a gap aware windowing strategy to construct context preserving segments for stable decoding. For diarization, a pretrained speaker segmentation model is finetuned on the official competition dataset (provided as part of the DL Sprint 4.0 competition organized under BUET CSE Fest), to better capture Bengali conversational patterns. The resulting systems deliver both efficient transcription of long form audio and speaker aware transcription to provide scalable speech technology solutions for low resource languages.

AI.title_translation: 823-OLT @ BUET DL Sprint 4.0：面向孟加拉语长音频的语境感知分窗ASR与微调说话人分离
AI.tldr: 提出面向孟加拉语长音频的语音识别与说话人分离框架，利用Whisper Medium与微调分割模型实现高效转录与说话人标注。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语在全球使用广泛，但长音频语音技术（转录与说话人归属）资源匮乏，亟需可扩展的低资源语言语音智能方案。

AI.translation: 孟加拉语虽为全球使用人数最多的语言之一，但在长音频语音技术中仍严重缺乏，尤其在转录与说话人归属方面。我们提出面向长音频孟加拉语语音智能的框架，采用基于Whisper Medium的自动语音识别与微调分割模型的说话人分离。ASR流程集成语音分离、语音活动检测与间隙感知分窗策略，构建保留语境的片段以实现稳定解码。对于说话人分离，在官方比赛数据集（BUET CSE Fest 下的 DL Sprint 4.0 提供）上微调预训练说话人分割模型，以更好捕捉孟加拉语会话模式。最终系统实现长音频高效转录与说话人感知转录，为低资源语言提供可扩展的语音技术方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出面向孟加拉语长音频的语音识别与说话人分离框架，通过语境感知分窗与微调策略提升低资源语言语音智能性能。

title: The Diffusion Duality, Chapter II: $Ψ$-Samplers and Efficient Curriculum
summary: Uniform-state discrete diffusion models excel at few-step generation and guidance due to their ability to self-correct, making them preferred over autoregressive or Masked diffusion models in these settings. However, their sampling quality plateaus with ancestral samplers as the number of steps increases. We introduce a family of Predictor-Corrector (PC) samplers for discrete diffusion that generalize prior methods and apply to arbitrary noise processes. When paired with uniform-state diffusion, our samplers outperform ancestral sampling on both language and image modeling, achieving lower generative perplexity at matched unigram entropy on OpenWebText and better FID/IS scores on CIFAR10. Crucially, unlike conventional samplers, our PC methods continue to improve with more sampling steps. Taken together, these findings call into question the assumption that Masked diffusion is the inevitable future of diffusion-based language modeling. Beyond sampling, we develop a memory-efficient curriculum for the Gaussian relaxation training phase, reducing training time by 25% and memory by 33% compared to Duo while maintaining comparable perplexity on OpenWebText and LM1B and strong downstream performance. We release code, checkpoints, and a video-tutorial on: https://s-sahoo.com/duo-ch2

AI.title_translation: 扩散对偶性·第二章：Ψ-采样器与高效课程
AI.tldr: 论文提出Predictor-Corrector采样器与内存友好课程，使均匀状态离散扩散模型在长步数下仍持续改进，并在语言与图像任务上超越Masked扩散。
AI.motivation: 均匀状态离散扩散虽在少步生成与引导上优于自回归和Masked扩散，但其祖先采样质量随步数增加而停滞，需新采样策略突破瓶颈。
AI.method: 设计通用Predictor-Corrector采样器家族，适配任意噪声过程；引入高斯松弛训练阶段的内存高效课程，减少25%训练时间与33%内存。
AI.result: 在OpenWebText上实现更低生成困惑度，CIFAR10上获得更佳FID/IS；PC采样器随步数增加持续提升性能，训练课程在保持困惑度与下游表现的同时显著节省资源。
AI.conclusion: PC采样器使均匀状态扩散在长步数下仍具优势，质疑Masked扩散作为语言建模必然方向的假设；高效课程进一步降低训练成本。
AI.translation: 离散均匀状态扩散模型因其自纠正能力，在少步生成与引导方面优于自回归或Masked扩散。然而，其采样质量随步数增加而趋于平稳。我们提出Predictor-Corrector采样器家族，适用于任意噪声过程，并在语言与图像建模上超越祖先采样。此外，开发了内存高效的训练课程，显著减少训练时间与内存。
AI.summary: 本文针对均匀状态离散扩散模型提出Predictor-Corrector采样器，突破长步数采样瓶颈，在文本与图像任务上取得更优生成质量，并配套内存高效训练课程，降低训练成本。
AI.keywords: 离散扩散模型,Predictor-Corrector采样器,均匀状态,课程学习,语言建模,图像生成
AI.comments: 作者提供了代码、检查点与视频教程，便于复现与推广；未来可探索PC采样器在更大规模模型与多模态任务上的扩展性。

title: Spa3R: Predictive Spatial Field Modeling for 3D Visual Reasoning
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit exceptional 2D visual understanding, their ability to comprehend and reason about 3D space--a cornerstone of spatial intelligence--remains superficial. Current methodologies attempt to bridge this domain gap either by relying on explicit 3D modalities or by augmenting VLMs with partial, view-conditioned geometric priors. However, such approaches hinder scalability and ultimately burden the language model with the ill-posed task of implicitly reconstructing holistic 3D geometry from sparse cues. In this paper, we argue that spatial intelligence can emerge inherently from 2D vision alone, rather than being imposed via explicit spatial instruction tuning. To this end, we introduce Spa3R, a self-supervised framework that learns a unified, view-invariant spatial representation directly from unposed multi-view images. Spa3R is built upon the proposed Predictive Spatial Field Modeling (PSFM) paradigm, where Spa3R learns to synthesize feature fields for arbitrary unseen views conditioned on a compact latent representation, thereby internalizing a holistic and coherent understanding of the underlying 3D scene. We further integrate the pre-trained Spa3R Encoder into existing VLMs via a lightweight adapter to form Spa3-VLM, effectively grounding language reasoning in a global spatial context. Experiments on the challenging VSI-Bench demonstrate that Spa3-VLM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 58.6% on 3D VQA, significantly outperforming prior methods. These results highlight PSFM as a scalable path toward advancing spatial intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/Spa3R.

AI.title_translation: Spa3R：用于3D视觉推理的预测性空间场建模
AI.tldr: 提出Spa3R框架，通过自监督方式从多视角图像学习统一视角不变空间表征，并整合进VLM，在VSI-Bench上实现SOTA的3D VQA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型缺乏真正的3D空间理解，依赖显式3D模态或稀疏几何先验的方法扩展性差，需让空间智能从2D视觉中自然涌现。
AI.method: 提出预测性空间场建模（PSFM）范式，Spa3R自监督学习从任意视角合成特征场，获得全局一致3D场景表征；用轻量适配器将预训练Spa3R编码器嵌入VLM，形成Spa3-VLM。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench上，Spa3-VLM取得58.6%的3D VQA准确率，显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: PSFM为可扩展地提升模型空间智能提供了新路径，无需显式3D监督即可实现强大的3D推理能力。
AI.translation: 虽然视觉语言模型在2D视觉理解上表现卓越，但其对3D空间的理解与推理——空间智能的基石——仍显浅薄。当前方法要么依赖显式3D模态，要么用部分视角条件几何先验增强VLM，却妨碍扩展性并将隐式重建完整3D几何的不适定任务强加给语言模型。本文主张空间智能可从2D视觉中自然涌现，而非通过显式空间指令微调强加。为此，我们提出Spa3R，一个自监督框架，直接从无位姿多视角图像中学习统一、视角不变的空间表征。Spa3R基于提出的预测性空间场建模（PSFM）范式，学会在给定紧凑潜码条件下为任意未见视角合成特征场，从而内化对底层3D场景的整体一致理解。我们将预训练Spa3R编码器通过轻量适配器集成到现有VLM，形成Spa3-VLM，使语言推理根植于全局空间上下文。在具有挑战性的VSI-Bench上，Spa3-VLM在3D VQA任务上达到58.6%的SOTA准确率，显著超越先前方法。结果凸显PSFM是推进空间智能的可扩展途径。代码已开源。
AI.summary: Spa3R通过PSFM自监督学习统一视角不变空间表征，无需显式3D监督即可让VLM获得全局3D理解，在VSI-Bench上刷新3D VQA记录。
AI.keywords: 空间智能,3D视觉推理,视觉语言模型,自监督学习,多视角学习,特征场合成
AI.comments: 方法简洁高效，无需位姿或3D真值；开源代码与轻量适配器设计利于社区快速复现与部署。

title: Human Video Generation from a Single Image with 3D Pose and View Control
summary: Recent diffusion methods have made significant progress in generating videos from single images due to their powerful visual generation capabilities. However, challenges persist in image-to-video synthesis, particularly in human video generation, where inferring view-consistent, motion-dependent clothing wrinkles from a single image remains a formidable problem. In this paper, we present Human Video Generation in 4D (HVG), a latent video diffusion model capable of generating high-quality, multi-view, spatiotemporally coherent human videos from a single image with 3D pose and view control. HVG achieves this through three key designs: (i) Articulated Pose Modulation, which captures the anatomical relationships of 3D joints via a novel dual-dimensional bone map and resolves self-occlusions across views by introducing 3D information; (ii) View and Temporal Alignment, which ensures multi-view consistency and alignment between a reference image and pose sequences for frame-to-frame stability; and (iii) Progressive Spatio-Temporal Sampling with temporal alignment to maintain smooth transitions in long multi-view animations. Extensive experiments on image-to-video tasks demonstrate that HVG outperforms existing methods in generating high-quality 4D human videos from diverse human images and pose inputs.

AI.title_translation: 基于单张图像与3D姿态/视角控制的人体视频生成
AI.tldr: 提出HVG潜变量视频扩散模型，通过关节姿态调制、多视角时序对齐与渐进时空采样，从单张图像生成高质量、多视角一致、时序连贯的人体视频。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型虽能从单图生成视频，但在推断视角一致、依赖运动的服装褶皱等细节时仍存巨大挑战，尤其在人体视频合成中。
AI.method: 设计HVG框架，包含：1)关节姿态调制，用双维骨骼图引入3D关节信息解决自遮挡；2)视角与时序对齐，保证参考图与姿态序列的多视角一致；3)渐进时空采样加时序对齐，实现长序列平滑过渡。
AI.result: 在图像到视频任务上，HVG在多样人体图像与姿态输入下生成的4D人体视频质量优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: HVG通过三大核心设计，实现了从单图控制3D姿态与视角的高质量、多视角、时序连贯的人体视频生成。
AI.translation: 近期扩散方法因强大视觉生成能力，在单图生成视频方面取得显著进展。然而，图像到视频合成仍面临挑战，尤其在人体视频生成中，从单图推断视角一致、运动依赖的服装褶皱仍是难题。本文提出4D人体视频生成（HVG）潜变量视频扩散模型，可从单图与3D姿态/视角控制生成高质量、多视角、时空连贯的人体视频。HVG通过三项关键设计实现：(i)关节姿态调制，通过新颖双维骨骼图捕捉3D关节解剖关系并引入3D信息解决跨视角自遮挡；(ii)视角与时序对齐，确保参考图与姿态序列的多视角一致与帧间稳定；(iii)渐进时空采样配合时序对齐，维持长多视角动画的平滑过渡。大量图像到视频实验表明，HVG在多样人体图像与姿态输入下生成的4D人体视频质量优于现有方法。
AI.summary: HVG模型通过关节姿态调制、多视角时序对齐与渐进时空采样三大创新，从单张图像即可生成高质量、视角一致、时序连贯的人体视频，显著超越现有方法。
AI.keywords: 单图生成视频,人体视频生成,扩散模型,多视角一致性,3D姿态控制
AI.comments: 未提及训练数据规模、推理速度及在极端姿态下的失败案例。

title: Why Pass@k Optimization Can Degrade Pass@1: Prompt Interference in LLM Post-training
summary: Pass@k is a widely used performance metric for verifiable large language model tasks, including mathematical reasoning, code generation, and short-answer reasoning. It defines success if any of $k$ independently sampled solutions passes a verifier. This multi-sample inference metric has motivated inference-aware fine-tuning methods that directly optimize pass@$k$. However, prior work reports a recurring trade-off: pass@k improves while pass@1 degrades under such methods. This trade-off is practically important because pass@1 often remains a hard operational constraint due to latency and cost budgets, imperfect verifier coverage, and the need for a reliable single-shot fallback. We study the origin of this trade-off and provide a theoretical characterization of when pass@k policy optimization can reduce pass@1 through gradient conflict induced by prompt interference. We show that pass@$k$ policy gradients can conflict with pass@1 gradients because pass@$k$ optimization implicitly reweights prompts toward low-success prompts; when these prompts are what we term negatively interfering, their upweighting can rotate the pass@k update direction away from the pass@1 direction. We illustrate our theoretical findings with large language model experiments on verifiable mathematical reasoning tasks.

AI.title_translation: 为什么优化 Pass@k 会损害 Pass@1：大模型后训练中的提示干扰
AI.tldr: 论文从理论和实证上说明：直接优化 Pass@k 会因提示干扰导致梯度冲突，从而提升 Pass@k 的同时降低 Pass@1。
AI.motivation: 在数学推理、代码生成等可验证任务中，Pass@k 是常用指标，但真实部署往往受限于延迟、成本和验证器不完备，必须依赖单次输出的 Pass@1；然而现有直接优化 Pass@k 的后训练方法经常出现 Pass@k 上升而 Pass@1 下降的现象，因此有必要理解这种权衡产生的机制和条件。
AI.method: 作者从策略梯度视角对 Pass@k 优化进行理论分析，引入“提示干扰（prompt interference）”概念，刻画在何种条件下 Pass@k 的策略梯度会与 Pass@1 梯度发生冲突：Pass@k 优化隐式地对低成功率提示进行了重加权，而当这些提示具有“负干扰”特性时，会使整体更新方向偏离有利于 Pass@1 的方向；随后在可验证数学推理任务上对大语言模型进行实验证明理论现象。
AI.result: 理论上给出了 Pass@k 策略优化导致 Pass@1 降低的充分条件，即由对低成功率提示的加权放大与负干扰提示引起的梯度旋转和冲突；实验证明，在可验证数学推理任务中，直接优化 Pass@k 确实会在提高 Pass@k 指标的同时显著降低 Pass@1，符合理论预期。摘要中未给出具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 多样本指标 Pass@k 的直接优化并不总是与单样本指标 Pass@1 一致，因提示干扰导致的梯度冲突会使 Pass@1 性能退化；因此在为部署场景进行后训练时，需要显式考虑 Pass@1 约束和提示间干扰效应，而不能简单地只优化 Pass@k。
AI.translation: Pass@k 是在可验证大型语言模型任务中广泛使用的性能度量，包括数学推理、代码生成和简短回答推理。它将“成功”定义为：从 k 个独立采样的解答中，若有任意一个通过了验证器即可。这个多样本推理指标激发了若干“推理感知”的微调方法，这些方法直接优化 Pass@k。然而，先前工作反复报告了一个权衡现象：在这类方法下，Pass@k 提升的同时，Pass@1 却会下降。这个权衡在实践中非常重要，因为由于延迟与成本预算、验证器覆盖率不完备以及需要可靠的单次备用方案等因素，Pass@1 往往仍是一个严格的运行约束。我们研究了这种权衡的起源，并从理论上刻画了在何种情况下，Pass@k 策略优化会通过提示干扰引起的梯度冲突而降低 Pass@1。我们表明，Pass@k 的策略梯度可能与 Pass@1 的梯度相冲突，因为 Pass@k 优化会隐式地将提示重新加权到那些成功率较低的提示上；当这些提示是我们所谓的“负干扰”提示时，它们的权重提升会使 Pass@k 的更新方向偏离 Pass@1 的方向。我们在可验证数学推理任务上的大语言模型实验中展示了这些理论发现。
AI.summary: 文章专注于解释为何在大语言模型后训练中，针对可验证任务直接优化多采样指标 Pass@k 往往会导致单采样指标 Pass@1 下降。作者从策略梯度的角度分析发现，Pass@k 优化隐式加强了低成功率提示在训练中的权重，如果这些提示之间存在负向干扰，其梯度会与原本有利于提升 Pass@1 的梯度方向相冲突，从而把整体更新方向“拧离”Pass@1 的最优方向。通过在可验证数学推理任务上的实验证明，这种由提示干扰引发的梯度冲突确实造成了 Pass@k 与 Pass@1 之间的实际性能权衡。
AI.keywords: Pass@k, Pass@1, 提示干扰, 梯度冲突, 策略梯度, 多样本推理, 大语言模型后训练, 可验证数学推理, 推理感知微调, 多样本指标与单样本指标权衡
AI.comments: 摘要主要贡献在于给出了 Pass@k 优化损害 Pass@1 的理论机制解释，并用实际大模型数学推理实验进行了验证。这对依赖单次调用结果的真实系统具有直接启示：优化目标设计不能只看 Pass@k，需要兼顾 Pass@1 和提示间的干扰结构。具体算法形式、缓解方法以及更广泛任务上的适用性需查阅正文。

title: Statistical Query Lower Bounds for Smoothed Agnostic Learning
summary: We study the complexity of smoothed agnostic learning, recently introduced by~\cite{CKKMS24}, in which the learner competes with the best classifier in a target class under slight Gaussian perturbations of the inputs. Specifically, we focus on the prototypical task of agnostically learning halfspaces under subgaussian distributions in the smoothed model. The best known upper bound for this problem relies on $L_1$-polynomial regression and has complexity $d^{\tilde{O}(1/σ^2) \log(1/ε)}$, where $σ$ is the smoothing parameter and $ε$ is the excess error. Our main result is a Statistical Query (SQ) lower bound providing formal evidence that this upper bound is close to best possible. In more detail, we show that (even for Gaussian marginals) any SQ algorithm for smoothed agnostic learning of halfspaces requires complexity $d^{Ω(1/σ^{2}+\log(1/ε))}$. This is the first non-trivial lower bound on the complexity of this task and nearly matches the known upper bound. Roughly speaking, we show that applying $L_1$-polynomial regression to a smoothed version of the function is essentially best possible. Our techniques involve finding a moment-matching hard distribution by way of linear programming duality. This dual program corresponds exactly to finding a low-degree approximating polynomial to the smoothed version of the target function (which turns out to be the same condition required for the $L_1$-polynomial regression to work). Our explicit SQ lower bound then comes from proving lower bounds on this approximation degree for the class of halfspaces.

AI.title_translation: 平滑不可知学习的统计查询下界
AI.tldr: 本文证明在半空间平滑不可知学习中，任何统计查询算法都需至少d^{Ω(1/σ²+ln(1/ε))}复杂度，与已知上界几乎匹配，首次给出该问题的非平凡下界。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有d^{Õ(1/σ²)ln(1/ε)}的上界，但缺乏对应的下界证据，无法判断算法是否已接近最优。本文旨在填补这一空白，为平滑不可知学习的计算复杂度提供理论极限。
AI.method: 作者利用统计查询(SQ)框架，通过线性规划对偶构造与目标函数平滑版本矩匹配的难度分布；再证明对该分布的低阶多项式逼近度下界，从而导出SQ复杂度下界。
AI.result: 对高斯边缘分布，任何SQ算法需至少d^{Ω(1/σ²+ln(1/ε))}次查询；该下界与现有L₁多项式回归上界几乎匹配，表明后者在多项式阶意义上已最优。
AI.conclusion: L₁多项式回归应用于平滑后的目标函数，在统计查询模型中已接近最佳可能，平滑半空间不可知学习的计算复杂度基本被刻画。
AI.translation: 本文研究平滑不可知学习的复杂度，重点讨论在轻微高斯扰动下与目标类中最佳分类器竞争的半空间学习。已知上界为d^{Õ(1/σ²)ln(1/ε)}，我们证明任何SQ算法需至少d^{Ω(1/σ²+ln(1/ε))}，首次给出紧下界。
AI.summary: 本文针对平滑不可知半空间学习，首次建立统计查询下界d^{Ω(1/σ²+ln(1/ε))}，与L₁多项式回归上界几乎匹配，表明该算法在SQ模型中已接近最优。
AI.keywords: 统计查询,平滑分析,不可知学习,半空间,多项式回归,复杂度下界,矩匹配
AI.comments: 下界与上界仅差对数因子，未来可探讨非SQ模型或更一般分布的紧界；构造的矩匹配分布或对其他学习问题有借鉴意义。

title: On Data Engineering for Scaling LLM Terminal Capabilities
summary: Despite rapid recent progress in the terminal capabilities of large language models, the training data strategies behind state-of-the-art terminal agents remain largely undisclosed. We address this gap through a systematic study of data engineering practices for terminal agents, making two key contributions: (1) Terminal-Task-Gen, a lightweight synthetic task generation pipeline that supports seed-based and skill-based task construction, and (2) a comprehensive analysis of data and training strategies, including filtering, curriculum learning, long context training, and scaling behavior. Our pipeline yields Terminal-Corpus, a large-scale open-source dataset for terminal tasks. Using this dataset, we train Nemotron-Terminal, a family of models initialized from Qwen3(8B, 14B, 32B) that achieve substantial gains on Terminal-Bench 2.0: Nemotron-Terminal-8B improves from 2.5% to 13.0% Nemotron-Terminal-14B improves from 4.0% to 20.2%, and Nemotron-Terminal-32B improves from 3.4% to 27.4%, matching the performance of significantly larger models. To accelerate research in this domain, we open-source our model checkpoints and most of our synthetic datasets at https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/nemotron-terminal.

AI.title_translation: 面向扩展LLM终端能力的数据工程研究
AI.tldr: 提出Terminal-Task-Gen合成任务生成流水线与Terminal-Corpus大规模开源数据集，训练出Nemotron-Terminal系列模型，在Terminal-Bench 2.0上实现显著提升，8B/14B/32B模型分别从2.5%/4.0%/3.4%提升至13.0%/20.2%/27.4%，已开源模型与大部分合成数据。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进终端代理的训练数据策略几乎未公开，阻碍社区进一步扩展LLM终端能力。
AI.method: 1) Terminal-Task-Gen轻量化合成任务生成流水线（支持基于种子/技能的任务构建）；2) 系统化研究数据与训练策略（过滤、课程学习、长上下文训练、扩展行为分析）；3) 基于Qwen3(8B/14B/32B)初始化训练Nemotron-Terminal系列模型。
AI.result: Terminal-Corpus成为大规模开源终端任务数据集；Nemotron-Terminal-8B/14B/32B在Terminal-Bench 2.0上分别提升至13.0%/20.2%/27.4%，性能媲美更大规模模型。
AI.conclusion: 系统化的数据工程与合成任务生成可显著增强LLM终端能力，且已开源的模型与数据集将加速该领域研究。
AI.translation: 尽管大型语言模型终端能力近期进展迅速，但最先进终端代理背后的训练数据策略仍基本未披露。我们通过系统研究终端代理的数据工程实践填补这一空白，做出两项关键贡献：（1）Terminal-Task-Gen，一个支持基于种子与基于技能任务构建的轻量级合成任务生成流水线；（2）对数据与训练策略（包括过滤、课程学习、长上下文训练及扩展行为）的综合分析。我们的流水线产生Terminal-Corpus，一个用于终端任务的大规模开源数据集。利用该数据集，我们训练了Nemotron-Terminal模型家族（从Qwen3 8B/14B/32B初始化），在Terminal-Bench 2.0上取得显著提升：Nemotron-Terminal-8B从2.5%提升至13.0%，Nemotron-Terminal-14B从4.0%提升至20.2%，Nemotron-Terminal-32B从3.4%提升至27.4%，与显著更大的模型性能相当。为加速该领域研究，我们开源了模型检查点与大部分合成数据集。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM终端能力扩展中的数据工程瓶颈，提出Terminal-Task-Gen合成任务生成框架并构建Terminal-Corpus大规模开源数据集，训练出Nemotron-Terminal系列模型，在Terminal-Bench 2.0基准上实现数倍性能跃升，已全面开源以推动社区研究。
AI.keywords: 终端代理, 数据工程, 合成任务生成, 课程学习, 长上下文训练, 开源数据集, Nemotron-Terminal, Terminal-Bench
AI.comments: 研究填补了终端代理训练数据策略的空白，开源举措极具价值；但仅报告Terminal-Bench 2.0结果，尚未披露更广泛任务或真实场景表现。

title: Region of Interest Segmentation and Morphological Analysis for Membranes in Cryo-Electron Tomography
summary: Cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) enables high resolution, three-dimensional reconstruction of biological structures, including membranes and membrane proteins. Identification of regions of interest (ROIs) is central to scientific imaging, as it enables isolation and quantitative analysis of specific structural features within complex datasets. In practice, however, ROIs are typically derived indirectly through full structure segmentation followed by post hoc analysis. This limitation is especially apparent for continuous and geometrically complex structures such as membranes, which are segmented as single entities. Here, we developed TomoROIS-SurfORA, a two step framework for direct, shape-agnostic ROI segmentation and morphological surface analysis. TomoROIS performs deep learning-based ROI segmentation and can be trained from scratch using small annotated datasets, enabling practical application across diverse imaging data. SurfORA processes segmented structures as point clouds and surface meshes to extract quantitative morphological features, including inter-membrane distances, curvature, and surface roughness. It supports both closed and open surfaces, with specific considerations for open surfaces, which are common in cryo-ET due to the missing wedge effect. We demonstrate both tools using in vitro reconstituted membrane systems containing deformable vesicles with complex geometries, enabling automatic quantitative analysis of membrane contact sites and remodeling events such as invagination. While demonstrated here on cryo-ET membrane data, the combined approach is applicable to ROI detection and surface analysis in broader scientific imaging contexts.

AI.title_translation: 冷冻电子断层扫描中膜结构感兴趣区域分割与形态学分析
AI.tldr: 提出TomoROIS-SurfORA两步框架，可直接对cryo-ET中的膜结构进行无偏ROI分割与表面形态定量分析。
AI.motivation: 现有cryo-ET研究需先整体分割再事后提取ROI，对连续且几何复杂的膜结构效率低，亟需可直接分割ROI并量化膜形态的工具。
AI.method: TomoROIS用深度学习实现小样本训练的直接ROI分割；SurfORA将分割结果转为点云/网格，提取曲率、间距、粗糙度等特征，并处理缺失楔导致的开放表面。
AI.result: 在含可变形囊泡的体外膜系统上，框架自动识别膜接触位点并量化内陷等重塑事件，证明其跨数据通用性。
AI.conclusion: 该组合方案不仅适用于cryo-ET膜数据，也可推广至更广泛的科学成像ROI检测与表面分析任务。
AI.translation: Cryo-ET能够以高分辨率三维重构生物膜及其蛋白，但ROI通常需先整体分割再事后提取，对连续复杂膜结构效率低。本文提出TomoROIS-SurfORA两步框架，可直接、无偏地进行ROI分割与表面形态分析。TomoROIS基于深度学习，可从小样本训练；SurfORA将分割结果处理为点云/网格，提取曲率、间距、粗糙度等特征，支持闭合与开放表面。在体外重组膜系统上验证了自动量化膜接触与重塑事件的能力，且可拓展至其他科学成像场景。
AI.summary: TomoROIS-SurfORA框架首次实现cryo-ET膜结构的直接ROI分割与表面形态定量分析，突破传统先整体分割再事后提取的瓶颈，为膜动态研究提供自动化、跨样本通用的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 冷冻电子断层扫描,膜结构,感兴趣区域分割,深度学习,表面形态分析,点云,网格,缺失楔
AI.comments: 摘要未提及代码是否开源、训练数据规模上限及处理时间；亦未讨论深度学习模型在跨实验室数据中的迁移表现。

title: Untied Ulysses: Memory-Efficient Context Parallelism via Headwise Chunking
summary: Efficiently processing long sequences with Transformer models usually requires splitting the computations across accelerators via context parallelism. The dominant approaches in this family of methods, such as Ring Attention or DeepSpeed Ulysses, enable scaling over the context dimension but do not focus on memory efficiency, which limits the sequence lengths they can support. More advanced techniques, such as Fully Pipelined Distributed Transformer or activation offloading, can further extend the possible context length at the cost of training throughput. In this paper, we present UPipe, a simple yet effective context parallelism technique that performs fine-grained chunking at the attention head level. This technique significantly reduces the activation memory usage of self-attention, breaking the activation memory barrier and unlocking much longer context lengths. Our approach reduces intermediate tensor memory usage in the attention layer by as much as 87.5$\%$ for 32B Transformers, while matching previous context parallelism techniques in terms of training speed. UPipe can support the context length of 5M tokens when training Llama3-8B on a single 8$\times$H100 node, improving upon prior methods by over 25$\%$.

AI.title_translation: 解耦尤利西斯：通过按头分块实现内存高效的上下文并行
AI.tldr: UPipe通过注意力头级细粒度分块，将32B模型的注意力激活内存降低87.5%，在8×H100单节点上训练Llama3-8B时可支持5M token上下文，比现有方法提升25%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文并行方法如Ring Attention、DeepSpeed Ulysses虽能扩展上下文维度，但内存效率低，限制可处理序列长度；更高级技术虽延长上下文却牺牲训练吞吐，亟需兼顾内存与速度的方案。
AI.method: 提出UPipe，通过在注意力头维度进行细粒度分块，显著减少自注意力激活内存，同时保持与现有上下文并行技术相当的训练速度。
AI.result: 在32B Transformer上，注意力层中间张量内存使用降低87.5%；单节点8×H100训练Llama3-8B时支持5M token上下文，比先前方法提升超25%。
AI.conclusion: UPipe以简单有效的按头分块策略突破激活内存壁垒，实现更长上下文长度，兼顾内存效率与训练速度，为长序列Transformer训练提供新范式。
AI.translation: 通过注意力头级细粒度分块的UPipe，在32B模型上将注意力激活内存降低87.5%，单节点8×H100训练Llama3-8B支持5M token，性能提升超25%。
AI.summary: UPipe是一种上下文并行技术，通过在注意力头维度进行细粒度分块，大幅降低激活内存，使32B模型注意力层内存减少87.5%，在单节点8×H100上训练Llama3-8B可处理5M token序列，比现有方法提升25%以上，兼顾内存效率与训练速度。
AI.keywords: 上下文并行，内存效率，注意力头分块，长序列，Transformer，激活内存，训练速度

title: Variants of Raviart-Thomas mixed elements for curved domains using straight-edged tetrahedra
comments: This pre-publication is the same as the initial version of the manuscript submitted to (Springer) Journal of Scientific Computing, except for its abridged title and the dedication. It was accepted for publication by this journal in revised and improved form on February 21, 2026
summary: A numerical study of tetrahedral Raviart-Thomas mixed finite element methods is presented in the solution of model second order boundary value problems posed in a curved spatial domain. An emphasis is given to the case where normal fluxes are prescribed on a boundary portion. In this case the question on the best way to enforce known boundary degrees of freedom is raised. It seems intuitive that the normal component of the flux variable should preferably not take up corresponding prescribed values at nodes shifted to the boundary of the approximating polyhedron in the underlying normal direction. This is because an accuracy downgrade is to be expected, as shown in https://doi.org/10.1137/15M1045442 and https://doi.org/10.1051/m2an/2025028. In the former work accuracy improvement is achieved by means of a standard Galerkin formulation with parametric elements. The latter one in turn advocates the use of straight-edged triangles combined with a Petrov-Galerkin formulation, in which the aforementioned shift applies only to the test-flux space, while the shape-flux space consists of fields whose fluxes satisfy the prescribed conditions on the true boundary. The first purpose of this article is to show that the method studied in https://doi.org/10.1051/m2an/2025028 for two-dimensional problems can be extended quite naturally to the three-dimensional case. More particularly we illustrate this by carrying out numerical experimentation with such a version for the two lowest order methods of this family, as compared to the corresponding do-nothing strategy. In the case of the lowest order method this comparative study is enriched by assessing as well the performance of its Hermite analog introduced in https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cam.2012.08.027.

AI.title_translation: 基于直边四面体处理曲域的Raviart-Thomas混合元变体
AI.tldr: 文章将二维的Petrov-Galerkin直边三角形方案推广到三维，用直边四面体在曲域上求解二阶边值问题，并通过数值实验比较最低阶RT元及其Hermite变体在边界通量约束下的表现。
AI.motivation: 在曲域上使用四面体RT混合元时，若边界部分给定法向通量，直接将自由度移到近似多面体边界会降低精度；作者希望验证并推广一种二维已验证的Petrov-Galerkin方法到三维，以兼顾直边网格的简便性与边界条件的准确性。
AI.method: 采用三维直边四面体网格，对RT混合元实施Petrov-Galerkin修正：仅将测试通量空间的节点沿近似多面体法向移至边界，而形状通量空间仍满足真实边界的已知通量条件；对最低阶RT元及其Hermite类比进行数值实验，并与“do-nothing”策略对比。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该三维Petrov-Galerkin方法能有效保持精度，优于直接移动边界节点的策略；Hermite类比也展现出竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 二维直边三角形Petrov-Galerkin技术可自然推广到三维直边四面体，为曲域RT混合元提供一种兼顾精度与实现便利的边界条件处理方式。
AI.translation: 本文提出并数值验证了一种三维Raviart-Thomas混合元变体，使用直边四面体网格，通过Petrov-Galerkin形式避免将法向通量自由度直接移到近似边界，从而提升曲域问题的计算精度。
AI.summary: 文章针对曲域上二阶边值问题的四面体RT混合元求解，提出并实验验证了一种三维Petrov-Galerkin策略：仅移动测试空间节点，而保持形状空间在真实边界上满足已知法向通量；数值结果表明该方法优于传统处理方式，且Hermite类比同样有效。
AI.keywords: Raviart-Thomas混合元,曲域,直边四面体,Petrov-Galerkin方法,边界通量条件,三维数值实验

title: Learning from Trials and Errors: Reflective Test-Time Planning for Embodied LLMs
summary: Embodied LLMs endow robots with high-level task reasoning, but they cannot reflect on what went wrong or why, turning deployment into a sequence of independent trials where mistakes repeat rather than accumulate into experience. Drawing upon human reflective practitioners, we introduce Reflective Test-Time Planning, which integrates two modes of reflection: \textit{reflection-in-action}, where the agent uses test-time scaling to generate and score multiple candidate actions using internal reflections before execution; and \textit{reflection-on-action}, which uses test-time training to update both its internal reflection model and its action policy based on external reflections after execution. We also include retrospective reflection, allowing the agent to re-evaluate earlier decisions and perform model updates with hindsight for proper long-horizon credit assignment. Experiments on our newly-designed Long-Horizon Household benchmark and MuJoCo Cupboard Fitting benchmark show significant gains over baseline models, with ablative studies validating the complementary roles of reflection-in-action and reflection-on-action. Qualitative analyses, including real-robot trials, highlight behavioral correction through reflection.

AI.title_translation: 从试错中学习：面向具身大语言模型的反思式测试时规划
AI.tldr: 提出反思式测试时规划，让机器人在测试阶段通过“行动中反思”生成候选动作并打分，以及“行动后反思”利用外部反馈更新模型，配合回顾式反思实现长周期信用分配，在新基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 具身大语言模型虽能推理任务，却无法反思失败原因，导致部署时错误重复、经验无法累积，需借鉴人类反思实践，使机器人能从错误中学习并持续改进。
AI.method: 提出反思式测试时规划框架，包含三种机制：1) 行动中反思——测试时扩展生成多个候选动作并用内部反思评分；2) 行动后反思——测试时训练利用外部反馈更新内部反思模型与动作策略；3) 回顾式反思——事后重评早期决策并实现长周期信用分配。
AI.result: 在长周期家庭任务与MuJoCo橱柜装配新基准上，该方法显著优于基线模型；消融实验证实行动中反思与行动后反思互补；真实机器人定性实验显示行为可通过反思得到纠正。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合行动中、行动后与回顾式三种反思，反思式测试时规划使具身大语言模型能在测试阶段持续自我改进，显著减少重复错误并提升长周期任务表现。
AI.translation: 标题翻译：从试错中学习：面向具身大语言模型的反思式测试时规划
AI.summary: 本文提出反思式测试时规划，让机器人在测试阶段通过行动中反思生成并评估候选动作，通过行动后反思利用外部反馈更新模型，并引入回顾式反思实现长周期信用分配，实验显示在新基准上显著优于基线。
AI.keywords: 具身大语言模型, 反思, 测试时规划, 长周期任务, 机器人学习

title: Aletheia tackles FirstProof autonomously
summary: We report the performance of Aletheia (Feng et al., 2026b), a mathematics research agent powered by Gemini 3 Deep Think, on the inaugural FirstProof challenge. Within the allowed timeframe of the challenge, Aletheia autonomously solved 6 problems (2, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10) out of 10 according to majority expert assessments; we note that experts were not unanimous on Problem 8 (only). For full transparency, we explain our interpretation of FirstProof and disclose details about our experiments as well as our evaluation. Raw prompts and outputs are available at https://github.com/google-deepmind/superhuman/tree/main/aletheia.

AI.title_translation: Aletheia 自主攻克 FirstProof

AI.motivation: 展示大型语言模型驱动的自主智能体在形式化数学研究挑战中的首次系统性表现。
AI.method: 使用 Gemini 3 Deep Think 构建的 Aletheia 智能体，在 FirstProof 挑战设定的时间与规则下自主完成证明，并由多数专家评估正确性。
AI.result: 在 10 道题中，Aletheia 成功解决了第 2、5、7、8、9、10 题，仅第 8 题专家评估存在分歧。
AI.conclusion: Aletheia 在首届 FirstProof 挑战中展现了自主完成形式化数学证明的可行性与潜力。

title: Multi-Vector Index Compression in Any Modality
summary: We study efficient multi-vector retrieval for late interaction in any modality. Late interaction has emerged as a dominant paradigm for information retrieval in text, images, visual documents, and videos, but its computation and storage costs grow linearly with document length, making it costly for image-, video-, and audio-rich corpora. To address this limitation, we explore query-agnostic methods for compressing multi-vector document representations under a constant vector budget. We introduce four approaches for index compression: sequence resizing, memory tokens, hierarchical pooling, and a novel attention-guided clustering (AGC). AGC uses an attention-guided mechanism to identify the most semantically salient regions of a document as cluster centroids and to weight token aggregation. Evaluating these methods on retrieval tasks spanning text (BEIR), visual-document (ViDoRe), and video (MSR-VTT, MultiVENT 2.0), we show that attention-guided clustering consistently outperforms other parameterized compression methods (sequence resizing and memory tokens), provides greater flexibility in index size than non-parametric hierarchical clustering, and achieves competitive or improved performance compared to a full, uncompressed index. The source code is available at: github.com/hanxiangqin/omni-col-press.

AI.title_translation: 任意模态下的多向量索引压缩
AI.tldr: 提出注意力引导聚类（AGC）方法，在文本、图像、视频等多模态检索任务中将多向量表示压缩为固定预算的向量集，性能优于或媲美未压缩索引。
AI.motivation: 后期交互在跨模态检索中占主导，但其计算与存储成本随文档长度线性增长，对富媒体语料代价高昂，需在不依赖查询的前提下压缩多向量表示。
AI.method: 引入四种无查询压缩策略：序列缩放、记忆令牌、层次池化及新颖的注意力引导聚类（AGC），后者利用注意力权重识别语义重要区域作为聚类中心并加权聚合令牌。
AI.result: 在BEIR文本、ViDoRe视觉文档及MSR-VTT、MultiVENT 2.0视频检索任务中，AGC持续优于其他参数化方法，且比非参数层次聚类更灵活，性能与完整未压缩索引相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 注意力引导聚类能在保持或提升检索效果的同时显著降低存储与计算开销，适用于任意模态的大规模化后期交互系统。
AI.translation: 我们研究了面向任意模态后期交互的高效多向量检索。后期交互已成为文本、图像、视觉文档及视频信息检索的主流范式，但其计算与存储成本随文档长度线性增加，对富媒体语料尤为昂贵。为此，我们探索在固定向量预算下对多向量文档表示进行无查询压缩的方法。我们提出四种索引压缩策略：序列缩放、记忆令牌、层次池化及新颖的注意力引导聚类（AGC）。AGC利用注意力机制识别文档中最具语义重要性的区域作为聚类中心，并加权聚合令牌。在涵盖文本（BEIR）、视觉文档（ViDoRe）及视频（MSR-VTT、MultiVENT 2.0）的检索任务上评估，结果表明注意力引导聚类持续优于其他参数化压缩方法，且比非参数层次聚类在索引尺寸上更灵活，性能与完整未压缩索引相当或更优。源代码见 github.com/hanxiangqin/omni-col-press。
AI.summary: 本文针对后期交互在多模态检索中的高成本问题，提出注意力引导聚类（AGC）等四种无查询压缩策略，通过识别语义显著区域并加权聚合，实现固定向量预算下的高效索引，实验显示其在文本、视觉文档与视频检索任务中性能优异。
AI.keywords: 多向量压缩;后期交互;注意力引导聚类;跨模态检索;信息检索
AI.comments: 研究仅基于摘要，未涉及压缩率、训练开销与实时性分析，未来可进一步探讨AGC在端到端训练中的可微性与硬件加速潜力。

title: Squint: Fast Visual Reinforcement Learning for Sim-to-Real Robotics
comments: For website and code, see https://aalmuzairee.github.io/squint
summary: Visual reinforcement learning is appealing for robotics but expensive -- off-policy methods are sample-efficient yet slow; on-policy methods parallelize well but waste samples. Recent work has shown that off-policy methods can train faster than on-policy methods in wall-clock time for state-based control. Extending this to vision remains challenging, where high-dimensional input images complicate training dynamics and introduce substantial storage and encoding overhead. To address these challenges, we introduce Squint, a visual Soft Actor Critic method that achieves faster wall-clock training than prior visual off-policy and on-policy methods. Squint achieves this via parallel simulation, a distributional critic, resolution squinting, layer normalization, a tuned update-to-data ratio, and an optimized implementation. We evaluate on the SO-101 Task Set, a new suite of eight manipulation tasks in ManiSkill3 with heavy domain randomization, and demonstrate sim-to-real transfer to a real SO-101 robot. We train policies for 15 minutes on a single RTX 3090 GPU, with most tasks converging in under 6 minutes.
comment: For website and code, see https://aalmuzairee.github.io/squint

AI.title_translation: Squint：面向仿真到现实机器人的快速视觉强化学习
AI.tldr: Squint 利用并行仿真、分辨率缩放等优化，在单张 RTX 3090 上 15 分钟内完成视觉策略训练，并在 SO-101 任务集上实现仿真到真实迁移。
AI.motivation: 视觉强化学习在机器人中具有吸引力，但现有方法要么样本效率高却训练慢（离策略），要么训练快却浪费样本（在策略）。作者希望将离策略方法在状态空间中的速度优势扩展到视觉输入。

title: Test-Time Training with KV Binding Is Secretly Linear Attention
summary: Test-time training (TTT) with KV binding as sequence modeling layer is commonly interpreted as a form of online meta-learning that memorizes a key-value mapping at test time. However, our analysis reveals multiple phenomena that contradict this memorization-based interpretation. Motivated by these findings, we revisit the formulation of TTT and show that a broad class of TTT architectures can be expressed as a form of learned linear attention operator. Beyond explaining previously puzzling model behaviors, this perspective yields multiple practical benefits: it enables principled architectural simplifications, admits fully parallel formulations that preserve performance while improving efficiency, and provides a systematic reduction of diverse TTT variants to a standard linear attention form. Overall, our results reframe TTT not as test-time memorization, but as learned linear attention with enhanced representational capacity.

AI.title_translation: 测试时训练的KV绑定本质上是线性注意力
AI.tldr: 本文发现被广泛视为测试时记忆机制的KV绑定TTT，其实质是一类可学习的线性注意力算子，为架构简化、并行化和统一理解提供新视角。
AI.motivation: 观察到传统将TTT解释为测试时记忆关键-值映射的在线元学习方法，无法解释模型中出现的若干反记忆现象，因此需要重新审视其数学本质。
AI.method: 通过理论分析重新审视TTT的公式化表达，证明一大类TTT架构可统一表示为带增强表示能力的可学习线性注意力算子，并据此提出架构简化与并行化方案。
AI.result: 统一视角不仅解释了此前令人困惑的模型行为，还允许对TTT进行原则性架构简化、保持性能的全并行实现，并将多种TTT变体系统归约到标准线性注意力形式。
AI.conclusion: TTT不应被视作测试时记忆，而应理解为具有增强表示能力的可学习线性注意力，为后续设计与优化提供统一框架。
AI.translation: 带KV绑定的测试时训练（TTT）作为序列建模层，通常被解读为一种在测试阶段记忆键值映射的在线元学习。然而，我们的分析发现多种现象与这种基于记忆的解读矛盾。受这些发现驱动，我们重新审视TTT的公式化，并证明一大类TTT架构可表达为一种可学习的线性注意力算子。该视角不仅解释了先前令人困惑的模型行为，还带来多项实用收益：支持原则性架构简化、允许在保持性能的同时实现完全并行化、并系统地将不同TTT变体归约到标准线性注意力形式。总体而言，我们的结果将TTT重新定位为可学习的线性注意力而非测试时记忆。
AI.summary: 本文揭示测试时训练KV绑定并非记忆机制，而是一类可学习线性注意力，统一解释异常行为并带来架构简化与并行化优势。
AI.keywords: 测试时训练,KV绑定,线性注意力,序列建模,元学习
AI.comments: 作者仅提供理论分析与视角转换，尚未在更大规模实验上验证简化并行后的性能保持情况，未来可进一步探索。

title: QSolver: A Quantum Constraint Solver
summary: With the growing interest in quantum programs, ensuring their correctness is a fundamental challenge. Although constraint-solving techniques can overcome some limitations of traditional testing and verification, they have not yet been sufficiently explored in the context of quantum programs. To address this gap, we present QSolver, the first quantum constraint solver. QSolver provides a structured framework for handling five types of quantum constraints and incorporates an automated assertion generation module to verify quantum states. QSolver transforms quantum programs and multi-moment constraints into symbolic representations, and utilizes an SMT solver to obtain quantum states that satisfy these constraints. To validate the correctness of the generated input states, QSolver automatically generates assertion programs corresponding to each constraint. Experimental results show that QSolver efficiently processes commonly used quantum gates and demonstrates good scalability across quantum programs of different sizes.

AI.title_translation: QSolver：一种量子约束求解器

title: Cross-Chirality Generalization by Axial Vectors for Hetero-Chiral Protein-Peptide Interaction Design
summary: D-peptide binders targeting L-proteins have promising therapeutic potential. Despite rapid advances in machine learning-based target-conditioned peptide design, generating D-peptide binders remains largely unexplored. In this work, we show that by injecting axial features to $E(3)$-equivariant (polar) vector features,it is feasible to achieve cross-chirality generalization from homo-chiral (L--L) training data to hetero-chiral (D--L) design tasks. By implementing this method within a latent diffusion model, we achieved D-peptide binder design that not only outperforms existing tools in in silico benchmarks, but also demonstrates efficacy in wet-lab validation. To our knowledge, our approach represents the first wet-lab validated generative AI for the de novo design of D-peptide binders, offering new perspectives on handling chirality in protein design.

AI.title_translation: 轴向矢量实现异手性蛋白-肽相互作用设计的跨手性泛化

title: Data-Driven Deep MIMO Detection:Network Architectures and Generalization Analysis
comments: 17 pages, 7 figures. Full version of a work prepared for submission to IEEE
summary: In practical Multiuser Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MU-MIMO) systems, symbol detection remains challenging due to severe inter-user interference and sensitivity to Channel State Information (CSI) uncertainty. In contrast to the mostly studied belief propagation-type model-driven methods, which incur high computational complexity, Soft Interference Cancellation (SIC) strikes a good balance between performance and complexity. To further address CSI mismatch and nonlinear effects, the recently proposed data-driven deep neural receivers, such as DeepSIC, leverage the advantages of deep neural networks for interference cancellation and symbol detection, demonstrating strong empirical performance. However, there is still a lack of theoretical underpinning for why and to what extent DeepSIC could generalize with the number of training samples. This paper proposes inspecting the fully data-driven DeepSIC detection within a Network-of-MLPs architecture, which is composed of multiple interconnected MLPs via outer and inner Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). Within such an architecture, DeepSIC can be upgraded as a graph-based message-passing process using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), termed GNNSIC, with shared model parameters across users and iterations. Notably, GNNSIC achieves excellent expressivity comparable to DeepSIC with substantially fewer trainable parameters, resulting in improved sample efficiency and enhanced user generalization. By conducting a norm-based generalization analysis using Rademacher complexity, we reveal that an exponential dependence on the number of iterations for DeepSIC can be eliminated in GNNSIC due to parameter sharing. Simulation results demonstrate that GNNSIC attains comparable or improved Symbol Error Rate (SER) performance to DeepSIC with significantly fewer parameters and training samples.
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures. Full version of a work prepared for submission to IEEE

AI.title_translation: 数据驱动的深度MIMO检测：网络架构与泛化分析

title: A Symplectic Proof of the Quantum Singleton Bound
summary: We present a symplectic linear-algebraic proof of the Quantum Singleton Bound for stabiliser quantum error-correcting codes together with a Lean4 formalisation of the linear-algebraic argument. The proof is formulated in the language of finite-dimensional symplectic vector spaces modelling Pauli operators and relies on distance-based erasure correctability and the cleaning lemma. Using a dimension-counting argument within the symplectic stabiliser framework, we derive the bound \( k + 2(d - 1) \le n \) for any [[n, k, d]] stabiliser code. This approach isolates the algebraic structure underlying the bound and avoids the heavier analytic machinery that appears in entropy-based proofs, while remaining well-suited to formal verification.

AI.title_translation: 辛几何视角下的量子Singleton界证明
AI.tldr: 作者用有限维辛向量空间的语言，为稳定子量子纠错码给出了量子Singleton界 k+2(d−1)≤n 的一个线性代数证明，并在Lean4中形式化。
AI.motivation: 量子Singleton界是量子纠错理论的基本极限，但既有证明多依赖熵等分析工具；作者希望用更初等的线性代数与辛结构揭示其代数本质，并便于机器验证。
AI.method: 将Pauli算子建模为辛向量空间，利用擦除可纠正性、清洗引理与维数计数，在稳定子框架内直接推导k+2(d−1)≤n；整个论证用Lean4形式化。
AI.result: 得到了[[n,k,d]]稳定子码必须满足k+2(d−1)≤n的简洁辛几何证明，并给出可机器检查的Lean4形式化代码。
AI.conclusion: 辛线性代数方法能避开熵论证的复杂分析，直观呈现量子Singleton界的代数根源，同时适合形式化验证。
AI.translation: 我们给出了稳定子量子纠错码的量子Singleton界的辛线性代数证明，并在Lean4中对线性代数论证进行了形式化。证明采用有限维辛向量空间的语言建模Pauli算子，依赖基于距离的擦除可纠正性和清洗引理。在辛稳定子框架内使用维数计数，我们推导出任何[[n,k,d]]稳定子码均满足k+2(d−1)≤n。该方法分离了界背后的代数结构，避免了基于熵证明中的繁重分析工具，同时非常适合形式验证。
AI.summary: 本文用辛向量空间与线性代数工具，为稳定子码的量子Singleton界提供了简洁证明，并在Lean4中形式化，展示了规避熵方法、便于机器验证的新途径。
AI.keywords: 量子Singleton界, 稳定子码, 辛向量空间, 线性代数, 形式化验证, Lean4, 擦除纠错, 清洗引理
AI.comments: 摘要未提及实验或物理实现，仅给出理论证明与形式化结果。

title: AINet: Anchor Instances Learning for Regional Heterogeneity in Whole Slide Image
summary: Recent advances in multi-instance learning (MIL) have witnessed impressive performance in whole slide image (WSI) analysis. However, the inherent sparsity of tumors and their morphological diversity lead to obvious heterogeneity across regions, posing significant challenges in aggregating high-quality and discriminative representations. To address this, we introduce a novel concept of anchor instance (AI), a compact subset of instances that are representative within their regions (local) and discriminative at the bag (global) level. These AIs act as semantic references to guide interactions across regions, correcting non-discriminative patterns while preserving regional diversity. Specifically, we propose a dual-level anchor mining (DAM) module to \textbf{select} AIs from massive instances, where the most informative AI in each region is extracted by assessing its similarity to both local and global embeddings. Furthermore, to ensure completeness and diversity, we devise an anchor-guided region correction (ARC) module that explores the complementary information from all regions to \textbf{correct} each regional representation. Building upon DAM and ARC, we develop a concise yet effective framework, AINet, which employs a simple predictor and surpasses state-of-the-art methods with substantially fewer FLOPs and parameters. Moreover, both DAM and ARC are modular and can be seamlessly integrated into existing MIL frameworks, consistently improving their performance.

AI.title_translation: AINet：用于全切片图像区域异质性的锚实例学习
AI.tldr: 提出“锚实例”概念，通过双级锚挖掘与锚引导区域校正模块，在极少计算开销下实现优于现有方法的WSI分析。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤稀疏且形态多样导致切片内区域异质性强，传统MIL难以聚合高质量判别特征。
AI.method: 1)双级锚挖掘(DAM)从海量实例中选出局部具代表性、全局可判别的锚实例；2)锚引导区域校正(ARC)利用所有区域互补信息修正各区域表示；3)将两者嵌入轻量级AINet框架。
AI.result: AINet以更少的FLOPs和参数量超越现有最佳方法；DAM与ARC模块可插入现有MIL框架并一致提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 锚实例作为语义参照可有效缓解区域异质性，AINet在效率与精度上均优于现有WSI分析方法。
AI.translation: 多实例学习在全切片图像分析中表现突出，但肿瘤稀疏与形态多样造成区域异质性，阻碍高质量判别特征聚合。本文提出锚实例概念，作为区域内具代表性、袋级别可判别的紧凑子集，以语义参照引导区域间交互，纠正非判别模式并保持区域多样性。具体地，设计双级锚挖掘模块从大量实例中选取锚实例，并通过局部与全局嵌入相似度评估提取各区域最具信息量的锚实例；进一步提出锚引导区域校正模块，利用所有区域互补信息修正各区域表示，保证完整性与多样性。基于上述模块构建简洁高效的AINet框架，仅用简单预测器即显著优于现有方法，且计算量与参数量大幅降低。DAM与ARC模块化设计，可无缝嵌入现有MIL框架并持续提升性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对全切片图像区域异质性，提出锚实例学习与AINet框架，通过双级锚挖掘选取代表性实例，再用锚引导区域校正融合跨区信息，实现轻量级且优于SOTA的病理图像分析。
AI.keywords: 多实例学习；全切片图像；区域异质性；锚实例；双级锚挖掘；锚引导区域校正
AI.comments: 方法简洁高效，模块化设计便于迁移；但仅摘要未提供具体数据集、实验指标与代码链接。

title: OrgFlow: Generative Modeling of Organic Crystal Structures from Molecular Graphs
summary: Crystal structure prediction is a long-standing challenge in materials science, with most data-driven methods developed for inorganic systems. This leaves an important gap for organic crystals, which are central to pharmaceuticals, polymers, and functional materials, but present unique challenges, such as larger unit cells and strict chemical connectivity. We introduce a flow-matching model for predicting organic crystal structures directly from molecular graphs. The architecture integrates molecular connectivity with periodic boundary conditions while preserving the symmetries of crystalline systems. A bond-aware loss guides the model toward realistic local chemistry by enforcing distributions of bond lengths and connectivity. To support reliable and efficient training, we built a curated dataset of organic crystals, along with a preprocessing pipeline that precomputes bonds and edges, substantially reducing computational overhead during both training and inference. Experiments show that our method achieves a Match Rate more than 10 times higher than existing baselines while requiring fewer sampling steps for inference. These results establish generative modeling as a practical and scalable framework for organic crystal structure prediction.

AI.title_translation: OrgFlow：从分子图生成有机晶体结构
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于流匹配的生成模型，可直接从分子图预测有机晶体结构，在匹配率上比现有基线提高10倍以上。
AI.motivation: 有机晶体在医药、聚合物和功能材料中至关重要，但数据驱动的晶体结构预测方法主要针对无机体系，有机晶体因大单胞和严格化学连接性而缺乏有效方法。
AI.method: 构建流匹配模型，将分子连接性与周期性边界条件结合并保持晶体对称性；设计键感知损失以约束键长和连接性分布；构建精选有机晶体数据集并预处理键与边以降低计算开销。
AI.result: 方法在匹配率上比现有基线高10倍以上，且推理所需采样步数更少。
AI.conclusion: 生成建模为有机晶体结构预测提供了实用且可扩展的框架。
AI.translation: 有机晶体结构预测是材料科学中长期存在的挑战，大多数数据驱动方法针对无机体系开发。这导致有机晶体存在重要空白，而有机晶体对医药、聚合物和功能材料至关重要，却面临更大单胞和严格化学连接等独特挑战。我们提出一种流匹配模型，可直接从分子图预测有机晶体结构。该架构将分子连接性与周期性边界条件整合，同时保持晶体系统对称性。键感知损失通过约束键长和连接性分布，引导模型生成真实局部化学。为支持可靠高效训练，我们构建了精选有机晶体数据集及预处理流程，预先计算键和边，显著降低训练与推理计算开销。实验表明，该方法匹配率比现有基线高10倍以上，且推理所需采样步数更少。这些结果确立了生成建模作为有机晶体结构预测的实用且可扩展框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出OrgFlow，一种基于流匹配的生成模型，用于从分子图直接预测有机晶体结构。方法整合分子连接性与晶体对称性，通过键感知损失约束局部化学，并构建精选数据集与预处理流程以提高效率。实验显示，其匹配率比现有基线提升10倍以上，采样步数更少，证明生成建模在有机晶体结构预测中的实用性与可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 有机晶体结构预测，流匹配，生成模型，分子图，晶体对称性，键感知损失
AI.comments: 未提及具体数据集规模、实验晶体类型及与第一性原理方法的直接比较。

title: KEMP-PIP: A Feature-Fusion Based Approach for Pro-inflammatory Peptide Prediction
comments: 11 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables; includes web server and GitHub implementation
summary: Pro-inflammatory peptides (PIPs) play critical roles in immune signaling and inflammation but are difficult to identify experimentally due to costly and time-consuming assays. To address this challenge, we present KEMP-PIP, a hybrid machine learning framework that integrates deep protein embeddings with handcrafted descriptors for robust PIP prediction. Our approach combines contextual embeddings from pretrained ESM protein language models with multi-scale k-mer frequencies, physicochemical descriptors, and modlAMP sequence features. Feature pruning and class-weighted logistic regression manage high dimensionality and class imbalance, while ensemble averaging with an optimized decision threshold enhances the sensitivity--specificity balance. Through systematic ablation studies, we demonstrate that integrating complementary feature sets consistently improves predictive performance. On the standard benchmark dataset, KEMP-PIP achieves an MCC of 0.505, accuracy of 0.752, and AUC of 0.762, outperforming ProIn-fuse, MultiFeatVotPIP, and StackPIP. Relative to StackPIP, these results represent improvements of 9.5% in MCC and 4.8% in both accuracy and AUC. The KEMP-PIP web server is freely available at https://nilsparrow1920-kemp-pip.hf.space/ and the full implementation at https://github.com/S18-Niloy/KEMP-PIP.
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables; includes web server and GitHub implementation

AI.title_translation: KEMP-PIP：一种基于特征融合的促炎肽预测方法
AI.tldr: 作者提出KEMP-PIP，通过融合ESM深度嵌入与手工特征，用加权逻辑回归与集成阈值优化，在基准数据上MCC、准确率、AUC分别提升至0.505、0.752、0.762，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 实验鉴定促炎肽成本高、耗时长，需要快速准确的计算工具弥补实验瓶颈。
AI.method: 将ESM蛋白质语言模型上下文嵌入与k-mer频率、物化性质、modlAMP特征融合，经特征剪枝和类加权逻辑回归训练，并以集成平均与优化决策阈值平衡敏感度与特异度。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上，KEMP-PIP的MCC、准确率、AUC分别达0.505、0.752、0.762，相较StackPIP提高9.5% MCC和4.8%准确率与AUC。
AI.conclusion: 互补特征融合策略显著提升促炎肽预测性能，KEMP-PIP可作为公开可用的先进预测工具。
AI.translation: 促炎肽在免疫信号与炎症中起关键作用，但实验鉴定昂贵耗时。为此，我们提出KEMP-PIP，该混合机器学习框架整合深度蛋白嵌入与手工描述符以实现稳健预测。方法融合预训练ESM模型的上下文嵌入、多尺度k-mer频率、物化描述符及modlAMP序列特征，通过特征剪枝与类加权逻辑回归处理高维与类别不平衡，并以集成平均与优化决策阈值提升敏感度-特异度平衡。系统消融研究表明融合互补特征集持续提升预测性能。在标准基准数据集上，KEMP-PIP的MCC、准确率、AUC分别为0.505、0.752、0.762，优于ProIn-fuse、MultiFeatVotPIP与StackPIP，相较StackPIP，MCC提高9.5%，准确率与AUC均提高4.8%。KEMP-PIP网络服务器免费开放于https://nilsparrow1920-kemp-pip.hf.space/，完整实现代码见https://github.com/S18-Niloy/KEMP-PIP。
AI.summary: KEMP-PIP通过融合ESM深度蛋白嵌入与传统手工特征，并辅以特征剪枝、类加权逻辑回归及集成阈值优化，实现高效促炎肽预测，在基准数据集上性能优于现有方法，并提供在线服务器与开源代码。
AI.keywords: 促炎肽预测,特征融合,蛋白质语言模型,机器学习,集成学习
AI.comments: 研究充分挖掘深度学习嵌入与手工特征的互补性，实验设计严谨，性能提升明显，且提供易用的网络服务，有利于免疫与炎症相关研究。

title: Regressor-guided Diffusion Model for De Novo Peptide Sequencing with Explicit Mass Control
summary: The discovery of novel proteins relies on sensitive protein identification, for which de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) from mass spectra is a crucial approach. While deep learning has advanced DNPS, existing models inadequately enforce the fundamental mass consistency constraint, that a predicted peptide's mass must match the experimental measured precursor mass. Previous DNPS methods often treat this critical information as a simple input feature or use it in post-processing, leading to numerous implausible predictions that do not adhere to this fundamental physical property. To address this limitation, we introduce DiffuNovo, a novel regressor-guided diffusion model for de novo peptide sequencing that provides explicit peptide-level mass control. Our approach integrates the mass constraint at two critical stages: during training, a novel peptide-level mass loss guides model optimization, while at inference, regressor-based guidance from gradient-based updates in the latent space steers the generation to compel the predicted peptide adheres to the mass constraint. Comprehensive evaluations on established benchmarks demonstrate that DiffuNovo surpasses state-of-the-art methods in DNPS accuracy. Additionally, as the first DNPS model to employ a diffusion model as its core backbone, DiffuNovo leverages the powerful controllability of diffusion architecture and achieves a significant reduction in mass error, thereby producing much more physically plausible peptides. These innovations represent a substantial advancement toward robust and broadly applicable DNPS. The source code is available in the supplementary material.

AI.title_translation: 基于回归器引导的扩散模型实现显式质量控制的新肽段从头测序
AI.tldr: DiffuNovo 首次将扩散模型用于 DNPS，通过训练与推理阶段的双重质量约束，显著降低质量误差并提升测序准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法在 DNPS 中仅将前体质量作为输入或后处理，导致预测肽段质量与实验值不一致，产生大量不符合物理规律的序列。
AI.method: 提出 DiffuNoVo：以扩散模型为核心骨架，训练时引入肽级质量损失，推理时利用潜空间梯度回归器引导，强制生成质量匹配的肽段。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，DiffuNovo 的 DNPS 准确率超越现有最佳方法，并将质量误差显著降低，生成更具物理合理性的肽段。
AI.conclusion: DiffuNovo 通过显式质量控制，为 DNPS 提供了鲁棒且广泛适用的新范式，展示了扩散模型在可控生成中的潜力。
AI.translation: 蛋白质发现依赖于灵敏的蛋白鉴定，其中质谱从头测序（DNPS）是关键。深度学习的进展未能有效约束预测肽段质量必须与实验前体质量一致，导致大量不合理结果。本文提出 DiffuNovo，一种回归器引导的扩散模型，在训练与推理阶段均显式施加质量约束，实现物理一致性并显著提升准确率。
AI.summary: DiffuNovo 将扩散模型引入 DNPS，通过肽级质量损失和潜空间回归器引导，实现端到端的质量控制，在准确性与物理合理性上均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 从头测序, 肽段测序, 扩散模型, 质量约束, 深度学习
AI.comments: 作者未在摘要中给出具体准确率提升幅度、数据集规模或运行时间，也未提及是否支持修饰肽段或与其他类型质谱数据的兼容性。

title: The Sim-to-Real Gap in MRS Quantification: A Systematic Deep Learning Validation for GABA
summary: Magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) is used to quantify metabolites in vivo and estimate biomarkers for conditions ranging from neurological disorders to cancers. Quantifying low-concentration metabolites such as GABA ($γ$-aminobutyric acid) is challenging due to low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and spectral overlap. We investigate and validate deep learning for quantifying complex, low-SNR, overlapping signals from MEGA-PRESS spectra, devise a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a Y-shaped autoencoder (YAE), and select the best models via Bayesian optimisation on 10,000 simulated spectra from slice-profile-aware MEGA-PRESS simulations. The selected models are trained on 100,000 simulated spectra. We validate their performance on 144 spectra from 112 experimental phantoms containing five metabolites of interest (GABA, Glu, Gln, NAA, Cr) with known ground truth concentrations across solution and gel series acquired at 3 T under varied bandwidths and implementations. These models are further assessed against the widely used LCModel quantification tool. On simulations, both models achieve near-perfect agreement (small MAEs; regression slopes $\approx 1.00$, $R^2 \approx 1.00$). On experimental phantom data, errors initially increased substantially. However, modelling variable linewidths in the training data significantly reduced this gap. The best augmented deep learning models achieved a mean MAE for GABA over all phantom spectra of 0.151 (YAE) and 0.160 (FCNN) in max-normalised relative concentrations, outperforming the conventional baseline LCModel (0.220). A sim-to-real gap remains, but physics-informed data augmentation substantially reduced it. Phantom ground truth is needed to judge whether a method will perform reliably on real data.

AI.title_translation: MRS定量中仿真-现实差距：面向GABA的系统化深度学习验证
AI.tldr: 用CNN与YAE深度学习模型，在10万条仿真MEGA-PRESS谱上训练，经线宽增强后在144条实验模型液谱上测试，GABA平均绝对误差0.15，优于LCModel的0.22，显著缩小但仍存在仿真-现实差距。
AI.motivation: 低浓度代谢物（如GABA）因信噪比低、谱峰重叠，传统MRS定量困难，需验证深度学习能否在真实场景可靠量化。
AI.method: 构建CNN与Y形自编码器；用贝叶斯优化在1万条切片轮廓感知MEGA-PRESS仿真谱上选超参数；以10万条仿真谱训练，并通过线宽扰动增强；与LCModel比较，评估144条3T模型液谱（含GABA、Glu、Gln、NAA、Cr）。
AI.result: 仿真集上两模型均接近完美（斜率≈1.00，R²≈1.00）；原始模型在实验模型液误差大；线宽增强后YAE对GABA平均MAE降至0.151，CNN降至0.160，均优于LCModel的0.220。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导的数据增强可显著缩小仿真-现实差距，但差距仍存；模型液真值对评估方法可靠性必不可少。
AI.translation: 磁共振波谱（MRS）用于活体定量代谢物并估计神经疾病至癌症等生物标志。低浓度代谢物如GABA因信噪比低、谱峰重叠难以定量。本文针对MEGA-PRESS复杂低信噪比重叠信号，提出并验证深度学习：设计CNN与Y形自编码器（YAE），在1万条切片轮廓感知仿真谱上用贝叶斯优化选模，再以10万条仿真谱训练。用144条来自112个实验模型液（溶液与凝胶，含GABA、Glu、Gln、NAA、Cr，浓度已知）在3T不同带宽与实现下采集的谱进行验证，并与常用LCModel比较。仿真集上两模型几近完美；实验模型液误差初显著增大，通过在训练中加入可变线宽后显著缩小差距。最佳增强模型对全部模型液GABA的平均MAE为0.151（YAE）与0.160（CNN），优于LCModel的0.220。仿真-现实差距仍存，但物理知情增强已大幅缩减。需模型液真值以判断方法在真实数据上的可靠性。
AI.summary: 本文针对MEGA-PRESS低信噪比谱，提出CNN与YAE深度学习框架，经线宽增强训练后在144条模型液谱上验证，GABA定量误差优于LCModel，证实物理引导的数据增强可有效缩小但仍无法消除仿真-现实差距。
AI.keywords: 磁共振波谱,深度学习,GABA定量,仿真-现实差距,MEGA-PRESS
AI.comments: 研究强调模型液真值验证的重要性，未来需在人体数据进一步评估；线宽增强策略可推广至其他代谢物及序列。

title: Gap-Dependent Bounds for Nearly Minimax Optimal Reinforcement Learning with Linear Function Approximation
summary: We study gap-dependent performance guarantees for nearly minimax-optimal algorithms in reinforcement learning with linear function approximation. While prior works have established gap-dependent regret bounds in this setting, existing analyses do not apply to algorithms that achieve the nearly minimax-optimal worst-case regret bound $\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{H^3K})$, where $d$ is the feature dimension, $H$ is the horizon length, and $K$ is the number of episodes. We bridge this gap by providing the first gap-dependent regret bound for the nearly minimax-optimal algorithm LSVI-UCB++ (He et al., 2023). Our analysis yields improved dependencies on both $d$ and $H$ compared to previous gap-dependent results. Moreover, leveraging the low policy-switching property of LSVI-UCB++, we introduce a concurrent variant that enables efficient parallel exploration across multiple agents and establish the first gap-dependent sample complexity upper bound for online multi-agent RL with linear function approximation, achieving linear speedup with respect to the number of agents.

AI.title_translation: 基于线性函数近似的近极小极大最优强化学习中的间隙相关界
AI.tldr: 论文首次为LSVI-UCB++算法给出间隙相关遗憾界，改进了对特征维度d与步长H的依赖，并据此提出并发多智能体版本，实现在线多智能体线性函数近似RL的首个间隙相关样本复杂度上界，随智能体数线性加速。
AI.motivation: 现有间隙相关分析无法覆盖已达近极小极大最优最坏遗憾界Õ(d√H³K)的算法，存在理论与最优算法脱节的问题。
AI.method: 作者分析LSVI-UCB++算法，利用其低策略切换特性，设计并发变体，使多智能体并行探索，并推导间隙相关遗憾界与样本复杂度上界。
AI.result: 获得LSVI-UCB++的首个间隙相关遗憾界，改进了d与H的依赖；提出并发多智能体RL，建立首个间隙相关样本复杂度上界，实现随智能体数线性加速。
AI.conclusion: 研究填补了间隙相关界与近极小极大最优算法间的空白，为多智能体线性函数近似RL提供了更紧致的理论保证与高效并行化方案。
AI.translation: 本文研究线性函数近似强化学习中近极小最优算法的间隙相关性能保证。先前工作虽给出间隙相关遗憾界，但其分析不适用于达到近极小最优最坏遗憾界Õ(d√H³K)的算法，其中d为特征维度，H为步长，K为幕数。我们首次为LSVI-UCB++算法提供间隙相关遗憾界，改进先前结果对d与H的依赖。此外，利用LSVI-UCB++的低策略切换特性，提出并发变体，实现多智能体并行探索，并建立在线多智能体线性函数近似RL的首个间隙相关样本复杂度上界，随智能体数实现线性加速。
AI.summary: 论文针对线性函数近似RL，首次为近极小最优算法LSVI-UCB++提供间隙相关遗憾界，改进对d、H的依赖，并据此提出并发多智能体版本，给出首个间隙相关样本复杂度上界，支持线性加速。
AI.keywords: 强化学习，线性函数近似，间隙相关界，近极小最优，LSVI-UCB++，多智能体，样本复杂度，并行探索

title: Compute System Organization for High Frequency High Order Wavefront Sensing and Control
summary: Maintaining long-term wavefront stability is critical for the Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO), which targets contrasts approaching $10^{-10}$ and therefore requires continuous dark-zone maintenance using high-order wavefront sensing and control (HOWFSC). Prior work has advanced HOWFSC algorithms and profiled candidate implementations on radiation-hardened processors, highlighting a substantial gap between the computational demands of LUVOIR-scale HOWFSC and the capabilities of current onboard spacecraft hardware. In this paper, we argue that this gap can be closed by offloading the HOWFSC pipeline to a dedicated co-flying compute satellite at Sun-Earth L2. This approach enables the use of modern, radiation-tolerant high-performance processors without increasing risk to the primary observatory. We show that such an architecture can increase the end-to-end control cadence from the sub-hertz regime typical of radiation-hardened onboard processing or ground-in-the-loop operation to tens and even hundreds of hertz. We evaluate commercial hardware platforms in terms of performance and feasibility, and we propose custom architectures that enable higher control frequencies with significant power consumption reductions. Finally, we outline system-level considerations for co-flying compute, including reliability, satellite integration, and inter-satellite communication constraints.

title: Inspectorch: Efficient rare event exploration in solar observations
comments: Comments: 12+1 pages, 11+2 figures, submitted to A&A
summary: The Sun is observed in unprecedented detail, enabling studies of its activity on very small spatiotemporal scales. However, the large volume of data collected by our telescopes cannot be fully analyzed with conventional methods. Popular machine learning methods identify general trends from observations, but tend to overlook unusual events due to their low frequency of occurrence. We study the applicability of unsupervised probabilistic methods to efficiently identify rare events in multidimensional solar observations and optimize our computational resources to the study of these extreme phenomena. We introduce Inspectorch, an open-source framework that utilizes flow-based models: flexible density estimators capable of learning the multidimensional distribution of solar observations. Once optimized, it assigns a probability to each sample, allowing us to identify unusual events. We apply this approach by applying it to observations from the Hinode Spectro-Polarimeter, the Interface Region Imaging Spectrograph, the Microlensed Hyperspectral Imager at Swedish 1-m Solar Telescope, the Atmospheric Imaging Assembly on board the Solar Dynamics Observatory and the Extreme Ultraviolet Imager on board Solar Orbiter. We find that the algorithm assigns consistently lower probabilities to spectra that exhibit unusual features. For example, it identifies profiles with very strong Doppler shifts, uncommon broadening, and temporal dynamics associated with small-scale reconnection events, among others. As a result, Inspectorch demonstrates that density estimation using flow-based models offers a powerful approach to identifying rare events in large solar datasets. The resulting probabilistic anomaly scores allow computational resources to be focused on the most informative and physically relevant events. We make our Python package publicly available at https://github.com/cdiazbas/inspectorch.

title: Fast Spectrogram Event Extraction via Offline Self-Supervised Learning: From Fusion Diagnostics to Bioacoustics
summary: Next-generation fusion facilities like ITER face a "data deluge," generating petabytes of multi-diagnostic signals daily that challenge manual analysis. We present a "signals-first" self-supervised framework for the automated extraction of coherent and transient modes from high-noise time-frequency data. We also develop a general-purpose method and tool for extracting coherent, quasi-coherent, and transient modes for fluctuation measurements in tokamaks by employing non-linear optimal techniques in multichannel signal processing with a fast neural network surrogate on fast magnetics, electron cyclotron emission, CO2 interferometers, and beam emission spectroscopy measurements from DIII-D. Results are tested on data from DIII-D, TJ-II, and non-fusion spectrograms. With an inference latency of 0.5 seconds, this framework enables real-time mode identification and large-scale automated database generation for advanced plasma control. Repository is in https://github.com/PlasmaControl/TokEye.

title: Detecting and Mitigating Group Bias in Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
summary: Heterogeneous treatment effects (HTEs) are increasingly estimated using machine learning models that produce highly personalized predictions of treatment effects. In practice, however, predicted treatment effects are rarely interpreted, reported, or audited at the individual level but, instead, are often aggregated to broader subgroups, such as demographic segments, risk strata, or markets. We show that such aggregation can induce systematic bias of the group-level causal effect: even when models for predicting the individual-level conditional average treatment effect (CATE) are correctly specified and trained on data from randomized experiments, aggregating the predicted CATEs up to the group level does not, in general, recover the corresponding group average treatment effect (GATE). We develop a unified statistical framework to detect and mitigate this form of group bias in randomized experiments. We first define group bias as the discrepancy between the model-implied and experimentally identified GATEs, derive an asymptotically normal estimator, and then provide a simple-to-implement statistical test. For mitigation, we propose a shrinkage-based bias-correction, and show that the theoretically optimal and empirically feasible solutions have closed-form expressions. The framework is fully general, imposes minimal assumptions, and only requires computing sample moments. We analyze the economic implications of mitigating detected group bias for profit-maximizing personalized targeting, thereby characterizing when bias correction alters targeting decisions and profits, and the trade-offs involved. Applications to large-scale experimental data at major digital platforms validate our theoretical results and demonstrate empirical performance.

AI.title_translation: 异质处理效应中的群体偏差检测与缓解
AI.tldr: 论文指出，即使个体因果模型正确，将其预测结果聚合成群体平均处理效应(GATE)仍会产生系统性偏差，并给出检测与校正该偏差的统一统计框架。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型虽能精准预测个体处理效应(CATE)，但实践中常需将预测聚合到人口、风险或市场等群体层面做决策；作者发现这种聚合会扭曲群体因果效应，需加以检测与纠正。
AI.method: 定义群体偏差为模型隐含GATE与实验识别GATE的差异，推导其渐近正态估计量与检验；提出基于收缩(shrinkage)的闭式偏差校正；仅需样本矩计算，无需额外假设。
AI.result: 理论证明校正公式最优且可实施；在大型数字平台实验数据中验证检测与校正有效；给出偏差校正改变定向决策与利润的经济条件及权衡。
AI.conclusion: 即使个体模型正确，群体聚合仍可能引入偏差；作者提出的统一框架可在随机实验中以最小假设检测并缓解该偏差，为利润最大化的个性化定向提供决策依据。
AI.translation: 异质处理效应(HTE)越来越多地通过机器学习模型估计，以产生高度个性化的处理效应预测。然而实践中，预测的处理效应很少在个人层面被解释、报告或审计，而通常被聚合到更广泛的分组，如人口段、风险层或市场。我们表明，这种聚合可能对群体层面的因果效应引入系统性偏差：即使用于预测个体条件平均处理效应(CATE)的模型设定正确且在随机实验数据上训练，将预测CATE聚合到群体层面通常也无法恢复相应的群体平均处理效应(GATE)。我们开发了一个统一的统计框架，用于在随机实验中检测并缓解这种群体偏差。我们首先定义群体偏差为模型隐含与实验识别的GATE之间的差异，推导一个渐近正态估计量，并提供易于实施的统计检验。为缓解，我们提出基于收缩的偏差校正，并证明理论上最优且经验可行的解具有闭式表达式。该框架完全通用，假设极少，仅需计算样本矩。我们分析了缓解检测到的群体偏差对利润最大化个性化定向的经济影响，刻画偏差校正何时改变定向决策与利润及其权衡。对大型数字平台实验数据的应用验证了我们的理论结果并展示了经验性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出一个通用统计框架，用于检测并纠正将个体因果预测聚合成群体平均处理效应时出现的系统性偏差，给出闭式校正公式并在真实平台实验中验证，同时分析其对个性化定向利润的影响。
AI.keywords: 异质处理效应;群体平均处理效应;群体偏差;因果推断;收缩估计;个性化定向
AI.comments: 摘要未提及代码是否开源、计算复杂度及实时性要求，也未讨论非随机实验场景下的适用性。

title: Selecting Optimal Variable Order in Autoregressive Ising Models
summary: Autoregressive models enable tractable sampling from learned probability distributions, but their performance critically depends on the variable ordering used in the factorization via complexities of the resulting conditional distributions. We propose to learn the Markov random field describing the underlying data, and use the inferred graphical model structure to construct optimized variable orderings. We illustrate our approach on two-dimensional image-like models where a structure-aware ordering leads to restricted conditioning sets, thereby reducing model complexity. Numerical experiments on Ising models with discrete data demonstrate that graph-informed orderings yield higher-fidelity generated samples compared to naive variable orderings.

AI.title_translation: 自回归伊辛模型中最优变量顺序的选择
AI.tldr: 通过先学习数据的马尔可夫随机场结构，再据此构造变量顺序，可显著降低自回归伊辛模型的复杂度并提升采样质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型的采样性能高度依赖变量顺序，而传统顺序常导致条件分布复杂；需要一种能自动发现更优顺序的方法以降低模型复杂度并提高生成样本保真度。
AI.method: 先利用数据推断出马尔可夫随机场（图结构），再依据图结构中的依赖关系构造变量顺序，使每个变量的条件集尽可能受限，从而实现结构感知的顺序优化。
AI.result: 在二维图像类伊辛模型实验中，图结构引导的顺序相比朴素顺序显著减少了条件集大小，生成的样本具有更高的保真度。
AI.conclusion: 利用推断出的图结构来指导自回归模型的变量顺序，可有效降低模型复杂度并提升生成质量，为自回归伊辛模型提供了一种实用的顺序选择策略。
AI.translation: 自回归模型使从已学习概率分布中采样变得可行，但其性能严重依赖于因式分解中使用的变量顺序，因为这决定了所得条件分布的复杂度。我们建议先学习描述底层数据的马尔可夫随机场，并利用推断出的图模型结构来构造优化的变量顺序。我们在二维图像类模型上进行了说明，结构感知的顺序导致受限的条件集，从而降低模型复杂度。对离散数据的伊辛模型进行数值实验表明，基于图的顺序相比朴素变量顺序能产生更高保真度的生成样本。
AI.summary: 本文提出“先学图结构、再定变量序”的两步法：用数据估计马尔可夫随机场后，根据图依赖关系构造自回归顺序，使每个变量只需条件于少量邻居，降低复杂度；实验表明该方法在伊辛图像模型上生成质量优于传统顺序。
AI.keywords: 自回归模型, 伊辛模型, 变量顺序, 马尔可夫随机场, 图结构学习, 模型复杂度, 采样保真度
AI.comments: 摘要未提及算法细节、时间复杂度、可扩展性或与传统方法的定量比较指标；也未讨论非图像数据上的泛化性能。

title: Incomplete Open Platonic Solids
summary:
Sol LeWitt famously enumerated all the incomplete open cubes, finding 122 of these connected, non-planar subsets of the edges of the cube.
  Since then, while several projects have revisited the cube enumeration, no such enumeration has been published for any other interesting solid.
  In this paper we present work on enumerating all the incomplete open platonic solids, finding 6 tetrahedra, 122 cubes (just like LeWitt), 185 octahedra, 2\,423\,206 dodecahedra and 16\,096\,166 icosahedra.

AI.title_translation: 不完全开放柏拉图立体
AI.tldr: 作者首次系统枚举了五种柏拉图立体中所有“不完全开放”的边子集，给出四面体6种、立方体122种、八面体185种、十二面体2,423,206种、二十面体16,096,166种。
AI.motivation: 继Sol LeWitt对立方体完成枚举后，长期缺乏对其他柏拉图立体类似结构的计数研究，本文填补了这一空白。
AI.method: 系统枚举所有连通的、非平面的柏拉图立体边子集，并去除与完整立体同构的“封闭”情况。
AI.result: 获得四面体6种、立方体122种（与LeWitt一致）、八面体185种、十二面体2,423,206种、二十面体16,096,166种不完全开放结构。
AI.conclusion: 首次完成所有柏拉图立体的不完全开放边子集枚举，揭示数量随立体复杂度急剧增长。
AI.translation: Sol LeWitt曾列举所有不完全开放立方体，共122种连通、非平面的立方体边子集。此后虽有项目重访立方体枚举，但未见其他有趣立体的类似枚举发表。本文枚举所有不完全开放柏拉图立体，发现四面体6种、立方体122种（与LeWitt相同）、八面体185种、十二面体2,423,206种、二十面体16,096,166种。
AI.summary: 本文将Sol LeWitt对立方体“不完全开放”边子集的枚举推广至所有五种柏拉图立体，通过系统算法枚举连通且非平面的边子集，首次给出四面体、八面体、十二面体与二十面体的完整计数结果，发现数量随立体复杂度呈爆炸式增长。
