title: Robust Mechanism Design with Anonymous Information
summary: In practice, auction data are often endogenously censored and anonymous, revealing only limited outcome statistics rather than full bid profiles. We study robust auction design when the seller observes only aggregated, anonymous order statistics and seeks to maximize worst-case expected revenue over all product distributions consistent with the observed statistic. We show that simple and widely used mechanisms are robustly optimal. Specifically, posted pricing is robustly optimal given the distribution of the highest value; the Myerson auction designed for the unique consistent i.i.d. distribution is robustly optimal given the lowest value distribution; and the second-price auction with an optimal reserve is robustly optimal when an intermediate order statistic is observed and the implied i.i.d. distribution is regular above its reserve. More generally, for a broad class of monotone symmetric mechanisms depending only on the top k order statistics, including multi-unit and position auctions, the worst-case revenue is attained under the i.i.d. distribution consistent with the observed k-th order statistic. Our results provide a tractable foundation for non-discriminatory auction design, where fairness and privacy are intrinsic consequences of the information structure rather than imposed constraints.

AI.title_translation: 匿名信息下的稳健机制设计
AI.tldr: 在仅观测到匿名汇总统计量时，经典拍卖（标价、Myerson拍卖、带保留价第二价格拍卖）对最坏情况期望收益是稳健的，且最优性源于信息结构本身而非外加公平约束。
AI.motivation: 现实中拍卖数据常被匿名化，仅提供有限汇总统计而非全部出价；卖方需在这种信息受限且最坏分布未知的情形下设计收益最大化机制。
AI.method: 将问题建模为卖方仅知最高/最低/第k阶统计量，求在所有与观测一致的产品分布上最大化最坏期望收益；证明最坏情况发生于与观测一致的独立同分布，并分析标价、Myerson拍卖、第二价格拍卖等经典机制在该分布下的收益表现。
AI.result: 标价在已知最高值分布时稳健最优；Myerson拍卖在已知最低值分布时稳健最优；带最优保留价的第二价格拍卖在观测中间阶统计且对应i.i.d.分布在保留价以上正则时稳健最优；对仅依赖前k阶统计的单调对称机制（含多单位与位置拍卖），最坏收益在对应i.i.d.分布下达到。
AI.conclusion: 简单常用机制在匿名信息环境下已具稳健最优性，公平与隐私由信息结构自然导出，无需额外约束，为无歧视拍卖设计提供了可处理的理论基础。
AI.translation: 实践中，拍卖数据常被内生删失且匿名，仅披露有限结果统计而非完整出价。我们研究当卖方仅观测到聚合匿名顺序统计量，并寻求在一切与观测一致的产品分布上最大化最坏期望收益时的稳健拍卖设计。我们证明简单且广泛使用的机制是稳健最优的：给定最高价分布，标价稳健最优；针对唯一一致i.i.d.分布设计的Myerson拍卖在已知最低价分布时稳健最优；当观测到中间顺序统计且所暗示的i.i.d.分布在保留价以上正则时，带最优保留价的第二价格拍卖稳健最优。更一般地，对仅依赖前k阶统计的广泛单调对称机制类（包括多单位与位置拍卖），最坏收益在与第k阶统计一致的i.i.d.分布下达到。我们的结果为非歧视拍卖设计提供了可处理的基础，其中公平与隐私是信息结构的内在结果而非外加约束。
AI.summary: 本文研究卖方仅知匿名汇总统计量时的稳健拍卖设计，证明标价、Myerson拍卖与带保留价第二价格拍卖分别在对应信息条件下对最坏情况期望收益稳健最优，并指出公平隐私由信息结构自然实现。
AI.keywords: 稳健机制设计,匿名信息,拍卖,最坏情况收益,顺序统计,标价,Myerson拍卖,第二价格拍卖
AI.comments: 结果简洁且具实践指导意义，未来可扩展到多阶段或更复杂信息结构。

title: Revenue Non-monotonicity in Matching Markets
summary:
The Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) mechanism is infamously revenue
  non-monotone in combinatorial auctions. I.e., when a buyer increases
  their value for a bundle of items, the total auction revenue may decrease.
  Combinatorial auctions exhibit complementarities which broadly
  result in complexities in auction theory. This brief note shows
  that non-monotonicity in multi-item auctions is not a result of
  complementarities, and in fact, VCG is revenue non-monotone even in matching
  markets.

AI.title_translation: 匹配市场中的收入非单调性
AI.tldr: 即使在无互补性的匹配市场中，VCG机制也会出现收入随买方估值上升反而下降的现象。

AI.method: 理论分析：将VCG机制应用于双边匹配市场，构造并检验收入非单调的实例。
AI.result: 证明即使不存在互补性，VCG在匹配市场中依然可能出现收入随买方估值增加而减少的情形。
AI.conclusion: VCG的收入非单调性是机制本身的属性，而非组合拍卖互补性所致。
AI.translation: VCG机制在组合拍卖中因收入非单调性而臭名昭著：当买家对物品组合的估值提高时，总拍卖收入反而可能下降。组合拍卖的互补性普遍导致拍卖理论复杂化。本文简要指出，多物品拍卖的非单调性并非互补性所致——即便在匹配市场中，VCG机制仍表现出收入非单调性。

title: Sharp isoperimetric inequalities on the Hamming cube II: The critical exponent
summary: A sharp isoperimetric inequality for the Hamming cube is proved at the critical exponent $β=\frac12$. This follows up on previous work, where such bounds were established for $β$ near $\frac12$. As a consequence, this result settles a conjecture of Kahn and Park on cube partitions and yields a sharp $L^1$ Poincaré inequality for Boolean-valued functions. It also confirms a low-noise limit for balanced functions predicted by the Hellinger conjecture on noisy Boolean channels in information theory.

title: PhyGHT: Physics-Guided HyperGraph Transformer for Signal Purification at the HL-LHC
summary: The High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC) at CERN will produce unprecedented datasets capable of revealing fundamental properties of the universe. However, realizing its discovery potential faces a significant challenge: extracting small signal fractions from overwhelming backgrounds dominated by approximately 200 simultaneous pileup collisions. This extreme noise severely distorts the physical observables required for accurate reconstruction. To address this, we introduce the Physics-Guided Hypergraph Transformer (PhyGHT), a hybrid architecture that combines distance-aware local graph attention with global self-attention to mirror the physical topology of particle showers formed in proton-proton collisions. Crucially, we integrate a Pileup Suppression Gate (PSG), an interpretable, physics-constrained mechanism that explicitly learns to filter soft noise prior to hypergraph aggregation. To validate our approach, we release a novel simulated dataset of top-quark pair production to model extreme pileup conditions. PhyGHT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines from the ATLAS and CMS experiments in predicting the signal's energy and mass correction factors. By accurately reconstructing the top quark's invariant mass, we demonstrate how machine learning innovation and interdisciplinary collaboration can directly advance scientific discovery at the frontiers of experimental physics and enhance the HL-LHC's discovery potential. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/rAIson-Lab/PhyGHT

AI.title_translation: PhyGHT：用于HL-LHC信号净化的物理引导超图Transformer

title: Revisiting the Unitary Actor Assumption: Toward Realistic Aggregation of Individual Preferences in Strategy Research
summary: The long-standing unitary-actor assumption in strategy research -- treating firms as monolithic entities with coherent preferences -- misses that organizations are coalitions of individuals with diverse and often conflicting goals. Although behavioral perspectives have challenged this assumption, the field lacks an operational method for deriving an organizational utility function from the disparate preferences of its members and the specific structures used to aggregate them. We develop a mathematical framework that (i) maps individual utility functions into choice probabilities via a random-utility model, (ii) combines those probabilities using an explicit aggregation structure (e.g., unanimity or polyarchy), and (iii) recovers an organizational utility function that rationalizes the collective behavior. This establishes organizational utility functions as operationally meaningful: they summarize and predict organizational choice, yet are generally not simple averages of members' utilities. Instead, aggregation structures systematically reshape preferences -- unanimity approximates the pointwise minima of underlying utility functions, amplifying risk aversion; polyarchy approximates the pointwise maxima, promoting risk-seeking. We illustrate strategic implications in Cournot competition and principal-agent settings, showing how internal aggregation structures shift competitive and collaborative outcomes. Overall, the framework provides a parsimonious way to retrofit unitary-actor models with behaviorally grounded organizational preferences, reconciling the coalition view of the firm with rigorous and tractable strategic analysis.

AI.title_translation: 重新审视单一行为体假设：在战略研究中实现个体偏好的现实聚合
AI.tldr: 论文构建数学框架，将组织视为个体偏好聚合的联盟，推导出可操作的组织效用函数，揭示聚合结构如何重塑风险偏好并影响战略结果。
AI.motivation: 战略研究长期把企业视为具有一致偏好的单一行为体，忽视组织内部个体偏好的多样与冲突，缺乏将成员偏好聚合为组织效用函数的可操作方法。
AI.method: 采用随机效用模型将个体效用映射为选择概率，再依显式聚合结构（如一致同意或多元统治）合并概率，最终恢复可解释集体行为的组织效用函数，并用Cournot竞争与委托-代理情境进行策略分析。
AI.result: 聚合结构系统重塑偏好：一致同意近似效用函数点态最小值，放大风险厌恶；多元统治近似点态最大值，促进风险寻求；内部聚合结构可改变竞争与合作结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以简洁方式将行为基础的组织偏好嵌入单一行为体模型，使企业联盟观与严谨可解的战略分析兼容。
AI.translation: 单一行为体假设长期存在于战略研究中，将企业视为具有一致偏好的单一块体，却忽略了组织是由目标多样且常相冲突的个体组成的联盟。尽管行为视角已挑战该假设，领域仍缺乏将成员 disparate 偏好与具体聚合结构操作性地导出组织效用函数的方法。我们建立数学框架：（i）通过随机效用模型将个体效用函数映射为选择概率；（ii）用显式聚合结构（如一致同意或多元统治）合并这些概率；（iii）恢复能理性化集体行为的组织效用函数。由此，组织效用函数具备操作意义：它们总结并预测组织选择，但通常并非成员效用的简单平均。相反，聚合结构系统重塑偏好——一致同意近似底层效用函数的点态最小值，放大风险厌恶；多元统治近似点态最大值，促进风险寻求。我们在Cournot竞争与委托—代理情境中展示战略含义，揭示内部聚合结构如何改变竞争与合作结果。总体而言，该框架提供简洁途径，将行为基础的组织偏好嵌入单一行为体模型，使企业联盟观与严谨且可解的战略分析相协调。
AI.summary: 作者挑战战略研究中的单一行为体假设，提出数学框架把组织看作个体偏好聚合的联盟。通过随机效用模型与聚合结构，恢复组织效用函数，证明聚合方式显著影响风险偏好与战略结果。

title: Progressive Per-Branch Depth Optimization for DEFOM-Stereo and SAM3 Joint Analysis in UAV Forestry Applications
summary: Accurate per-branch 3D reconstruction is a prerequisite for autonomous UAV-based tree pruning; however, dense disparity maps from modern stereo matchers often remain too noisy for individual branch analysis in complex forest canopies. This paper introduces a progressive pipeline integrating DEFOM-Stereo foundation-model disparity estimation, SAM3 instance segmentation, and multi-stage depth optimization to deliver robust per-branch point clouds. Starting from a naive baseline, we systematically identify and resolve three error families through successive refinements. Mask boundary contamination is first addressed through morphological erosion and subsequently refined via a skeleton-preserving variant to safeguard thin-branch topology. Segmentation inaccuracy is then mitigated using LAB-space Mahalanobis color validation coupled with cross-branch overlap arbitration. Finally, depth noise - the most persistent error source - is initially reduced by outlier removal and median filtering, before being superseded by a robust five-stage scheme comprising MAD global detection, spatial density consensus, local MAD filtering, RGB-guided filtering, and adaptive bilateral filtering. Evaluated on 1920x1080 stereo imagery of Radiata pine (Pinus radiata) acquired with a ZED Mini camera (63 mm baseline) from a UAV in Canterbury, New Zealand, the proposed pipeline reduces the average per-branch depth standard deviation by 82% while retaining edge fidelity. The result is geometrically coherent 3D point clouds suitable for autonomous pruning tool positioning. All code and processed data are publicly released to facilitate further UAV forestry research.

title: Standard Transformers Achieve the Minimax Rate in Nonparametric Regression with $C^{s,λ}$ Targets
summary: The tremendous success of Transformer models in fields such as large language models and computer vision necessitates a rigorous theoretical investigation. To the best of our knowledge, this paper is the first work proving that standard Transformers can approximate Hölder functions $ C^{s,λ}\left([0,1]^{d\times n}\right) $$ (s\in\mathbb{N}_{\geq0},0<λ\leq1) $ under the $L^t$ distance ($t \in [1, \infty]$) with arbitrary precision. Building upon this approximation result, we demonstrate that standard Transformers achieve the minimax optimal rate in nonparametric regression for Hölder target functions. It is worth mentioning that, by introducing two metrics: the size tuple and the dimension vector, we provide a fine-grained characterization of Transformer structures, which facilitates future research on the generalization and optimization errors of Transformers with different structures. As intermediate results, we also derive the upper bounds for the Lipschitz constant of standard Transformers and their memorization capacity, which may be of independent interest. These findings provide theoretical justification for the powerful capabilities of Transformer models.

title: On Channel Estimation for Group-Connected Beyond Diagonal RIS Assisted Multi-User MIMO Communication
summary: Beyond diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surface (BD-RIS) architectures offer superior beamforming gain over conventional diagonal RISs. However, the channel estimation overhead is the main hurdle for reaping the above gain in practice. This letter addresses this issue for group-connected BDRIS aided uplink communication from multiple multi-antenna users to one multi-antenna base station (BS). We first reveal that within each BD-RIS group, the cascaded channel associated with one user antenna and one BD-RIS element is a scaled version of that associated with any other user antenna and BD-RIS element due to the common RIS-BS channel. This insight drastically reduces the dimensionality of the channel estimation problem. Building on this property, we propose an efficient two-phase channel estimation protocol. In the first phase, the reference cascaded channels for all groups are estimated in parallel based on common received signals while determining the scaling coefficients for a single reference antenna. In the second phase, the scaling coefficients for all remaining user antennas are estimated. Numerical results demonstrate that our proposed framework achieves substantially lower estimation error with fewer pilot signals compared to state-of-the-art benchmark schemes.

AI.title_translation: 面向群组连接超对角RIS辅助多用户MIMO通信的信道估计研究

AI.translation: 超对角可重构智能表面(BD-RIS)架构相比传统对角RIS具有更高的波束赋形增益，但信道估计开销是实际获得该增益的主要障碍。本文针对群组连接BD-RIS辅助的上行多天线多用户至多天线基站通信解决此问题。我们首先揭示，在每个BD-RIS群组内，由于存在共同的RIS-基站信道，一个用户天线与一个BD-RIS元件对应的级联信道是任何其他用户天线与BD-RIS元件对应级联信道的比例版本。该洞察大幅降低了信道估计问题的维度。基于此特性，我们提出高效的两阶段信道估计协议：第一阶段基于共同接收信号并行估计所有群组的参考级联信道，并确定单参考天线的比例系数；第二阶段估计所有剩余用户天线的比例系数。数值结果表明，所提框架相比现有基准方案在显著降低估计误差的同时减少了导频信号数量。
AI.summary: 本文研究群组连接BD-RIS辅助的上行多用户MIMO系统信道估计。作者发现同一BD-RIS群组内级联信道呈比例关系，利用该特性提出两阶段估计协议：先并行估计参考信道与比例系数，再估计其余比例系数，显著降低导频与误差。
AI.keywords: 超对角可重构智能表面，信道估计，群组连接，多用户MIMO，级联信道，比例特性

title: Characterizing Online and Private Learnability under Distributional Constraints via Generalized Smoothness
summary: Understanding minimal assumptions that enable learning and generalization is perhaps the central question of learning theory. Several celebrated results in statistical learning theory, such as the VC theorem and Littlestone's characterization of online learnability, establish conditions on the hypothesis class that allow for learning under independent data and adversarial data, respectively. Building upon recent work bridging these extremes, we study sequential decision making under distributional adversaries that can adaptively choose data-generating distributions from a fixed family $U$ and ask when such problems are learnable with sample complexity that behaves like the favorable independent case. We provide a near complete characterization of families $U$ that admit learnability in terms of a notion known as generalized smoothness i.e. a distribution family admits VC-dimension-dependent regret bounds for every finite-VC hypothesis class if and only if it is generalized smooth. Further, we give universal algorithms that achieve low regret under any generalized smooth adversary without explicit knowledge of $U$. Finally, when $U$ is known, we provide refined bounds in terms of a combinatorial parameter, the fragmentation number, that captures how many disjoint regions can carry nontrivial mass under $U$. These results provide a nearly complete understanding of learnability under distributional adversaries. In addition, building upon the surprising connection between online learning and differential privacy, we show that the generalized smoothness also characterizes private learnability under distributional constraints.

AI.title_translation: 通过广义平滑性刻画分布约束下的在线和隐私可学习性
AI.tldr: 本文通过广义平滑性，近乎完整地刻画了在分布对抗下以及隐私设置中的可学习性，并提供了通用算法。
AI.motivation: 学习理论的核心问题是理解实现学习和泛化的最小假设。现有理论主要关注独立数据和对抗性数据下的学习，但缺乏对在固定分布族下自适应选择数据生成分布的“分布对抗”情况的理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，研究在这种情况下何时能以类似独立情况的样本复杂度进行学习。
AI.method: 本文研究了在固定分布族$U$下，分布对抗自适应选择数据生成分布的序贯决策问题。通过引入“广义平滑性”概念来刻画分布族$U$的可学习性。提出了在任何广义平滑对抗下都能实现低遗憾的通用算法，无需明确知道$U$。当$U$已知时，利用组合参数“碎片数”来提供更精细的界限。此外，还利用在线学习和差分隐私之间的联系，将广义平滑性应用于刻画分布约束下的隐私可学习性。
AI.result: 本文近乎完整地刻画了允许学习的分布族$U$：一个分布族当且仅当它是广义平滑的时，才对每个有限VC假设类都允许依赖于VC维度的遗憾界限。提出了在任何广义平滑对抗下都能实现低遗憾的通用算法，且无需明确知道$U$。当$U$已知时，提供了基于组合参数“碎片数”的更精细的界限。广义平滑性也刻画了分布约束下的隐私可学习性。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果提供了对分布对抗下可学习性的近乎完整的理解，并且广义平滑性也同样适用于刻画分布约束下的隐私可学习性。
AI.translation: 理解实现学习和泛化的最小假设也许是学习理论的核心问题。统计学习理论中的几个著名结果，例如VC定理和Littlestone对在线可学习性的刻画，分别建立了在独立数据和对抗性数据下允许学习的假设类条件。基于最近连接这些极端情况的工作，我们研究了在分布对抗下的序贯决策制定，这些对抗可以自适应地从一个固定族$U$中选择数据生成分布，并询问何时这些问题可以以表现类似于有利的独立情况的样本复杂度进行学习。我们通过一个称为广义平滑性的概念，近乎完整地刻画了允许学习的族$U$，即一个分布族当且仅当它是广义平滑的时，才对每个有限VC假设类都允许依赖于VC维度的遗憾界限。此外，我们提供了在任何广义平滑对抗下都能实现低遗憾的通用算法，无需明确知道$U$。最后，当$U$已知时，我们根据一个组合参数——碎片数——提供了更精细的界限，该参数捕获了在$U$下有多少不相交区域可以承载非平凡的质量。这些结果提供了对分布对抗下可学习性的近乎完整的理解。此外，基于在线学习和差分隐私之间令人惊讶的联系，我们表明广义平滑性也刻画了分布约束下的隐私可学习性。
AI.summary: 本文通过引入“广义平滑性”概念，对在分布对抗下以及在分布约束下的隐私设置中的可学习性进行了近乎完整的刻画。研究发现，当且仅当一个分布族是广义平滑的时，它才允许依赖于VC维度的遗憾界限。论文还提出了无需明确知道分布族的通用算法，并在已知分布族时，通过碎片数提供了更精细的界限。
AI.keywords: 广义平滑性, 分布对抗, 可学习性, 隐私学习, 序贯决策
AI.comments: 这篇论文在学习理论领域做出了重要贡献，它将传统的独立数据和对抗性数据下的学习理论推广到了更复杂的分布对抗场景。引入“广义平滑性”概念是一个关键的创新点，它为理解和刻画此类问题提供了统一的框架。此外，将这一概念扩展到隐私可学习性，揭示了在线学习与差分隐私之间的深层联系，具有重要的理论和实践意义。其通用算法的提出，使得在未知具体分布族的情况下也能实现低遗憾学习，增强了方法的普适性。

title: Amortized Bayesian inference for actigraph time sheet data from mobile devices
summary: Mobile data technologies use ``actigraphs'' to furnish information on health variables as a function of a subject's movement. The advent of wearable devices and related technologies has propelled the creation of health databases consisting of human movement data to conduct research on mobility patterns and health outcomes. Statistical methods for analyzing high-resolution actigraph data depend on the specific inferential context, but the advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) frameworks require that the methods be congruent to transfer learning and amortization. This article devises amortized Bayesian inference for actigraph time sheets. We pursue a Bayesian approach to ensure full propagation of uncertainty and its quantification using a hierarchical dynamic linear model. We build our analysis around actigraph data from the Physical Activity through Sustainable Transport Approaches in Los Angeles (PASTA-LA) study conducted by the Fielding School of Public Health in the University of California, Los Angeles. Apart from achieving probabilistic imputation of actigraph time sheets, we are also able to statistically learn about the time-varying impact of explanatory variables on the magnitude of acceleration (MAG) for a cohort of subjects.

AI.title_translation: 移动设备体动记录时间表数据的摊销贝叶斯推断

title: On the Convergence of Stochastic Gradient Descent with Perturbed Forward-Backward Passes
summary: We study stochastic gradient descent (SGD) for composite optimization problems with $N$ sequential operators subject to perturbations in both the forward and backward passes. Unlike classical analyses that treat gradient noise as additive and localized, perturbations to intermediate outputs and gradients cascade through the computational graph, compounding geometrically with the number of operators. We present the first comprehensive theoretical analysis of this setting. Specifically, we characterize how forward and backward perturbations propagate and amplify within a single gradient step, derive convergence guarantees for both general non-convex objectives and functions satisfying the Polyak--Łojasiewicz condition, and identify conditions under which perturbations do not deteriorate the asymptotic convergence order. As a byproduct, our analysis furnishes a theoretical explanation for the gradient spiking phenomenon widely observed in deep learning, precisely characterizing the conditions under which training recovers from spikes or diverges. Experiments on logistic regression with convex and non-convex regularization validate our theories, illustrating the predicted spike behavior and the asymmetric sensitivity to forward versus backward perturbations.

AI.title_translation: 扰动前向-后向传递下随机梯度下降的收敛性研究
AI.tldr: 本文首次全面理论分析了复合优化中SGD在前后向传递存在扰动时的收敛性，解释了梯度尖峰现象。
AI.motivation: 经典梯度下降分析将噪声视为局部加性噪声，但对于复合优化问题，前向和后向传递中的扰动会通过计算图级联并几何级放大。因此，需要对这种设置进行全面的理论分析。
AI.method: 本文通过以下方式进行了理论分析：1. 刻画了前向和后向扰动在单个梯度步中如何传播和放大。2. 推导了针对一般非凸目标函数和满足Polyak--Łojasiewicz条件的函数的收敛性保证。3. 确定了扰动不恶化渐近收敛阶数的条件。4. 通过实验验证了理论，使用了带有凸和非凸正则化的逻辑回归。
AI.result: 1. 揭示了前向和后向扰动在单个梯度步内的传播和放大机制。2. 为一般非凸目标和满足Polyak--Łojasiewicz条件的函数提供了收敛性保证。3. 确定了扰动不影响渐近收敛阶数的条件。4. 理论上解释了深度学习中广泛观察到的梯度尖峰现象，并精确刻画了训练从尖峰中恢复或发散的条件。5. 实验验证了理论预测的尖峰行为以及对前向与后向扰动的不对称敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次对复合优化中随机梯度下降在前向和后向传递受扰动的情况进行了全面的理论分析，揭示了扰动传播机制，提供了收敛性保证，并对深度学习中的梯度尖峰现象提供了理论解释。
AI.translation: 我们研究了复合优化问题中的随机梯度下降（SGD），其中包含N个顺序运算符，并在前向和后向传递中受到扰动。与将梯度噪声视为加性和局部化的经典分析不同，对中间输出和梯度的扰动会通过计算图级联，并随着运算符数量的增加而几何级联。我们首次对这种设置进行了全面的理论分析。具体来说，我们刻画了前向和后向扰动在单个梯度步中如何传播和放大，推导了针对一般非凸目标函数和满足Polyak--Łojasiewicz条件的函数的收敛性保证，并确定了扰动不恶化渐近收敛阶数的条件。作为附带结果，我们的分析为深度学习中广泛观察到的梯度尖峰现象提供了理论解释，精确刻画了训练从尖峰中恢复或发散的条件。在带有凸和非凸正则化的逻辑回归上的实验验证了我们的理论，展示了预测的尖峰行为以及对前向与后向扰动的不对称敏感性。
AI.summary: 本文对含有N个顺序运算符的复合优化问题中，前向和后向传递均受扰动的随机梯度下降（SGD）进行了首次全面的理论分析。研究揭示了扰动在计算图中的几何级联传播和放大机制，为非凸和满足Polyak--Łojasiewicz条件的函数提供了收敛性保证，并确定了扰动不影响渐近收敛阶数的条件。此外，该研究为深度学习中的梯度尖峰现象提供了理论解释，并通过逻辑回归实验验证了理论预测。
AI.keywords: 随机梯度下降, 复合优化, 扰动传播, 梯度尖峰, 收敛性分析
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于它首次对随机梯度下降在前后向传递均存在扰动这一复杂设置进行了全面的理论分析，这与传统将噪声视为简单加性的方法截然不同。其重要性体现在揭示了扰动在计算图中的几何级联效应，为理解深度学习中梯度尖峰现象提供了坚实的理论基础，并为设计更鲁棒的优化算法提供了指导。

title: DANCE: Doubly Adaptive Neighborhood Conformal Estimation
summary: The recent developments of complex deep learning models have led to unprecedented ability to accurately predict across multiple data representation types. Conformal prediction for uncertainty quantification of these models has risen in popularity, providing adaptive, statistically-valid prediction sets. For classification tasks, conformal methods have typically focused on utilizing logit scores. For pre-trained models, however, this can result in inefficient, overly conservative set sizes when not calibrated towards the target task. We propose DANCE, a doubly locally adaptive nearest-neighbor based conformal algorithm combining two novel nonconformity scores directly using the data's embedded representation. DANCE first fits a task-adaptive kernel regression model from the embedding layer before using the learned kernel space to produce the final prediction sets for uncertainty quantification. We test against state-of-the-art local, task-adapted and zero-shot conformal baselines, demonstrating DANCE's superior blend of set size efficiency and robustness across various datasets.

AI.keywords: 保形预测, 不确定性量化, 深度学习, 最近邻, 嵌入表示

title: F10.7 Index Prediction: A Multiscale Decomposition Strategy with Wavelet Transform for Performance Optimization
summary: In this study, we construct Dataset A for training, validation, and testing, and Dataset B to evaluate generalization. We propose a novel F10.7 index forecasting method using wavelet decomposition, which feeds F10.7 together with its decomposed approximate and detail signals into the iTransformer model. We also incorporate the International Sunspot Number (ISN) and its wavelet-decomposed signals to assess their influence on prediction performance. Our optimal method is then compared with the latest method from S. Yan et al. (2025) and three operational models (SWPC, BGS, CLS). Additionally, we transfer our method to the PatchTST model used in H. Ye et al. (2024) and compare our method with theirs on Dataset B. Key findings include: (1) The wavelet-based combination methods overall outperform the baseline using only F10.7 index. The prediction performance improves as higher-level approximate and detail signals are incrementally added. The Combination 6 method integrating F10.7 with its first to fifth level approximate and detail signals outperforms methods using only approximate or detail signals. (2) Incorporating ISN and its wavelet-decomposed signals does not enhance prediction performance. (3) The Combination 6 method significantly surpasses S. Yan et al. (2025) and three operational models, with RMSE, MAE, and MAPE reduced by 18.22%, 15.09%, and 8.57%, respectively, against the former method. It also excels across four different conditions of solar activity. (4) Our method demonstrates superior generalization and prediction capability over the method of H. Ye et al. (2024) across all forecast horizons. To our knowledge, this is the first application of wavelet decomposition in F10.7 prediction, substantially improving forecast performance.

AI.title_translation: F10.7指数预测：一种结合小波变换的多尺度分解策略以优化性能

AI.result:
1. 基于小波的组合方法总体优于仅使用F10.7指数的基线方法。随着更高层次的近似和细节信号的逐步添加，预测性能得到改善。“组合6”方法（整合F10.7及其第一至第五层近似和细节信号）优于仅使用近似或细节信号的方法。

4. 在所有预测时域上，本方法都比H. Ye et al. (2024)的方法表现出更优越的泛化能力和预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次将小波分解应用于F10.7指数预测，显著提高了预测性能，并提出了一种优于现有先进方法和业务模型的创新预测策略。
AI.translation: 在本研究中，我们构建了用于训练、验证和测试的数据集A，以及用于评估泛化能力的数据集B。我们提出了一种新颖的F10.7指数预测方法，该方法利用小波分解，将F10.7及其分解的近似和细节信号输入到iTransformer模型中。我们还结合了国际太阳黑子数（ISN）及其小波分解信号，以评估它们对预测性能的影响。然后，我们将我们最优的方法与S. Yan et al. (2025)的最新方法和三个业务模型（SWPC、BGS、CLS）进行了比较。此外，我们将我们的方法迁移到H. Ye et al. Yan et al. (2025)和三个业务模型，相对于前者，RMSE、MAE和MAPE分别降低了18.22%、15.09%和8.57%。它在四种不同的太阳活动条件下也表现出色。(4) 在所有预测时域上，我们的方法都比H. Ye et al. (2024)的方法表现出更优越的泛化能力和预测能力。据我们所知，这是小波分解首次应用于F10.7预测，它显著提高了预测性能。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的F10.7指数预测方法，该方法通过结合小波分解和iTransformer模型，将F10.7指数及其多尺度分解的近似和细节信号作为输入。通过与现有先进方法和业务模型的广泛比较，结果表明，结合F10.7及其多层小波分解信号的“组合6”方法显著优于基线和对比方法，并在不同太阳活动条件下表现稳定，同时展现出卓越的泛化能力。研究还发现国际太阳黑子数（ISN）的加入并未提升性能。这项工作首次将小波分解应用于F10.7预测，为提高空间天气预报精度提供了新策略。

title: Entropy stable numerical schemes for divergence diminishing Chew, Goldberger & Low equations for plasma flows
summary: Chew, Goldberger & Low (CGL) equations are a set of hyperbolic PDEs with non-conservative products used to model the plasma flows, when the assumption of local thermodynamic equilibrium is not valid, and the pressure tensor is assumed to be rotated by the magnetic field. This results in the pressure tensor, which is described by the two scalar components. As the magnetic field also evolves, controlling the divergence of the magnetic field is important. In this work, we consider the generalized Lagrange multiplier (GLM) technique for the CGL model. The resulting model is referred to as the GLM-CGL system. To make the system suitable for entropy-stable schemes, we reformulate the GLM-CGL system by treating some conservative terms as non-conservative. The resulting system has a non-conservative part that does not affect entropy evolution. We then propose entropy stable numerical methods for the GLM-CGL model. The numerical results for the GLM-CGL system are then compared with the CGL system without the GLM divergence diminishing approach to demonstrate that the GLM approach indeed leads to significant improvement in the magnetic field divergence diminishing.

AI.title_translation: 等离子体流散度递减Chew-Goldberger-Low方程的熵稳定数值格式
AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了用于等离子体流CGL方程的广义拉格朗日乘子（GLM）技术，以实现磁场散度递减，并通过熵稳定数值格式进行了求解。
AI.motivation: Chew, Goldberger & Low (CGL) 方程用于模拟等离子体流，但磁场演化时，控制磁场散度至关重要。传统的CGL方程可能在处理磁场散度方面存在问题。
AI.method: 本文将广义拉格朗日乘子（GLM）技术应用于CGL模型，形成GLM-CGL系统。为了适应熵稳定格式，对GLM-CGL系统进行了重新表述，将部分保守项视为非保守项，但其非保守部分不影响熵演化。然后，提出了用于GLM-CGL模型的熵稳定数值方法。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，与没有GLM散度递减方法的CGL系统相比，GLM方法在磁场散度递减方面带来了显著改进。
AI.conclusion: GLM技术可以有效地应用于CGL方程，以改善磁场散度控制，并通过熵稳定数值格式实现精确模拟。
AI.translation: Chew, Goldberger & Low (CGL) 方程是一组具有非保守项的双曲偏微分方程，用于在局部热力学平衡假设不成立、压力张量被磁场旋转时模拟等离子体流。这导致压力张量由两个标量分量描述。随着磁场的演化，控制磁场的散度非常重要。在这项工作中，我们考虑了用于CGL模型的广义拉格朗日乘子（GLM）技术。由此产生的模型被称为GLM-CGL系统。为了使该系统适用于熵稳定格式，我们通过将一些保守项视为非保守项来重新表述GLM-CGL系统。由此产生的系统具有不影响熵演化的非保守部分。然后，我们提出了用于GLM-CGL模型的熵稳定数值方法。然后将GLM-CGL系统的数值结果与没有GLM散度递减方法的CGL系统进行比较，以证明GLM方法确实在磁场散度递减方面带来了显著改进。
AI.summary: 本文针对等离子体流的Chew, Goldberger & Low (CGL) 方程，引入广义拉格朗日乘子（GLM）技术以有效控制磁场散度。研究者将GLM应用于CGL模型，形成GLM-CGL系统，并对其进行重新表述，使其适用于熵稳定数值格式。通过数值实验证明，GLM方法显著改善了磁场散度递减的效果。
AI.keywords: CGL方程, GLM技术, 熵稳定格式, 磁场散度, 等离子体流
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将GLM技术与CGL方程结合，并开发了熵稳定数值格式来解决磁场散度控制问题，这对于等离子体流的精确模拟具有重要意义。

title: Implicit Decision Diagrams
summary:
Decision Diagrams (DDs) have emerged as a powerful tool for discrete optimization, with rapidly growing adoption. DDs are directed acyclic layered graphs; restricted DDs are a generalized greedy heuristic for finding feasible solutions, and relaxed DDs compute combinatorial relaxed bounds. There is substantial theory that leverages DD-based bounding, yet the complexity of constructing the DDs themselves has received little attention. Standard restricted DD construction requires $O(w \log(w))$ per layer; standard relaxed DD construction requires $O(w^2)$, where $w$ is the width of the DD. Increasing $w$ improves bound quality at the cost of more time and memory.
  We introduce implicit Decision Diagrams, storing arcs implicitly rather than explicitly, and reducing per-layer complexity to $O(w)$ for restricted and relaxed DDs. We prove this is optimal: any framework treating state-update and merge operations as black boxes cannot do better.
  Optimal complexity shifts the challenge from algorithmic overhead to low-level engineering. We show how implicit DDs can drive a MIP solver, and release ImplicitDDs.jl, an open-source Julia solver exploiting the implementation refinements our theory enables. Experiments demonstrate the solver outperforms Gurobi on Subset Sum.

AI.title_translation: 隐式决策图
AI.tldr: 本文引入了隐式决策图，通过隐式存储弧，将受限和松弛决策图的每层复杂度从$O(w 	ext{log}(w))$和$O(w^2)$降低到最优的$O(w)$，并在子集和问题上展示了优于Gurobi的性能。
AI.motivation: 决策图（DDs）在离散优化中是一种强大的工具，但其构建的复杂性并未得到充分关注。标准受限DD构建复杂度为$O(w 	ext{log}(w))$，标准松弛DD构建复杂度为$O(w^2)$，其中$w$是DD的宽度。增加$w$可以提高界限质量，但会增加时间和内存成本。
AI.method: 本文引入了隐式决策图，通过隐式而不是显式存储弧，将受限和松弛决策图的每层复杂度降低到$O(w)$。作者证明这是最优的，并发布了一个名为ImplicitDDs.jl的开源Julia求解器，该求解器利用了理论所实现的实现改进。
AI.result: 隐式决策图将受限和松弛决策图的每层复杂度降低到$O(w)$。实验表明，该求解器在子集和问题上优于Gurobi。
AI.conclusion: 隐式决策图通过降低决策图的构建复杂度，使其在离散优化中更具效率和竞争力。将挑战从算法开销转移到低级工程，并通过开源求解器展示了其优越性。
AI.translation:
决策图（DDs）已成为离散优化的强大工具，并被迅速采用。DDs是定向无环分层图；受限DDs是寻找可行解的广义贪婪启发式方法，而松弛DDs则计算组合松弛界限。有大量理论利用基于DD的边界，但DDs本身的构建复杂性却很少受到关注。标准受限DD构建每层需要$O(w 	ext{log}(w))$，标准松弛DD构建需要$O(w^2)$，其中$w$是DD的宽度。增加$w$会以更多时间和内存为代价提高边界质量。
我们引入了隐式决策图，通过隐式而不是显式存储弧，将受限和松弛DDs的每层复杂度降低到$O(w)$。我们证明这是最优的：任何将状态更新和合并操作视为黑盒的框架都无法做得更好。
最优复杂度将挑战从算法开销转移到低级工程。我们展示了隐式DDs如何驱动MIP求解器，并发布了ImplicitDDs.jl，这是一个利用我们理论实现的实现改进的开源Julia求解器。实验表明该求解器在子集和问题上优于Gurobi。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为隐式决策图的新方法，旨在解决传统决策图（DDs）在构建过程中存在的计算复杂性问题。通过隐式存储弧，该方法成功地将受限和松弛DDs的每层构建复杂度从$O(w 	ext{log}(w))$和$O(w^2)$显著降低到最优的$O(w)$。研究证明了这种复杂度的最优性，并将其应用于MIP求解器中。作者还发布了开源Julia求解器ImplicitDDs.jl，并通过实验证明其在子集和问题上优于Gurobi。
AI.keywords: 隐式决策图, 决策图, 离散优化, 算法复杂度, MIP求解器
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了隐式决策图，通过改变数据存储方式，极大地优化了决策图构建的算法复杂度，使其达到了理论最优。这种优化对于离散优化领域具有重要意义，因为它能有效提升DDs在实际应用中的效率和可扩展性。发布开源求解器进一步验证了其理论价值和实用性。

title: Hawkes Identification with a Prescribed Causal Basis: Closed-Form Estimators and Asymptotics
summary: Driven by the recent surge in neural-inspired modeling, point processes have gained significant traction in systems and control. While the Hawkes process is the standard model for characterizing random event sequences with memory, identifying its unknown kernels is often hindered by nonlinearity. Approaches using prescribed basis kernels have emerged to enable linear parameterization, yet they typically rely on iterative likelihood methods and lack rigorous analysis under model misspecification. This paper justifies a closed-form Least Squares identification framework for Hawkes processes with prescribed kernels. We guarantee estimator existence via the almost-sure positive definiteness of the empirical Gram matrix and prove convergence to the true parameters under correct specification, or to well-defined pseudo-true parameters under misspecification. Furthermore, we derive explicit Central Limit Theorems for both regimes, providing a complete and interpretable asymptotic theory. We demonstrate these theoretical findings through comparative numerical simulations.

AI.title_translation: 具有规定因果基础的霍克斯过程识别：闭式估计器和渐近性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于霍克斯过程核识别的闭式最小二乘框架，解决了非线性问题，并提供了严格的渐近理论。
AI.motivation: 霍克斯过程（Hawkes process）核的识别常常受到非线性的阻碍。现有使用规定基核的方法通常依赖迭代似然方法，并且在模型错误设定下缺乏严格的分析。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个用于具有规定核的霍克斯过程的闭式最小二乘识别框架。通过经验格拉姆矩阵的几乎必然正定性保证了估计器的存在性，并推导了在正确和错误设定下的收敛性及中心极限定理。
AI.result: 本文证明了估计器的存在性，并在模型正确设定下收敛到真实参数，在模型错误设定下收敛到定义明确的伪真实参数。此外，还推导了两种情况下的显式中心极限定理，提供了一个完整且可解释的渐近理论。这些理论发现通过比较数值模拟得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出并验证了一个闭式最小二乘识别框架，为霍克斯过程的核识别提供了一个在正确和错误设定下都具有鲁棒性和可解释性的渐近理论。
AI.translation: 在神经启发建模最近激增的推动下，点过程在系统和控制领域获得了显著的关注。虽然霍克斯过程是表征具有记忆的随机事件序列的标准模型，但识别其未知核常常受到非线性的阻碍。使用规定基核的方法已经出现，以实现线性参数化，但它们通常依赖于迭代似然方法，并且在模型错误设定下缺乏严格的分析。本文证明了一个用于具有规定核的霍克斯过程的闭式最小二乘识别框架是合理的。我们通过经验格拉姆矩阵的几乎必然正定性保证了估计器的存在性，并证明了在正确设定下收敛到真实参数，或者在错误设定下收敛到定义明确的伪真实参数。此外，我们为这两种机制推导了显式中心极限定理，提供了一个完整且可解释的渐近理论。我们通过比较数值模拟展示了这些理论发现。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个针对具有规定核的霍克斯过程的闭式最小二乘识别框架，以克服传统方法中核识别的非线性问题和对迭代方法的依赖。该框架通过经验格拉姆矩阵保证了估计器的存在性，并严格证明了在模型正确设定下收敛到真实参数，在模型错误设定下收敛到定义明确的伪真实参数。此外，论文为这两种情况推导了明确的中心极限定理，从而提供了一个完整且可解释的渐近理论，并通过数值模拟验证了这些理论发现。
AI.keywords: 霍克斯过程, 闭式估计器, 最小二乘, 渐近理论, 核识别
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入闭式最小二乘识别框架，有效解决了霍克斯过程核识别中的非线性挑战，并提供了在模型正确设定和错误设定下的严格渐近理论，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Maximum entropy based testing in network models: ERGMs and constrained optimization
summary:
Stochastic network models play a central role across a wide range of scientific disciplines, and questions of statistical inference arise naturally in this context. In this paper we investigate goodness-of-fit and two-sample testing procedures for statistical networks based on the principle of maximum entropy (MaxEnt). Our approach formulates a constrained entropy-maximization problem on the space of networks, subject to prescribed structural constraints. The resulting test statistics are defined through the Lagrange multipliers associated with the constrained optimization problem, which, to our knowledge, is novel in the statistical networks literature.
  We establish consistency in the classical regime where the number of vertices is fixed. We then consider asymptotic regimes in which the graph size grows with the sample size, developing tests for both dense and sparse settings. In the dense case, we analyze exponential random graph models (ERGM) (including the Erdös-Rènyi models), while in the sparse regime our theory applies to Erd{ö}s-R{è}nyi graphs.
  Our analysis leverages recent advances in nonlinear large deviation theory for random graphs. We further show that the proposed Lagrange-multiplier framework connects naturally to classical score tests for constrained maximum likelihood estimation. The results provide a unified entropy-based framework for network model assessment across diverse growth regimes.

AI.title_translation: 网络模型中的最大熵检验：ERGM与约束优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于最大熵原理和拉格朗日乘子的统计网络拟合优度与两样本检验方法，适用于不同图增长机制下的稠密和稀疏网络模型。
AI.motivation: 在广泛的科学学科中，随机网络模型扮演着核心角色，统计推断问题自然而然地出现。本文旨在研究基于最大熵原理的统计网络拟合优度与两样本检验程序。
AI.method: 该方法在网络空间中构建一个受结构约束的最大熵优化问题。测试统计量通过与该约束优化问题相关的拉格朗日乘子来定义。分析利用了随机图非线性大偏差理论的最新进展。
AI.result: 在顶点数量固定的经典机制下建立了测试的一致性。针对图大小随样本量增长的渐近机制，开发了适用于稠密和稀疏设置的检验方法。在稠密情况下，分析了指数随机图模型（ERGM）；在稀疏情况下，理论适用于Erdös-Rènyi图。此外，所提出的拉格朗日乘子框架与约束最大似然估计的经典得分检验自然连接。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果提供了一个统一的、基于熵的框架，用于评估不同增长机制下的网络模型。
AI.translation:
随机网络模型在广泛的科学学科中扮演着核心角色，统计推断问题在此背景下自然而然地出现。在本文中，我们研究了基于最大熵（MaxEnt）原理的统计网络的拟合优度与两样本检验程序。我们的方法在网络空间中构建了一个受规定结构约束的约束熵最大化问题。由此产生的检验统计量通过与约束优化问题相关的拉格朗日乘子来定义，据我们所知，这在统计网络文献中是新颖的。
我们建立了顶点数量固定时经典机制下的一致性。然后我们考虑图大小随样本量增长的渐近机制，开发了适用于稠密和稀疏设置的检验。在稠密情况下，我们分析了指数随机图模型（ERGM）（包括Erdös-Rènyi模型），而在稀疏机制下，我们的理论适用于Erdös-Rènyi图。
我们的分析利用了随机图非线性大偏差理论的最新进展。我们进一步表明，所提出的拉格朗日乘子框架与约束最大似然估计的经典得分检验自然连接。这些结果为跨越不同增长机制的网络模型评估提供了一个统一的、基于熵的框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于最大熵原理的统计网络拟合优度与两样本检验方法。该方法将问题表述为受约束的最大熵优化，并利用拉格朗日乘子定义检验统计量，这在网络统计文献中是新颖的。研究建立了检验在经典和渐近机制下的一致性，并为稠密（如ERGM）和稀疏（如Erdös-Rènyi图）网络开发了具体检验。此外，该框架与经典得分检验相联系，提供了一个统一的、基于熵的网络模型评估框架。
AI.keywords: 最大熵, 网络模型, ERGM, 约束优化, 统计推断
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次将拉格朗日乘子引入到统计网络的拟合优度与两样本检验统计量的定义中，并提供了一个统一的、基于熵的框架来评估不同增长机制下的网络模型。该方法结合了最大熵原理和约束优化理论，为网络模型分析提供了新颖的视角和工具。

title: Functional Continuous Decomposition
summary: The analysis of non-stationary time-series data requires insight into its local and global patterns with physical interpretability. However, traditional smoothing algorithms, such as B-splines, Savitzky-Golay filtering, and Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), lack the ability to perform parametric optimization with guaranteed continuity. In this paper, we propose Functional Continuous Decomposition (FCD), a JAX-accelerated framework that performs parametric, continuous optimization on a wide range of mathematical functions. By using Levenberg-Marquardt optimization to achieve up to $C^1$ continuous fitting, FCD transforms raw time-series data into $M$ modes that capture different temporal patterns from short-term to long-term trends. Applications of FCD include physics, medicine, financial analysis, and machine learning, where it is commonly used for the analysis of signal temporal patterns, optimized parameters, derivatives, and integrals of decomposition. Furthermore, FCD can be applied for physical analysis and feature extraction with an average SRMSE of 0.735 per segment and a speed of 0.47s on full decomposition of 1,000 points. Finally, we demonstrate that a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) enhanced with FCD features, such as optimized function values, parameters, and derivatives, achieved 16.8% faster convergence and 2.5% higher accuracy over a standard CNN.

AI.title_translation: 函数连续分解
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为函数连续分解（FCD）的JAX加速框架，用于对非平稳时间序列数据进行参数化、连续优化，以实现对局部和全局模式的物理可解释性分析，并在信号分析和机器学习任务中展示了优越的性能。
AI.motivation: 分析非平稳时间序列数据需要洞察其具有物理可解释性的局部和全局模式。然而，传统的平滑算法（如B样条、Savitzky-Golay滤波和经验模态分解）缺乏进行参数优化和保证连续性的能力。
AI.method: 本文提出了函数连续分解（FCD），一个JAX加速框架，它使用Levenberg-Marquardt优化算法实现高达C^1连续拟合，将原始时间序列数据转换为M个模式，以捕捉不同时间尺度的模式。FCD可应用于物理、医学、金融分析和机器学习。
AI.result: FCD在物理分析和特征提取方面的平均每段SRMSE为0.735，对1,000个点进行完整分解的速度为0.47秒。此外，使用FCD特征（如优化函数值、参数和导数）增强的卷积神经网络（CNN）比标准CNN实现了16.8%的更快速收敛和2.5%的更高准确性。
AI.conclusion: FCD提供了一个强大的框架，用于对非平稳时间序列数据进行参数化、连续优化，并在信号分析和机器学习应用中展现出显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 对非平稳时间序列数据的分析需要深入了解其具有物理可解释性的局部和全局模式。然而，传统的平滑算法，如B样条、Savitzky-Golay滤波和经验模态分解（EMD），缺乏进行参数优化和保证连续性的能力。在本文中，我们提出了函数连续分解（FCD），这是一个JAX加速框架，它对各种数学函数执行参数化、连续优化。通过使用Levenberg-Marquardt优化实现高达C^1连续拟合，FCD将原始时间序列数据转换为M个模式，这些模式捕获从短期到长期趋势的不同时间模式。FCD的应用包括物理、医学、金融分析和机器学习，它通常用于分析信号时间模式、优化参数、分解的导数和积分。此外，FCD可应用于物理分析和特征提取，平均每段SRMSE为0.735，对1,000个点进行完整分解的速度为0.47秒。最后，我们证明了用FCD特征（如优化函数值、参数和导数）增强的卷积神经网络（CNN）比标准CNN实现了16.8%的更快速收敛和2.5%的更高准确性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为函数连续分解（FCD）的新型JAX加速框架，旨在解决传统时间序列分析方法在非平稳数据处理中缺乏参数优化和连续性保证的问题。FCD利用Levenberg-Marquardt优化实现高达C^1的连续拟合，将时间序列数据分解为捕捉不同时间尺度模式的M个模式。实验结果表明，FCD在信号分析和特征提取方面表现出色，并能显著提升卷积神经网络的收敛速度和准确性，适用于物理、医学、金融和机器学习等多个领域。
AI.keywords: 函数连续分解, 时间序列分析, JAX, Levenberg-Marquardt优化, 连续性
AI.comments: FCD的创新之处在于其结合了JAX加速的参数化连续优化方法，解决了传统方法在处理非平稳时间序列数据时缺乏连续性和优化能力的痛点。实现C^1连续拟合和在机器学习任务中提升性能的特点，使其在多领域具有重要应用潜力。

title: Decentralized Trading Networks: Equilibria and Fairness
summary: We explore stability and fairness considerations in decentralized networked markets with bilateral contracts, building on the trading networks framework [Hatfield et al., 2013]. In our trading network game, we show that a well-defined subset of Nash equilibria can be supported as competitive equilibria. Considering an offer-based trading dynamic as well as a stochastic price clock market, we prove new convergence results to Nash equilibrium and competitive equilibrium, providing a rationale for stability properties in decentralized, dynamic trading networks. Turning to the tension between fairness and (core) stability, we prove several negative results: inessential agents always receive zero utility in any core outcome, and even essential agents can get zero utility in all core outcomes.

AI.title_translation: 去中心化交易网络：均衡与公平性
AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了去中心化交易网络中双边合约的稳定性与公平性，证明了纳什均衡与竞争性均衡的收敛性，并揭示了核心稳定性与公平性之间的负面关系。
AI.motivation: 研究去中心化网络市场中双边合约的稳定性与公平性问题。
AI.method: 在交易网络框架下，通过交易网络博弈模型，分析纳什均衡与竞争性均衡，并考虑基于报价的交易动态和随机价格时钟市场，以证明收敛性。同时，通过分析核心结果来探讨公平性。
AI.result: 证明了纳什均衡的一个子集可以作为竞争性均衡得到支持。证明了报价交易动态和随机价格时钟市场向纳什均衡和竞争性均衡收敛的新结果。证明了在任何核心结果中，非必要代理总是获得零效用，甚至必要代理在所有核心结果中也可能获得零效用。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化交易网络中存在稳定的均衡，但核心稳定性往往与公平性相冲突，可能导致一些代理获得零效用。
AI.translation: 我们以交易网络框架 [Hatfield et al., 2013] 为基础，探讨了去中心化网络市场中双边合约的稳定性与公平性考量。在我们的交易网络博弈中，我们表明纳什均衡的一个明确子集可以作为竞争性均衡得到支持。考虑到基于报价的交易动态以及随机价格时钟市场，我们证明了向纳什均衡和竞争性均衡收敛的新结果，为去中心化、动态交易网络中的稳定性特性提供了理论依据。转向公平性与（核心）稳定性之间的张力，我们证明了几个负面结果：非必要代理在任何核心结果中总是获得零效用，甚至必要代理在所有核心结果中也可能获得零效用。
AI.summary: 本研究基于现有交易网络框架，深入探讨了去中心化网络市场中双边合约的稳定性与公平性。通过构建交易网络博弈模型，研究发现纳什均衡的特定子集可作为竞争性均衡存在，并且基于报价的交易动态和随机价格时钟市场能够收敛到纳什均衡与竞争性均衡。然而，在公平性与核心稳定性之间存在冲突，表现为非必要代理和部分必要代理在核心结果中可能获得零效用。
AI.keywords: 去中心化交易网络, 纳什均衡, 竞争性均衡, 公平性, 核心稳定性
AI.comments: 该论文在去中心化交易网络的均衡和稳定性方面提供了重要的理论贡献，特别是在收敛性证明方面。同时，其关于核心稳定性与公平性之间负面关系的发现，揭示了这类系统在设计时可能面临的挑战，具有实际指导意义。

title: Symbol-Aware Precoder Design for Physical-Layer Anonymous Communications
comments: This paper has been submitted for possible journal publication
summary: Physical-layer characteristics, such as channel state information (CSI) and transmitter noise induced by hardware impairments, are often uniquely associated with a transmitter. This paper investigates transmitter anonymity at the physical layer from a signal design perspective. We consider an anonymous communication problem where the receiver should reliably decode the signal from the transmitter but should not make use of the signal to infer the transmitter's identity.Transmitter anonymity is quantified using a Kullback-Leibler divergence (KLD)-based metric, which enables the formulation of explicit anonymity constraints in the precoder design.We then propose an anonymous symbol-level precoding strategy that preserves reliable communication under spatial multiplexing while preventing transmitter identification. The proposed framework employs a partitioned equal-gain combining (P-EGC) scheme that leverages receiver diversity without requiring transmitter-specific CSI. Simulation results demonstrate anonymity-reliability tradeoffs across different signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) and numbers of data streams. Moreover, the results reveal opposite trends of anonymity with respect to transmitter-dependent noise variations in the low-SNR and high-SNR regimes.
comment: This paper has been submitted for possible journal publication

AI.title_translation: 物理层匿名通信的符号感知预编码器设计
AI.tldr: 研究物理层匿名通信，提出一种符号级预编码策略，通过KLD度量匿名性，在空间复用下实现可靠通信并防止发射机识别，展示了匿名性-可靠性权衡。
AI.motivation: 物理层特性（如信道状态信息和硬件缺陷引起的噪声）通常与发射机唯一关联，可能导致接收机推断发射机身份。本文旨在解决在确保可靠通信的同时，防止接收机通过信号推断发射机身份的匿名通信问题。
AI.method: 使用基于Kullback-Leibler散度（KLD）的度量量化发射机匿名性，并将其纳入预编码器设计以制定明确的匿名性约束。提出一种匿名的符号级预编码策略，并在空间复用下结合分区等增益合并（P-EGC）方案，利用接收机分集且无需发射机特定CSI，以保持可靠通信并防止发射机识别。
AI.result: 模拟结果揭示了在不同信噪比（SNR）和数据流数量下的匿名性-可靠性权衡。此外，结果表明在低信噪比和高信噪比区域，匿名性与发射机相关噪声变化呈现相反的趋势。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功设计了一种符号感知的预编码器，实现了物理层匿名通信，并在可靠性和匿名性之间取得了平衡。研究揭示了在不同信噪比条件下，匿名性与发射机相关噪声的复杂关系。
AI.translation: 物理层特性，例如信道状态信息（CSI）和硬件缺陷引起的发射机噪声，通常与发射机唯一关联。本文从信号设计的角度研究物理层发射机匿名性。我们考虑一个匿名通信问题，其中接收机应可靠地解码来自发射机的信号，但不应利用该信号推断发射机的身份。发射机匿名性使用基于Kullback-Leibler散度（KLD）的度量进行量化，这使得在预编码器设计中能够制定明确的匿名性约束。然后，我们提出了一种匿名的符号级预编码策略，该策略在空间复用下保持可靠通信，同时防止发射机识别。所提出的框架采用分区等增益合并（P-EGC）方案，该方案利用接收机分集而无需发射机特定的CSI。仿真结果表明了在不同信噪比（SNR）和数据流数量下的匿名性-可靠性权衡。此外，结果揭示了在低信噪比和高信噪比区域，匿名性与发射机相关噪声变化呈现相反的趋势。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨物理层匿名通信，旨在使接收机在可靠解码信号的同时，无法推断发射机身份。论文通过基于Kullback-Leibler散度（KLD）的度量量化匿名性，并将其纳入预编码器设计。提出了一种符号级预编码策略，结合分区等增益合并（P-EGC）方案，在空间复用下实现可靠通信和匿名性，且无需发射机特定CSI。模拟结果展示了匿名性与可靠性之间的权衡，并揭示了匿名性与发射机相关噪声在不同信噪比条件下的相反趋势。
AI.keywords: 物理层匿名通信, 符号感知预编码, Kullback-Leibler散度, 分区等增益合并, 匿名性-可靠性权衡
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的符号感知预编码器设计，以解决物理层匿名通信中的关键挑战。其创新之处在于利用KLD度量量化匿名性，并将其融入预编码设计中，同时结合P-EGC方案避免对发射机特定CSI的需求。这对于隐私保护至关重要的无线通信系统具有重要意义。

title: Some Simple Economics of AGI
comments: JEL Classification: D82, D83, J23, J24, L23, O33. 112 pages, 3 figures
summary: For millennia, human cognition was the primary engine of progress on Earth. As AI decouples cognition from biology, the marginal cost of measurable execution falls to zero, absorbing any labor capturable by metrics--including creative, analytical, and innovative work. The binding constraint on growth is no longer intelligence but human verification bandwidth: the capacity to validate, audit, and underwrite responsibility when execution is abundant. We model the AGI transition as the collision of two racing cost curves: an exponentially decaying Cost to Automate and a biologically bottlenecked Cost to Verify. This structural asymmetry widens a Measurability Gap between what agents can execute and what humans can afford to verify. It also drives a shift from skill-biased to measurability-biased technical change. Rents migrate to verification-grade ground truth, cryptographic provenance, and liability underwriting--the ability to insure outcomes rather than merely generate them. The current human-in-the-loop equilibrium is unstable: eroded from below as apprenticeship collapses (Missing Junior Loop) and from within as experts codify their obsolescence (Codifier's Curse). Unverified deployment becomes privately rational--a Trojan Horse externality. Unmanaged, these forces pull toward a Hollow Economy. Yet by scaling verification alongside agentic capabilities, the forces that threaten collapse become the catalyst for unbounded discovery and experimentation--an Augmented Economy. We derive a practical playbook for individuals, companies, investors, and policymakers. Today's defining challenge is not the race to deploy the most autonomous systems; it is the race to secure the foundations of their oversight. Only by scaling our bandwidth for verification alongside our capacity for execution can we ensure that the intelligence we have summoned preserves the humanity that initiated it.

AI.title_translation: AGI的一些简单经济学
AI.tldr: 随着AGI使认知与生物学分离，执行的边际成本趋近于零，导致劳动力被吸收。增长的瓶颈从智能转向人类验证带宽。论文分析了自动化成本和验证成本的碰撞，揭示了可衡量性差距，并提出通过同步扩展验证能力来避免“空心经济”并实现“增强经济”。
AI.motivation: 随着AI将认知与生物学分离，可衡量执行的边际成本趋于零，这吸收了所有可被指标捕获的劳动力，包括创造性、分析性和创新性工作。这导致增长的限制不再是智能，而是人类验证带宽。本文旨在探讨这种转变的经济影响，并为应对挑战提供策略。
AI.method: 本文将AGI转型建模为两条竞争成本曲线的碰撞：呈指数衰减的自动化成本和受生物学限制的验证成本。通过分析这种结构不对称性，推导了对个人、公司、投资者和政策制定者的实用策略。
AI.result: 结构不对称性扩大了智能体可以执行而人类可以负担验证之间的“可衡量性差距”。这推动了从技能偏向到可测量性偏向的技术变革。租金转移到验证级基本事实、加密溯源和责任承保。当前的人机循环平衡是不稳定的，未经验证的部署会产生特洛伊木马式外部性，导致“空心经济”。
AI.conclusion: 今天的核心挑战不是部署最自主的系统，而是确保其监督的基础。只有通过在扩展执行能力的同时扩展验证带宽，才能确保所召唤的智能保留了启动它的人性。通过同步扩展验证能力，可以避免“空心经济”并实现“增强经济”。
AI.translation: 几千年来，人类认知一直是地球进步的主要引擎。随着人工智能将认知与生物学分离，可衡量执行的边际成本趋于零，吸收了所有可被指标捕获的劳动力——包括创造性、分析性和创新性工作。增长的限制不再是智能，而是人类验证带宽：当执行能力充裕时，验证、审计和承担责任的能力。我们将AGI转型建模为两条竞争成本曲线的碰撞：呈指数衰减的自动化成本和受生物学限制的验证成本。这种结构不对称性扩大了智能体可以执行而人类可以负担验证之间的“可衡量性差距”。它还推动了从技能偏向到可测量性偏向的技术变革。租金转移到验证级基本事实、加密溯源和责任承保——即保障结果而非仅仅生成结果的能力。当前的人机循环平衡是不稳定的：学徒制崩溃（缺失的初级循环）从下方侵蚀，专家将自身过时化（编码者的诅咒）从内部侵蚀。未经验证的部署在私人层面变得理性——一种特洛伊木马式外部性。如果管理不当，这些力量将导致“空心经济”。然而，通过在扩展智能体能力的同时扩展验证能力，那些威胁崩溃的力量将成为无限发现和实验的催化剂——一个“增强经济”。我们为个人、公司、投资者和政策制定者推导了一套实用的策略。当今的决定性挑战不是部署最自主系统的竞赛；而是确保其监督基础的竞赛。只有通过在扩展执行能力的同时扩展验证带宽，我们才能确保所召唤的智能保留了启动它的人性。

title: Training-Free Intelligibility-Guided Observation Addition for Noisy ASR
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) degrades severely in noisy environments. Although speech enhancement (SE) front-ends effectively suppress background noise, they often introduce artifacts that harm recognition. Observation addition (OA) addressed this issue by fusing noisy and SE enhanced speech, improving recognition without modifying the parameters of the SE or ASR models. This paper proposes an intelligibility-guided OA method, where fusion weights are derived from intelligibility estimates obtained directly from the backend ASR. Unlike prior OA methods based on trained neural predictors, the proposed method is training-free, reducing complexity and enhances generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse SE-ASR combinations and datasets demonstrate strong robustness and improvements over existing OA baselines. Additional analyses of intelligibility-guided switching-based alternatives and frame versus utterance-level OA further validate the proposed design.

AI.title_translation: 用于嘈杂ASR的免训练可懂度引导观测添加
AI.tldr: 提出了一种免训练的可懂度引导观测添加方法，通过融合原始噪声语音和增强语音，利用后端ASR的可懂度估计来确定融合权重，有效改善了嘈杂环境下的ASR性能，且无需训练，复杂度低，泛化性强。
AI.motivation: 嘈杂环境下的自动语音识别（ASR）性能严重下降。语音增强（SE）虽然能有效抑制背景噪声，但通常会引入损害识别的伪影。现有的观测添加（OA）方法融合了噪声和增强语音，但通常依赖于经过训练的神经网络预测器。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种可懂度引导的观测添加（OA）方法。该方法直接从后端ASR获取可懂度估计，并以此来推导融合权重。与以往基于训练神经网络预测器的OA方法不同，此方法是免训练的，从而降低了复杂度并增强了泛化能力。
AI.result: 在不同的SE-ASR组合和数据集上进行了广泛实验，结果表明该方法具有强大的鲁棒性，并优于现有的OA基线。对基于可懂度引导的切换替代方案以及帧级与话语级OA的额外分析进一步验证了所提出的设计。
AI.conclusion: 该免训练的可懂度引导观测添加方法有效降低了复杂度并增强了泛化能力，能够显著改善嘈杂环境下的ASR性能。
AI.translation: 自动语音识别（ASR）在嘈杂环境中性能严重下降。尽管语音增强（SE）前端能有效抑制背景噪声，但它们通常会引入损害识别的伪影。观测添加（OA）通过融合噪声和SE增强语音来解决这个问题，在不修改SE或ASR模型参数的情况下改善了识别。本文提出了一种可懂度引导的OA方法，其中融合权重直接从后端ASR获得的可懂度估计中得出。与以前基于训练神经网络预测器的OA方法不同，所提出的方法是免训练的，降低了复杂度并增强了泛化能力。在不同的SE-ASR组合和数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法具有强大的鲁棒性，并优于现有的OA基线。对基于可懂度引导的切换替代方案以及帧级与话语级OA的额外分析进一步验证了所提出的设计。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的免训练可懂度引导观测添加（OA）方法，旨在改善嘈杂环境下的ASR性能。该方法通过将原始噪声语音和语音增强后的语音进行融合，并利用后端ASR直接提供的可懂度估计来动态确定融合权重。与依赖训练预测器的传统OA方法不同，本方法无需训练，从而降低了复杂性并提高了泛化能力。实验结果证实了其在多种SE-ASR配置和数据集上的鲁棒性和优越性。
AI.keywords: 自动语音识别, 语音增强, 观测添加, 可懂度引导, 免训练
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个免训练的可懂度引导观测添加方法。通过直接利用后端ASR的可懂度估计来确定融合权重，避免了传统OA方法中训练预测器的复杂性，提高了方法的泛化能力和实用性，对于实际应用具有重要意义。

title: Cell-Free Massive MIMO-Assisted SWIPT Using Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces
summary: This study explores a next-generation multiple access (NGMA) framework for cell-free massive MIMO (CF-mMIMO) systems enhanced by stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIMs), aiming to improve simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) performance. A fundamental challenge lies in optimally selecting the operating modes of access points (APs) to jointly maximize the received energy and satisfy spectral efficiency (SE) quality-of-service constraints. Practical system impairments, including a non-linear harvested energy model, pilot contamination (PC), channel estimation errors, and reliance on long-term statistical channel state information (CSI), are considered. We derive closed-form expressions for both the achievable SE and the average sum harvested energy (sum-HE). A mixed-integer non-convex optimization problem is formulated to jointly optimize the SIM phase shifts, APs mode selection, and power allocation to maximize average sum-HE under SE and average harvested energy constraints. To solve this problem, we propose a centralized training, decentralized execution (CTDE) framework based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL), which efficiently handles high-dimensional decision spaces. A Markovian environment and a normalized joint reward function are introduced to enhance the training stability across on-policy and off-policy DRL algorithms. Additionally, we provide a two-phase convex-based solution as a theoretical robust performance. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed DRL-based CTDE framework achieves SWIPT performance comparable to convexification-based solution, while significantly outperforming baselines.

AI.title_translation: 无蜂窝大规模MIMO辅助的基于堆叠智能超表面的SWIPT
AI.tldr: 本研究探索了基于堆叠智能超表面（SIMs）增强的无蜂窝大规模MIMO（CF-mMIMO）系统中的下一代多址（NGMA）框架，以改善同步无线信息和功率传输（SWIPT）性能。主要挑战是优化接入点（AP）的操作模式，同时最大化接收能量并满足频谱效率（SE）服务质量约束。研究考虑了非线性能量收集模型、导频污染、信道估计误差和长期统计信道状态信息等实际系统缺陷。推导了可实现SE和平均总收集能量的闭式表达式。提出了一个混合整数非凸优化问题，以联合优化SIM相移、AP模式选择和功率分配，从而在SE和平均收集能量约束下最大化平均总收集能量。为了解决这个问题，研究提出了一个基于深度强化学习（DRL）的集中训练、去中心化执行（CTDE）框架。数值结果表明，所提出的DRL-based CTDE框架实现了与基于凸化的解决方案相当的SWIPT性能，并且显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 本研究旨在探索一个基于堆叠智能超表面（SIMs）增强的无蜂窝大规模MIMO（CF-mMIMO）系统中的下一代多址（NGMA）框架，以改善同步无线信息和功率传输（SWIPT）性能。其主要动机是解决在实际系统缺陷下，如何优化接入点（AP）的操作模式选择，以共同最大化接收能量并满足频谱效率（SE）服务质量约束这一根本性挑战。
AI.method:
1. 探索了一个基于SIMs增强的CF-mMIMO NGMA框架，旨在改善SWIPT性能。
2. 考虑了包括非线性能量收集模型、导频污染、信道估计误差和长期统计CSI在内的实际系统缺陷。
3. 推导了可实现SE和平均总收集能量的闭式表达式。
4. 提出了一个混合整数非凸优化问题，以联合优化SIM相移、AP模式选择和功率分配，从而在SE和平均收集能量约束下最大化平均总收集能量。
5. 为解决该优化问题，提出了一个基于深度强化学习（DRL）的集中训练、去中心化执行（CTDE）框架，并引入了马尔可夫环境和归一化联合奖励函数以增强训练稳定性。
6. 提供了一个两阶段基于凸化的解决方案作为理论上的稳健性能参考。
AI.result:
1. 推导了可实现频谱效率（SE）和平均总收集能量（sum-HE）的闭式表达式。
2. 所提出的基于深度强化学习（DRL）的集中训练、去中心化执行（CTDE）框架能够高效处理高维决策空间。
3. 数值结果表明，该DRL-based CTDE框架实现的SWIPT性能与基于凸化的解决方案相当。
4. 该框架显著优于现有的基线方案。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的基于深度强化学习（DRL）的集中训练、去中心化执行（CTDE）框架，在无蜂窝大规模MIMO系统中，通过堆叠智能超表面（SIMs）辅助的同步无线信息和功率传输（SWIPT）场景下，能够有效解决复杂的资源优化问题。在考虑实际系统缺陷的情况下，该框架在性能上达到了与理论凸化解决方案相当的水平，并显著优于传统基线方案，证明了其在未来无线通信系统中的潜力和实用性。

AI.summary: 本文研究了在无蜂窝大规模MIMO（CF-mMIMO）系统中，利用堆叠智能超表面（SIMs）增强同步无线信息和功率传输（SWIPT）的性能。面对优化AP模式选择以最大化接收能量和满足频谱效率（SE）约束的挑战，并考虑了非线性能量收集模型、导频污染等实际系统缺陷。研究推导了SE和平均总收集能量的闭式表达式，并提出了一个混合整数非凸优化问题。为解决此问题，开发了一个基于深度强化学习（DRL）的集中训练、去中心化执行（CTDE）框架，通过引入马尔可夫环境和归一化奖励函数来提高训练稳定性。数值结果表明，该DRL-based CTDE框架在SWIPT性能上与基于凸化的解决方案相当，并显著优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 无蜂窝大规模MIMO, 堆叠智能超表面, SWIPT, 深度强化学习, 资源分配
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将堆叠智能超表面（SIMs）引入到无蜂窝大规模MIMO系统中，以提升SWIPT性能，并有效解决了在实际系统缺陷下的复杂优化问题。特别是通过提出基于深度强化学习（DRL）的集中训练、去中心化执行（CTDE）框架来处理高维决策空间和非凸优化问题，展现了DRL在无线通信资源管理中的强大潜力。其性能与理论上的凸化解决方案相当，证明了该方法的有效性和实用性。

title: Asymptotics of solutions to the linear search problem
summary: The exact leading asymptotics of solutions to the symmetric linear search problem are obtained for any positive probability density on the real line with a monotonic, sufficiently regular tail. A similar result holds for densities on a compact interval.

AI.comments: 本文提供了一个关于线性搜索问题解渐近性的精确数学结果，这对于理解此类问题的理论行为具有重要意义。然而，抽象中未提及具体方法和潜在应用。

title: Multimodal MRI Report Findings Supervised Brain Lesion Segmentation with Substructures
comments: IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI) 2026
summary: Report-supervised (RSuper) learning seeks to alleviate the need for dense tumor voxel labels with constraints derived from radiology reports (e.g., volumes, counts, sizes, locations). In MRI studies of brain tumors, however, we often involve multi-parametric scans and substructures. Here, fine-grained modality/parameter-wise reports are usually provided along with global findings and are correlated with different substructures. Moreover, the reports often describe only the largest lesion and provide qualitative or uncertain cues (``mild,'' ``possible''). Classical RSuper losses (e.g., sum volume consistency) can over-constrain or hallucinate unreported findings under such incompleteness, and are unable to utilize these hierarchical findings or exploit the priors of varied lesion types in a merged dataset. We explicitly parse the global quantitative and modality-wise qualitative findings and introduce a unified, one-sided, uncertainty-aware formulation (MS-RSuper) that: (i) aligns modality-specific qualitative cues (e.g., T1c enhancement, FLAIR edema) with their corresponding substructures using existence and absence losses; (ii) enforces one-sided lower-bounds for partial quantitative cues (e.g., largest lesion size, minimal multiplicity); and (iii) adds extra- vs. intra-axial anatomical priors to respect cohort differences. Certainty tokens scale penalties; missing cues are down-weighted. On 1238 report-labeled BraTS-MET/MEN scans, our MS-RSuper largely outperforms both a sparsely-supervised baseline and a naive RSuper method.
