title: Learning to Control Unknown Strongly Monotone Games
comments: Accepted for publication at IEEE Transactions on Control of Network Systems (TCNS)
summary: Consider a strongly monotone game where the players' utility functions include a reward function and a linear term for each dimension, with coefficients that are controlled by the manager. Gradient play converges to a unique Nash equilibrium (NE) that does not optimize the global objective. The global performance at NE can be improved by imposing linear constraints on the NE, also known as a generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE). We therefore want the manager to control the coefficients such that they impose the desired constraint on the NE. However, this requires knowing the players' rewards and action sets. Obtaining this game information is infeasible in a large-scale network and violates user privacy. To overcome this, we propose a simple algorithm that learns to shift the NE to meet the linear constraints by adjusting the controlled coefficients online. Our algorithm only requires the linear constraints violation as feedback and does not need to know the reward functions or the action sets. We prove that our algorithm converges with probability 1 to the set of GNE given by coupled linear constraints. We then prove an L2 convergence rate of near-$O(t^{-1/4})$.
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE Transactions on Control of Network Systems (TCNS)

AI.title_translation: 学习控制未知强单调博弈
AI.tldr: 提出一种无需知道玩家奖励与动作集的在线算法，通过调节控制系数使纳什均衡满足线性约束，实现全局目标优化。
AI.motivation: 强单调博弈中梯度玩法收敛到的纳什均衡无法优化全局目标，而调整线性系数可施加约束提升性能，但大规模网络下获取玩家信息不可行且侵犯隐私。
AI.method: 设计仅依赖约束违反反馈的在线学习算法，通过迭代调整控制系数，将纳什均衡推向满足线性约束的广义纳什均衡。
AI.result: 算法以概率1收敛到满足耦合线性约束的广义纳什均衡集，并获得近O(t^{-1/4})的L2收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: 无需知晓奖励函数或动作集即可在线学习控制系数，使系统收敛至期望约束下的均衡，兼顾隐私与可扩展性。
AI.translation: 考虑一个强单调博弈，其中玩家的效用函数包含奖励函数和管理者控制的各维度线性项系数。梯度玩法收敛到不优化全局目标的唯一纳什均衡（NE）。通过在NE上施加线性约束（即广义纳什均衡GNE）可改善NE处的全局性能。因此希望管理者控制系数以在NE上施加所需约束，但这需要知道玩家的奖励和动作集，在大规模网络中不可行且侵犯隐私。为此提出一种简单算法，仅利用线性约束违反作为反馈在线调整控制系数，无需知道奖励函数或动作集，即可学习将NE移至满足线性约束。证明算法以概率1收敛到由耦合线性约束给出的GNE集，并获得近O(t^{-1/4})的L2收敛速率。
AI.summary: 本文研究强单调博弈中管理者在无法获知玩家奖励与动作集的前提下，如何通过在线调节控制系数，使纳什均衡满足线性约束以优化全局性能。提出仅需约束违反反馈的算法，证明其几乎必然收敛至广义纳什均衡并获得收敛速率保证。
AI.keywords: 强单调博弈；纳什均衡；广义纳什均衡；在线学习；约束优化；隐私保护
AI.comments: 摘要清晰展示了问题、挑战与贡献，但缺少与基线方法的数值对比及实际应用场景描述。

title: Coherent and Multi-modality Image Inpainting via Latent Space Optimization
summary: With the advancements in denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs), image inpainting has significantly evolved from merely filling information based on nearby regions to generating content conditioned on various prompts such as text, exemplar images, and sketches. However, existing methods, such as model fine-tuning and simple concatenation of latent vectors, often result in generation failures due to overfitting and inconsistency between the inpainted region and the background. In this paper, we argue that the current large diffusion models are sufficiently powerful to generate realistic images without further tuning. Hence, we introduce PILOT (in\textbf{P}ainting v\textbf{I}a \textbf{L}atent \textbf{O}p\textbf{T}imization), an optimization approach grounded on a novel \textit{semantic centralization} and \textit{background preservation loss}. Our method searches latent spaces capable of generating inpainted regions that exhibit high fidelity to user-provided prompts while maintaining coherence with the background. Furthermore, we propose a strategy to balance optimization expense and image quality, significantly enhancing generation efficiency. Our method seamlessly integrates with any pre-trained model, including ControlNet and DreamBooth, making it suitable for deployment in multi-modal editing tools. Our qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate that PILOT outperforms existing approaches by generating more coherent, diverse, and faithful inpainted regions in response to provided prompts.

AI.title_translation: 基于潜空间优化的连贯多模态图像修复
AI.tldr: 提出PILOT，一种无需微调、通过潜空间优化与语义中心化损失实现高保真背景一致图像修复的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于DDPM的修复方法因微调或简单拼接导致过拟合与前景背景不一致，需利用大扩散模型固有生成能力实现免调优高质量修复。
AI.method: 构建PILOT框架，设计语义中心化与背景保持损失，在潜空间搜索满足提示且背景一致的隐码，并引入优化-质量权衡策略。
AI.result: PILOT无需重训练即可与ControlNet/DreamBoth等模型结合，在定性与定量指标上均优于现有方法，生成更连贯、多样且忠实的修复区域。
AI.conclusion: 大扩散模型无需微调即可通过潜空间优化实现高质量多模态修复，PILOT为通用高效工具部署提供新思路。
AI.translation: 随着去噪扩散概率模型的发展，图像修复已从局部填充演进为基于文本、样图与草图等多提示生成内容。然而微调或简单拼接常因过拟合与前后景不一致导致失败。本文认为现有大扩散模型已足够强大，无需再训练。为此提出PILOT（潜空间优化修复），基于语义中心化与背景保持损失在潜空间搜索兼顾提示保真与背景一致的隐码，并平衡优化开销与质量，可无缝接入ControlNet与DreamBooth，实验表明其生成区域更连贯、多样且忠实。
AI.summary: PILOT利用大扩散模型固有能力，通过潜空间优化与新颖损失实现免微调高质量多模态图像修复，兼顾效率与泛化。
AI.keywords: 图像修复; 去噪扩散模型; 潜空间优化; 语义中心化; 背景保持; 多模态生成; 免微调
AI.comments: 未提及代码是否开源、优化耗时具体数值及用户提示交互细节。

title: Rethinking Disentanglement under Dependent Factors of Variation
summary: Representation learning is an approach that allows to discover and extract the factors of variation from the data. Intuitively, a representation is said to be disentangled if it separates the different factors of variation in a way that is understandable to humans. Definitions of disentanglement and metrics to measure it usually assume that the factors of variation are independent of each other. However, this is generally false in the real world, which limits the use of these definitions and metrics to very specific and unrealistic scenarios. In this paper we give a definition of disentanglement based on information theory that is also valid when the factors of variation are not independent. Furthermore, we relate this definition to the Information Bottleneck Method. Finally, we propose a method to measure the degree of disentanglement from the given definition that works when the factors of variation are not independent. We show through different experiments that the method proposed in this paper correctly measures disentanglement with non-independent factors of variation, while other methods fail in this scenario.

AI.title_translation: 重思依赖变化因子下的解耦表征
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种信息论框架下的解耦定义及度量，适用于真实世界中彼此依赖的变化因子，并通过实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统解耦定义与度量均假设变化因子独立，而现实中因子常相关，导致现有方法失效，需要新的理论框架。
AI.method: 基于信息论重新定义解耦，并将其与信息瓶颈方法关联；提出可处理因子依赖的解耦度量算法。
AI.result: 所提度量在非独立因子场景下仍能准确评估解耦程度，而传统方法在此场景下失败。
AI.conclusion: 新定义与度量扩展了解耦表征的适用范围，使其在真实依赖数据上仍具可操作性。
AI.translation: 表征学习旨在从数据中提取变化因子。直观上，若表征以人类可理解方式分离各因子，则称其解耦。现有定义与度量通常假设因子独立，但这在真实世界极少成立，限制了其实用性。本文提出基于信息论的解耦定义，适用于因子依赖情形，并将其与信息瓶颈方法关联。最后，我们提出对应度量方法，在因子不独立时仍可评估解耦程度。实验表明，本文方法在非独立因子下准确度量解耦，而其他方法在此场景失效。
AI.summary: 针对传统解耦方法假设因子独立而现实常依赖的问题，作者提出信息论框架下的新定义与度量，关联信息瓶颈原理，实验证明其在依赖因子场景下优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 解耦表征，信息论，信息瓶颈，因子依赖，表征学习
AI.comments: 摘要未提及代码是否开源、计算复杂度及高维数据扩展性。

title: RegTrack: Simplicity Beneath Complexity in Robust Multi-Modal 3D Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Existing 3D multi-object tracking (MOT) methods often sacrifice efficiency and generalizability for robustness, largely relying on complex association metrics derived from multi-modal architectures and class-specific motion priors. Challenging the rooted belief that greater complexity necessarily yields greater robustness, we propose a robust, efficient, and generalizable method for multi-modal 3D MOT, dubbed RegTrack. Inspired by Yang-Mills gauge theory, RegTrack is built upon a unified tri-cue encoder (UTEnc), comprising three tightly coupled components: a local-global point cloud encoder (LG-PEnc), a mixture-of-experts-based geometry encoder (MoE-GEnc), and an image encoder from a well-pretrained visual-language model. LG-PEnc efficiently encodes the spatial and structural information of point clouds to produce foundational representations for each object, whose pairwise similarities serve as the sole association metric. MoE-GEnc seamlessly interacts with LG-PEnc to model inter-object geometric relationships across frames, adaptively compensating for inter-frame object motion without relying on any class-specific priors. The image encoder is kept frozen and is used exclusively during training to provide a well-pretrained representation space. Point cloud representations are aligned to this space to supervise the motion compensation process, encouraging representation invariance across frames for the same object while enhancing discriminability among different objects. Through this formulation, RegTrack attains robust, efficient, and generalizable inference using only point cloud inputs, requiring just 2.6M parameters. Extensive experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show that RegTrack outperforms its thirty-five competitors.

AI.title_translation: RegTrack：鲁棒多模态三维多目标跟踪中的简约与复杂之下的简洁性
AI.tldr: RegTrack是一种鲁棒、高效、通用的多模态3D多目标跟踪方法，仅依赖点云输入和轻量化参数实现高精度跟踪，无需复杂关联指标或类别特定运动先验。
AI.motivation: 现有3D多目标跟踪方法常因依赖多模态架构和类别特定运动先验而牺牲效率和泛化能力。本文旨在挑战“复杂度越高鲁棒性越强”的固有观念，提出一种更简洁的解决方案。
AI.method: 受杨-米尔斯规范理论启发，RegTrack基于统一三元线索编码器（UTEnc）构建，包括局部-全局点云编码器（LG-PEnc）、基于专家混合的几何编码器（MoE-GEnc）和冻结的预训练视觉-语言模型图像编码器。LG-PEnc生成对象基础表示，其成对相似性作为唯一关联指标；MoE-GEnc建模帧间几何关系以自适应补偿运动；图像编码器仅在训练中提供表示空间以监督运动补偿过程。
AI.result: RegTrack仅需点云输入和260万个参数，在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，其性能优于35个竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: RegTrack通过简洁的设计实现了鲁棒、高效和通用的3D多目标跟踪，无需复杂关联指标或类别特定先验，验证了简单性在复杂任务中的有效性。
AI.translation: RegTrack：鲁棒多模态三维多目标跟踪中的简约与复杂之下的简洁性
AI.summary: 本文提出RegTrack，一种基于统一三元线索编码器的多模态3D多目标跟踪方法，通过点云编码生成对象表示作为关联指标，结合几何编码器自适应补偿运动，并利用冻结的图像编码器在训练中提供表示监督。该方法仅需点云输入和轻量化参数，在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上超越现有方法，证明了简洁设计在保持鲁棒性和泛化能力方面的优势。
AI.keywords: 三维多目标跟踪, 多模态, 点云编码, 几何关系, 鲁棒性, 高效性, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 论文创新性地将杨-米尔斯规范理论思想引入3D跟踪，简化了关联过程并去除了类别特定先验依赖，但未讨论实时性能或计算资源消耗的具体数据。

title: DiSPo: Diffusion-SSM based Policy Learning for Coarse-to-Fine Action Discretization
summary: We aim to solve the problem of generating coarse-to-fine skills learning from demonstrations (LfD). To scale precision, traditional LfD approaches often rely on extensive fine-grained demonstrations with external interpolations or dynamics models with limited generalization capabilities. For memory-efficient learning and convenient granularity change, we propose a novel diffusion-state space model (SSM) based policy (DiSPo) that learns from diverse coarse skills and produces varying control scales of actions by leveraging an SSM, Mamba. Our evaluations show the adoption of Mamba and the proposed step-scaling method enable DiSPo to outperform in three coarse-to-fine benchmark tests with maximum 81% higher success rate than baselines. In addition, DiSPo improves inference efficiency by generating coarse motions in less critical regions. We finally demonstrate the scalability of actions with simulation and real-world manipulation tasks. Code and Videos are available at https://robo-dispo.github.io.

AI.title_translation: DiSPo：基于扩散-状态空间模型的策略学习用于粗到细动作离散化
AI.tldr: DiSPo 利用扩散-状态空间模型（Mamba）从粗粒度示范中学习，可按需输出不同精度的动作，在粗到细技能学习任务中成功率最高提升81%，并提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 传统从示范中学习（LfD）方法要获得高精度需大量细粒度示范或依赖泛化能力有限的外部插值/动力学模型，亟需一种内存高效且可灵活改变粒度的方法。
AI.method: 提出基于扩散-状态空间模型的策略 DiSPo，用 Mamba 架构从多样粗技能示范中学习，并通过步长缩放机制实现不同控制尺度的动作生成。
AI.result: 在三个粗到细基准测试中，DiSPo 成功率比基线最高提升 81%；能在非关键区域先产生粗运动，提高推理效率；在仿真与真实操作任务中验证了动作可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: DiSPo 通过结合 Mamba 与步长缩放，实现了从粗示范到多精度动作的高效生成，兼具高成功率与推理效率，适用于仿真与真实机器人操纵任务。
AI.translation: 我们旨在解决从示范中生成粗到细技能的问题。为提升精度，传统 LfD 需大量细粒度示范或泛化有限的动力学模型。为此，提出基于扩散-状态空间模型的策略 DiSPo，用 Mamba 从粗技能学习并输出不同控制尺度动作。实验表明 DiSPo 在三个基准测试中成功率最高提升 81%，并在非关键区域生成粗运动以提升推理效率。仿真与真实任务验证了其动作可扩展性。代码与视频见官网。
AI.summary: DiSPo 将扩散模型与状态空间模型 Mamba 结合，实现从粗示范到多精度动作的策略学习。通过步长缩放机制，DiSPo 在粗到细任务中显著超越基线，提升推理效率，并在仿真与真实机器人实验中验证可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 粗到细技能学习；从示范中学习；扩散模型；状态空间模型；Mamba；动作离散化；策略学习
AI.comments: 摘要未提及网络结构细节、训练数据量、计算资源消耗及失败案例分析；真实实验仅提及“演示”而无具体对象与数量。

title: Minibatch Optimal Transport and Perplexity Bound Estimation in Discrete Flow Matching
summary: Discrete flow matching, a recent framework for modeling categorical data, has shown competitive performance with autoregressive models. However, unlike continuous flow matching, the rectification strategy cannot be applied due to the stochasticity of discrete paths, necessitating alternative methods to minimize state transitions. We propose a dynamic-optimal-transport-like minimization objective and derive its Kantorovich formulation for discrete flows with convex interpolants, where transport cost depends solely on inter-state similarity and can be optimized via minibatch strategies. We show that such methods can reduce the number of transitions up to 32 times (1024 to 32) to reach the same generative perplexity without compromising diversity. Additionally, path nondeterminism in discrete flows precludes an instantaneous change-of-variables analogue, preventing precise probability estimation available to continuous flows. We therefore propose two upper bounds on perplexity, enabling principled training, evaluation and model comparison. Finally, we introduce Multimask Flows which outperform masked flows in generative perplexity without compromising diversity, particularly when utilizing minibatch Optimal Transport.

AI.title_translation: 小批量最优传输与离散流匹配中的困惑度界估计
AI.tldr: 提出小批量最优传输目标来减少离散流匹配的状态转移次数，并给出困惑度上界，新Multimask Flows在保持多样性的同时显著降低生成困惑度。
AI.motivation: 离散流匹配因路径随机性无法使用连续流的矫正策略，需减少状态转移次数，同时缺乏连续流的可逆性导致无法精确估计概率，需要可比较的困惑度度量。
AI.method: 1) 设计类动态最优传输的凸插值目标，导出其Kantorovich形式，仅依赖状态间相似度；2) 用小批量策略优化该目标；3) 提出两个困惑度上界；4) 引入Multimask Flows结构。
AI.result: 状态转移次数减少32倍（1024→32）即可达到相同生成困惑度，Multimask Flows在保持多样性的同时优于masked flows。
AI.conclusion: 小批量最优传输显著降低离散流匹配的路径成本，Multimask Flows结合该策略提升生成质量，提出的困惑度上界支持有原则的模型训练与比较。
AI.translation: 离散流匹配是一种用于建模分类数据的新框架，性能与自回归模型相当。然而，其离散路径的随机性使得无法应用连续流匹配的矫正策略，因此需要替代方法来最小化状态转移。我们提出类似动态最优传输的极小化目标，并为带凸插值的离散流推导其Kantorovich形式，其中传输代价仅依赖状态间相似度，可通过小批量策略优化。实验表明，该方法可将转移次数减少32倍（1024降至32）而保持相同生成困惑度，且不损失多样性。此外，离散流的路径不确定性使其无法获得连续流的瞬时变量变换公式，从而无法精确估计概率。为此，我们提出两个困惑度上界，实现有原则的训练、评估与模型比较。最后，我们引入Multimask Flows，在利用小批量最优传输时，其生成困惑度优于masked flows且保持多样性。
AI.summary: 针对离散流匹配路径随机性问题，提出小批量最优传输目标减少状态转移，并给出困惑度上界以支持训练与评估。Multimask Flows结构进一步提升生成性能。
AI.keywords: 离散流匹配,小批量最优传输,困惑度上界,状态转移,Multimask Flows,生成建模
AI.comments: 方法创新在于将最优传输引入离散流匹配并给出可计算的上界，实验显示巨大的转移次数压缩比，未来可探索更大规模数据与更紧的概率估计。

title: Two Models for Surface Segmentation using the Total Variation of the Normal Vector
summary: We consider the problem of surface segmentation, where the goal is to partition a surface represented by a triangular mesh. The segmentation is based on the similarity of the normal vector field to a given set of label vectors. We propose a variational approach and compare two different regularizers, both based on a total variation measure. The first regularizer penalizes the total variation of the assignment function directly, while the second regularizer penalizes the total variation in the label space. In order to solve the resulting optimization problems, we use variations of the split Bregman (ADMM) iteration adapted to the problem at hand. While computationally more expensive, the second regularizer yields better results in our experiments. In particular it removes noise more reliably in regions of constant curvature. In order to mitigate the computational cost, we present a manifold Newton scheme for the most expensive subproblem, which is related to the Riemannian center of mass on a sphere. This significantly improves the computational cost.

AI.title_translation: 基于法向量总变差的两种曲面分割模型
AI.tldr: 提出两种基于法向量总变差测度的曲面分割变分模型，通过改进的ADMM与流形牛顿法优化，第二种模型在降噪与常曲率区域表现更优。
AI.motivation: 三角网格曲面分割需依据法向量场相似性进行区域划分，现有方法在保持特征与降噪方面仍需改进。
AI.method: 1.构建两种变分正则化模型：直接惩罚赋值函数总变差 vs. 在标签空间惩罚总变差；2.采用改进的split Bregman (ADMM) 迭代求解；3.对最耗时的黎曼质心子问题提出流形牛顿算法加速。
AI.result: 实验表明，第二种正则化在常曲率区域更可靠地去除噪声，分割质量更高，但计算成本更大。
AI.conclusion: 标签空间总变差正则化虽计算昂贵，却能显著提升分割与降噪效果，结合流形牛顿加速后可在一定程度上缓解计算负担。
AI.translation: 我们研究曲面分割问题，其目标是将由三角网格表示的曲面划分为若干区域，分割依据为法向量场与给定标签向量的相似度。我们提出变分方法，比较两种基于总变差测度的正则化：第一种直接惩罚赋值函数的总变差，第二种在标签空间惩罚总变差。为求解相应优化问题，我们采用针对问题改进的split Bregman (ADMM) 迭代。实验表明，第二种正则化在常曲率区域更可靠地去除噪声，虽计算更昂贵。为降低计算成本，我们对最昂贵的子问题提出流形牛顿算法，该子问题与球面上的黎曼质心相关，显著提升了计算效率。
AI.summary: 本文针对三角网格曲面分割，提出两种基于法向量总变差测度的变分模型，并通过改进ADMM与流形牛顿算法求解。实验显示，标签空间总变差正则化在常曲率区域降噪效果更佳，加速策略有效缓解其计算开销。
AI.keywords: 曲面分割，总变差，法向量，ADMM，流形牛顿法，黎曼质心，三角网格
AI.comments: 摘要清晰阐述两种正则化差异与优劣，但缺少具体数据集、量化指标及运行时间对比，后续可补充。

title: Predicting Subway Passenger Flows under Incident Situation with Causality
summary: In the context of rail transit operations, real-time passenger flow prediction is essential; however, most models primarily focus on normal conditions, with limited research addressing incident situations. There are several intrinsic challenges associated with prediction during incidents, such as a lack of interpretability and data scarcity. To address these challenges, we propose a two-stage method that separates predictions under normal conditions and the causal effects of incidents. First, a normal prediction model is trained using data from normal situations. Next, the synthetic control method is employed to identify the causal effects of incidents, combined with placebo tests to determine significant levels of these effects. The significant effects are then utilized to train a causal effect prediction model, which can forecast the impact of incidents based on features of the incidents and passenger flows. During the prediction phase, the results from both the normal situation model and the causal effect prediction model are integrated to generate final passenger flow predictions during incidents. Our approach is validated using real-world data, demonstrating improved accuracy. Furthermore, the two-stage methodology enhances interpretability. By analyzing the causal effect prediction model, we can identify key influencing factors related to the effects of incidents and gain insights into their underlying mechanisms. Our work can assist subway system managers in estimating passenger flow affected by incidents and enable them to take proactive measures. Additionally, it can deepen researchers' understanding of the impact of incidents on subway passenger flows.

AI.title_translation: 突发事件情境下地铁客流预测：基于因果推断
AI.tldr: 提出两阶段模型，先预测正常客流，再用合成控制法量化事件因果效应并训练效应预测模型，最终叠加得突发事件客流预测，兼顾精度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有客流预测多聚焦常态，突发事件下数据稀缺、预测不可解释，亟需能刻画事件因果效应且可解释的方法。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1)用常态数据训练基础预测模型；2)以合成控制法估计事件因果效应，经安慰剂检验筛得显著效应，训练因果效应预测模型；3)预测阶段将两模型结果叠加得突发事件客流。
AI.result: 真实数据验证显示，该方法在突发事件下预测精度提升，且通过因果效应模型可识别关键影响因素并揭示作用机制。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段因果方法有效提升突发事件客流预测精度与可解释性，助力运营方提前应对并深化对事件影响的理解。
AI.translation: 在轨道交通运营中，实时客流预测至关重要，但既有模型多针对常态，突发事件研究稀缺。其预测难点在于可解释性不足与数据稀缺。本文提出两阶段法：先以常态数据训练正常预测模型，再用合成控制法识别事件因果效应，结合安慰剂检验确定显著性；显著效应用于训练因果效应预测模型，可据事件及客流特征预测影响。预测时融合两模型结果生成突发事件客流。真实数据验证精度提升且增强可解释性，可辅助管理者预估受影响客流并主动应对，同时深化研究者对事件影响机制的认识。
AI.summary: 本文针对地铁突发事件客流预测难题，提出两阶段因果推断框架：先预测常态客流，再用合成控制法量化事件因果效应并训练效应模型，最终叠加输出突发事件预测。真实数据实验表明精度提升且模型可解释，为运营方提供决策支持。
AI.keywords: 地铁客流预测；突发事件；因果推断；合成控制法；两阶段模型
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体数据集、评估指标、实验规模及与基线模型的定量对比，亦未讨论计算复杂度与实时性。

title: Disturbance-Adaptive Data-Driven Predictive Control: Trading Comfort Violations for Savings in Building Climate Control
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology
summary: Model Predictive Control (MPC) has demonstrated significant potential in improving energy efficiency in building climate control, outperforming traditional controllers commonly used in modern building management systems. Among MPC variants, Data-driven Predictive Control (DPC) offers the advantage of modeling building dynamics directly from data, thereby substantially reducing commissioning efforts. However, inevitable model uncertainties and measurement noise can result in comfort violations, even with dedicated MPC setups. This paper introduces a Disturbance-Adaptive DPC (DAD-DPC) framework that ensures asymptotic satisfaction of predefined violation bounds without knowing the uncertainty and noise distributions. The framework employs a data-driven pipeline based on Willems' Fundamental Lemma and conformal prediction for application in building climate control. The proposed DAD-DPC framework was validated through four building cases using the high-fidelity BOPTEST simulation platform and an occupied campus building, Polydome. DAD-DPC successfully regulated the average comfort violations to meet pre-defined bounds. Notably, the 5%-violation DAD-DPC setup achieved 30.1%/11.2%/27.1%/20.5% energy savings compared to default controllers across four cases. These results demonstrate the framework's effectiveness in balancing energy consumption and comfort violations, offering a practical solution for building climate control applications.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology

AI.title_translation: 扰动自适应数据驱动预测控制：在建筑气候控制中以舒适度违换节能
AI.tldr: 提出DAD-DPC框架，在无需知道不确定性与噪声分布的情况下，保证舒适度违规渐近满足预设上界，并在BOPTEST与真实建筑实验中实现最高30%节能。
AI.motivation: 传统MPC虽节能，但模型误差与测量噪声导致舒适度违规；现有数据驱动预测控制(DPC)虽减少建模工作量，却缺乏对违规概率的严格保证。
AI.method: 结合Willems基本引理与保形预测，构建扰动自适应数据驱动预测控制(DAD-DPC)闭环框架，在线调整控制策略使违规率渐近收敛至预设上界。
AI.result: 在BOPTEST四个建筑场景与Polydome实际建筑验证中，5%违规设定下的DAD-DPC相比默认控制器分别节能30.1%、11.2%、27.1%、20.5%，且平均违规率严格低于5%。
AI.conclusion: DAD-DPC能在不牺牲舒适度合规的前提下显著降低能耗，为建筑气候控制提供可部署的实用方案。
AI.translation: 本文提出一种扰动自适应数据驱动预测控制框架，可在未知不确定性与噪声分布的情况下，确保舒适度违规渐近满足预设界限，并在仿真与真实建筑中实现显著节能。
AI.summary: 本文针对建筑气候控制，提出扰动自适应数据驱动预测控制(DAD-DPC)。该方法利用Willems基本引理与保形预测，在线调整控制策略，使舒适度违规率渐近满足预设上界。在BOPTEST四场景与Polydome真实建筑实验中，5%违规设定下节能达30%，验证其在节能与舒适度之间的有效平衡。
AI.keywords: 数据驱动预测控制;建筑气候控制;模型预测控制;舒适度约束;保形预测;Willems基本引理;节能
AI.comments: 未提及抽象

title: Characterizing LLM Inference Energy-Performance Tradeoffs across Workloads and GPU Scaling
summary: LLM inference exhibits substantial variability across queries and execution phases, yet inference configurations are often applied uniformly. We present a measurement-driven characterization of workload heterogeneity and energy-performance behavior of LLM inference under GPU dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS). We evaluate five decoder-only LLMs (1B-32B parameters) across four NLP benchmarks using a controlled offline setup. We show that lightweight semantic features predict inference difficulty better than input length, with 44.5% of queries achieving comparable quality across model sizes. At the hardware level, the decode phase dominates inference time (77-91%) and is largely insensitive to GPU frequency. Consequently, reducing GPU frequency from 2842 MHz to 180 MHz achieves an average of 42% energy savings with only a 1-6% latency increase. We further provide a use case with an upper-bound analysis of the potential benefits of combining workload-aware model selection with phase-aware DVFS, motivating future energy-efficient LLM inference systems.

AI.title_translation: 表征LLM推理在不同工作负载与GPU扩展下的能效-性能权衡
AI.tldr: 通过测量驱动的方法揭示LLM推理的查询与阶段差异，利用DVFS在解码阶段降频42%节能仅增1-6%延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理配置对所有查询统一设置，忽视查询间与执行阶段的高度异质性，需量化其能效-性能权衡以实现节能。
AI.method: 在离线受控环境下，对5种1B-32B解码器模型在4个NLP基准上测量DVFS下的能耗与延迟，用轻量语义特征预测推理难度，并分析阶段级频率敏感度。
AI.result: 语义特征比输入长度更能预测难度，44.5%查询在不同模型上质量相当；解码阶段占77-91%时间且对GPU频率不敏感；频率从2842 MHz降至180 MHz平均节能42%，延迟仅增1-6%。
AI.conclusion: 解码阶段是节能关键，结合负载感知模型选择与阶段感知DVFS可显著降低能耗，为未来绿色LLM推理系统提供设计依据。
AI.translation: LLM推理在不同查询和执行阶段表现出显著差异，但推理配置通常被统一应用。本文通过测量驱动的方法，对LLM推理在GPU动态电压与频率调整（DVFS）下的工作负载异构性与能效-性能行为进行表征。我们在受控离线环境中评估五个仅解码器LLM（1B–32B参数）在四个NLP基准上的表现。结果显示，轻量语义特征比输入长度更能预测推理难度，44.5%的查询在不同模型规模下可获得相当质量。在硬件层面，解码阶段占推理时间77–91%，且对GPU频率几乎不敏感。因此，将GPU频率从2842 MHz降至180 MHz可平均节能42%，而延迟仅增加1–6%。我们进一步给出结合负载感知模型选择与阶段感知DVFS的潜在收益上界分析，为未来节能LLM推理系统提供动力。
AI.summary: 本文系统测量LLM推理在不同模型与查询下的能耗与延迟，发现解码阶段对频率不敏感，通过大幅降低频率可节能四成且几乎不增延迟，为绿色部署提供实证指导。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型推理；能效优化；DVFS；工作负载异构性；解码阶段；GPU频率调节
AI.comments: 研究聚焦离线场景，线上动态负载与多卡扩展下的效果尚待验证；未来可探索更细粒度DVFS策略与实时调度结合。

title: Universality of Benign Overfitting in Binary Linear Classification
comments: 83 pages, 10 figures; two sections added in the supplement, added clarifications, fixed minor typos
summary: The practical success of deep learning has led to the discovery of several surprising phenomena. One of these phenomena, that has spurred intense theoretical research, is ``benign overfitting'': deep neural networks seem to generalize well in the over-parametrized regime even though the networks show a perfect fit to noisy training data. It is now known that benign overfitting also occurs in various classical statistical models. For linear maximum margin classifiers, benign overfitting has been established theoretically in a class of mixture models with very strong assumptions on the covariate distribution. However, even in this simple setting, many questions remain open. For instance, most of the existing literature focuses on the noiseless case where all true class labels are observed without errors, whereas the more interesting noisy case remains poorly understood. We provide a comprehensive study of benign overfitting for linear maximum margin classifiers. We discover a phase transition in test error bounds for the noisy model which was previously unknown and provide some geometric intuition behind it. We further considerably relax the required covariate assumptions in both, the noisy and noiseless case. Our results demonstrate that benign overfitting of maximum margin classifiers holds in a much wider range of scenarios than was previously known and provide new insights into the underlying mechanisms.
comment: 83 pages, 10 figures; two sections added in the supplement, added clarifications, fixed minor typos

AI.title_translation: 二元线性分类中良性过拟合的普适性
AI.tldr: 论文证明在更宽松的协变量假设下，线性最大间隔分类器在带噪与无噪场景中均会出现良性过拟合，并首次揭示带噪模型的测试误差界相变现象。
AI.motivation: 现有理论仅在强假设的无噪混合模型中刻画线性分类器的良性过拟合，而真实场景普遍带噪且假设过强，亟需更一般化、带噪设置下的理论解释。
AI.method: 放松协变量分布假设，建立带噪与无噪情形下线性最大间隔分类器的泛化误差界，并通过几何视角分析误差界随参数变化的相变行为。
AI.result: 发现带噪模型测试误差界存在尖锐相变；在显著更弱的条件下证明良性过拟合广泛成立，扩展了此前仅适用于强假设的结论。
AI.conclusion: 良性过拟合并非特殊场景下的奇例，而是在宽松条件下普遍存在于二元线性最大间隔分类，为理解深度学习的过参数化泛化提供了更普适的理论基础。
AI.translation: 论文标题译为《二元线性分类中良性过拟合的普适性》。
AI.summary: 本文系统研究线性最大间隔分类器的良性过拟合，首次在带噪模型中发现测试误差相变，并在显著放宽的协变量假设下证明其普适性，拓展了理论适用范围。
AI.keywords: 良性过拟合、线性最大间隔分类器、过参数化、泛化误差、相变、带噪标签
AI.comments: 结果对协变量分布的放松具有实际意义，但摘要未提及高维渐近框架或具体实验验证，未来可探讨更复杂模型与算法稳定性。

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Real-World Engine Control
summary: This work introduces a toolchain for applying Reinforcement Learning (RL), specifically the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithm, in safety-critical real-world environments. As an exemplary application, transient load control is demonstrated on a single-cylinder internal combustion engine testbench in Homogeneous Charge Compression Ignition (HCCI) mode, that offers high thermal efficiency and low emissions. However, HCCI poses challenges for traditional control methods due to its nonlinear, autoregressive, and stochastic nature. RL provides a viable solution, however, safety concerns, such as excessive pressure rise rates, must be addressed when applying to HCCI. A single unsuitable control input can severely damage the engine or cause misfiring and shut down. Additionally, operating limits are not known a priori and must be determined experimentally. To mitigate these risks, real-time safety monitoring based on the k-nearest neighbor algorithm is implemented, enabling safe interaction with the testbench. The feasibility of this approach is demonstrated as the RL agent learns a control policy through interaction with the testbench. A root mean square error of 0.1374 bar is achieved for the indicated mean effective pressure, comparable to neural network-based controllers from the literature. The toolchain's flexibility is further demonstrated by adapting the agent's policy to increase ethanol energy shares, promoting renewable fuel use while maintaining safety. This RL approach addresses the longstanding challenge of applying RL to safety-critical real-world environments. The developed toolchain, with its adaptability and safety mechanisms, paves the way for future applicability of RL in engine testbenches and other safety-critical settings.

AI.title_translation: 面向真实发动机控制的安全强化学习
AI.tldr: 提出一套将DDPG强化学习算法应用于HCCI发动机瞬态负载控制的工具链，通过k近邻实时安全监控实现安全交互，在台架实验中取得与文献神经网络控制器相当的IMEP均方根误差，并展示对可再生燃料的适应性。
AI.motivation: HCCI发动机具有高效率低排放优势，但其非线性、自回归与随机特性使传统控制方法难以应对；强化学习虽有潜力，却存在因不当控制输入导致硬件损毁或熄火的安全风险，且运行边界需实验确定。
AI.method: 采用DDPG算法作为核心控制器；引入基于k近邻算法的实时安全监控机制，在台架交互过程中动态识别危险状态；通过实验迭代确定安全运行边界；最终对策略进行调优以提升乙醇掺混比例。
AI.result: RL智能体在单缸HCCI发动机台架上成功学到有效控制策略，指示平均有效压力(IMEP)的均方根误差达到0.1374 bar，与文献中神经网络控制器水平相当；在保持安全前提下，可将乙醇能量占比提高至更高水平。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的安全强化学习工具链首次在真实、安全关键的发动机台架环境中验证了RL的可行性，其安全监控与策略自适应能力为强化学习在发动机测试乃至其他安全关键场景中的推广应用奠定基础。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一套工具链，将深度确定性策略梯度(DDPG)强化学习算法应用于安全关键的真实世界环境。作为示例应用，在均质充量压缩点火(HCCI)模式的单缸内燃机台架上进行瞬态负载控制，该模式具有高热效率和低排放优点，但其非线性、自回归和随机特性对传统控制方法构成挑战。RL虽提供可行方案，却需解决压力升高率过高等安全问题，单次不当控制输入即可严重损坏发动机或导致熄火。此外，运行极限无法先验得知，必须通过实验确定。为降低风险，实现了基于k近邻算法的实时安全监控，确保与台架的安全交互。RL智能体通过与台架交互学习控制策略，指示平均有效压力的均方根误差达到0.1374 bar，与文献中基于神经网络的控制器相当。该工具链的灵活性进一步通过调整策略提高乙醇能量占比得以验证，在保障安全的同时促进可再生燃料使用。此RL方法解决了将强化学习应用于安全关键真实环境的长期难题，所开发工具链的适应性和安全机制为RL在发动机台架及其他安全关键环境中的未来应用铺平了道路。
AI.summary: 本文针对HCCI发动机控制难题，提出集成DDPG算法与k近邻安全监控的强化学习工具链，在真实台架上实现安全高效的瞬态负载控制，误差达0.1374 bar，并展示对可再生燃料的适应性。
AI.keywords: 强化学习；安全关键系统；HCCI发动机；DDPG；k近邻；实时安全监控；瞬态负载控制；乙醇掺混
AI.comments: 研究首次在真实HCCI台架上验证了安全强化学习的可行性，其安全监控与策略自适应机制对推广RL至其他安全关键系统具有重要借鉴意义。

title: A Statistical Learning Perspective on Semi-dual Adversarial Neural Optimal Transport Solvers
summary: Neural network-based optimal transport (OT) is a recent and fruitful direction in the generative modeling community. It finds its applications in various fields such as domain translation, image super-resolution, computational biology and others. Among the existing OT approaches, of considerable interest are adversarial minimax solvers based on semi-dual formulations of OT problems. While promising, these methods lack theoretical investigation from a statistical learning perspective. Our work fills this gap by establishing upper bounds on the generalization error of an approximate OT map recovered by the minimax quadratic OT solver. Importantly, the bounds we derive depend solely on some standard statistical and mathematical properties of the considered functional classes (neural nets). While our analysis focuses on the quadratic OT, we believe that similar bounds could be derived for general OT case, paving the promising direction for future research. Our experimental illustrations are available online https://github.com/milenagazdieva/StatOT.

AI.title_translation: 半对偶对抗神经最优传输求解器的统计学习视角
AI.tldr: 本文首次从统计学习角度为基于半对偶形式的二次最优传输对抗求解器建立泛化误差上界，表明误差仅取决于神经网络函数类的标准性质。
AI.motivation: 基于半对偶形式的对抗神经网络最优传输方法虽在生成建模等领域表现突出，但缺乏统计学习理论保障，亟需建立其泛化误差界以理解其学习保证。
AI.method: 将半对偶二次最优传输的极小极大求解过程纳入统计学习框架，推导恢复近似最优传输映射的泛化误差上界，并限定误差仅依赖于所用神经网络的常规统计与数学性质。
AI.result: 得到了仅依赖神经网络函数类标准性质的泛化误差上界，为二次最优传输情形提供了理论保证，并指出类似界限有望推广到一般最优传输情形。
AI.conclusion: 该理论分析填补了半对偶对抗神经最优传输方法在统计学习理论上的空白，为未来推广到一般OT问题及改进算法提供了可行方向。
AI.translation: 基于神经网络的最优传输(OT)是生成建模领域一个新兴且成果丰硕的方向，在域迁移、图像超分辨率、计算生物学等领域有广泛应用。在现有OT方法中，基于半对偶OT问题形式的对抗极小极大求解器尤为引人关注。尽管前景良好，这些方法仍缺乏统计学习视角的理论研究。本文通过为极小极大二次OT求解器恢复的近似OT映射建立泛化误差上界填补了这一空白。重要的是，我们导出的界仅依赖于所考虑函数类(神经网络)的标准统计与数学性质。虽然分析聚焦于二次OT，但我们相信类似界可推广到一般OT情形，为未来研究开辟有前景的方向。实验示例见https://github.com/milenagazdieva/StatOT。
AI.summary: 本文从统计学习理论出发，为基于半对偶形式的对抗神经最优传输求解器建立了仅依赖神经网络性质的泛化误差上界，首次为其提供理论保证，并指出推广到一般OT的潜力。
AI.keywords: 最优传输，神经网络，半对偶形式，泛化误差界，对抗学习，统计学习理论
AI.comments: 作者仅给出二次OT的理论分析，未在摘要中报告具体实验验证或泛化误差界的数值规模；代码已开源。

title: Improving the Convergence of Private Shuffled Gradient Methods with Public Data
summary: We consider the problem of differentially private (DP) convex empirical risk minimization (ERM). While the standard DP-SGD algorithm is theoretically well-established, practical implementations often rely on shuffled gradient methods that traverse the training data sequentially rather than sampling with replacement in each iteration. Despite their widespread use, the theoretical privacy-accuracy trade-offs of private shuffled gradient methods (\textit{DP-ShuffleG}) remain poorly understood, leading to a gap between theory and practice. In this work, we leverage privacy amplification by iteration (PABI) and a novel application of Stein's lemma to provide the first empirical excess risk bound of \textit{DP-ShuffleG}. Our result shows that data shuffling results in worse empirical excess risk for \textit{DP-ShuffleG} compared to DP-SGD. To address this limitation, we propose \textit{Interleaved-ShuffleG}, a hybrid approach that integrates public data samples in private optimization. By alternating optimization steps that use private and public samples, \textit{Interleaved-ShuffleG} effectively reduces empirical excess risk. Our analysis introduces a new optimization framework with surrogate objectives, varying levels of noise injection, and a dissimilarity metric, which can be of independent interest. Our experiments on diverse datasets and tasks demonstrate the superiority of \textit{Interleaved-ShuffleG} over several baselines.

AI.title_translation: 利用公开数据改进私有洗牌梯度方法的收敛性
AI.tldr: 针对差分隐私凸经验风险最小化，提出Interleaved-ShuffleG，通过在私有优化中交替引入公开数据，首次给出DP-ShuffleG的实证超额风险界并显著降低风险。
AI.motivation: 私有洗牌梯度法(DP-ShuffleG)在实践中广泛应用，但其隐私-精度权衡理论缺失，导致性能低于DP-SGD，需要理论解释与改进。
AI.method: 1) 利用迭代隐私放大(PABI)与Stein引理推导DP-ShuffleG的实证超额风险界；2) 提出Interleaved-ShuffleG，在训练步骤中交替使用私有与公开样本，并引入代理目标、可变噪声注入与不相似度度量的优化框架。
AI.result: 理论表明DP-ShuffleG的洗牌会降低实证超额风险；Interleaved-ShuffleG在多个数据集和任务上优于多个基线，显著降低实证超额风险。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入公开数据并交替优化，Interleaved-ShuffleG克服了私有洗牌梯度法的性能劣势，所提优化框架具有独立研究价值。
AI.translation: 我们研究了差分隐私（DP）凸经验风险最小化（ERM）问题。虽然标准DP-SGD算法在理论上已确立，但实际实现常依赖按顺序遍历训练数据的洗牌梯度方法，而非每轮有放回采样。尽管广泛使用，私有洗牌梯度法（DP-ShuffleG）的隐私-精度权衡理论尚不清楚，导致理论与实践的差距。本文利用迭代隐私放大（PABI）和Stein引理的新应用，首次给出DP-ShuffleG的实证超额风险界，表明数据洗牌会使其风险高于DP-SGD。为克服此局限，我们提出Interleaved-ShuffleG，通过在私有优化中交替使用私有与公开样本，有效降低实证超额风险。分析引入了代理目标、可变噪声注入与不相似度度量的新优化框架，实验在多种数据集和任务上验证其优于多种基线。
AI.summary: 针对差分隐私凸ERM，论文首次给出私有洗牌梯度法(DP-ShuffleG)的实证超额风险界，发现其因数据洗牌而性能劣于DP-SGD。为此提出Interleaved-ShuffleG，通过交替利用公开与私有样本，显著降低实证超额风险，并在多个任务上取得最优效果。
AI.keywords: 差分隐私，洗牌梯度法，经验风险最小化，公开数据，隐私放大，Stein引理
AI.comments: 论文贡献在于理论填补DP-ShuffleG空白，并通过公开数据引入实用改进；未来可探索公开数据比例自适应及非凸场景扩展。

title: Oracular Programming: A Modular Foundation for Building LLM-Enabled Software
summary: Large Language Models can solve a wide range of tasks from just a few examples, but they remain difficult to steer and lack a capability essential for building reliable software at scale: the modular composition of computations under enforceable contracts. As a result, they are typically embedded in larger software pipelines that use domain-specific knowledge to decompose tasks and improve reliability through validation and search. Yet the complexity of writing, tuning, and maintaining such pipelines has so far limited their sophistication. We propose oracular programming: a foundational paradigm for integrating traditional, explicit computations with inductive oracles such as LLMs. It rests on two directing principles: the full separation of core and search logic, and the treatment of few-shot examples as grounded and evolvable program components. Within this paradigm, experts express high-level problem-solving strategies as programs with unresolved choice points. These choice points are resolved at runtime by LLMs, which generalize from user-provided examples of correct and incorrect decisions. An oracular program is composed of three orthogonal components: a strategy that consists of a nondeterministic program with choice points that can be reified into a search tree, a policy that specifies how to navigate this tree with the help of LLM oracles, and a set of demonstrations that describe successful and unsuccessful tree navigation scenarios across diverse problem instances. Each component is expressed in a dedicated programming language and can be independently improved or substituted. We address the key programming language design challenges of modularly composing oracular programs and enforcing consistency between their components as they evolve.

AI.title_translation: 神谕式编程：构建LLM赋能软件的模块化基础
AI.tldr: 提出“神谕编程”范式，将确定性计算与LLM归纳推理解耦，通过策略-策略演示三元组实现模块化组合与可演化契约。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM难以被精确控制且缺乏可组合契约，导致复杂软件需手工构建任务分解与验证管道，维护成本高，限制了系统复杂度。
AI.method: 1) 核心逻辑与搜索逻辑完全分离；2) 将少量示例视为可演化程序组件；3) 用专用语言分别描述策略、策略与演示，并在运行时由LLM填充选择点，形成可替换、可独立改进的三元组结构。
AI.result: 该范式支持把高层策略写成含选择点的非确定性程序，由LLM根据示例导航搜索树，实现模块化组合与一致性检查。
AI.conclusion: 神谕编程为将传统计算与LLM整合提供模块化、可演化的统一框架，能显著提升复杂LLM软件的可维护性与可扩展性。
AI.translation: 本文提出神谕编程范式，通过分离核心与搜索逻辑，把少量示例当作可演化组件，使LLM在运行时根据用户示例填充选择点，实现模块化、可替换的策略-策略演示三元组，从而支持构建可维护、可扩展的LLM软件。
AI.summary: 神谕编程把LLM视为可插拔的归纳神谕，将策略、搜索导航与示例三元组解耦，用专用语言分别描述并强制一致性，允许独立演化，显著降低构建与维护复杂LLM管道的门槛。
AI.keywords: 神谕编程，大语言模型，模块化，契约，搜索树，少量示例，程序合成
AI.comments: 摘要未给出实验结果或具体评估指标，需进一步验证其在真实场景下的可靠性与性能。

title: Using the Path of Least Resistance to Explain Deep Networks
summary: Integrated Gradients (IG), a widely used axiomatic path-based attribution method, assigns importance scores to input features by integrating model gradients along a straight path from a baseline to the input. While effective in some cases, we show that straight paths can lead to flawed attributions. In this paper, we identify the cause of these misattributions and propose an alternative approach that equips the input space with a model-induced Riemannian metric (derived from the explained model's Jacobian) and computes attributions by integrating gradients along geodesics under this metric. We call this method Geodesic Integrated Gradients (GIG). To approximate geodesic paths, we introduce two techniques: a k-Nearest Neighbours-based approach for smaller models and a Stochastic Variational Inference-based method for larger ones. Additionally, we propose a new axiom, No-Cancellation Completeness (NCC), which strengthens completeness by ruling out feature-wise cancellation. We prove that, for path-based attributions under the model-induced metric, NCC holds if and only if the integration path is a geodesic. Through experiments on both synthetic and real-world image classification data, we provide empirical evidence supporting our theoretical analysis and showing that GIG produces more faithful attributions than existing methods, including IG, on the benchmarks considered.

AI.title_translation: 利用最小阻力路径解释深度网络
AI.tldr: 提出Geodesic Integrated Gradients(GIG)，用模型诱导的黎曼度量下的测地线路径取代IG的直线路径，并通过新公理NCC与实验验证其更忠实。
AI.motivation: 传统Integrated Gradients沿直线路径积分会导致错误归因，需寻找更符合模型几何结构的替代路径以提升可解释性。
AI.method: 1)用模型Jacobian定义输入空间的黎曼度量；2)在该度量下计算并积分梯度于测地线路径；3)用k-NN或随机变分推断近似测地线；4)引入No-Cancellation Completeness(NCC)公理。
AI.result: 理论上证明NCC成立当且仅当路径为测地线；实验表明GIG在合成与真实图像分类数据上的归因忠实度优于IG等方法。
AI.conclusion: 沿模型诱导测地线的GIG可消除直线路径导致的归因缺陷，新公理NCC为路径选择提供理论保证。
AI.translation: Geodesic Integrated Gradients：一种沿模型诱导测地线路径进行梯度积分的深度网络解释方法
AI.summary: 本文指出Integrated Gradients采用直线路径会造成归因偏差，提出在由模型Jacobian定义的黎曼度量下改用测地线路径，并给出高效近似算法与新公理NCC，实验验证其归因更忠实。
AI.keywords: 可解释性,归因方法,Integrated Gradients,黎曼度量,测地线路径,No-Cancellation Completeness
AI.comments: 未提及具体数据集名称、计算开销与超参数敏感性，未来可探索非图像领域的适用性。

title: Revisiting the Generalization Problem of Low-level Vision Models Through the Lens of Image Deraining
comments: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2305.15134
summary: Generalization to unseen degradations remains a fundamental challenge for low-level vision models. This paper aims to investigate the underlying mechanism of this failure, using image deraining as a primary case study due to its well-defined and decoupled structure. Through systematic experiments, we reveal that generalization issues are not primarily caused by limited network capacity, but rather by a ``shortcut learning'' phenomenon driven by the relative complexity between image content and degradation patterns. We find that when background content is excessively complex, networks preferentially overfit the simpler degradation characteristics to minimize training loss, thereby failing to learn the underlying image distribution. To address this, we propose two principled strategies: (1) balancing the complexity of training data (backgrounds vs. degradations) to redirect the network's focus toward content reconstruction, and (2) leveraging strong content priors from pre-trained generative models to physically constrain the network onto a high-quality image manifold. Extensive experiments on image deraining, denoising, and deblurring validate our theoretical insights. Our work provides an interpretability-driven perspective and a principled methodology for improving the robustness and generalization of low-level vision models.

AI.title_translation: 从图像去雨视角再审视底层视觉模型的泛化难题
AI.tldr: 论文指出底层视觉模型泛化失败的主因并非网络容量不足，而是“捷径学习”：网络在复杂背景下降级优先拟合简单退化特征。通过平衡训练数据复杂度与引入预训练生成模型先验，可显著提升去雨、去噪、去模糊任务的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 底层视觉模型对未见退化类型泛化能力弱，亟需揭示其根本机制并给出可解释、可推广的改进方案。
AI.method: 以图像去雨为案例，系统实验揭示“捷径学习”现象；提出两项策略：1) 平衡训练数据中的背景与退化复杂度；2) 利用预训练生成模型提供的高质量图像流形先验约束网络。
AI.result: 在图像去雨、去噪、去模糊任务上验证了理论分析的正确性，所提策略显著增强了模型对未见退化的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 捷径学习是低层视觉模型泛化失败的核心原因；通过数据复杂度平衡与强内容先验引入，可在多个任务上获得可解释且一致的泛化提升。
AI.translation: 本文通过图像去雨系统探讨底层视觉模型泛化失败机制，指出核心在于“捷径学习”而非网络容量不足，并提出数据复杂度平衡与生成先验约束两种策略，在多种任务上验证了有效性。
AI.summary: 作者发现底层视觉模型泛化差源于“捷径学习”：当背景复杂时，网络优先拟合简单退化而非图像内容。为此，作者平衡训练数据复杂度并引入预训练生成先验，使网络聚焦内容重建。实验涵盖去雨、去噪、去盲，结果验证策略有效，提供了提升泛化的新视角与方法论。

title: SEFL: A Framework for Generating Synthetic Educational Assignment Feedback with LLM Agents
summary: Providing high-quality feedback on student assignments is crucial for student success, but it is heavily limited by time and budgetary constraints. In this work, we introduce Synthetic Educational Feedback Loops (SEFL), a synthetic data framework designed to generate data that resembles immediate, on-demand feedback at scale without relying on extensive, real-world student assignments and teacher feedback. To obtain this type of data, two large language models (LLMs) operate in a teacher-student role to simulate assignment completion and formative feedback, generating 19.8K synthetic pairs of student work and corresponding critiques and actionable improvements from a teacher. With this data, we fine-tune smaller, more computationally efficient LLMs on these synthetic pairs, enabling them to replicate key features of high-quality, goal-oriented feedback. Through comprehensive evaluations with three LLM judges and three human experts, across a subset of 900 outputs, we demonstrate that SEFL-tuned models outperform both their untuned counterparts and an existing baseline in terms of feedback quality. The potential for societal impact is reinforced by extensive qualitative comments and ratings from human stakeholders -- both students and higher education instructors. SEFL has the potential to transform feedback processes for higher education and beyond.

AI.title_translation: SEFL：使用LLM智能体生成合成教育作业反馈的框架

AI.conclusion: SEFL有潜力改变高等教育及更广泛领域的反馈过程，得到人类利益相关者的积极定性评价支持。

title: A deep learning framework for efficient pathology image analysis
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed digital pathology by enabling biomarker prediction from high-resolution whole-slide images (WSIs). However, current methods are computationally inefficient, processing thousands of redundant tiles per WSI and requiring complex aggregator models. We introduce EAGLE (Efficient Approach for Guided Local Examination), a deep learning framework that emulates pathologists by selectively analyzing informative regions. EAGLE incorporates two foundation models: CHIEF for efficient tile selection and Virchow2 for extracting high-quality features. Benchmarking was conducted against leading slide- and tile-level foundation models across 43 tasks from nine cancer types, spanning morphology, biomarker prediction, treatment response and prognosis. EAGLE outperformed state-of-the-art patch aggregation methods by up to 23% and achieved the highest AUROC overall. It processed a slide in 2.27 seconds, reducing computational time by more than 99% compared to existing models. This efficiency enables real-time workflows, allows rapid review of the exact tiles used for each prediction, and reduces dependence on high-performance computing, making AI-powered pathology more accessible. By reliably identifying meaningful regions and minimizing artifacts, EAGLE provides robust and auditable outputs, supported by systematic negative controls and attention concentration analyses. Its unified embedding enables rapid slide searches, integration into multi-omics pipelines and emerging clinical foundation models.

AI.title_translation: 用于高效病理图像分析的深度学习框架
AI.tldr: EAGLE框架通过模仿病理学家选择性检查关键区域，在43项癌症任务上实现SOTA性能，单张切片处理仅需2.27秒，计算时间降低99%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有AI病理方法需处理整片切片数千冗余图块，计算低效且依赖复杂聚合模型，亟需高效可解释的方案。
AI.method: 提出EAGLE框架，结合CHIEF高效图块选择模型与Virchow2特征提取基础模型，仅分析信息丰富区域，并引入系统负对照与注意力集中分析确保可审计性。
AI.result: 在9种癌型43项任务中，EAGLE较最佳图块聚合方法提升达23%，AUROC总体最高；单切片处理2.27秒，计算耗时降低99%以上，支持实时流程与精确回溯。
AI.conclusion: EAGLE以类病理学家策略实现高效、可解释且鲁棒的AI病理分析，降低高性能计算依赖，促进AI病理普及与多组学整合。
AI.translation: 人工智能通过高分辨率全载玻片图像实现生物标志物预测，已革新数字病理。然而，现有方法计算低效，需处理每张切片数千冗余图块并依赖复杂聚合模型。我们提出EAGLE（Efficient Approach for Guided Local Examination），一种深度学习框架，模拟病理学家选择性分析信息丰富区域。EAGLE整合两个基础模型：CHIEF用于高效图块选择，Virchow2用于提取高质量特征。我们在九种癌症43项任务（涵盖形态、生物标志物预测、治疗反应与预后）上，与领先切片/图块级基础模型进行基准测试。EAGLE较最新图块聚合方法提升达23%，总体AUROC最高。其单切片处理仅需2.27秒，计算时间较现有模型减少逾99%。该效率支持实时工作流程，可快速审查每次预测所用图块，降低对高性能计算的依赖，使AI病理更易普及。通过可靠识别有意义区域并减少伪影，EAGLE提供稳健且可审计的输出，辅以系统负对照与注意力集中分析。其统一嵌入支持快速切片检索、多组学流程整合及新兴临床基础模型。

title: Distributional Vision-Language Alignment by Cauchy-Schwarz Divergence
summary: Vision-language alignment is crucial for various downstream tasks such as cross-modal generation and retrieval. Previous multimodal approaches like CLIP utilize InfoNCE to maximize mutual information, primarily aligning pairwise samples across modalities while overlooking distributional differences. In addition, InfoNCE has inherent conflict in terms of alignment and uniformity in multimodality, leading to suboptimal alignment with modality gaps. To overcome the limitations, we propose CS-Aligner, a novel framework that performs distributional vision-language alignment by integrating Cauchy-Schwarz (CS) divergence with mutual information. CS-Aligner captures both the global distribution information of each modality and the pairwise semantic relationships. We find that the CS divergence seamlessly addresses the InfoNCE's alignment-uniformity conflict and serves complementary roles with InfoNCE, yielding tighter and more precise alignment. Moreover, by introducing distributional alignment, CS-Aligner enables incorporating additional information from unpaired data and token-level representations, enhancing flexible and fine-grained alignment in practice. Experiments on text-to-image generation and cross-modality retrieval tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on vision-language alignment.

AI.title_translation: 基于Cauchy-Schwarz散度的分布级视觉-语言对齐
AI.tldr: 提出CS-Aligner框架，用Cauchy-Schwarz散度替代InfoNCE，实现全局分布与局部样本同时对齐，缓解对齐-均匀冲突，并支持无配对数据与token级表示，提升生成与检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP类方法仅用InfoNCE做样本级对齐，忽视分布差异，且对齐与均匀目标冲突，导致模态间隙与次优对齐。
AI.method: 设计CS-Aligner，将Cauchy-Schwarz散度与互信息结合，显式对齐跨模态全局分布，同时保留样本语义关系，并引入无配对数据与token级特征。
AI.result: 在文本到图像生成与跨模态检索任务上，CS-Aligner实现更紧密、更精确的对齐，性能优于InfoNCE基线。
AI.conclusion: CS散度能有效解决InfoNCE的对齐-均匀冲突，分布级对齐策略可灵活利用无配对与细粒度信息，显著提升下游任务表现。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言对齐对跨模态生成与检索至关重要。先前CLIP等多模态方法采用InfoNCE最大化互信息，仅对齐成对样本而忽略分布差异，且存在对齐与均匀目标的内在冲突，导致模态间隙与次优对齐。为此，我们提出CS-Aligner，通过将Cauchy-Schwarz散度与互信息整合，实现分布级视觉-语言对齐。CS-Aligner同时捕获各模态的全局分布信息与成对语义关系，无缝缓解InfoNCE的对齐-均匀冲突，并与InfoNCE互补，实现更紧密、更精确的对齐。引入分布对齐后，CS-Aligner可利用无配对数据与token级表示，实现灵活且细粒度的对齐。文本到图像生成与跨模态检索实验验证了我们方法在视觉-语言对齐上的有效性。
AI.summary: CS-Aligner用Cauchy-Schwarz散度替代InfoNCE，实现全局分布与局部样本同时对齐，缓解对齐-均匀冲突，支持无配对与token级信息，在生成与检索任务上表现更优。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言对齐，Cauchy-Schwarz散度，InfoNCE，分布对齐，跨模态检索，文本到图像生成

title: Bridging Gaps in Natural Language Processing for Yorùbá: A Systematic Review of a Decade of Progress and Prospects
summary: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is becoming a dominant subset of artificial intelligence as the need to help machines understand human language looks indispensable. Several NLP applications are ubiquitous, partly due to the myriad of datasets being churned out daily through mediums like social networking sites. However, the growing development has not been evident in most African languages due to the persisting resource limitations, among other issues. Yorùbá language, a tonal and morphologically rich African language, suffers a similar fate, resulting in limited NLP usage. To encourage further research towards improving this situation, this systematic literature review aims to comprehensively analyse studies addressing NLP development for Yorùbá, identifying challenges, resources, techniques, and applications. A well-defined search string from a structured protocol was employed to search, select, and analyse 105 primary studies between 2014 and 2024 from reputable databases. The review highlights the scarcity of annotated corpora, the limited availability of pre-trained language models, and linguistic challenges like tonal complexity and diacritic dependency as significant obstacles. It also revealed the prominent techniques, including rule-based methods, among others. The findings reveal a growing body of multilingual and monolingual resources, even though the field is constrained by socio-cultural factors such as code-switching and the desertion of language for digital usage. This review synthesises existing research, providing a foundation for advancing NLP for Yorùbá and in African languages generally. It aims to guide future research by identifying gaps and opportunities, thereby contributing to the broader inclusion of Yorùbá and other under-resourced African languages in global NLP advancements.

AI.title_translation: 连接约鲁巴语自然语言处理中的差距：十年进展与前景的系统综述
AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了2014-2024年间105项约鲁巴语NLP研究，指出语料稀缺、预训练模型缺乏及音调复杂性是主要障碍，并提出未来方向。
AI.motivation: 非洲语言在NLP发展中资源匮乏，约鲁巴语作为典型代表，亟需梳理已有研究、识别挑战与机遇，以推动其NLP进步并实现全球包容性。
AI.method: 制定结构化检索协议，用明确检索式在权威数据库中搜索、筛选并分析105篇2014-2024年的核心文献，进行系统综述。
AI.result: 发现标注语料稀缺、预训练模型不足、音调复杂及变音符号依赖是主要障碍；规则方法等仍是主流技术；多语与单语资源正增长，但受代码切换与数字弃用等社会文化因素限制。
AI.conclusion: 研究为约鲁巴语及非洲低资源语言NLP发展提供综合基础，指明缺口与机会，有助于其融入全球NLP进步。
AI.translation: 自然语言处理（NLP）正成为人工智能的主导分支，因让机器理解人类语言的需求日益不可或缺。尽管社交网络等每日产生大量数据推动了诸多NLP应用，非洲语言却因资源限制等问题发展缓慢。约鲁巴语作为声调丰富、形态复杂的非洲语言，NLP应用同样受限。本文系统综述2014-2024年105篇研究，分析其挑战、资源、技术与应用，指出标注语料稀缺、预训练模型不足及声调复杂性是主要障碍，并揭示规则方法等主流技术。尽管多语与单语资源逐步增长，社会文化因素仍制约发展。本综述为未来研究提供方向，推动约鲁巴语及其他非洲低资源语言纳入全球NLP进程。
AI.summary: 本文系统回顾十年约鲁巴语NLP研究，识别资源稀缺、音调复杂等核心挑战，总结规则方法等主流技术，提出未来研究方向，以促进该语言在全球NLP中的包容性发展。
AI.keywords: 约鲁巴语,自然语言处理,低资源语言,系统综述,音调复杂性,语料稀缺

title: Characterizing Production GPU Workloads using System-wide Telemetry Data
summary: GPGPU-accelerated clusters and supercomputers are central to modern high-performance computing (HPC). Over the past decade, these systems continue to expand, and GPUs now expose a wide range of hardware counters that provide detailed views of performance and resource usage. Despite the potential of these counters, few studies have evaluated the insights they offer about real workloads at scale. In this work, we address this gap by analyzing previously underexplored GPU hardware counters collected via Lightweight Distributed Metric Service on Perlmutter, a leadership-class supercomputer. We quantify uneven work distribution across GPUs within a job and the steadiness of GPU activity over time, and we classify jobs as compute- or memory-bound using a roofline-based criterion. We then use these metrics to interpret job behavior in terms of practical workload characteristics to provide interpretable, job-level insights. Our findings can inform workload optimization and future HPC system design. For example, 81% of jobs are memory-bound, and memory-bound jobs tend to consume more energy than compute-bound jobs at comparable GPU-hours. Among jobs requesting 80 GB GPUs, 55% peak at 50% HBM capacity or less.

AI.title_translation: 基于系统级遥测数据刻画生产级GPU工作负载
AI.tldr: 利用Perlmutter超算的系统级遥测数据，首次大规模分析GPU硬件计数器，揭示81%作业为内存受限且能耗更高，且55%的80 GB GPU作业峰值显存使用率≤50%。
AI.motivation: 尽管现代HPC系统提供丰富的GPU硬件计数器，但缺乏对这些计数器在真实大规模工作负载中实际价值的系统评估。
AI.method: 通过轻量级分布式指标服务收集Perlmutter的GPU硬件计数器，量化作业内GPU负载不均与时域稳定性，并基于roofline模型将作业划分为计算或内存受限。
AI.result: 81%作业为内存受限，其能耗显著高于同GPU-小时的计算受限作业；在申请80 GB显存的作业中，55%峰值HBM使用率≤50%。
AI.conclusion: 系统级遥测数据可提供可解释的作业级洞察，指导工作负载优化与未来HPC系统设计。
AI.translation: 基于系统级遥测数据刻画生产级GPU工作负载
AI.summary: 本文首次利用Perlmutter超算的GPU硬件计数器大规模分析生产负载，发现内存受限作业占81%且能耗更高，显存利用率普遍偏低，为HPC优化与系统设计提供依据。
AI.keywords: GPU、HPC、硬件计数器、roofline模型、内存受限、能耗、遥测数据

title: Armijo Line-search Can Make (Stochastic) Gradient Descent Provably Faster
summary: Armijo line-search (Armijo-LS) is a standard method to set the step-size for gradient descent (GD). For smooth functions, Armijo-LS alleviates the need to know the global smoothness constant L and adapts to the ``local'' smoothness, enabling GD to converge faster. Existing theoretical analyses show that GD with Armijo-LS (GD-LS) can result in constant factor improvements over GD with a 1/L step-size (denoted as GD(1/L)). We strengthen these results and show that if the objective function satisfies a certain non-uniform smoothness condition, GD-LS can result in a faster convergence rate than GD(1/L). In particular, we prove that for convex objectives corresponding to logistic regression and multi-class classification, GD-LS can converge to the optimum at a linear rate, and hence improves over the sublinear convergence of GD(1/L). Furthermore, for non-convex objectives satisfying gradient domination (e.g., those corresponding to the softmax policy gradient in RL or generalized linear models with a logistic link function), GD-LS can match the fast convergence of algorithms tailored for these specific settings. Finally, we analyze the convergence of stochastic GD with a stochastic line-search on convex losses under the interpolation assumption.

AI.title_translation: Armijo线搜索可使（随机）梯度下降证明性地更快
AI.tldr: 本文证明Armijo线搜索不仅带来常数因子加速，还能在凸与非凸情形下获得比固定步长1/L更快的收敛速率，包括线性收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有理论仅表明Armijo线搜索带来常数因子改进，作者想揭示其在更宽松光滑条件下能否实现更优的收敛速率，甚至线性收敛。
AI.method: 引入非均匀光滑性假设，对凸（逻辑回归、多分类）与非凸（梯度支配）目标分别建立GD-LS的收敛率；并在插值假设下分析随机GD配合随机线-search。
AI.result: 对凸目标，GD-LS可达线性收敛，优于GD(1/L)的次线性；对梯度支配的非凸目标，GD-LS收敛率可匹敌专用算法；随机线-search在插值设定下亦有收敛保证。
AI.conclusion: Armijo线搜索不仅免除全局光滑常数L的依赖，还能在理论上实现比固定步长1/L更快的收敛速率，对凸与非凸问题均具显著优势。
AI.translation: Armijo线搜索（Armijo-LS）是设定梯度下降步长的标准方法。对光滑函数，Armijo-LS无需知道全局光滑常数L，能适应“局部”光滑度，使GD收敛更快。现有理论表明，带Armijo-LS的GD（GD-LS）相比固定步长1/L的GD（GD(1/L)）仅有常数因子改进。我们强化这些结果，证明若目标函数满足某种非均匀光滑条件，GD-LS可比GD(1/L)获得更快的收敛率。特别地，我们证明对逻辑回归与多分类对应的凸目标，GD-LS可以线性速率收敛到最优，从而优于GD(1/L)的次线性收敛。对满足梯度支配的非凸目标（如RL中的softmax策略梯度或带逻辑链接的广义线性模型），GD-LS可匹配专为这些情形设计的算法的快速收敛。最后，我们在插值假设下分析凸损失上随机GD配合随机线-search的收敛性。
AI.summary: 作者在非均匀光滑条件下证明，Armijo线搜索使梯度下降在凸与非凸问题上均可获得优于固定步长1/L的收敛率，包括线性收敛；并首次给出随机线-search在插值设定下的理论保证。
AI.keywords: Armijo线搜索, 梯度下降, 非均匀光滑, 线性收敛, 随机线搜索, 插值, 梯度支配
AI.comments: Not mentioned in abstract

title: Interaction-Aware Model Predictive Decision-Making for Socially-Compliant Autonomous Driving in Mixed Urban Traffic Scenarios
summary: Autonomous vehicles must negotiate with pedestrians in ways that are both safe and socially compliant. We present an interaction-aware model predictive decision-making (IAMPDM) framework that integrates a gap-acceptance-inspired intention model with MPC to jointly reason about human intent and vehicle control in real time. The pedestrian module produces a continuous crossing-propensity signal - driven by time-to-collision (TTC) with an intention discounting mechanism - that modulates MPC safety terms and minimum-distance constraints. We implement IAMPDM in a projection-based, motion-tracked simulator and compare it against a rule-based intention-aware controller (RBDM) and a conservative non-interactive baseline (NIA). In a human-in-the-decision-loop study with 25 participants, intention-aware methods shortened negotiation and completion time relative to NIA across scenarios, at the expense of tighter TTC/DST margins, with no significant difference between IAMPDM and RBDM except for TTC in one scenario. Results indicate that intention-aware decision-making algorithms reduce pedestrian crossing time and improve subjective ratings of comfort, safety, and trust relative to a non-cooperative decision-making algorithm. We discuss implications for real-world deployment of interaction-aware autonomous vehicles. We detail decision-making calibration and real-time implementation (CasADi/IPOPT) and propose deployment guardrails - minimum surrogate-safety margins, deadlock prevention - to balance efficiency with safety.

AI.title_translation: 面向混合城市交通场景的交互感知模型预测决策：实现社会合规的自动驾驶
AI.tldr: 提出IAMPDM框架，将意图模型与MPC结合，实时推断行人意图并控制车辆，实验表明可缩短协商时间、提升舒适性与信任度。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶系统在与人交互时缺乏社会合规性，需同时保证安全与效率，因此需能实时推断行人意图并据此决策。
AI.method: 构建IAMPDM框架：用基于间隙接受的连续穿越倾向模型，根据TTC与意图折扣机制生成信号，在线调制MPC安全项与最小距离约束，并与RBDM、NIA对比。
AI.result: 25人实验显示，意图感知方法较NIA缩短协商与完成时间，提升舒适/安全/信任评分，IAMPDM与RBDM差异大多不显著，仅TTC在单一场景显著优于RBDM。
AI.conclusion: 交互感知决策算法可在保持安全的同时提升效率与社会接受度，需设置最小安全裕度与死锁预防等护栏以平衡效率与安全。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶车辆必须以安全且社会合规的方式与行人协商。我们提出交互感知模型预测决策（IAMPDM）框架，将受间隙接受启发的意图模型与MPC集成，实时联合推断人类意图并控制车辆。行人模块生成连续的穿越倾向信号——由碰撞时间（TTC）与意图折扣机制驱动——调节MPC安全项与最小距离约束。我们在基于投影、运动跟踪的模拟器中实现IAMPDM，并与基于规则的意图感知控制器（RBDM）及保守非交互基线（NIA）对比。在25名参与者的人机决策环研究中，意图感知方法相对NIA在所有场景中缩短协商与完成时间，TTC/DST裕度更紧，IAMPDM与RBDM仅在单一场景的TTC有显著差异。结果表明意图感知决策算法减少行人穿越时间，提升舒适、安全与信任的主观评分。我们讨论交互感知自动驾驶的实车部署，给出决策校准与实时实现（CasADi/IPOPT），提出部署护栏——最小代理安全裕度、死锁预防——以平衡效率与安全。
AI.summary: IAMPDM通过实时推断行人穿越意图并动态调整MPC约束，实现安全且社会合规的自动驾驶，实验验证其在效率、舒适与信任方面优于非交互方法，并提供实车部署的安全护栏。
AI.keywords: 交互感知决策；模型预测控制；行人意图推断；社会合规；自动驾驶；人机协商
AI.comments: 未提及其他交通参与者（如自行车）的适用性，也未给出具体安全裕度数值与计算复杂度分析。

title: Semantic Parallelism: Redefining Efficient MoE Inference via Model-Data Co-Scheduling
comments: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary:
Prevailing LLM serving engines employ expert parallelism (EP) to implement multi-device inference of massive MoE models. However, the efficiency of expert parallel inference is largely bounded by inter-device communication, as EP embraces expensive all-to-all collectives to route tokens to the remote experts if not collocating on the same GPU/NPU device. Nevertheless, state-of-the-art schemes treat expert device-placement and request (or token) device-scheduling as separate concerns, triggering excessive communication between them and compromising inference efficiency
  This paper proposes Semantic Parallelism, a novel parallelism paradigm that minimizes the steep communication costs in EP-centric MoE serving via model-data collaborative scheduling. We implement Semantic Parallelism in a framework called Sem-MoE. Sem-MoE maximally collocates experts and their activating tokens onto the same device using proactively modeled activation likelihood between them and introduces three key techniques: (1) Offline model scheduling, which preliminarily clusters and collocates experts onto devices based on their co-activation tendencies for certain classes of input. (2) Online inter-request data scheduling for Attention-DP setups, which proactively rebatches incoming requests onto the device that hosts experts most likely and frequently activated by the corresponding requests. (3) Online intra-request data scheduling for Attention-TP setups, which seamlessly fuses a token reshuffling procedure into the original inference pipeline and proactively reschedules tokens to devices to reduce dispersed remote routing. We build Sem-MoE into a prevailing LLM serving engine SGLANG. Experiments show our collaborative scheduling approach can effectively reduce the all-to-all communication volume in EP and achieve superior inference throughput compared to existing solutions.
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026

AI.title_translation: 语义并行：通过模型-数据协同调度重新定义高效MoE推理
AI.tldr: 提出“语义并行”新范式，通过离线模型放置与在线请求/令牌重调度协同，显著降低MoE推理中的all-to-all通信量，提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有专家并行(EP)将专家放置与请求调度割裂，导致大量跨设备通信，成为MoE推理瓶颈，需要一体化协同调度方案。
AI.method: 1)离线基于共激活倾向聚类并共置专家；2)Attention-DP场景在线重批请求到最可能激活其专家的设备；3)Attention-TP场景在线将令牌重调度融入推理流程以减少远程路由。
AI.result: 在SGLANG上实现Sem-MoE，实验显示显著降低EP的all-to-all通信量，推理吞吐量优于现有方案。
AI.conclusion: 模型-数据协同调度可有效缓解MoE serving的通信瓶颈，语义并行是提升大规模MoE推理效率的新方向。
AI.translation: 当前LLM服务引擎采用专家并行(EP)实现大规模MoE模型的多设备推理，但EP依赖昂贵的all-to-all通信，效率受限。现有方法将专家放置与请求调度分离，导致通信开销大。本文提出语义并行，通过模型-数据协同调度最小化EP通信成本，实现Sem-MoE框架，实验验证其通信量与吞吐量优势。
AI.summary: 本文针对MoE模型推理中专家并行带来的高通信开销，提出“语义并行”范式及Sem-MoE框架，通过离线模型共置与在线请求/令牌重调度协同，显著减少all-to-all通信，实验在SGLANG上验证其吞吐量提升。
AI.keywords: MoE，专家并行，all-to-all通信，模型-数据协同调度，语义并行，推理优化
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体模型规模、硬件配置、能耗评估及与最新EP+TP混合策略的对比细节。

title: SEED: Towards More Accurate Semantic Evaluation for Visual Brain Decoding
summary: We present SEED (Semantic Evaluation for Visual Brain Decoding), a novel metric for evaluating the semantic decoding performance of visual brain decoding models. It integrates three complementary metrics, each capturing a different aspect of semantic similarity between images inspired by neuroscientific findings. Using carefully crowd-sourced human evaluation data, we demonstrate that SEED achieves the highest alignment with human evaluation, outperforming other widely used metrics. Through the evaluation of existing visual brain decoding models with SEED, we further reveal that crucial information is often lost in translation, even in the state-of-the-art models that achieve near-perfect scores on existing metrics. This finding highlights the limitations of current evaluation practices and provides guidance for future improvements in decoding models. Finally, to facilitate further research, we open-source the human evaluation data, encouraging the development of more advanced evaluation methods for brain decoding. Our code and the human evaluation data are available at https://github.com/Concarne2/SEED.

AI.title_translation: SEED：迈向视觉脑解码语义评估的更高精度
AI.tldr: 提出名为SEED的新指标，通过融合三种互补的语义相似度度量，显著优于现有评估方式，并揭示当前模型在语义层面仍存在关键信息丢失。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉脑解码模型评估指标与人类主观判断不一致，无法充分反映模型在语义层面的真实表现，亟需更准确的评估方法。
AI.method: 综合三种受神经科学启发的互补语义相似度指标，构建SEED评估体系，并采集众包人类评价数据对指标进行验证与对比。
AI.result: SEED与人类评估的契合度最高，显著优于其他常用指标；即使现有最先进模型在旧指标上得分接近完美，用SEED评估仍发现大量语义信息损失。
AI.conclusion: 当前评估实践存在局限，SEED能更好指导未来解码模型改进；作者开源人类评估数据以促进后续研究。
AI.translation: 我们提出SEED（视觉脑解码语义评估），一种评估视觉脑解码模型语义解码性能的新指标。它整合三种互补指标，分别捕捉受神经科学启发的图像间语义相似性的不同方面。借助精心众包的人类评估数据，我们证明SEED与人类评估的一致性最高，优于其他广泛使用的指标。通过用SEED评估现有视觉脑解码模型，我们进一步发现，即使在现有指标上得分近乎完美的最先进模型，也会在翻译过程中丢失关键信息。该发现凸显当前评估实践的局限，并为未来解码模型的改进提供指导。最后，为促进进一步研究，我们开源人类评估数据，鼓励开发更先进的脑解码评估方法。代码和数据见https://github.com/Concarne2/SEED。
AI.summary: 本文提出新评估指标SEED，用于更准确衡量视觉脑解码模型的语义保真度。SEED融合三种互补语义相似度度量，经众包人类评价验证，其与人类判断的一致性显著优于现有指标。对当前模型的再评估显示，即使顶级模型在旧指标上表现优异，仍存在语义信息缺失，提示需改进模型与评估标准。作者已开源数据与代码。
AI.keywords: 视觉脑解码；语义评估；SEED指标；人类评价；信息丢失；开源数据
AI.comments: 该研究填补了视觉脑解码领域语义评估的空白，SEED指标有望成为新的标准，推动模型在真实语义保真度上的提升。

title: WonderVerse: Extendable 3D Scene Generation with Video Generative Models
summary: We introduce \textit{WonderVerse}, a simple but effective framework for generating extendable 3D scenes. Unlike existing methods that rely on iterative depth estimation and image inpainting, often leading to geometric distortions and inconsistencies, WonderVerse leverages the powerful world-level priors embedded within video generative foundation models to create highly immersive and geometrically coherent 3D environments. Furthermore, we propose a new technique for controllable 3D scene extension to substantially increase the scale of the generated environments. Besides, we introduce a novel abnormal sequence detection module that utilizes camera trajectory to address geometric inconsistency in the generated videos. Finally, WonderVerse is compatible with various 3D reconstruction methods, allowing both efficient and high-quality generation. Extensive experiments on 3D scene generation demonstrate that our WonderVerse, with an elegant and simple pipeline, delivers extendable and highly-realistic 3D scenes, markedly outperforming existing works that rely on more complex architectures.

AI.title_translation: WonderVerse：利用视频生成模型进行可扩展3D场景生成
AI.tldr: WonderVerse利用视频生成基础模型的世界先验，避免迭代深度估计与图像修复，实现几何一致的可扩展3D场景，并引入相机轨迹异常检测模块，兼容多种3D重建方法，实验显示其简洁流程优于复杂架构。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖迭代深度估计和图像修复，导致几何畸变与不一致，亟需利用视频生成模型内嵌的世界级先验来构建几何一致且可扩展的沉浸式3D环境。
AI.method: 框架核心是用视频生成基础模型替代传统深度估计与修复；提出可控3D场景扩展技术以扩大环境规模；引入基于相机轨迹的异常序列检测模块以消除几何不一致；保持与多种3D重建方法的兼容性。
AI.result: 在3D场景生成任务的大量实验中，WonderVerse以简洁流程生成可扩展且高度真实的3D场景，显著优于采用更复杂架构的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: WonderVerse证明利用视频生成模型的世界先验可简洁高效地实现几何一致、可扩展且逼真的3D场景生成，为后续3D内容创作与重建提供通用且高性能的框架。
AI.translation: 我们提出WonderVerse，一个简单却有效的可扩展3D场景生成框架。与依赖迭代深度估计和图像修复、常导致几何畸变与不一致的现有方法不同，WonderVerse利用嵌入视频生成基础模型的强大世界级先验，创建高度沉浸且几何一致的3D环境。此外，我们提出可控3D场景扩展新技术，显著扩大生成环境规模；并引入基于相机轨迹的异常序列检测模块，解决生成视频中的几何不一致。最后，WonderVerse兼容多种3D重建方法，实现高效且高质量的生成。大量3D场景生成实验表明，WonderVerse以优雅简洁的流水线交付可扩展且高度真实的3D场景，明显优于依赖更复杂架构的现有工作。
AI.summary: WonderVerse通过视频生成基础模型的世界先验，跳过传统深度估计与修复，实现几何一致、可扩展的3D场景生成，并辅以相机轨迹异常检测与兼容多种重建方法，实验验证其简洁流程在真实感与扩展性上优于复杂架构。
AI.keywords: 3D场景生成，视频生成模型，可扩展环境，几何一致性，相机轨迹异常检测
AI.comments: 摘要未披露技术细节（如具体视频模型、扩展控制机制、重建兼容性实现）及定量指标，需查阅全文获取；对计算成本与实时性也未提及。

title: A categorical perspective on constraint satisfaction: The wonderland of adjunctions
comments: Reorganisation since the last version, including new definitions and clearer proofs. Some sections were omitted from this version. 14+2 pages
summary:
The so-called algebraic approach to the constraint satisfaction problem (CSP) has been a prevalent method of the study of complexity of these problems since early 2000's. The core of this approach is the notion of *polymorphisms* which determine the complexity of the problem (up to log-space reductions). In the past few years, a new, more general version of the CSP emerged, the promise constraint satisfaction problem (PCSP), and the notion of polymorphisms and most of the core theses of the algebraic approach were generalised to the promise setting. Nevertheless, recent work also suggests that insights from other fields are immensely useful in the study of PCSPs including algebraic topology.
  In this paper, we provide an entry point for category-theorists into the study of complexity of CSPs and PCSPs. We show that many standard CSP notions have clear and well-known categorical counterparts. For example, the algebraic structure of polymorphisms can be described as a set-functor defined as a right Kan extension. We provide purely categorical proofs of core results of the algebraic approach including a proof that the complexity only depends on the polymorphisms. Our new proofs are substantially shorter and, from the categorical perspective, cleaner than previous proofs of the same results. Moreover, as expected, are applicable more widely. We believe that, in particular in the case of PCSPs, category theory brings insights that can help solve some of the current challenges of the field.

AI.title_translation: 范畴论视角下的约束满足：伴随的奇妙世界
AI.tldr: 本文用范畴论重述约束满足问题（CSP）及其承诺版本（PCSP），证明多态性等核心概念可简洁地用右Kan扩张等范畴构造表达，并给出更短、更通用的代数复杂性结论证明。
AI.motivation: 传统代数方法虽能刻画CSP/PCSP复杂性，但证明冗长且难以推广；作者希望借助范畴论提供更简洁、统一且易推广的视角，并为解决PCSP当前难题带来新洞察。
AI.method: 将CSP/PCSP的基本对象与态射翻译成范畴语言，把多态性描述为Set上的自函子并通过右Kan扩张构造，用伴随和函子范畴给出复杂性仅依赖多态性的纯范畴证明。
AI.result: 获得比经典证明更短、更清晰的范畴化证明；表明代数结构可自然升维到函子层面；为PCSP研究提供新的抽象工具与视角。
AI.conclusion: 范畴论不仅简化并统一了CSP/PCSP的代数理论，还因其高度抽象性可望帮助解决PCSP领域尚未克服的挑战。
AI.translation: 所谓CSP的代数方法自2000年代初以来一直是研究其复杂性的主流，核心是多态性决定复杂度（在对数空间归约下）。近年兴起的承诺约束满足问题（PCSP）将这一概念与代数方法推广至更一般场景，但亦显示代数拓扑等领域洞见极具价值。本文向范畴论学者敞开CSP/PCSP复杂性研究之门，展示标准CSP概念皆有清晰范畴对应：多态性的代数结构可表为右Kan扩张的集函子；我们以纯范畴方式重证核心结论——复杂度仅取决于多态性，证明更短更干净且适用范围更广。我们相信，对PCSP而言，范畴论能带来解决当下挑战的新洞察。
AI.summary: 文章用范畴论重写CSP/PCSP的代数理论，将多态性解释为右Kan扩张，给出复杂度依赖多态性的简洁证明，并指出该视角对攻克PCSP开放问题具潜力。
AI.keywords: 约束满足问题，承诺CSP，多态性，范畴论，伴随，Kan扩张，复杂性
AI.comments: 摘要未提实验或具体复杂度分类结果；未说明新证明是否已导出全新可解性边界；亦未讨论与拓扑方法的具体结合点。

title: VISIONLOGIC: From Neuron Activations to Causally Grounded Concept Rules for Vision Models
summary: While concept-based explanations improve interpretability over local attributions, they often rely on correlational signals and lack causal validation. We introduce VisionLogic, a novel neural-symbolic framework that produces faithful, hierarchical explanations as global logical rules over causally validated concepts. VisionLogic first learns activation thresholds that abstract neuron activations into predicates, then induces class-level logical rules from these predicates. It then grounds predicates to visual concepts via ablation-based causal tests with iterative region refinement, ensuring that discovered concepts correspond to features that are causal for predicate activation. Across different vision architectures such as CNNs and ViTs, it produces interpretable concepts and compact rules that largely preserve the original model's predictive performance. In our large-scale human evaluations, VisionLogic's concept explanations significantly improve participants' understanding of model behavior over prior concept-based methods.

AI.title_translation: VISIONLOGIC：从神经元激活到视觉模型的因果概念规则
AI.tldr: VisionLogic提出神经符号框架，将神经元激活抽象为谓词并通过因果验证生成全局逻辑规则，实现高保真且可解释的视觉概念解释。
AI.motivation: 现有概念解释依赖相关性信号，缺乏因果验证，难以忠实反映模型行为，需要可解释且因果可靠的全局解释方法。
AI.method: 1)学习激活阈值将神经元激活转为谓词；2)基于谓词归纳类别级逻辑规则；3)通过基于消融的因果测试与迭代区域精化将谓词锚定到视觉概念，确保概念对谓词激活具有因果性。
AI.result: 在CNN与ViT等多种视觉架构上，VisionLogic生成可解释概念与紧凑规则，基本保持原模型预测性能；大规模人工评估显示其概念解释显著优于先前方法，显著提升参与者对模型行为的理解。
AI.conclusion: VisionLogic通过因果验证的概念规则提供高保真全局解释，兼顾模型性能与人类可理解性，为视觉模型可解释性提供有效途径。
AI.translation: 虽然基于概念的解释比局部归因更具可解释性，但它们常依赖相关信号且缺乏因果验证。我们提出VisionLogic，一种新型神经符号框架，能以全局逻辑规则形式提供忠实、分层的解释，这些规则建立在经过因果验证的概念之上。VisionLogic首先学习激活阈值，将神经元激活抽象为谓词，然后从谓词中归纳出类级逻辑规则。接着，它通过基于消融的因果测试与迭代区域精化将谓词锚定到视觉概念，确保发现的概念对应于对谓词激活具有因果性的特征。在CNN与ViT等不同视觉架构上，它生成的可解释概念与紧凑规则基本保持原模型的预测性能。在我们的大规模人工评估中，VisionLogic的概念解释显著优于先前基于概念的方法，显著提升参与者对模型行为的理解。
AI.summary: VisionLogic提出神经符号框架，将神经元激活抽象为谓词并通过因果验证生成全局逻辑规则，实现高保真且可解释的视觉概念解释。
AI.keywords: 可解释性,概念解释,因果验证,神经符号,全局规则,视觉模型

title: A Survey on Federated Fine-tuning of Large Language Models
comments: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive success across various tasks. Integrating LLMs with Federated Learning (FL), a paradigm known as FedLLM, offers a promising avenue for collaborative model adaptation while preserving data privacy. This survey provides a systematic and comprehensive review of FedLLM. We begin by tracing the historical development of both LLMs and FL, summarizing relevant prior research to set the context. Subsequently, we delve into an in-depth analysis of the fundamental challenges inherent in deploying FedLLM. Addressing these challenges often requires efficient adaptation strategies; therefore, we conduct an extensive examination of existing Parameter-Efficient Fine-tuning (PEFT) methods and explore their applicability within the FL framework. To rigorously evaluate the performance of FedLLM, we undertake a thorough review of existing fine-tuning datasets and evaluation benchmarks. Furthermore, we discuss FedLLM's diverse real-world applications across multiple domains. Finally, we identify critical open challenges and outline promising research directions to foster future advancements in FedLLM. This survey aims to serve as a foundational resource for researchers and practitioners, offering valuable insights into the rapidly evolving landscape of federated fine-tuning for LLMs. It also establishes a roadmap for future innovations in privacy-preserving AI. We actively maintain a \href{https://github.com/Clin0212/Awesome-Federated-LLM-Learning}{GitHub repo} to track cutting-edge advancements in this field.

title: A Survey on the Optimization of Large Language Model-based Agents
comments: Published in ACM Computing Surveys, Vol. 58, No. 9, Article 223, July 2026
summary: With the rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs), LLM-based agents have been widely adopted in various fields, becoming essential for autonomous decision-making and interactive tasks. However, current work typically relies on prompt design or fine-tuning strategies applied to vanilla LLMs, which often leads to limited effectiveness or suboptimal performance in complex agent-related environments. Although LLM optimization techniques can improve model performance across many general tasks, they lack specialized optimization towards critical agent functionalities such as long-term planning, dynamic environmental interaction, and complex decision-making. Although numerous recent studies have explored various strategies to optimize LLM-based agents for complex agent tasks, a systematic review summarizing and comparing these methods from a holistic perspective is still lacking. In this survey, we provide a comprehensive review of LLM-based agent optimization approaches, categorizing them into parameter-driven and parameter-free methods. We first focus on parameter-driven optimization, covering fine-tuning-based optimization, reinforcement learning-based optimization, and hybrid strategies, analyzing key aspects such as trajectory data construction, fine-tuning techniques, reward function design, and optimization algorithms. Additionally, we briefly discuss parameter-free strategies that optimize agent behavior through prompt engineering and external knowledge retrieval. Finally, we summarize the datasets and benchmarks used for evaluation and tuning, review key applications of LLM-based agents, and discuss major challenges and promising future directions. Our repository for related references is available at https://github.com/YoungDubbyDu/LLM-Agent-Optimization.

title: Towards the Usage of Window Counting Constraints in the Synthesis of Reactive Systems to Reduce State Space Explosion
comments: 31 pages, 11 figures, extended version of arXiv:2410.21884, submitted to LMCS
summary: The synthesis of reactive systems aims for the automated construction of strategies for systems that interact with their environment. Whereas the synthesis approach has the potential to change the development of reactive systems significantly due to the avoidance of manual implementation, it still suffers from a lack of efficient synthesis algorithms for many application scenarios. The translation of the system specification into an automaton that allows for strategy construction (if a winning strategy exists) is nonelementary in the length of the specification in S1S and doubly exponential for LTL, raising the need of highly specialized algorithms. In this article, we present an approach on how to reduce this state space explosion in the construction of this automaton by exploiting a monotonicity property of specifications. For this, we introduce window counting constraints that allow for step-wise refinement or abstraction of specifications. In an iterative synthesis procedure, those window counting constraints are used to construct automata representing over- or under-approximations (depending on the counting constraint) of constraint-compliant behavior. Analysis results on winning regions of previous iterations are used to reduce the size of the next automaton, leading to an overall reduction of the state space explosion extent. We present the implementation results of the iterated synthesis for a zero-sum game setting as proof of concept. Furthermore, we discuss the current limitations of the approach in a zero-sum setting and sketch future work in non-zero-sum settings.

title: Towards Trustworthy GUI Agents: A Survey
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents extend large language models from text generation to action execution in real-world digital environments. Unlike conversational systems, GUI agents perform irreversible operations such as submitting forms, granting permissions, or deleting data, making trustworthiness a core requirement. This survey identifies the execution gap as a key challenge in building trustworthy GUI agents: the misalignment between perception, reasoning, and interaction in dynamic, partially observable interfaces. We introduce a workflow-aligned taxonomy that decomposes trust into Perception Trust, Reasoning Trust, and Interaction Trust, showing how failures propagate across agent pipelines and compound through action/observation loops. We systematically review benign failure modes and adversarial attacks at each stage, together with corresponding defense mechanisms tailored to GUI settings. We further analyze evaluation practices and argue that task completion alone is insufficient for trust assessment. We highlight emerging trust-aware metrics and benchmarks that capture error cascades and the security/utility trade-off, and outline open challenges for deploying GUI agents safely and reliably.

title: Sobolev-Poincaré inequalities for piecewise $W^{1,p}$ functions over general polytopic meshes
summary: We establish Sobolev-Poincaré inequalities for piecewise $W^{1,p}$ functions over families of fairly general polytopic (thence also shape-regular simplicial and Cartesian) meshes in any dimension; amongst others, they cover the case of standard Poincaré inequalities for piecewise $W^{1,p}$ functions and can be useful in the analysis of nonconforming finite element discretizations of nonlinear problems. Crucial tools in their derivation are novel Sobolev-trace inequalities and $W^{1,p}$-stable right-inverses of the divergence satisfying mixed boundary conditions. We provide estimates with constants having an explicit dependence on the geometric properties of the domain and the underlying family of polytopic meshes.

title: The Price of Competitive Information Disclosure
comments: Added appendix proofs of Nash equilibrium existence for two game variants where the PoA analysis extends with minor changes. Accepted to STOC 2026
summary: In many decision-making scenarios, individuals strategically choose what information to disclose to optimize their own outcomes. It is unclear whether such strategic information disclosure can lead to good societal outcomes. To address this question, we consider a competitive Bayesian persuasion model in which multiple agents selectively disclose information about their qualities to a principal, who aims to choose the candidates with the highest qualities. Using the price-of-anarchy framework, we quantify the inefficiency of such strategic disclosure. We show that the price of anarchy is at most a constant when the agents have independent quality distributions, even if their utility functions are heterogeneous. This result provides the first theoretical guarantee on the limits of inefficiency in Bayesian persuasion with competitive information disclosure.

title: Enhancing Out-of-Distribution Detection with Extended Logit Normalization
summary: \noindent Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for the safe deployment of machine learning models. Extensive work has focused on devising various scoring functions for detecting OOD samples, while only a few studies focus on training neural networks using certain model calibration objectives, which often lead to a compromise in predictive accuracy and support only limited choices of scoring functions. In this work, we first identify the feature collapse phenomena in Logit Normalization (LogitNorm), then propose a novel hyperparameter-free formulation that significantly benefits a wide range of post-hoc detection methods. To be specific, we devise a feature distance-awareness loss term in addition to LogitNorm, termed $\textbf{ELogitNorm}$, which enables improved OOD detection and in-distribution (ID) confidence calibration. Extensive experiments across standard benchmarks demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art training-time methods in OOD detection while maintaining strong ID classification accuracy. Our code is available on: https://github.com/limchaos/ElogitNorm.

AI.title_translation: 基于扩展Logit归一化的分布外检测增强
