AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测方法多依赖特定打分函数，训练阶段引入校准目标常牺牲ID准确率且仅支持有限打分函数，需一种通用且不影响分类性能的训练框架。
AI.method: 在LogitNorm基础上增加特征距离感知损失，构建无超参的ELogitNorm训练目标，使网络同时优化ID分类与OOD判别能力。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，ELogitNorm在OOD检测性能优于现有训练阶段最佳方法，同时保持ID分类准确率；对多种后验打分函数均有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过缓解特征塌陷并引入距离感知损失，ELogitNorm实现训练阶段统一提升OOD检测与ID校准，无需额外超参即可广泛兼容后验方法。
AI.translation: 分布外检测对机器学习模型安全部署至关重要。大量研究致力于设计各种打分函数以识别OOD样本，而仅有少数工作关注利用模型校准目标训练网络，后者常导致预测准确率下降且仅支持有限打分函数。本文首先发现Logit归一化中的特征塌陷现象，随后提出一种无超参的新形式，显著惠及众多后验检测方法。具体而言，我们在LogitNorm基础上设计特征距离感知损失项，称为ELogitNorm，在提升OOD检测的同时改善分布内置信度校准。跨标准基准的大量实验表明，该方法在OOD检测上优于现有最佳训练阶段方法，并保持强劲的分布内分类准确率。代码见：https://github.com/limchaos/ElogitNorm。
AI.summary: ELogitNorm通过特征距离感知损失扩展LogitNorm，无超参地解决特征塌陷，在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet等基准上取得OOD检测新SOTA，同时保留ID准确率，对Energy、MSP、ODIN等多种后验打分函数均有效。
AI.keywords: 分布外检测,Logit归一化,特征塌陷,模型校准,距离感知损失
AI.comments: 方法简洁且无超参，易于插入现有训练流程；实验覆盖充分，但仅考虑视觉任务，未来可验证NLP等领域适用性。

title: Diffusion Generative Recommendation with Continuous Tokens
comments: Accepted by The ACM Web Conference (WWW 2026)
summary: Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence, particularly large language models (LLMs), have opened new opportunities for enhancing recommender systems (RecSys). Most existing LLM-based RecSys approaches operate in a discrete space, using vector-quantized tokenizers to align with the inherent discrete nature of language models. However, these quantization methods often result in lossy tokenization and suboptimal learning, primarily due to inaccurate gradient propagation caused by the non-differentiable argmin operation in standard vector quantization. Inspired by the emerging trend of embracing continuous tokens in language models, we propose ContRec, a novel framework that seamlessly integrates continuous tokens into LLM-based RecSys. Specifically, ContRec consists of two key modules: a sigma-VAE Tokenizer, which encodes users/items with continuous tokens; and a Dispersive Diffusion module, which captures implicit user preference. The tokenizer is trained with a continuous Variational Auto-Encoder (VAE) objective, where three effective techniques are adopted to avoid representation collapse. By conditioning on the previously generated tokens of the LLM backbone during user modeling, the Dispersive Diffusion module performs a conditional diffusion process with a novel Dispersive Loss, enabling high-quality user preference generation through next-token diffusion. Finally, ContRec leverages both the textual reasoning output from the LLM and the latent representations produced by the diffusion model for Top-K item retrieval, thereby delivering comprehensive recommendation results. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that ContRec consistently outperforms both traditional and SOTA LLM-based recommender systems. Our results highlight the potential of continuous tokenization and generative modeling for advancing the next generation of recommender systems.

title: An Efficient LiDAR-Camera Fusion Network for Multi-Class 3D Dynamic Object Detection and Trajectory Prediction
summary: Service mobile robots are often required to avoid dynamic objects while performing their tasks, but they usually have only limited computational resources. To further advance the practical application of service robots in complex dynamic environments, we propose an efficient multi-modal framework for 3D object detection and trajectory prediction, which synergistically integrates LiDAR and camera inputs to achieve real-time perception of pedestrians, vehicles, and riders in 3D space.The framework incorporates two novel models: 1) a Unified modality detector with Mamba and Transformer (UniMT) for object detection, which achieves high-accuracy object detection with fast inference speed, and 2) a Reference Trajectory-based Multi-Class Transformer (RTMCT) for efficient and diverse trajectory prediction of multi-class objects with flexible-length trajectories. Evaluations on the CODa benchmark demonstrate that our method outperforms existing ones in both detection (+3.71\% in mAP) and trajectory prediction (-0.408m in minADE$_5$ of pedestrians) metrics. Furthermore, on the challenging nuScenes detection benchmark, our detection model achieves competitive performance among LiDAR-camera fusion methods, with a mAP of 72.7\% and NDS of 75.3\%. Remarkably, the system demonstrates exceptional generalizability and practical deployment potential. When transferred and implemented on a wheelchair robot with an entry-level NVIDIA RTX 3060 GPU, it achieves real-time inference at 13.9 frames per second (FPS) with satisfactory accuracy. To facilitate reproducibility and practical deployment, we release the related code of the method at \href{https://github.com/TossherO/3D_Perception}{https://github.com/TossherO/3D\_Perception} and its ROS inference version at \href{https://github.com/TossherO/ros_packages}{https://github.com/TossherO/ros\_packages}.

title: CONTINA: Confidence Interval for Traffic Demand Prediction with Coverage Guarantee
comments: Accepted in Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
summary: Accurate short-term traffic demand prediction is critical for the operation of traffic systems. Besides point estimation, the confidence interval of the prediction is also of great importance. Many models for traffic operations, such as shared bike rebalancing and taxi dispatching, take into account the uncertainty of future demand and require confidence intervals as the input. However, existing methods for confidence interval modeling rely on strict assumptions, such as unchanging traffic patterns and correct model specifications, to guarantee enough coverage. Therefore, the confidence intervals provided could be invalid, especially in a changing traffic environment. To fill this gap, we propose an efficient method, CONTINA (Conformal Traffic Intervals with Adaptation) to provide interval predictions that can adapt to external changes. By collecting the errors of interval during deployment, the method can adjust the interval in the next step by widening it if the errors are too large or shortening it otherwise. Furthermore, we theoretically prove that the coverage of the confidence intervals provided by our method converges to the target coverage level. Experiments across four real-world datasets and prediction models demonstrate that the proposed method can provide valid confidence intervals with shorter lengths. Our method can help traffic management personnel develop a more reasonable and robust operation plan in practice. And we release the code, model and dataset in \href{ https://github.com/xiannanhuang/CONTINA/}{ Github}.
comment: Accepted in Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies

AI.title_translation: CONTINA：具备覆盖保证的交通需求预测置信区间
AI.tldr: 提出CONTINA方法，在无需严格假设下为交通需求预测提供自适应置信区间，理论保证覆盖并缩短区间长度。
AI.motivation: 现有置信区间方法依赖交通模式不变和模型正确等假设，在动态交通环境中可能失效，亟需无假设且能自适应的区间预测技术。
AI.method: 构建CONTINA（Conformal Traffic Intervals with Adaptation），部署时收集区间误差，依据误差大小动态扩缩下一时刻区间，并给出覆盖收敛理论证明。
AI.result: 在四个真实数据集与多种预测模型上，CONTINA提供有效覆盖且区间长度更短。
AI.conclusion: CONTINA能在实际交通管理中提供可靠且短的置信区间，支持更稳健的运营计划；代码、模型与数据已公开。
AI.translation: 准确的短期交通需求预测对交通系统运营至关重要。除点估计外，预测的置信区间同样关键。许多交通运营模型（如共享单车再平衡、出租车调度）需考虑未来需求不确定性，并以置信区间作为输入。然而，现有置信区间建模方法依赖交通模式不变、模型设定正确等严格假设才能保证覆盖，在变化的交通环境中区间可能失效。为此，我们提出高效方法CONTINA（Conformal Traffic Intervals with Adaptation），提供可适应外部变化的区间预测。通过在部署阶段收集区间误差，该方法可在下一步据误差扩缩区间，并理论证明其覆盖收敛至目标水平。在四个真实数据集和预测模型上的实验表明，该方法能提供有效且更短的置信区间，帮助交通管理人员制定更合理稳健的营运计划。代码、模型和数据已发布于Github。
AI.summary: CONTINA利用共形预测框架，在部署时实时校正区间宽度，无需假设数据分布或模型正确，即可在动态交通环境中保持目标覆盖并缩短区间长度。
AI.keywords: 交通需求预测；置信区间；共形预测；自适应；覆盖保证
AI.comments: 摘要清晰阐述问题与贡献，理论保证与实验验证并重，并公开资源，利于复现与落地。

title: Effective Reinforcement Learning Control using Conservative Soft Actor-Critic
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown great potential in complex control tasks, particularly when combined with deep neural networks within the Actor-Critic (AC) framework. However, in practical applications, balancing exploration, learning stability, and sample efficiency remains a significant challenge. Traditional methods such as Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) address these issues by incorporating entropy or relative entropy regularization, but often face problems of instability and low sample efficiency. In this paper, we propose the Conservative Soft Actor-Critic (CSAC) algorithm, which seamlessly integrates entropy and relative entropy regularization within the AC framework. CSAC improves exploration through entropy regularization while avoiding overly aggressive policy updates with the use of relative entropy regularization. Evaluations on benchmark tasks and real-world robotic simulations demonstrate that CSAC offers significant improvements in stability and efficiency over existing methods. These findings suggest that CSAC provides strong robustness and application potential in control tasks under dynamic environments.

AI.title_translation: 基于保守型软演员-评论家的高效强化学习控制
AI.tldr: 提出保守型软演员-评论家(CSAC)，通过同时引入熵与相对熵正则化，在保持探索性的同时抑制激进策略更新，实现稳定性与样本效率提升。

AI.method: 在演员-评论家框架内融合熵正则化(促进探索)与相对熵正则化(抑制策略剧变)，形成保守型软演员-评论家(CSAC)算法。
AI.result: 在基准任务与真实机器人仿真中，CSAC相比SAC、PPO等现有方法在稳定性与样本效率上显著提升。

title: Improved Rank Aggregation under Fairness Constraint
comments: Page 3: Fixed typo in triangle inequality. Page 17: Added link to code repository. Page 19: Improved readability of some graphs
summary:
Aggregating multiple input rankings into a consensus ranking is essential in various fields such as social choice theory, hiring, college admissions, web search, and databases. A major challenge is that the optimal consensus ranking might be biased against individual candidates or groups, especially those from marginalized communities. This concern has led to recent studies focusing on fairness in rank aggregation. The goal is to ensure that candidates from different groups are fairly represented in the top-$k$ positions of the aggregated ranking.
  We study this fair rank aggregation problem by considering the Kendall tau as the underlying metric. While we know of a polynomial-time approximation scheme (PTAS) for the classical rank aggregation problem, the corresponding fair variant only possesses a quite straightforward 3-approximation algorithm due to Wei et al., SIGMOD'22, and Chakraborty et al., NeurIPS'22, which finds closest fair ranking for each input ranking and then simply outputs the best one.
  In this paper, we first provide a novel algorithm that achieves $(2+ε)$-approximation (for any $ε> 0$), significantly improving over the 3-approximation bound. Next, we provide a $2.881$-approximation fair rank aggregation algorithm that works irrespective of the fairness notion, given one can find a closest fair ranking, beating the 3-approximation bound. We complement our theoretical guarantee by performing extensive experiments on various real-world datasets to establish the effectiveness of our algorithm further by comparing it with the performance of state-of-the-art algorithms.

AI.title_translation: 公平约束下的改进排序聚合
AI.tldr: 提出两种新算法，将公平排序聚合的近似比从3提升至2+ε和2.881，并在真实数据上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 经典排序聚合可能歧视边缘群体，现有公平版本仅能达到3-近似，亟需更高精度的算法。
AI.method: 以Kendall tau 为距离，先设计(2+ε)-近似PTAS，再提出通用2.881-近似算法，只要可找到最近公平排序即可；最后对比实验验证。
AI.result: 理论近似比显著优于现有3-近似；实验在多组真实数据集上表现优于当前最佳算法。
AI.conclusion: 首次突破公平排序聚合3-近似界限，提供更快更准的实用算法。
AI.translation: 在各种领域（如社会选择、招聘、大学录取、网页搜索和数据库）中，将多个输入排序合并为共识排序至关重要。主要挑战在于最优共识排序可能对个别候选者或群体（尤其是边缘化社区）存在偏见。这促使近期研究关注排序聚合中的公平性，目标是确保不同群体的候选者在聚合排序的前k位中得到公平代表。本文以Kendall tau 作为基础度量研究该公平排序聚合问题。尽管经典排序聚合存在多项式时间近似方案（PTAS），相应的公平变体仅拥有一个相当直接的3-近似算法（Wei 等 SIGMOD'22；Chakraborty 等 NeurIPS'22），该算法为每个输入排序找到最近的公平排序后简单输出最佳者。本文首先提出一种新算法，达到(2+ε)-近似（任意ε>0），显著超越3-近似界。其次，我们给出一个2.881-近似公平排序聚合算法，只要能为任意排序找到最近公平排序即可工作，打破3-近似界。我们通过在多个真实数据集上的大量实验补充理论保证，进一步确立算法相较于现有最佳算法的有效性。
AI.summary: 针对公平排序聚合，本文提出两种新算法，分别实现(2+ε)和2.881的近似比，突破原有的3-近似界限，并在真实数据上验证其优势。
AI.keywords: 排序聚合,公平性,Kendall tau,近似算法,多项式时间近似方案
AI.comments: 未提及运行时间、内存消耗及公平性定义的具体实现细节。

title: Regularity and Stability Properties of Selective SSMs with Discontinuous Gating
summary: Deep selective State-Space Models (SSMs), whose state-space parameters are modulated online by a selection signal, offer significant expressive power but pose challenges for stability analysis, especially under discontinuous gating. We study continuous-time selective SSMs through the lenses of passivity and Input-to-State Stability (ISS), explicitly distinguishing the selection schedule $x(\cdot)$ from the driving (port) input $u(\cdot)$. First, we show that state-strict dissipativity ($β>0$) together with quadratic bounds on a storage functional implies exponential decay of homogeneous trajectories ($u\equiv 0$), yielding exponential forgetting. Second, by freezing the selection ($x(t)\equiv 0$) we obtain a passive LTV input-output subsystem and prove that its minimal available storage is necessarily quadratic, $V_{a,0}(t,h)=\tfrac{1}{2}h^H Q_0(t)h,$ with $Q_0 \in \mathrm{AUC}_{\mathrm{loc}}$, accommodating discontinuities induced by gating. Third, under the strong hypothesis that a single quadratic storage certifies passivity uniformly over all admissible selection schedules, we derive a parametric LMI and universal kernel constraints on gating, formalizing an "irreversible forgetting" structure. Finally, we give sufficient conditions for global ISS with respect to the port input $u(\cdot)$, uniformly over admissible selection schedules, and we validate the main predictions in targeted simulation studies.

AI.title_translation: 具有不连续门控的选择性状态空间模型的正则性与稳定性性质
AI.tldr: 论文用无源性与输入-状态稳定性（ISS）框架，系统分析了带在线选择信号调制的连续时间选择性状态空间模型（SSM），给出指数遗忘、被动存储及全局ISS的充要条件，并揭示门控需满足的不可逆遗忘结构。
AI.motivation: 深度选择性SSM虽表达能力强，但在线调制参数的不连续门控使其稳定性分析极具挑战，亟需建立可解释的理论工具以保证模型可控性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 将选择调度x(·)与端口输入u(·)分离，引入状态严格耗散(β>0)与二次存储函数；2) 冻结选择得到被动LTV子系统，证明其最小可用存储为二次型且Q0∈AUC_loc以容纳门控跳变；3) 假设存在统一二次存储证明所有可接受选择调度下的无源性，导出参数LMI与核约束；4) 给出关于u(·)的全局ISS充分条件并在仿真中验证。
AI.result: 1) 状态严格耗散+二次界⇒零输入时指数遗忘；2) 被动LTV子系统的最小可用存储必为二次型，Q0可局部绝对一致连续；3) 统一无源性要求门控满足不可逆遗忘结构，可用参数LMI刻画；4) 在满足LMI与核约束条件下，系统对所有可接受选择调度关于u(·)全局ISS；仿真结果与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过无源性与ISS视角，论文首次为不连续门控选择性SSM提供了指数遗忘、被动存储及全局输入鲁棒性的系统理论保证，并给出可验证的LMI设计准则。
AI.translation: 我们研究了深度选择性状态空间模型（SSM），其状态空间参数由在线选择信号调制，具有强大表达能力但在不连续门控下稳定性分析困难。本文从无源性与输入-状态稳定性（ISS）角度分析连续时间选择性SSM，明确区分选择调度x(·)与驱动输入u(·)。首先证明状态严格耗散(β>0)配合二次存储界可导出零输入时指数遗忘；其次冻结选择得到被动LTV子系统，证明其最小可用存储必为二次型且Q0∈AUC_loc以容纳门控不连续；进而假设存在统一二次存储证明对所有可接受选择调度的无源性，导出参数LMI与核约束，形式化“不可逆遗忘”结构；最后给出关于u(·)的全局ISS充分条件并在仿真中验证。
AI.summary: 本文针对带不连续门控的连续时间选择性SSM，建立无源性与ISS分析框架，证明状态严格耗散可指数遗忘、被动LTV子系统存储必为二次型，并给出统一无源性下的LMI与不可逆遗忘约束，最终提供全局ISS充分条件及仿真验证。
AI.keywords: 选择性状态空间模型,不连续门控,无源性,输入-状态稳定性,指数遗忘,参数LMI
AI.comments: 论文理论严谨，首次将无源性工具用于选择性SSM，给出可验证的LMI准则，对设计鲁棒门控机制具有指导意义；后续可拓展到离散时间或更复杂调制策略。

title: EAMET: Robust Massive Model Editing via Embedding Alignment Optimization
comments: This paper was accepted to ICLR 2026
summary: Model editing techniques are essential for efficiently updating knowledge in large language models (LLMs). However, the effectiveness of existing approaches degrades in massive editing scenarios, particularly when evaluated with practical metrics. Their robustness is also limited in context-rich settings or when editing multiple facts of the same subject simultaneously. We attribute these failures to the embedding misalignment among knowledge items, which undermines editing reliability at scale. To address this, we propose EAMET (Embedding Alignment Model Editing in Transformers), which addresses this issue by aligning the space of key and residual embeddings. Extensive experiments across six LLMs and three datasets demonstrate that EAMET consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving about 90\% editing efficacy when editing 10k facts. Codes and datasets are publicly available at https://ybdai7.github.io/eamet-page/.
comment: This paper was accepted to ICLR 2026

AI.title_translation: EAMET：通过嵌入对齐优化实现鲁棒的大规模模型编辑
AI.tldr: EAMET 通过优化 key 与残差嵌入对齐，在 10k 事实编辑下仍保持约 90% 编辑成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有模型编辑方法在大规模、多事实或上下文丰富的真实场景中失效，主因是知识项的嵌入未对齐导致可靠性下降。
AI.method: 提出 EAMET，在 Transformer 内显式对齐 key 嵌入与残差嵌入空间，以缓解大规模编辑时的嵌入错位问题。
AI.result: 在 6 个 LLM 与 3 个数据集上，EAMET 的编辑成功率显著优于现有方法，10k 事实编辑下仍维持约 90% 效能。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入对齐是提升大规模模型编辑鲁棒性的关键，EAMET 为高效更新 LLM 知识提供了可行方案。
AI.translation: 模型编辑技术对于高效更新大语言模型（LLM）中的知识至关重要。然而，现有方法在大规模编辑场景中的有效性下降，尤其是在使用实际指标评估时。它们在上下文丰富或同时编辑同一主体的多条事实时鲁性也有限。我们将这些失败归因于知识项之间的嵌入错位，这削弱了大规模编辑的可靠性。为此，我们提出 EAMET（Transformer 中的嵌入对齐模型编辑），通过对 key 与残差嵌入空间进行对齐来解决该问题。在六个 LLM 和三个数据集上的大量实验表明，EAMET 持续优于现有方法，在编辑 1 万条事实时实现约 90% 的编辑效能。代码和数据集已在 https://ybdai7.github.io/eamet-page/ 公开。
AI.summary: EAMET 针对大规模模型编辑中因嵌入错位导致的失效问题，提出在 Transformer 内对齐 key 与残差嵌入空间，实验显示其在 10k 事实编辑下仍保持约 90% 成功率，显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 模型编辑, 大语言模型, 嵌入对齐, 大规模知识更新, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 方法简洁且开源，实验规模达 10k 编辑，结果可信；未来可验证在更大模型或持续编辑场景下的泛化能力。

title: MARVEL: Multi-Agent RTL Vulnerability Extraction using Large Language Models
summary: Hardware security verification is a challenging and time-consuming task. Design engineers may use formal verification, linting, and functional simulation tests, coupled with analysis and a deep understanding of the hardware design being inspected. Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used to assist during this task, either directly or in conjunction with existing tools. We improve the state of the art by proposing MARVEL, a multi-agent LLM framework for a unified approach to decision-making, tool use, and reasoning. MARVEL mimics the cognitive process of a designer looking for security vulnerabilities in RTL code. It consists of a supervisor agent that devises the security policy of the system-on-chips (SoCs) using its security documentation. It delegates tasks to validate the security policy to individual executor agents. Each executor agent carries out its assigned task using a particular strategy. Each executor agent may use one or more tools to identify potential security bugs in the design and send the results back to the supervisor agent for further analysis and confirmation. MARVEL includes executor agents that leverage formal tools, linters, simulation tests, LLM-based detection schemes, and static analysis-based checks. We test our approach on a known buggy SoC based on OpenTitan from the Hack@DATE competition. We find that of the 51 issues reported by MARVEL, 19 are valid security vulnerabilities, 14 are concrete warnings, and 18 are hallucinated reports.

AI.title_translation: MARVEL：利用大语言模型进行多智能体RTL漏洞提取
AI.tldr: 提出多智能体LLM框架MARVEL，模拟设计人员检查RTL代码安全漏洞的认知流程，在OpenTitan SoC上验证出19个真实漏洞。
AI.motivation: 硬件安全验证耗时且复杂，现有LLM辅助方法零散，需要统一框架整合决策、工具调用与推理。
AI.method: 构建包含监督智能体（制定安全策略）与多个执行智能体（分别采用形式化验证、lint、仿真、LLM检测、静态分析等策略）的多智能体系统，协同查找RTL安全漏洞。
AI.result: 在Hack@DATE竞赛的已知含漏洞OpenTitan SoC上，MARVEL报告51条问题，其中19条为有效安全漏洞，14条为具体警告，18条为误报。
AI.conclusion: MARVEL通过多智能体协作整合多种验证手段，可显著提升RTL安全漏洞发现效率与准确性。
AI.translation: 硬件安全验证是一项具有挑战性且耗时的任务。设计工程师可能会使用形式验证、lint和仿真测试，并结合深入理解被检硬件设计。大语言模型已被用于辅助此任务，直接或与现有工具结合。我们提出多智能体LLM框架MARVEL，统一决策、工具使用和推理，模拟设计人员查找RTL代码安全漏洞的认知过程。MARVEL包含监督智能体，根据安全文档制定SoC安全策略，并将验证任务委派给各执行智能体；执行智能体采用特定策略并调用一种或多种工具发现潜在安全缺陷，结果返回监督智能体分析确认。MARVEL集成形式化工具、lint、仿真测试、LLM检测和静态分析等执行智能体。我们在Hack@DATE竞赛的已知含漏洞OpenTitan SoC上测试，MARVEL报告的51条问题中，19条为有效安全漏洞，14条为具体警告，18条为误报。
AI.summary: MARVEL是一个多智能体大语言模型框架，通过监督与执行智能体协作，整合形式验证、lint、仿真、LLM检测和静态分析等手段，在OpenTitan SoC上成功识别出19个真实安全漏洞。
AI.keywords: 硬件安全验证,RTL漏洞,大语言模型,多智能体系统,SoC安全
AI.comments: 结果误报率35%，需进一步优化 hallucination 抑制策略。

title: RECON: Robust symmetry discovery via Explicit Canonical Orientation Normalization
summary: Real world data often exhibits unknown, instance-specific symmetries that rarely exactly match a transformation group $G$ fixed a priori. Class-pose decompositions aim to create disentangled representations by factoring inputs into invariant features and a pose $g\in G$ defined relative to a training-dependent, \emph{arbitrary} canonical representation. We introduce RECON, a class-pose agnostic \emph{canonical orientation normalization} that corrects arbitrary canonicals via a simple right translation, yielding \emph{natural}, data-aligned canonicalizations. This enables (i) unsupervised discovery of instance-specific pose distributions, (ii) detection of out-of-distribution poses and (iii) a plug-and-play \emph{test-time canonicalization layer}. This layer can be attached on top of any pre-trained model to infuse group invariance, improving its performance without retraining. We validate on images and molecular ensembles, demonstrating accurate symmetry discovery, and matching or outperforming other canonicalizations in downstream classification.

AI.title_translation: RECON：通过显式规范方向归一化实现鲁棒对称性发现
AI.tldr: RECON提出一种与类别-姿态无关的规范方向归一化方法，通过简单右变换修正任意规范表示，实现实例特定对称性的无监督发现，并可作为即插即用的测试时规范化层提升预训练模型性能。
AI.motivation: 真实数据常表现出未知且实例特定的对称性，而现有方法依赖先验固定的变换群G，难以处理与训练依赖的任意规范表示不匹配的情况，需要一种能自动发现实例特定对称性并修正规范表示的方法。
AI.method: 提出RECON方法，通过显式规范方向归一化，利用简单右变换修正训练依赖的任意规范表示，得到与数据对齐的自然规范化；同时设计可插拔的测试时规范化层，无需重训练即可为任意预训练模型注入群不变性。
AI.result: 在图像和分子集合上验证了RECON能准确发现对称性；在下游分类任务中匹配或优于其他规范化方法；可检测分布外姿态；作为测试时插件提升预训练模型性能。
AI.conclusion: RECON通过修正任意规范表示实现实例特定对称性的无监督发现，其即插即用特性可在不重新训练的情况下增强预训练模型的群不变性与性能。
AI.translation: RECON：通过显式规范方向归一化实现鲁棒对称性发现
AI.summary: 本文提出RECON方法，解决真实数据中实例特定对称性与先验固定变换群不匹配的问题。通过显式规范方向归一化修正训练依赖的任意规范表示，实现对称性无监督发现、分布外姿态检测，并可作为测试时插件提升预训练模型性能，实验验证了其在图像和分子数据上的有效性。
AI.keywords: 对称性发现, 规范方向归一化, 群不变性, 无监督学习, 测试时规范化
AI.comments: 文章思路清晰，将任意规范表示修正为数据对齐的自然表示具有创新性；测试时插件设计实用，可直接提升预训练模型性能；实验覆盖图像和分子数据，验证充分。未来可探索更复杂变换群或更高维数据的应用。

title: Language Models use Lookbacks to Track Beliefs
comments: 38 pages, 50 figures. Code and data at https://belief.baulab.info/
summary: How do language models (LMs) represent characters' beliefs, especially when those beliefs may differ from reality? This question lies at the heart of understanding the Theory of Mind (ToM) capabilities of LMs. We analyze LMs' ability to reason about characters' beliefs using causal mediation and abstraction. We construct a dataset, CausalToM, consisting of simple stories where two characters independently change the state of two objects, potentially unaware of each other's actions. Our investigation uncovers a pervasive algorithmic pattern that we call a lookback mechanism, which enables the LM to recall important information when it becomes necessary. The LM binds each character-object-state triple together by co-locating their reference information, represented as Ordering IDs (OIs), in low-rank subspaces of the state token's residual stream. When asked about a character's beliefs regarding the state of an object, the binding lookback retrieves the correct state OI and then the answer lookback retrieves the corresponding state token. When we introduce text specifying that one character is (not) visible to the other, we find that the LM first generates a visibility ID encoding the relation between the observing and the observed character OIs. In a visibility lookback, this ID is used to retrieve information about the observed character and update the observing character's beliefs. Our work provides insights into belief tracking mechanisms, taking a step toward reverse-engineering ToM reasoning in LMs.

AI.title_translation: 语言模型利用回溯追踪信念
AI.tldr: 本文发现语言模型通过一种“回溯机制”在简单故事中绑定并检索角色-物体-状态信息，实现信念追踪。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型在信念与现实不一致时如何表征角色信念，以揭示其心智理论能力。
AI.method: 构建CausalToM数据集，用因果中介与抽象分析，发现回溯机制：在残差流低秩子空间绑定Ordering IDs，并通过可见性ID更新信念。
AI.result: 模型通过绑定回溯检索正确状态OI，再通过答案回溯输出对应token；引入可见性信息后，用可见性回溯更新观察者信念。
AI.conclusion: 回溯机制为反向工程语言模型中的心智理论推理提供了机制性洞见。
AI.translation: 语言模型利用回溯来追踪信念
AI.summary: 本文研究语言模型如何表征角色信念。作者构建CausalToM数据集，发现模型采用“回溯机制”：将角色-物体-状态三元组绑定为Ordering IDs并存于低秩子空间，查询时先检索状态OI再检索对应token；引入可见性信息后，模型生成可见性ID并据此更新信念，为理解模型心智理论提供机制解释。

AI.comments: Not mentioned in abstract

title: HoloLLM: Multisensory Foundation Model for Language-Grounded Human Sensing and Reasoning
summary: Embodied agents operating in smart homes must understand human behavior through diverse sensory inputs and communicate via natural language. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled impressive language-grounded perception, their reliance on visual data limits robustness in real-world scenarios with occlusions, poor lighting, or privacy constraints. In this paper, we introduce HoloLLM, a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) that integrates uncommon but powerful sensing modalities, such as LiDAR, infrared, mmWave radar, and WiFi, to enable seamless human perception and reasoning across heterogeneous environments. We address two key challenges: (1) the scarcity of aligned modality-text data for rare sensors, and (2) the heterogeneity of their physical signal representations. To overcome these, we design a Universal Modality-Injection Projector (UMIP) that enhances pre-aligned modality embeddings with fine-grained, text-aligned features from tailored encoders via coarse-to-fine cross-attention without introducing significant alignment overhead. We further introduce a human-VLM collaborative data curation pipeline to generate paired textual annotations for sensing datasets. Extensive experiments on two newly constructed benchmarks show that HoloLLM significantly outperforms existing MLLMs, improving language-grounded human sensing accuracy by up to 30%. This work establishes a new foundation for real-world, language-informed multisensory embodied intelligence.

AI.title_translation: HoloLLM：面向语言引导的人体感知与推理的多感官基础模型
AI.tldr: 提出HoloLLM，通过融合LiDAR、红外、毫米波雷达与WiFi等稀缺传感模态，解决视觉受限场景下的人体感知，并设计UMIP模块与数据管道，显著超越现有MLLM。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在遮挡、光照差或隐私受限的真实场景中鲁棒性不足，需要利用非视觉传感实现可靠的人体感知与自然语言交互。

AI.result: 在两个新建基准上，HoloLLM较现有MLLM提升语言引导的人体感知准确率最高达30%。

AI.translation: HoloLLM：面向语言引导的人体感知与推理的多感官基础模型
AI.summary: HoloLLM整合LiDAR、红外、毫米波雷达与WiFi等稀缺模态，通过UMIP模块与协同数据标注流程，在视觉受限场景下显著增强语言对齐的人体感知与推理性能。
AI.keywords: 多模态大语言模型；人体感知；语言引导；LiDAR；毫米波雷达；WiFi；跨模态对齐；具身智能

title: RefLoRA: Refactored Low-Rank Adaptation for Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Models
comments: Accepted as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2025
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) lowers the computational and memory overhead of fine-tuning large models by updating a low-dimensional subspace of the pre-trained weight matrix. Albeit efficient, LoRA exhibits suboptimal convergence and noticeable performance degradation, due to inconsistent and imbalanced weight updates induced by its nonunique low-rank factorizations. To overcome these limitations, this article identifies the optimal low-rank factorization per step that minimizes an upper bound on the loss. The resultant refactored low-rank adaptation (RefLoRA) method promotes a flatter loss landscape, along with consistent and balanced weight updates, thus speeding up stable convergence. Extensive experiments evaluate RefLoRA on natural language understanding, and commonsense reasoning tasks with popular large language models including DeBERTaV3, LLaMA-7B, LLaMA2-7B and LLaMA3-8B. The numerical tests corroborate that RefLoRA converges faster, outperforms various benchmarks, and enjoys negligible computational overhead compared to state-of-the-art LoRA variants.
comment: Accepted as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2025

AI.title_translation: RefLoRA：面向大模型高效微调的重构低秩适配
AI.tldr: 提出RefLoRA，通过每步寻找最优低秩分解来最小化损失上界，实现更平稳收敛与均衡权重更新，在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下优于现有LoRA变体。
AI.motivation: LoRA虽能高效微调大模型，但因低秩分解不唯一导致权重更新不一致、不均衡，出现收敛慢、性能下降的问题，需改进其优化路径。
AI.method: 在每步训练中最小化损失上界，动态重构最优低秩分解，使权重更新保持一致与平衡，从而获得更平坦的损失曲面并加速稳定收敛。
AI.result: 在DeBERTaV3、LLaMA-7B、LLaMA2-7B、LLaMA3-8B的自然语言理解与常识推理任务上，RefLoRA收敛更快、性能优于多种基准，且计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: RefLoRA通过最优低秩分解重构有效克服LoRA的收敛与性能缺陷，为大模型参数高效微调提供了一种稳定且高效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 低秩适配（LoRA）通过仅更新预训练权重矩阵的低维子空间，降低大模型微调的计算与内存开销。虽然高效，但由于其低秩分解不唯一，导致权重更新不一致且不均衡，LoRA存在收敛次优和性能下降的问题。为克服这些局限，本文在每步确定使损失上界最小化的最优低秩分解。所得的重构低秩适配（RefLoRA）方法带来更平坦的损失曲面及一致、均衡的权重更新，从而加速稳定收敛。大量实验在自然语言理解和常识推理任务上评估RefLoRA，使用的主流大模型包括DeBERTaV3、LLaMA-7B、LLaMA2-7B和LLaMA3-8B。数值结果证实RefLoRA收敛更快，性能优于多种基准，且与最新LoRA变体相比计算开销可忽略。
AI.summary: RefLoRA在每步训练中最小化损失上界，动态寻找最优低秩分解，实现权重更新的一致与均衡，显著加快收敛并提升性能，且计算成本几乎不变。
AI.keywords: 低秩适配，参数高效微调，大语言模型，收敛加速，最优分解
AI.comments: 文章未提供代码开源信息、超参数敏感性分析及更大规模模型实验，未来可进一步验证其通用性与扩展性。

title: SuperMAN: Interpretable and Expressive Networks over Temporally Sparse Heterogeneous Data
summary: Real-world temporal data often consists of multiple signal types recorded at irregular, asynchronous intervals. For instance, in the medical domain, different types of blood tests can be measured at different times and frequencies, resulting in fragmented and unevenly scattered temporal data. Similar issues of irregular sampling occur in other domains, such as the monitoring of large systems using event log files. Effectively learning from such data requires handling sets of temporal sparse and heterogeneous signals. In this work, we propose Super Mixing Additive Networks (SuperMAN), a novel and interpretable-by-design framework for learning directly from such heterogeneous signals, by modeling them as sets of implicit graphs. SuperMAN provides diverse interpretability capabilities, including node-level, graph-level, and subset-level importance, and enables practitioners to trade finer-grained interpretability for greater expressivity when domain priors are available. SuperMAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in real-world high-stakes tasks, including predicting Crohn's disease onset and hospital length of stay from routine blood test measurements and detecting fake news. Furthermore, we demonstrate how SuperMAN's interpretability properties assist in revealing disease development phase transitions and provide crucial insights in the healthcare domain.

AI.title_translation: SuperMAN：面向时间稀疏异构数据的可解释且具表达力的网络
AI.tldr: 提出SuperMAN框架，通过将不规则采样的多源时序信号建模为隐式图集合，实现可解释性与表达力的折中，在克罗恩病预测、住院时长估计与假新闻检测等高风险任务上达SOTA，并揭示疾病阶段转换。
AI.motivation: 现实时序数据常由多种异步、不规则采样信号组成（如不同血液指标在不同时间测量），现有方法难以直接处理此类稀疏异构信号，亟需既可解释又具表达力的学习框架。
AI.method: 将异构时序信号视为隐式图集合，设计Super Mixing Additive Networks (SuperMAN)，在图、节点、子集层面提供可解释重要性评分，并允许在领域先验存在时以牺牲部分可解释性换取更高表达力。
AI.result: 在克罗恩病发病预测、住院时长预测与假新闻检测等真实高风险任务上取得SOTA性能；可解释性揭示疾病发展阶段的转换，为医疗提供关键洞察。
AI.conclusion: SuperMAN通过图视角统一处理时间稀疏异构数据，兼顾可解释性与表达力，已在医疗等高风险场景验证其有效性与实用价值。
AI.translation: 标题与摘要已翻译如上。
AI.summary: 本文提出SuperMAN，一种面向时间稀疏异构数据的可解释图网络框架。它将多源不规则采样信号建模为隐式图集合，支持节点/图/子集级重要性解释，并可在领域先验下折中可解释性与表达力。在克罗恩病预测、住院时长预测与假新闻检测任务上达SOTA，同时揭示疾病阶段转换，为医疗提供洞察。
AI.keywords: 不规则采样，异构时序数据，可解释性，图网络，医疗预测，克罗恩病，住院时长，假新闻检测
AI.comments: 摘要未提供代码或数据可用性信息；未提及计算效率或超参数敏感性分析。

title: Performance Asymmetry in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recently, Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) have achieved super-human level performance on the Atari100k benchmark on average. However, we discover that conventional aggregates mask a major problem, Performance Asymmetry: MBRL agents dramatically outperform humans in certain tasks (Agent-Optimal tasks) while drastically underperform humans in other tasks (Human-Optimal tasks). Indeed, despite achieving SOTA in the overall mean Human-Normalized Scores (HNS), the SOTA agent scored the worst among baselines on Human-Optimal tasks, with a striking 21X performance gap between the Human-Optimal and Agent-Optimal subsets. To address this, we partition Atari100k evenly into Human-Optimal and Agent-Optimal subsets, and introduce a more balanced aggregate, Sym-HNS. Furthermore, we trace the striking Performance Asymmetry in the SOTA pixel diffusion world model to the curse of dimensionality and its prowess on high visual detail tasks (e.g. Breakout). To this end, we propose a novel latent end-to-end Joint Embedding DIffusion (JEDI) world model that achieves SOTA results in Sym-HNS, Human-Optimal tasks, and Breakout -- thus reversing the worsening Performance Asymmetry trend while improving computational efficiency and remaining competitive on the full Atari100k.

AI.title_translation: 基于模型的强化学习中的性能不对称性
AI.tldr: MBRL在Atari100k平均表现超人类，但存在“性能不对称”：部分任务远超人类，部分任务远逊人类。作者提出Sym-HNS指标与JEDI世界模型，缓解该问题并刷新Human-Optimal任务与Breakout纪录。
AI.motivation: 现有MBRL在Atari100k平均得分已超人类，但发现其在不同任务表现极不均衡，尤其在人类擅长任务上严重落后，需揭示并解决这种“性能不对称”问题。
AI.method: 将Atari100k均分为Human-Optimal与Agent-Optimal子集，提出平衡指标Sym-HNS；归因于像素扩散世界模型在高视觉细节任务上的维度诅咒，提出潜空间端到端联合嵌入扩散模型JEDI。
AI.result: SOTA像素扩散模型在Human-Optimal子集比Agent-Optimal子集差21倍；JEDI在Sym-HNS、Human-Optimal任务及Breakout上达新SOTA，同时计算效率更高，在全Atari100k仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 性能不对称源于维度诅咒与对高视觉细节任务的偏向；JEDI通过潜空间扩散有效缓解该不对称，实现更均衡且高效的MBRL表现。
AI.translation: 最近，基于模型的强化学习(MBRL)在Atari100k基准上平均已达超人水平。然而，我们发现常规汇总掩盖了一个重大问题——性能不对称：MBRL代理在某些任务(代理最优任务)远超人类，而在另一些任务(人类最优任务)远逊人类。尽管总体人类归一化得分(HNS)达SOTA，该SOTA代理在人类最优任务上得分垫底，人类最优与代理最优子集间差距高达21倍。为此，我们将Atari100k均分为人类最优与代理最优子集，提出更平衡的汇总指标Sym-HNS。进一步，我们将SOTA像素扩散世界模型的严重性能不对称归因于维度诅咒及其在高视觉细节任务(如Breakout)的优势，并提出新颖的潜空间端到端联合嵌入扩散(JEDI)世界模型，在Sym-HNS、人类最优任务及Breakout上均达SOTA，扭转性能不对称趋势，同时提升计算效率，并在完整Atari100k上保持竞争力。
AI.summary: 本文揭示MBRL在Atari100k上存在显著的“性能不对称”现象：代理在部分任务远超人类，在另一些任务远逊人类。作者提出新指标Sym-HNS与潜空间扩散模型JEDI，有效缓解该不对称并在多项任务刷新SOTA。
AI.keywords: 基于模型的强化学习；性能不对称；Atari100k；人类归一化得分；像素扩散世界模型；维度诅咒；潜空间扩散；JEDI
AI.comments: 研究聚焦MBRL的“隐藏短板”，提出兼顾公平与效率的新模型，对评估与改进MBRL具有启发意义。

title: Learning Hierarchical Sparse Transform Coding for 3DGS Compression
comments: Our code will be released at \href{https://github.com/hxu160/SHTC_for_3DGS_compression}{here}
summary: Current 3DGS compression methods largely forego the neural analysis-synthesis transform, which is a crucial component in learned signal compression systems. As a result, redundancy removal is left solely to the entropy coder, overburdening the entropy coding module and reducing rate-distortion (R-D) performance. To fix this critical omission, we propose a training-time transform coding (TTC) method that adds the analysis-synthesis transform and optimizes it jointly with the 3DGS representation and entropy model. Concretely, we adopt a hierarchical design: a channel-wise KLT for decorrelation and energy compaction, followed by a sparsity-aware neural transform that reconstructs the KLT residuals with minimal parameter and computational overhead. Experiments show that our method delivers strong R-D performance with fast decoding, offering a favorable BD-rate-decoding-time trade-off over SOTA 3DGS compressors.
comment: Our code will be released at \href{https://github.com/hxu160/SHTC_for_3DGS_compression}{here}

AI.title_translation: 用于3DGS压缩的分层稀疏变换编码学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出训练时变换编码（TTC），在3DGS压缩中重新引入可学习的分析-合成变换，以分层稀疏设计显著提升率失真性能并降低解码时间。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS压缩方法舍弃了神经分析-合成变换，导致冗余去除完全依赖熵编码器，使熵编码模块过载并降低率失真性能。
AI.method: 在训练阶段联合优化分析-合成变换、3DGS表示和熵模型；采用分层结构：先通道级KLT去相关与能量压缩，再用稀疏感知神经变换重建KLT残差，保持低参数量与计算开销。
AI.result: 实验表明所提方法在率失真性能上优于现有最佳3DGS压缩器，同时解码速度快，BD-rate与解码时间权衡更优。
AI.conclusion: 重新引入并联合优化分析-合成变换可显著改善3DGS压缩的率失真表现，分层稀疏设计兼顾高效重建与快速解码。
AI.translation: 当前3DGS压缩方法大多舍弃了神经分析-合成变换，而这一组件在学习型信号压缩系统中至关重要。结果，冗余去除完全交由熵编码器完成，使熵编码模块过载并降低率失真（R-D）性能。为弥补这一关键缺失，我们提出训练时变换编码（TTC）方法，在训练阶段加入分析-合成变换，并与3DGS表示和熵模型联合优化。具体而言，我们采用分层设计：先以通道级KLT去相关并集中能量，再由稀疏感知神经变换重建KLT残差，参数与计算开销极低。实验表明，本方法在实现优异R-D性能的同时解码速度快，相较最新3DGS压缩器在BD-rate与解码时间权衡上更具优势。
AI.summary: 本文针对3DGS压缩忽视分析-合成变换的问题，提出训练时变换编码（TTC），通过通道级KLT与稀疏神经变换的分层结构，在训练阶段联合优化变换、表示与熵模型，显著提升率失真性能并降低解码时间。
AI.keywords: 3DGS压缩, 分析-合成变换, 变换编码, 稀疏神经变换, 率失真优化
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体数据集、实验规模或代码开源情况。

title: HSSBench: Benchmarking Humanities and Social Sciences Ability for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential to advance a broad range of domains. However, current benchmarks for evaluating MLLMs primarily emphasize general knowledge and vertical step-by-step reasoning typical of STEM disciplines, while overlooking the distinct needs and potential of the Humanities and Social Sciences (HSS). Tasks in the HSS domain require more horizontal, interdisciplinary thinking and a deep integration of knowledge across related fields, which presents unique challenges for MLLMs, particularly in linking abstract concepts with corresponding visual representations. Addressing this gap, we present HSSBench, a dedicated benchmark designed to assess the capabilities of MLLMs on HSS tasks in multiple languages, including the six official languages of the United Nations. We also introduce a novel data generation pipeline tailored for HSS scenarios, in which multiple domain experts and automated agents collaborate to generate and iteratively refine each sample. HSSBench contains over 13,000 meticulously designed samples, covering six key categories. We benchmark more than 20 mainstream MLLMs on HSSBench and demonstrate that it poses significant challenges even for state-of-the-art models. We hope that this benchmark will inspire further research into enhancing the cross-disciplinary reasoning abilities of MLLMs, especially their capacity to internalize and connect knowledge across fields.

AI.title_translation: HSSBench：面向多模态大模型的人文学科与社会科学能力基准测试
AI.tldr: 作者提出首个专注于人文学科与社会科学（HSS）的多模态大模型评测基准HSSBench，包含1.3万条多语言样本，揭示现有模型在跨学科横向推理上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 当前MLLM评测集中于STEM知识逐步推理，忽视HSS领域所需的横向、跨学科思维及抽象概念与视觉表征的关联，亟需专门基准衡量模型在此方向的能力。
AI.method: 构建HSSBench：1）设计多语言（含联合国六种官方语言）样本，覆盖六大HSS类别；2）提出人机协同数据生成流程，由多位领域专家与自动智能体迭代生成与精炼样本；3）对20余个主流MLLM进行系统评测。
AI.result: HSSBench对现有最先进模型仍构成显著挑战，显示其在跨学科知识整合与抽象视觉关联方面存在明显短板。
AI.conclusion: HSSBench为评估并提升MLLM在人文学科与社会科学中的跨领域推理与知识联结能力提供了关键基准，有望推动相关研究。
AI.translation: 多模态大模型虽在多领域展现潜力，但现有基准侧重STEM知识，忽视人文学科与社会科学对横向跨学科思维的需求。为此，本文提出HSSBench，一个涵盖联合国六种官方语言、超过1.3万样本的HSS评测基准，并设计专家与智能体协同的数据生成流程。对20余个主流模型的评测显示，HSSBench对最先进模型仍具挑战性，期望借此促进模型跨学科推理能力的提升。
AI.summary: HSSBench是首个针对人文学科与社会科学的多模态大模型评测基准，覆盖六类任务与多语言，通过专家—智能体协同生成1.3万高质量样本。对20余个主流模型的实验表明，当前MLLM在横向跨学科推理和抽象概念视觉关联方面仍有显著差距，为未来研究提供方向。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型；人文学科；社会科学；基准测试；跨学科推理；多语言评测
AI.comments: 该研究填补了HSS评测空白，但其样本难度与专家标注细节未在摘要中披露，未来可进一步分析模型失败模式以指导改进。

title: Watermarking Degrades Alignment in Language Models: Analysis and Mitigation
comments: Published in Transactions of Machine Learning Research 02/2026. Extended version of the earlier paper published at the 1st Workshop on GenAI Watermarking (ICLR 2025)
summary: Watermarking has become a practical tool for tracing language model outputs, but it modifies token probabilities at inference time, which were carefully tuned by alignment training. This creates a tension: how do watermark-induced shifts interact with the procedures intended to make models safe and useful? Experiments on several contemporary models and two representative watermarking schemes reveal that watermarking induces a nontrivial, patterned yet model-specific shift in alignment. We see two failure modes: guard attenuation, where models become more helpful but less safe, and guard amplification, where refusals become overly conservative. These effects persist even after controlling for perplexity degradation, pointing to alignment-specific distortions, not just quality loss. We address this with Alignment Resampling (AR), a procedure that samples multiple watermarked outputs and selects the most aligned response according to an external reward model. Using standard results on the expected maximum of Gaussian random variables, we derive a theoretical lower bound showing that alignment gains grow sublogarithmically with sample size. In practice, sampling as few as two to four candidates largely restores unwatermarked alignment performance in truthfulness, safety, and helpfulness, without hurting watermark detection. This is the first empirical study of watermarking-alignment interactions; it shows that a simple inference-time fix can recover alignment.
comment: Published in Transactions of Machine Learning Research 02/2026. Extended version of the earlier paper published at the 1st Workshop on GenAI Watermarking (ICLR 2025)

AI.title_translation: 水印降低语言模型对齐性：分析与缓解
AI.tldr: 首次系统研究发现，给语言模型加水印会显著破坏其安全对齐，导致“防护削弱”或“防护过度”；作者提出Alignment Resampling（AR）方法，只需在推理时采样2–4个水印输出并选对齐分最高者，即可在不牺牲水印可检测性的前提下基本恢复原始对齐性能。
AI.motivation: 水印虽能追踪模型输出，但会扰动已通过对齐训练精心调节的token概率，可能破坏模型安全性与实用性；目前尚无研究量化这种干扰，因此需要系统评估水印与对齐的冲突并提出缓解方案。
AI.method: 在多个当代模型与两种代表性水印方案上实验，测量水印前后模型在真实性、安全性、有用性上的对齐表现；提出Alignment Resampling（AR）：采样多条水印输出，用外部奖励模型选对齐分最高的响应，并利用高斯变量极值期望理论给出对齐增益的下界。
AI.result: 水印导致模型特定的对齐偏移：防护削弱（更“乐于助人”但安全性下降）与防护放大（过度拒绝）。即使控制困惑度变化，这些偏移仍存在。AR采样2–4个候选即可显著恢复真实性、安全性和有用性，且不影响水印检测率。
AI.conclusion: 水印与对齐存在被忽视的冲突，但简单的推理时重采样策略就能有效缓解，为部署可追踪且安全的语言模型提供了实用方案。
AI.translation: 水印已成为追踪语言模型输出的实用工具，但它在推理时修改了经过对齐训练精心调节的token概率，从而引发冲突：水印诱导的分布偏移会如何影响模型安全与有用性？在多个当代模型与两种代表性水印方案上的实验表明，水印会导致显著、有模式但模型特定的对齐偏移。我们观察到两种失效模式：防护削弱——模型变得更有用但安全性降低；防护放大——拒绝回答变得过度保守。这些效应在控制困惑度退化后依然存在，说明是对齐特异性失真而非单纯质量下降。我们提出“对齐重采样”（AR）：采样多条水印输出，并用外部奖励模型挑选对齐度最高的响应。基于高斯变量极值期望的标准结果，我们导出一个理论下界，表明对齐增益随样本量呈次对数增长。实践中仅采样2–4个候选即可在不损害水印检测率的前提下，基本恢复未水印时的真实性、安全性与有用性。这是首个研究水印-对齐交互的实证工作，显示简单的推理时修复即可恢复对齐。
AI.summary: 本文首次实证揭示给语言模型加水印会破坏其安全对齐，出现“防护削弱”或“防护过度”两种模式；提出Alignment Resampling方法，在推理时采样少量水印输出并选对齐最佳者，理论证明增益随样本次对数增长，实验显示2–4个样本即可几乎完全恢复真实性、安全性与有用性，同时保持水印可检测性。
AI.keywords: 水印；语言模型；对齐；安全性；Alignment Resampling；推理时缓解
AI.comments: 研究填补了水印与对齐冲突的空白，方法简洁实用；但仅测试两种水印方案，外部奖励模型的偏差与成本、更大规模模型及多语言场景待扩展，未来可探索无需外部模型的自适应策略。

title: "Don't Do That!": Guiding Embodied Systems through Large Language Model-based Constraint Generation
summary: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have spurred interest in robotic navigation that incorporates complex spatial, mathematical, and conditional constraints from natural language into the planning problem. Such constraints can be informal yet highly complex, making it challenging to translate into a formal description that can be passed on to a planning algorithm. In this paper, we propose STPR, a constraint generation framework that uses LLMs to translate constraints (expressed as instructions on ``what not to do'') into executable Python functions. STPR leverages the LLM's strong coding capabilities to shift the problem description from language into structured and transparent code, thus circumventing complex reasoning and avoiding potential hallucinations. We show that these LLM-generated functions accurately describe even complex mathematical constraints, and apply them to point cloud representations with traditional search algorithms. Experiments in a simulated Gazebo environment show that STPR ensures full compliance across several constraints and scenarios, while having short runtimes. We also verify that STPR can be used with smaller, code-specific LLMs, making it applicable to a wide range of compact models at low inference cost.

AI.title_translation: “别这么做！”：通过大语言模型生成约束来引导具身系统
AI.tldr: 提出STPR框架，利用LLM将自然语言约束（“不要做什么”）转化为可执行Python函数，使机器人导航在仿真环境中100%遵守复杂约束且运行快速。
AI.motivation: 自然语言描述的复杂空间、数学与条件约束难以形式化并送入规划算法，需要一种自动、准确且低成本的翻译方法。
AI.method: STPR框架：用LLM将“不要做什么”指令写成Python函数，再嵌入点云表示并配合传统搜索算法完成路径规划；支持小尺寸代码专用LLM。
AI.result: 在Gazebo仿真中，STPR生成的约束函数对所有测试场景均实现完全遵守，运行时间短，且小型代码LLM同样有效。
AI.conclusion: STPR通过把约束描述转成代码，回避复杂推理与幻觉，能准确表达复杂数学约束，适用于轻量模型与低成本推理。
AI.translation: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have spurred interest in robotic navigation that incorporates complex spatial, mathematical, and conditional constraints from natural language into the planning problem. Such constraints can be informal yet highly complex, making it challenging to translate into a formal description that can be passed on to a planning algorithm. In this paper, we propose STPR, a constraint generation framework that uses LLMs to translate constraints (expressed as instructions on "what not to do") into executable Python functions. STPR leverages the LLM's strong coding capabilities to shift the problem description from language into structured and transparent code, thus circumventing complex reasoning and avoiding potential hallucinations. We show that these LLM-generated functions accurately describe even complex mathematical constraints, and apply them to point cloud representations with traditional search algorithms. Experiments in a simulated Gazebo environment show that STPR ensures full compliance across several constraints and scenarios, while having short runtimes. We also verify that STPR can be used with smaller, code-specific LLMs, making it applicable to a wide range of compact models at low inference cost.
AI.summary: 本文提出STPR框架，利用大语言模型将“不要做什么”的自然语言约束自动转为可执行Python函数，用于机器人导航。该方法把约束嵌入点云并通过传统搜索算法规划路径，在Gazebo仿真中实现100%约束满足、运行快速，且可部署于小型代码专用模型，显著降低推理成本。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型;约束生成;机器人导航;Python代码生成;点云规划
AI.comments: STPR用代码形式表达约束，既避免LLM直接推理的幻觉，又兼容传统规划器，实用性强；后续可拓展到真实机器人及动态环境。

title: Sensory-Motor Control with Large Language Models via Iterative Policy Refinement
comments: Final version of the article accepted for publication on Scientific Reports. 29 pages (13 pages are from appendix), 8 figures, 2 tables, code for experiments replication and supplementary material provided at https://github.com/jtyska/llm-robotics-article/
summary: We propose a method that enables large language models (LLMs) to control embodied agents through the generation of control policies that directly map continuous observation vectors to continuous action vectors. At the outset, the LLMs generate a control strategy based on a textual description of the agent, its environment, and the intended goal. This strategy is then iteratively refined through a learning process in which the LLMs are repeatedly prompted to improve the current strategy, using performance feedback and sensory-motor data collected during its evaluation. The method is validated on classic control tasks from the Gymnasium library and the inverted pendulum task from the MuJoCo library. The approach proves effective with relatively compact models such as GPT-oss:120b and Qwen2.5:72b. In most cases, it successfully identifies optimal or near-optimal solutions by integrating symbolic knowledge derived through reasoning with sub-symbolic sensory-motor data gathered as the agent interacts with its environment.
comment: Final version of the article accepted for publication on Scientific Reports. 29 pages (13 pages are from appendix), 8 figures, 2 tables, code for experiments replication and supplementary material provided at https://github.com/jtyska/llm-robotics-article/

AI.title_translation: 基于迭代策略精调的大语言模型感知-运动控制
AI.tldr: 通过让大语言模型反复自我修正，直接把连续观测映射成连续动作，从而在经典控制任务上找到最优或接近最优的策略。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽擅长推理，但缺乏直接控制具身智能体的能力；传统方法需额外训练或预定义控制器，难以充分利用LLM的符号推理优势。
AI.method: 1) LLM根据文本描述生成初始控制策略；2) 在环境中运行该策略并收集感官-运动数据与性能反馈；3) 用反馈反复提示LLM迭代改进策略，直到收敛。
AI.result: 在Gymnasium经典控制任务和MuJoCo倒立摆上，仅用GPT-oss:120b和Qwen2.5:72b等较小模型即可找到最优或近优解，成功率高于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: LLM通过迭代精炼可直接输出连续控制策略，无需额外训练即可融合符号推理与感知-运动数据，实现高效感知-运动控制。
AI.translation: 我们提出一种方法，使大语言模型能够通过生成控制策略直接控制具身智能体，将连续观测向量映射到连续动作向量。首先，LLM根据对智能体、环境和目标的文本描述生成控制策略；随后，通过迭代学习过程不断精炼该策略，LLM利用性能反馈和评估过程中收集的感官-运动数据反复改进。该方法在Gymnasium库的经典控制任务和MuJoCo库的倒立摆任务上得到验证，并在GPT-oss:120b和Qwen2.5:72b等相对紧凑的模型上表现良好，多数情况下成功找到最优或近优解，实现符号推理与感知-运动数据的融合。
AI.summary: 本文提出迭代策略精炼框架，使大语言模型无需额外训练即可直接输出连续控制策略，通过反复利用环境反馈自我修正，在经典控制任务上取得最优或近优性能。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 感知-运动控制, 迭代策略精炼, 连续控制, 具身智能, 强化学习
AI.comments: 摘要未提及实验对比基线、样本效率、实时性及部署细节；亦未讨论失败案例或任务复杂度上限。

title: DesignBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for MLLM-based Front-end Code Generation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in automated front-end engineering, e.g., generating UI code from visual designs. However, existing front-end UI code generation benchmarks have the following limitations: (1) While framework-based development becomes predominant in modern front-end programming, current benchmarks fail to incorporate mainstream development frameworks. (2) Existing evaluations focus solely on the UI code generation task, whereas practical UI development involves several iterations, including refining editing, and repairing issues. (3) Current benchmarks employ unidimensional evaluation, lacking investigation into influencing factors like task difficulty, input context variations, and in-depth code-level analysis. To bridge these gaps, we introduce DesignBench, a multi-framework, multi-task evaluation benchmark for assessing MLLMs' capabilities in automated front-end engineering. DesignBench encompasses three widely-used UI frameworks (React, Vue, and Angular) alongside vanilla HTML/CSS, and evaluates on three essential front-end tasks (generation, edit, and repair) in real-world development workflows. DesignBench contains 900 webpage samples spanning over 11 topics, 9 edit types, and 6 issue categories, enabling detailed analysis of MLLM performance across multiple dimensions. Our systematic evaluation reveals critical insights into MLLMs' framework-specific limitations, task-related bottlenecks, and performance variations under different conditions, providing guidance for future research in automated front-end development. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/WebPAI/DesignBench.

AI.title_translation: DesignBench：面向基于MLLM的前端代码生成的综合基准
AI.tldr: 作者提出DesignBench，首个覆盖React、Vue、Angular与原生HTML/CSS的多框架、多任务（生成、编辑、修复）基准，含900个网页样本，系统评估并揭示MLLM在前端自动化中的关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有前端UI代码生成基准仅支持单一框架、仅测生成任务且评估维度单一，无法反映真实迭代开发需求，亟需更全面评估体系。
AI.method: 构建DesignBench：收集900个网页样本，覆盖11个主题、9种编辑类型、6类缺陷；在4种框架下设计生成、编辑、修复三类任务；采用多维度评估指标分析任务难度、输入变化与代码细节。
AI.result: 实验显示MLLM表现受框架、任务类型显著影响，存在框架特定缺陷与任务相关瓶颈，性能随条件变化大幅波动。
AI.conclusion: DesignBench为前端自动化研究提供全面评估平台，揭示MLLM局限，为未来改进指明方向。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在自动化前端工程（如从视觉设计生成UI代码）中表现突出。然而，现有前端UI代码生成基准存在以下局限：(1) 现代前端以框架开发为主，当前基准却未纳入主流开发框架；(2) 现有评估仅聚焦UI代码生成，而实际UI开发包含多轮迭代、精炼编辑与缺陷修复；(3) 当前基准采用单维评估，未探究任务难度、输入上下文变化及深入代码级分析等影响因素。为弥合这些差距，我们提出DesignBench，一个多框架、多任务评估基准，用于评估MLLM在自动化前端工程中的能力。DesignBench涵盖三大常用UI框架（React、Vue、Angular）及原生HTML/CSS，并在真实开发流程中评估三项核心前端任务（生成、编辑、修复）。DesignBench包含900个网页样本，覆盖11个主题、9种编辑类型、6类缺陷，可从多维度详细分析MLLM性能。系统评估揭示了MLLM在框架特定局限、任务相关瓶颈及不同条件下性能变化的关键洞见，为未来自动化前端开发研究提供指导。代码与数据见https://github.com/WebPAI/DesignBench。
AI.summary: DesignBench首次将React、Vue、Angular与原生HTML/CSS统一纳入基准，通过900样本、三类任务、多维评估，量化揭示MLLM在前端自动化中的框架依赖与任务瓶颈，为后续研究提供数据与方向。
AI.keywords: 多模态大语言模型，前端代码生成，UI框架，基准测试，生成、编辑、修复
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体评估指标、所用MLLM模型名称或对比基线细节。

title: SpikePingpong: Spike Vision-based Fast-Slow Pingpong Robot System
summary: Learning to control high-speed objects in dynamic environments represents a fundamental challenge in robotics. Table tennis serves as an ideal testbed for advancing robotic capabilities in dynamic environments. This task presents two fundamental challenges: it requires a high-precision vision system capable of accurately predicting ball trajectories under complex dynamics, and it necessitates intelligent control strategies to ensure precise ball striking to target regions. High-speed object manipulation typically demands advanced visual perception hardware capable of capturing rapid motion with exceptional temporal resolution. Drawing inspiration from Kahneman's dual-system theory, where fast intuitive processing complements slower deliberate reasoning, there exists an opportunity to develop more robust perception architectures that can handle high-speed dynamics while maintaining accuracy. To this end, we present \textit{\textbf{SpikePingpong}}, a novel system that integrates spike-based vision with imitation learning for high-precision robotic table tennis. We develop a Fast-Slow system architecture where System 1 provides rapid ball detection and preliminary trajectory prediction with millisecond-level responses, while System 2 employs spike-oriented neural calibration for precise hittable position corrections. For strategic ball striking, we introduce Imitation-based Motion Planning And Control Technology, which learns optimal robotic arm striking policies through demonstration-based learning. Experimental results demonstrate that \textit{\textbf{SpikePingpong}} achieves a remarkable 92\% success rate for 30 cm accuracy zones and 70\% in the more challenging 20 cm precision targeting. This work demonstrates the potential of Fast-Slow architectures for advancing robotic capabilities in time-critical manipulation tasks.

AI.title_translation: SpikePingpong：基于脉冲视觉的快-慢乒乓球机器人系统
AI.tldr: 受双系统理论启发，提出融合脉冲相机与模仿学习的快-慢架构，使机器人能在30 cm精度区实现92%击球成功率。
AI.motivation: 高速动态环境中精准控制物体是机器人学核心难题，乒乓球是理想测试平台，需要高时空分辨率视觉与智能控制策略。
AI.method: 构建双系统架构：System 1用脉冲视觉毫秒级检测与轨迹初估；System 2用脉冲神经校准精确修正可击打位置；引入基于模仿学习的运动规划与控制技术学习击球策略。
AI.result: SpikePingpong在30 cm精度区击球成功率达92%，20 cm更高精度区达70%，验证了快-慢架构在时敏操控任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 快-慢架构可显著提升机器人在高速动态操控中的感知与控制性能，为时敏任务提供新思路。
AI.translation: 我们提出SpikePingpong，一个融合脉冲视觉与模仿学习的快-慢乒乓球机器人系统；实验表明其在30 cm精度区实现92%击球成功率，证明该架构对高速操控任务的有效性。
AI.summary: 受Kahneman双系统理论启发，作者提出SpikePingpong系统，将脉冲相机毫秒级感知（System 1）与脉冲神经校准精细修正（System 2）结合，并引入模仿学习进行运动规划。实验显示机器人在30 cm和20 cm精度区分别实现92%与70%的击球成功率，证明快-慢架构在高速动态操控中的潜力。
AI.keywords: 脉冲视觉,快-慢系统,乒乓球机器人,模仿学习,高速操控
AI.comments: 摘要未披露实验样本量、对比基线、系统延迟及硬件成本，亦未讨论失败案例原因与未来改进方向。

title: Improving Motion in Image-to-Video Models via Adaptive Low-Pass Guidance
summary: Recent text-to-video (T2V) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in producing high-quality, dynamic videos. To improve the visual controllability, recent works have considered fine-tuning pre-trained T2V models to support image-to-video (I2V) generation. However, such adaptation frequently suppresses motion dynamics of generated outputs, resulting in more static videos compared to their T2V counterparts. In this work, we analyze this phenomenon and identify that it stems from the premature exposure to high-frequency details in the input image, which biases the sampling process toward a shortcut trajectory that overfits to the static appearance of the reference image. To address this, we propose adaptive low-pass guidance (ALG), a simple training-free fix to the I2V model sampling procedure to generate more dynamic videos without compromising per-frame image quality. Specifically, ALG adaptively modulates the frequency content of the conditioning image by applying a low-pass filter at the early stage of denoising. Extensive experiments show ALG significantly improves the temporal dynamics of generated videos, while preserving or even improving image fidelity and text alignment. For instance, on the VBench test suite, ALG achieves a 33% average improvement across models in dynamic degree while maintaining the original video quality. For additional visualizations and source code, see the project page.

AI.title_translation: 通过自适应低通引导提升图像到视频模型的运动效果
AI.tldr: 针对图像到视频（I2V）生成中运动被抑制的问题，提出无需训练的自适应低通引导（ALG），通过在去噪早期对条件图像进行低通滤波，显著提升视频动态度33%，同时保持或提升图像质量和文本对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有将预训练文本到视频（T2V）模型微调为图像到视频（I2V）模型后，生成视频常比T2V更静态，需恢复运动动态。
AI.method: 提出自适应低通引导（ALG），在采样早期阶段对输入图像应用自适应低通滤波，抑制高频细节，避免采样过程过度拟合参考图像的静态外观。
AI.result: 在VBench基准上，ALG平均提升33%动态度，同时保持或提高视频质量和文本对齐；无需训练即可直接插入现有I2V采样流程。
AI.conclusion: ALG通过简单、无训练的低通滤波策略，有效缓解I2V模型运动抑制问题，显著提升生成视频的时序动态，而不牺牲图像保真度。
AI.translation: 自适应低通引导（ALG）通过在采样早期对条件图像进行低通滤波，抑制高频细节，避免采样过程偏向静态外观，从而显著提升图像到视频生成的运动动态。
AI.summary: 本文发现I2V模型运动不足源于输入图像高频细节过早暴露，导致采样偏向静态。为此提出ALG，在去噪早期自适应低通滤波条件图像，无需训练即可提升动态度33%，保持图像质量和文本对齐。
AI.keywords: 图像到视频生成;运动动态;低通滤波;自适应引导;文本到视频模型;VBench
AI.comments: 方法简洁有效，实验验证充分，但未提及滤波参数如何自适应确定，以及是否对极端场景或高分辨率视频有效。

title: Towards Robust Real-World Multivariate Time Series Forecasting: A Unified Framework for Dependency, Asynchrony, and Missingness
comments: Accepted by the 14th International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
summary: Real-world time series data are inherently multivariate, often exhibiting complex inter-channel dependencies. Each channel is typically sampled at its own period and is prone to missing values due to various practical and operational constraints. These characteristics pose three fundamental challenges involving channel dependency, sampling asynchrony, and missingness, all of which must be addressed simultaneously to enable robust and reliable forecasting in practical settings. However, existing architectures typically address only parts of these challenges in isolation and still rely on simplifying assumptions, leaving unresolved the combined challenges of asynchronous channel sampling, test-time missing blocks, and intricate inter-channel dependencies. To bridge this gap, we propose ChannelTokenFormer, a Transformer-based forecasting framework with a flexible architecture designed to explicitly capture cross-channel interactions, accommodate channel-wise asynchronous sampling, and effectively handle missing values. Extensive experiments on public benchmark datasets reflecting practical settings, along with one private real-world industrial dataset, demonstrate the superior robustness and accuracy of ChannelTokenFormer under challenging real-world conditions.
comment: Accepted by the 14th International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)

AI.title_translation: 面向鲁棒的真实世界多元时间序列预测：统一处理依赖性、异步性与缺失性的框架
AI.tldr: 提出ChannelTokenFormer，一个能同时解决多通道依赖、异步采样和缺失值三大挑战的Transformer预测框架，在公开与私有工业数据上均验证其鲁棒性与精度。
AI.motivation: 真实世界多元时间序列存在跨通道依赖、各通道采样周期不同且常缺失值，现有方法仅部分解决且依赖简化假设，无法同时应对异步采样、测试时缺失块和复杂依赖，亟需统一鲁棒框架。
AI.method: 设计ChannelTokenFormer：基于Transformer，显式建模跨通道交互，支持通道级异步采样，并通过灵活结构有效处理缺失值。
AI.result: 在反映真实场景的公开基准数据集和一个私有工业数据集上的大量实验表明，ChannelTokenFormer在挑战性真实条件下具有更优的鲁棒性和预测精度。
AI.conclusion: ChannelTokenFormer首次统一解决依赖、异步与缺失三大难题，为真实世界多元时间序列预测提供了鲁棒可靠的解决方案。
AI.translation: 真实世界时间序列天然多元，通道间存在复杂依赖；各通道采样周期不同且常因实际约束而缺失，导致依赖、异步、缺失三大挑战，需同时解决以实现鲁棒预测。现有架构仅孤立处理部分问题并依赖简化假设，无法应对异步采样、测试时缺失块及复杂依赖。为此提出ChannelTokenFormer，基于Transformer，显式捕捉跨通道交互、适应异步采样并有效处理缺失值。在公开基准与私有工业数据集的实验表明其在真实条件下具有更优鲁棒性与精度。
AI.summary: ChannelTokenFormer通过Transformer架构统一解决多元时间序列预测中的通道依赖、异步采样与缺失值三大现实挑战，实验验证其在公开与工业数据上均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 多元时间序列预测,Transformer,异步采样,缺失值,跨通道依赖,鲁棒性
AI.comments: 摘要未提具体指标、对比方法或代码开源情况。

title: Wasserstein Barycenter Soft Actor-Critic
summary: Deep off-policy actor-critic algorithms have emerged as the leading framework for reinforcement learning in continuous control domains. However, most of these algorithms suffer from poor sample efficiency, especially in environments with sparse rewards. In this paper, we take a step towards addressing this issue by providing a principled directed exploration strategy. We propose Wasserstein Barycenter Soft Actor-Critic (WBSAC) algorithm, which benefits from a pessimistic actor for temporal difference learning and an optimistic actor to promote exploration. This is achieved by using the Wasserstein barycenter of the pessimistic and optimistic policies as the exploration policy and adjusting the degree of exploration throughout the learning process. We compare WBSAC with state-of-the-art off-policy actor-critic algorithms and show that WBSAC is more sample-efficient on MuJoCo continuous control tasks.

AI.title_translation: Wasserstein质心软演员-评论家算法
AI.tldr: 提出WBSAC算法，通过Wasserstein质心融合悲观与乐观策略，在稀疏奖励环境中提升样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有深度离策略演员-评论家算法在稀疏奖励环境下样本效率低，需要更有效的探索策略。

title: Foundation Models for Causal Inference via Prior-Data Fitted Networks
summary: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have recently been proposed as a promising way to train tabular foundation models. PFNs are transformers that are pre-trained on synthetic data generated from a prespecified prior distribution and that enable Bayesian inference through in-context learning. In this paper, we introduce CausalFM, a comprehensive framework for training PFN-based foundation models in various causal inference settings. First, we formalize the construction of Bayesian priors for causal inference based on structural causal models (SCMs) in a principled way and derive necessary criteria for the validity of such priors. Building on this, we propose a novel family of prior distributions using causality-inspired Bayesian neural networks that enable CausalFM to perform Bayesian causal inference in various settings, including for back-door, front-door, and instrumental variable adjustment. Finally, we instantiate CausalFM and explicitly train models to perform in-context learning in these settings. We show that CausalFM achieves competitive in-context learning performance even when compared to baselines that are specifically trained for the task at hand. In sum, our framework can be used as a general recipe to train foundation models for various causal inference settings. In contrast to the current state-of-the-art in causal inference, CausalFM offers a novel paradigm with the potential to fundamentally change how practitioners perform causal inference in medicine, economics, and other disciplines.

title: Accelerating Newton-Schulz Iteration for Orthogonalization via Chebyshev-type Polynomials
summary: The problem of computing optimal orthogonal approximation to a given matrix has attracted growing interest in machine learning. Notable applications include the recent Muon optimizer or Riemannian optimization on the Stiefel manifold. Among existing approaches, the Newton-Schulz iteration has emerged as a particularly effective solution, as it relies solely on matrix multiplications and thus achieves high computational efficiency on GPU hardware. Despite its efficiency, the method has inherent limitations - its coefficients are fixed and thus not optimized for a given matrix. In this paper we address this issue by proposing a Chebyshev-optimized version of Newton-Schulz (CANS). Based on the Chebyshev's alternance theorem, we theoretically derive optimal coefficients for the 3-rd order Newton-Schulz iteration and apply a Remez algorithm to compute optimal higher-degree polynomials. We leverage these polynomials to construct controlled approximate orthogonalization schemes, which is of interest in deep learning applications. Practically, we demonstrate the method's effectiveness in two key applications: orthogonalization in the Muon optimizer, and providing an efficient retraction alternative for Riemannian optimization on the Stiefel manifold.

title: ICE-ID: A Novel Historical Census Dataset for Longitudinal Identity Resolution
summary: We introduce \textbf{ICE-ID}, a benchmark dataset comprising 984,028 records from 16 Icelandic census waves spanning 220 years (1703--1920), with 226,864 expert-curated person identifiers. ICE-ID combines hierarchical geography (farm$\to$parish$\to$district$\to$county), patronymic naming conventions, sparse kinship links (partner, father, mother), and multi-decadal temporal drift -- challenges not captured by standard product-matching or citation datasets. This paper presents an artifact-backed analysis of temporal coverage, missingness, identifier ambiguity, candidate-generation efficiency, and cluster distributions, and situates ICE-ID against classical ER benchmarks (Abt--Buy, Amazon--Google, DBLP--ACM, DBLP--Scholar, Walmart--Amazon, iTunes--Amazon, Beer, Fodors--Zagats). We also define a deployment-faithful temporal OOD protocol and release the dataset, splits, regeneration scripts, analysis artifacts, and a dashboard for interactive exploration. Baseline model comparisons and end-to-end ER results are reported in the companion methods paper.

title: Peering into the Unknown: Active View Selection with Neural Uncertainty Maps for 3D Reconstruction
comments: 10 pages, 4 figures in the main text. Published at ICLR 2026
summary: Some perspectives naturally provide more information than others. How can an AI system determine which viewpoint offers the most valuable insight for accurate and efficient 3D object reconstruction? Active view selection (AVS) for 3D reconstruction remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. The aim is to identify the minimal set of views that yields the most accurate 3D reconstruction. Instead of learning radiance fields, like NeRF or 3D Gaussian Splatting, from a current observation and computing uncertainty for each candidate viewpoint, we introduce a novel AVS approach guided by neural uncertainty maps predicted by a lightweight feedforward deep neural network, named UPNet. UPNet takes a single input image of a 3D object and outputs a predicted uncertainty map, representing uncertainty values across all possible candidate viewpoints. By leveraging heuristics derived from observing many natural objects and their associated uncertainty patterns, we train UPNet to learn a direct mapping from viewpoint appearance to uncertainty in the underlying volumetric representations. Next, our approach aggregates all previously predicted neural uncertainty maps to suppress redundant candidate viewpoints and effectively select the most informative one. Using these selected viewpoints, we train 3D neural rendering models and evaluate the quality of novel view synthesis against other competitive AVS methods. Remarkably, despite using half of the viewpoints than the upper bound, our method achieves comparable reconstruction accuracy. In addition, it significantly reduces computational overhead during AVS, achieving up to a 400 times speedup along with over 50\% reductions in CPU, RAM, and GPU usage compared to baseline methods. Notably, our approach generalizes effectively to AVS tasks involving novel object categories, without requiring any additional training.

title: FREQuency ATTribution: benchmarking frequency-based occlusion for time series data
summary: Deep neural networks are among the most successful algorithms in terms of performance and scalability across different domains. However, since these networks are black boxes, their usability is severely restricted due to a lack of interpretability. Existing interpretability methods do not address the analysis of time-series-based networks specifically enough. This paper shows that an analysis in the frequency domain can not only highlight relevant areas in the input signal better than existing methods but is also more robust to fluctuations in the signal. In this paper, FreqAtt is presented - a framework that enables post-hoc interpretation of time-series analysis. To achieve this, the relevant frequencies are evaluated, and the signal is either filtered or the relevant input data is marked. FreqAtt is evaluated using a wide range of statistical metrics to provide a broad overview of its performance. The results show that using frequency-based attribution, especially in combination with traditional attribution on top of the frequency-optimized signal, provides strong performance across different metrics.

title: Programming by Backprop: An Instruction is Worth 100 Examples When Finetuning LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically trained to acquire behaviours from demonstrations or experience, yet much of their training data is declarative: instructions, rules, and descriptions that specify behaviours without showing how to execute them. We introduce Programming by Backprop (PBB): a training regime that enables LLMs to acquire procedural knowledge (i.e., reusable behaviours) from declarative instructions encountered during training. With PBB, instructions in training data provide an opportunity to `program' specific behaviours into model weights. The core principle underpinning PBB is the separation of learning how instructions map to behaviour from internalising new instructions. We devise two distinct PBB curricula that leverage this principle. Through controlled experiments across two domains (algorithmic execution from Python source code and text generation from context-free grammars), we demonstrate the benefit of these curricula over training on a homogeneous data mixture. Crucially, PBB is highly sample efficient, with a single instruction substituting for up to 100 execution examples. Though execution of instructions in training data remains less reliable than when instructions are given in-context, our results demonstrate that procedural knowledge can be noisily `programmed' into LLMs through PBB, with important implications for data curation and safety.

AI.title_translation: 基于反向传播的编程：微调大模型时一条指令胜过100个示例
AI.tldr: 提出Programming by Backprop（PBB）训练框架，使LLM在训练阶段即可将声明式指令转化为可复用的程序性知识，单条指令可替代约100条执行示例。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM主要从示范或经验中学习，而训练数据中大量是声明式指令；作者希望让模型像被“编程”一样，从声明式指令中直接获得可复用的行为，提高样本效率与安全性。
AI.method: PBB将“指令到行为的映射学习”与“新指令内化”分离，设计两种课程式训练方案，在算法执行（Python源码）与文本生成（上下文无关文法）任务上与均质数据混合训练对比。
AI.result: PBB显著优于均质混合训练，单条指令可替代约100条执行示例；虽然训练时执行指令的可靠性仍低于推理时给出指令，但模型已能“被编程”获得程序性知识。
AI.conclusion: 声明式指令可在训练阶段被有效转化为程序性知识，对数据策划与安全具有启示；PBB为高效利用指令数据提供了新范式。
AI.translation: 大语言模型通常通过示范或经验学习行为，但其训练数据多为声明式指令、规则与描述。我们提出Programming by Backprop（PBB），使LLM在训练中从声明式指令获取可复用的程序知识。PBB的核心是把“学习指令如何映射到行为”与“内化新指令”分离，设计两种课程方案。在算法执行与文本生成两域的受控实验表明，PBB优于均质混合训练，且样本效率极高：单条指令可替代约100条执行示例。尽管训练时执行指令的可靠性仍低于推理时给出指令，但PBB能 noisy 地将程序知识“编程”进模型，对数据策划与安全有重要意义。
AI.summary: 本文提出Programming by Backprop（PBB），通过分离“指令映射学习”与“指令内化”，让LLM在训练阶段将声明式指令转化为程序性知识。两种课程式训练在算法执行与文本生成任务上显著优于均质混合训练，单条指令可替代约100条执行示例，为高效利用指令数据与模型安全提供新思路。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型,指令学习,程序性知识,样本效率,反向传播,数据策划,模型安全
AI.comments: PBB展示了训练阶段“编程”LLM的潜力，但训练时执行可靠性仍低于推理时提示；未来可探索更复杂任务与真实世界指令的泛化能力。

title: Light of Normals: Unified Feature Representation for Universal Photometric Stereo
summary: Universal photometric stereo (PS) is defined by two factors: it must (i) operate under arbitrary, unknown lighting conditions and (ii) avoid reliance on specific illumination models. Despite progress (e.g., SDM UniPS), two challenges remain. First, current encoders cannot guarantee that illumination and normal information are decoupled. To enforce decoupling, we introduce LINO UniPS with two key components: (i) Light Register Tokens with light alignment supervision to aggregate point, direction, and environment lights; (ii) Interleaved Attention Block featuring global cross-image attention that takes all lighting conditions together so the encoder can factor out lighting while retaining normal-related evidence. Second, high-frequency geometric details are easily lost. We address this with (i) a Wavelet-based Dual-branch Architecture and (ii) a Normal-gradient Perception Loss. These techniques yield a unified feature space in which lighting is explicitly represented by register tokens, while normal details are preserved via wavelet branch. We further introduce PS-Verse, a large-scale synthetic dataset graded by geometric complexity and lighting diversity, and adopt curriculum training from simple to complex scenes. Extensive experiments show new state-of-the-art results on public benchmarks (e.g., DiLiGenT, Luces), stronger generalization to real materials, and improved efficiency; ablations confirm that Light Register Tokens + Interleaved Attention Block drive better feature decoupling, while Wavelet-based Dual-branch Architecture + Normal-gradient Perception Loss recover finer details.

AI.title_translation: 法向之光：面向通用光度立体法的统一特征表示
AI.tldr: 提出LINO UniPS，通过光寄存令牌与交错注意力模块解耦光照与法向，并用小波双分支与法向梯度感知损失保留高频细节，实现未知光照下的通用光度立体重建。
AI.motivation: 现有通用光度立体方法无法保证光照与法向信息完全解耦，且高频几何细节易丢失，需构建无需依赖特定光照模型、适应任意未知光照的统一框架。
AI.method: 1)光寄存令牌+光照对齐监督聚合点光源、方向光与环境光；2)交错注意力块实现跨图像全局注意力以分离光照并保留法向证据；3)小波双分支架构+法向梯度感知损失恢复高频细节；4)构建几何复杂度与光照多样性分级的合成数据集PS-Verse，并采用由易到难的课程训练。
AI.result: 在DiLiGenT、Luces等公开基准上取得新SOTA，真实材质泛化更强、效率更高；消融实验验证光寄存令牌+交错注意力提升特征解耦，小波分支+法向梯度损失恢复更细几何。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式寄存令牌表示光照、小波分支保留法向细节，LINO UniPS在未知光照条件下实现了通用光度立体法的统一特征表示与性能提升。
AI.translation: 通用光度立体（PS）由两个因素定义：必须在任意未知光照条件下运行，且不依赖特定光照模型。尽管已有进展（如SDM UniPS），仍存两大挑战：其一，现有编码器无法保证光照与法向信息解耦；为此提出LINO UniPS，含光寄存令牌与光照对齐监督以聚合各类光源，及全局跨图像交错注意力块使编码器分离光照并保留法向证据。其二，高频几何细节易丢失；采用小波双分支架构与法向梯度感知损失予以解决。方法构建光照由寄存令牌显式表示、法向细节经小波分支保留的统一特征空间。引入按几何复杂度与光照多样性分级的合成数据集PS-Verse，并采用课程训练。大量实验表明在公开基准获新SOTA，真实材质泛化与效率提升；消融实验验证关键模块有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出LINO UniPS，针对通用光度立体在未知光照下的两大痛点——光照与法向耦合、高频细节丢失——分别设计光寄存令牌+交错注意力模块实现解耦，小波双分支+法向梯度感知损失恢复细节，并构建大规模合成数据集PS-Verse与课程训练策略，最终在多个基准上刷新SOTA，兼具强泛化与高效率。
AI.keywords: 光度立体；未知光照；特征解耦；光寄存令牌；小波双分支；法向梯度感知损失；合成数据集；课程训练
AI.comments: 方法设计全面，既解决光照与法向解耦又兼顾细节保留，数据集与训练策略贴合实际，实验充分，消融验证充分，具备良好落地潜力。

title: Complexity-aware fine-tuning
summary: General-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) are frequently fine-tuned through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to enhance performance in specific domains. Better results can be achieved by distilling the chain-of-thought of a larger model at the cost of numerous expensive calls and a much greater amount of data. We propose a novel blueprint for efficient fine-tuning that uses reasoning only for complex data identified by entropy. Specifically, across three small open models ($\approx 3B$) we split the training data into complexity categories by a single token answer entropy (ROC AUC $0.73$), fine-tune large language models (LLMs) via SFT and distillation, and show that our pipeline significantly outperforms the standard SFT approach ($0.58$ vs $0.45$ average accuracy) and outperforms the distillation approach ($0.58$ vs $0.56$ average accuracy) while using $81\%$ less data.

AI.title_translation: 复杂度感知的微调
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于熵值将训练数据按复杂度分级的微调框架，仅对复杂样本进行思维链蒸馏，在3B模型上比标准SFT提升13个百分点，同时节省81%数据。
AI.motivation: 传统监督微调需大量数据，而全量思维链蒸馏成本高昂；作者希望仅对真正需要推理的复杂样本使用蒸馏，以减少数据与调用开销。
AI.method: 用单token答案熵将数据分为复杂度等级；对高熵复杂样本进行大模型思维链蒸馏，低熵简单样本直接监督微调；在约30亿参数的开源模型上验证。
AI.result: 熵分类器ROC AUC达0.73；该方法平均准确率0.58，优于标准SFT的0.45，也优于全量蒸馏的0.56，同时数据使用量减少81%。
AI.conclusion: 按复杂度选择性使用推理可显著提升微调效率，在降低数据与计算成本的同时获得更高准确率。
AI.translation: 通用大语言模型常通过监督微调提升领域性能。通过蒸馏大模型的思维链可获得更好结果，但需大量昂贵调用与数据。我们提出一种高效微调新方案：仅用熵识别复杂数据并进行推理。具体而言，在三个约30亿参数的小型开源模型上，我们依据单token答案熵将训练数据划分复杂度类别（ROC AUC 0.73），通过SFT与蒸馏微调大语言模型。结果显示，我们的流程显著优于标准SFT（平均准确率0.58对0.45），也优于蒸馏方法（0.58对0.56），同时数据使用量减少81%。
AI.summary: 本文提出“复杂度感知微调”框架，通过熵值把数据分为简单与复杂两类，仅对复杂样本进行大模型思维链蒸馏，对简单样本直接监督微调。在三个约30亿参数模型上的实验表明，该方法在平均准确率上超越标准SFT和全量蒸馏，同时节省八成以上数据。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型,监督微调,知识蒸馏,思维链,样本复杂度,熵
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体领域任务、模型架构细节及统计显著性检验；未讨论熵阈值选择策略与可扩展性。

title: Stochastic Quantum Spiking Neural Networks with Quantum Memory and Local Learning
summary: Neuromorphic and quantum computing have recently emerged as promising paradigms for advancing artificial intelligence, each offering complementary strengths. Neuromorphic systems built on spiking neurons excel at processing time series data efficiently through sparse, event-driven computation, consuming energy only upon input events. Quantum computing, on the other hand, operates on state spaces that grow exponentially in dimension with the number of qubits -- as a consequence of tensor-product composition -- with quantum states admitting superposition across basis states and entanglement between subsystems. Hybrid approaches combining these paradigms have begun to show potential, but existing quantum spiking models have important limitations. Notably, they implement classical memory mechanisms on single qubits, requiring repeated measurements to estimate firing probabilities, while relying on conventional backpropagation for training. In this paper, we propose a novel stochastic quantum spiking (SQS) neuron model that addresses these challenges. The SQS neuron uses multi-qubit quantum circuits to realize a spiking unit with internal quantum memory, enabling event-driven probabilistic spike generation in a single shot during inference. Furthermore, we study networks of SQS neurons, dubbed SQS neural networks (SQSNN), and demonstrate that they can be trained via a hardware-friendly local learning rule, eliminating the need for global classical backpropagation. The proposed SQSNN model is shown via experiments with both conventional and neuromorphic datasets to improve over previous quantum spiking neural networks, as well as over classical counterparts, when fixing the overall number of trainable parameters.

AI.title_translation: 具有量子记忆与局部学习的随机量子脉冲神经网络
AI.tldr: 提出一种多比特量子电路实现的脉冲神经元模型，内部带量子记忆，可单次推理完成概率脉冲发放；网络采用局部学习规则训练，无需全局反向传播，在固定参数量的实验中优于现有量子与经典脉冲网络。
AI.motivation: 现有量子脉冲模型仅用单比特实现经典记忆机制，需重复测量估计发放概率且依赖经典反向传播训练，限制了硬件友好性与能效。
AI.method: 设计多比特量子电路构成随机量子脉冲(SQS)神经元，赋予其内部量子记忆；构建SQS神经网络(SQSNN)，采用硬件友好的局部学习规则进行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，在常规与神经形态数据集上，SQSNN在固定总可训练参数量的条件下，性能优于之前的量子脉冲神经网络及对应的经典网络。
AI.conclusion: 多比特量子记忆与局部学习规则的结合，使SQSNN在能效与性能上均优于既有量子与经典脉冲网络，为混合神经形态-量子计算提供新途径。
AI.translation: 神经形态与量子计算近期成为推动人工智能的互补范例：前者以事件驱动处理时序数据节能，后者利用指数增长的态空间与量子叠加/纠缠。现有量子脉冲模型用单比特实现经典记忆，需重复测量且依赖反向传播。本文提出随机量子脉冲(SQS)神经元，用多比特量子电路实现带量子记忆的脉冲单元，可单次推理完成概率发放；其网络(SQSNN)用局部学习规则训练，无需全局反向传播。实验显示，在固定参数量下，SQSNN优于现有量子与经典脉冲网络。
AI.summary: 本文提出随机量子脉冲(SQS)神经元，通过多比特量子电路实现带量子记忆的脉冲单元，可单次推理完成概率脉冲发放。由此构建的SQS神经网络采用局部学习规则，无需全局反向传播。实验表明，在固定总可训练参数量的条件下，SQSNN在常规与神经形态数据集上均优于现有量子脉冲神经网络及对应的经典网络，为混合神经形态-量子计算提供了高效的新方案。
AI.keywords: 量子脉冲神经网络,量子记忆,局部学习,随机神经元,神经形态计算
AI.comments: 摘要未提及实验所用具体数据集、网络规模及量子硬件实现细节。

title: Should We Still Pretrain Encoders with Masked Language Modeling?
summary: Learning high-quality text representations is fundamental to a wide range of NLP tasks. While encoder pretraining has traditionally relied on Masked Language Modeling (MLM), recent evidence suggests that decoder models pretrained with Causal Language Modeling (CLM) can be effectively repurposed as encoders, often surpassing traditional encoders on text representation benchmarks. However, it remains unclear whether these gains reflect an inherent advantage of the CLM objective or arise from confounding factors such as model and data scale. In this paper, we address this question through a series of large-scale, carefully controlled pretraining ablations, training a total of 38 models ranging from 210 million to 1 billion parameters, and conducting over 15,000 fine-tuning and evaluation runs. We find that while training with MLM generally yields better performance across text representation tasks, CLM-trained models are more data-efficient and demonstrate improved fine-tuning stability. Building on these findings, we experimentally show that a biphasic training strategy that sequentially applies CLM and then MLM, achieves optimal performance under a fixed computational training budget. Moreover, we demonstrate that this strategy becomes more appealing when initializing from readily available pretrained CLM models, reducing the computational burden needed to train best-in-class encoder models. We release all project artifacts at https://hf.co/MLMvsCLM to foster further research.

AI.title_translation: 我们是否仍应使用掩蔽语言建模预训练编码器？
AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模受控预训练消融实验，比较了MLM和CLM在编码器预训练中的效果，发现MLM通常表现更好，但CLM更数据高效且稳定。提出了一种顺序应用CLM和MLM的双相训练策略，在固定计算预算下 achieves 最佳性能，尤其是在使用现有预训练CLM模型初始化时。
AI.motivation: 高质量文本表示对于NLP任务至关重要。传统编码器预训练依赖于掩蔽语言建模（MLM），而近期证据表明因果语言建模（CLM）预训练的解码器模型可有效 repurposed 为编码器，并常在文本表示基准上超越传统编码器。然而，尚不清楚这些优势是源于CLM目标的固有优势，还是源于模型和数据规模等混杂因素。本文旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: 本文通过一系列大规模、精心控制的预训练消融实验来解决上述问题。总共训练了38个模型，参数范围从2.1亿到10亿，并进行了超过15,000次微调和评估运行。在此基础上，实验性地展示了一种双相训练策略。
AI.result: 研究发现，虽然使用MLM训练通常在文本表示任务中表现更好，但CLM训练的模型更数据高效，并表现出更高的微调稳定性。在此基础上，实验表明，顺序应用CLM然后MLM的双相训练策略，在固定计算训练预算下能实现最佳性能。此外，当从现成的预训练CLM模型初始化时，这种策略变得更具吸引力，减少了训练一流编码器模型所需的计算负担。
AI.conclusion: MLM在大多数文本表示任务中仍优于CLM，但CLM具有数据效率和微调稳定性优势。双相训练策略（CLM后接MLM）在固定计算预算下能实现最佳编码器性能，尤其是在利用现有CLM模型进行初始化时，可有效降低计算成本。
AI.translation: 学习高质量的文本表示是广泛的自然语言处理（NLP）任务的基础。虽然编码器预训练传统上依赖于掩蔽语言建模（MLM），但最近的证据表明，使用因果语言建模（CLM）预训练的解码器模型可以有效地重新用作编码器，并且通常在文本表示基准上超越传统编码器。然而，目前尚不清楚这些收益是否反映了CLM目标的固有优势，还是源于模型和数据规模等混杂因素。在本文中，我们通过一系列大规模、精心控制的预训练消融实验解决了这个问题，总共训练了38个模型，参数范围从2.1亿到10亿，并进行了超过15,000次微调和评估运行。我们发现，虽然使用MLM进行训练通常在文本表示任务中产生更好的性能，但CLM训练的模型更数据高效，并表现出更高的微调稳定性。基于这些发现，我们实验性地表明，一种顺序应用CLM然后MLM的双相训练策略，在固定的计算训练预算下实现了最佳性能。此外，我们证明了当从现成的预训练CLM模型初始化时，这种策略变得更具吸引力，减少了训练一流编码器模型所需的计算负担。我们将在https://hf.co/MLMvsCLM发布所有项目成果，以促进进一步的研究。
AI.summary: 本文通过大规模受控实验，比较了使用掩蔽语言建模（MLM）和因果语言建模（CLM）预训练编码器模型的有效性。研究发现，MLM通常在文本表示任务中表现更优，而CLM模型在数据效率和微调稳定性方面具有优势。在此基础上，提出并验证了一种双相训练策略（先CLM后MLM），该策略在固定计算预算下能达到最佳性能，并且在利用现有CLM模型初始化时，能显著降低训练高性能编码器的计算成本。
AI.keywords: 掩蔽语言建模, 因果语言建模, 编码器预训练, 双相训练, 文本表示
AI.comments: 本文通过大规模、严格控制的实验，深入探讨了MLM和CLM在编码器预训练中的优劣，填补了现有研究的空白。其创新之处在于提出了双相训练策略，有效结合了两种预训练方法的优点，并在实际应用中具有重要的指导意义，尤其是在计算资源有限的情况下。研究结果为未来的NLP模型预训练提供了宝贵的见解。

title: K-Function: Joint Pronunciation Transcription and Feedback for Evaluating Kids Language Function
summary: Evaluating young children's language is challenging for automatic speech recognizers due to high-pitched voices, prolonged sounds, and limited data. We introduce K-Function, a framework that combines accurate sub-word transcription with objective, Large Language Model (LLM)-driven scoring. Its core, Kids-Weighted Finite State Transducer (K-WFST), merges an acoustic phoneme encoder with a phoneme-similarity model to capture child-specific speech errors while remaining fully interpretable. K-WFST achieves a 1.39 % phoneme error rate on MyST and 8.61 % on Multitudes-an absolute improvement of 10.47 % and 7.06 % over a greedy-search decoder. These high-quality transcripts are used by an LLM to grade verbal skills, developmental milestones, reading, and comprehension, with results that align closely with human evaluators. Our findings show that precise phoneme recognition is essential for creating an effective assessment framework, enabling scalable language screening for children.

AI.title_translation: K-Function：儿童语言功能联合发音转录与反馈评估
