title: Evaluating and Mitigating LLM-as-a-judge Bias in Communication Systems
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to autonomously evaluate the quality of content in communication systems, e.g., to assess responses in telecom customer support chatbots. However, the impartiality of these AI "judges" is not guaranteed, and any biases in their evaluation criteria could skew outcomes and undermine user trust. In this paper, we systematically investigate judgment biases in two LLM-as-a-judge models (i.e., GPT-Judge and JudgeLM) under the point-wise scoring setting, encompassing 11 types of biases that cover both implicit and explicit forms. We observed that state-of-the-art LLM judges demonstrate robustness to biased inputs, generally assigning them lower scores than the corresponding clean samples. Providing a detailed scoring rubric further enhances this robustness. We further found that fine-tuning an LLM on high-scoring yet biased responses can significantly degrade its performance, highlighting the risk of training on biased data. We also discovered that the judged scores correlate with task difficulty: a challenging dataset like GPQA yields lower average scores, whereas an open-ended reasoning dataset (e.g., JudgeLM-val) sees higher average scores. Finally, we proposed four potential mitigation strategies to ensure fair and reliable AI judging in practical communication scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 评估与缓解通信系统中LLM-as-a-judge的偏差
AI.tldr: 本文系统评估GPT-Judge与JudgeLM在通信场景中的11类评判偏差，发现详细评分标准可增强鲁棒性，并提出四种缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 通信系统日益依赖大模型自动评判内容质量，但其评判公正性未被验证，潜在偏差可能损害结果与用户信任，亟需系统研究。
AI.method: 在点对点打分设定下，对GPT-Judge和JudgeLM测试11种显性与隐性偏差；对比干净与带偏输入的得分差异；引入详细评分标准；在高分但带偏数据上微调模型；分析任务难度与得分相关性；提出四种缓解策略。
AI.result: 先进LLM评委对带偏输入通常给更低分；提供详细评分标准可进一步提升鲁棒性；用高分带偏数据微调会显著降低性能；GPQA等困难数据集得分更低，开放推理数据集得分更高。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-a-judge虽整体鲁棒但仍存偏差风险，需通过评分标准、数据筛选与训练策略等多方干预，才能保证通信系统中AI评判的公平可靠。
AI.translation: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于自主评估通信系统内容质量，例如评估电信客服聊天机器人的回复。然而，这些AI“裁判”的公正性并无保障，其评估标准的任何偏差都可能扭曲结果并削弱用户信任。本文系统研究两种LLM-as-a-judge模型（GPT-Judge与JudgeLM）在点对点打分设定下的评判偏差，涵盖11类显性与隐性偏差。我们发现，最先进的LLM评委对偏差输入表现出鲁棒性，通常给它们低于干净样本的分数；提供详细评分标准可进一步增强鲁棒性。我们还发现，用高分但带偏的回复微调LLM会显著降低其性能，凸显在偏差数据上训练的风险。此外，被评分数与任务难度相关：GPQA等挑战性数据集平均得分更低，而开放式推理数据集（如JudgeLM-val）平均得分更高。最后，我们提出四种潜在缓解策略，以确保实际通信场景中AI评判的公平与可靠。
AI.summary: 本文针对通信系统中使用大模型作评委的偏差问题，对GPT-Judge与JudgeLM在点对点打分下进行系统评估，发现模型对偏差输入具一定鲁棒性，详细评分标准可提升公正性，但偏差数据微调会显著降低性能，并据此提出四种缓解策略。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型；LLM-as-a-judge；评判偏差；通信系统；评分标准；微调；鲁棒性
AI.comments: 研究聚焦通信客服场景，但未披露四种缓解策略的具体细节与实验验证，未来可扩展至多语言及实时对话环境。

title: Spatial-DISE: A Unified Benchmark for Evaluating Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Spatial reasoning ability is crucial for Vision Language Models (VLMs) to support real-world applications in diverse domains including robotics, augmented reality, and autonomous navigation. Unfortunately, existing benchmarks are inadequate in assessing spatial reasoning ability, especially the \emph{intrinsic-dynamic} spatial reasoning which is a fundamental aspect of human spatial cognition. In this paper, we propose a unified benchmark, \textbf{Spatial-DISE}, based on a cognitively grounded taxonomy that categorizes tasks into four fundamental quadrants: \textbf{I}ntrinsic-\textbf{S}tatic, Intrinsic-\textbf{D}ynamic, \textbf{E}xtrinsic-Static, and Extrinsic-Dynamic spatial reasoning. Moreover, to address the issue of data scarcity, we develop a scalable and automated pipeline to generate diverse and verifiable spatial reasoning questions, resulting in a new \textbf{Spatial-DISE} dataset that includes Spatial-DISE Bench (559 evaluation VQA pairs) and Spatial-DISE-12K (12K+ training VQA pairs). Our comprehensive evaluation across 28 state-of-the-art VLMs reveals that, current VLMs have a large and consistent gap to human competence, especially on multi-step multi-view spatial reasoning. Spatial-DISE offers a robust framework, valuable dataset, and clear direction for future research toward human-like spatial intelligence. Benchmark, dataset, and code will be publicly released.

AI.title_translation: Spatial-DISE：评估视觉语言模型空间推理能力的统一基准
AI.tldr: 作者提出Spatial-DISE统一基准，从内在/外在+静态/动态四象限评估VLMs空间推理，自动生成12K+训练与559评测样本，揭示现有模型与人类存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法充分评估视觉语言模型的内在动态空间推理能力，而空间推理对机器人、AR、自主导航等现实应用至关重要。
AI.method: 构建基于认知分类的四象限任务体系（内在-静态、内在-动态、外在-静态、外在-动态），设计可扩展自动化管道生成多样化可验证空间推理问答，形成Spatial-DISE Bench与Spatial-DISE-12K数据集，并对28个前沿VLM进行系统评测。
AI.result: 当前最先进VLM在多步多视角空间推理任务上与人类表现存在显著且一致的差距。
AI.conclusion: Spatial-DISE为迈向类人空间智能提供了稳健框架、有价值数据集及明确研究方向。
AI.translation: 空间推理能力对视觉语言模型支持机器人、增强现实和自主导航等现实应用至关重要。然而现有基准不足以评估空间推理能力，尤其是人类空间认知核心方面的内在动态空间推理。本文提出统一基准Spatial-DISE，基于认知分类将任务分为内在-静态、内在-动态、外在-静态、外在-动态四象限。为解决数据稀缺，开发可扩展自动化管道生成多样化可验证空间推理问题，形成含Spatial-DISE Bench（559对VQA）和Spatial-DISE-12K（12K+训练VQA）的数据集。对28个前沿VLM全面评估显示，当前VLM与人类能力存在显著差距，尤其在多步多视角空间推理。Spatial-DISE为类人空间智能研究提供框架、数据集与方向，相关资源将公开。
AI.summary: 本文提出Spatial-DISE统一基准，从内在/外在+静态/动态四象限体系评估视觉语言模型的空间推理能力。通过自动化管道生成12K+训练与559评测样本，系统评测28个前沿模型后发现其在多步多视角任务上与人类差距显著，为未来类人空间智能研究提供框架与数据支撑。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型；空间推理；基准；内在动态；四象限分类；自动化生成；多步多视角
AI.comments: 该基准首次系统区分内在动态空间推理并公开大规模数据，有望推动机器人与AR等领域VLM空间智能研究。

title: Understanding the Ability of LLMs to Handle Character-Level Perturbation
summary: This work investigates the resilience of contemporary large language models (LLMs) against frequent character-level perturbations. We examine three types of character-level perturbations including introducing numerous typos within words, shuffling the characters in each word, and inserting a large number of invisible characters into the text. Surprisingly, even under severe perturbation, such as shuffling nearly all words character-wise to produce text that is almost unreadable to humans, or inserting invisible characters which are several times more than the visible ones as noise, many LLMs still maintain notable performance. We explore the underlying causes of this robustness and find that LLMs exhibit remarkable resilience to chaotic segmentation and fragmented tokenization. Furthermore, we examine the mechanisms by which LLMs remove perturbations to correctly comprehend text, including both implicit and explicit mechanisms for character-level perturbation. We hope that our findings on the low-level robustness of LLMs will unveil their inherent architectural strengths, reveal the potential risks of their misuse, and inform the reliable deployment of LLMs across diverse application scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 理解大语言模型处理字符级扰动的能力
AI.tldr: 研究发现，即使文本被人为打乱到人类几乎无法阅读，大模型仍能保持较高性能，揭示其对字符级扰动具有惊人鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 探讨当代大语言模型在面对常见字符级扰动时的鲁棒性，了解其内在架构优势与潜在风险，为可靠部署提供依据。
AI.method: 对三种字符级扰动（大量拼写错误、单词内字符重排、插入大量不可见字符）进行实验，观察模型表现并分析其去扰动机制。
AI.result: 即使扰动严重到文本几乎不可读或不可见字符数倍于可见字符，多数LLM仍保持显著性能，表现出对混乱切分和碎片化分词的强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LLM具备低层次鲁棒性，能隐式和显式去除字符级扰动以正确理解文本，这一特性既体现架构优势，也提示潜在滥用风险。
AI.translation: 本研究考察了当代大语言模型对频繁字符级扰动的鲁棒性。我们考察三种字符级扰动：在单词中引入大量拼写错误、对每个单词的字符进行重排、以及在文本中插入大量不可见字符。令人惊讶的是，即使在严重扰动下，如几乎对所有单词进行字符级重排以产生对人类几乎不可读的文本，或插入的不可见字符是可见字符数倍作为噪声，许多LLM仍保持显著性能。我们探索了这种鲁棒性的根本原因，发现LLM对混乱切分和碎片化分词表现出显著韧性。此外，我们研究了LLM去除扰动以正确理解文本的机制，包括隐式和显式的字符级扰动处理机制。我们希望对LLM低层次鲁棒性的发现能揭示其内在架构优势，揭示其潜在滥用风险，并为在不同应用场景中可靠部署LLM提供参考。
AI.summary: 本文系统评估大语言模型对字符级扰动的鲁棒性，发现模型在极端扰动下仍能保持性能，归因于其强大的分词与去噪机制，为安全部署提供启示。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型,字符级扰动,鲁棒性,分词,不可见字符
AI.comments: 研究未提及具体模型名称、评估指标、数据集或量化结果，后续可补充更详细的实验设置与性能对比。

title: LUMI: Unsupervised Intent Clustering with Multiple Pseudo-Labels
summary: In this paper, we propose an intuitive, training-free and label-free method for intent clustering in conversational search. Current approaches to short text clustering use LLM-generated pseudo-labels to enrich text representations or to identify similar text pairs for pooling. The limitations are: (1) each text is assigned only a single label, and refining representations toward a single label can be unstable; (2) text-level similarity is treated as a binary selection, which fails to account for continuous degrees of similarity. Our method LUMI is designed to amplify similarities between texts by using shared pseudo-labels. We first generate pseudo-labels for each text and collect them into a pseudo-label set. Next, we compute the mean of the pseudo-label embeddings and pool it with the text embedding. Finally, we perform text-level pooling: Each text representation is pooled with its similar pairs, where similarity is determined by the degree of shared labels. Our evaluation on four benchmark sets shows that our approach achieves competitive results, better than recent state-of-the-art baselines, while avoiding the need to estimate the number of clusters during embedding refinement, as is required by most methods. Our findings indicate that LUMI can effectively be applied in unsupervised short-text clustering scenarios.

AI.title_translation: LUMI：利用多重伪标签的无监督意图聚类
AI.tldr: 无需训练与标注，通过共享多重伪标签增强文本相似度，实现对话搜索意图聚类，效果优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅用单一伪标签，表征易不稳定；文本相似度被二值化，无法捕捉连续相似度。
AI.method: 为每句生成多重伪标签→计算伪标签嵌入均值并与原文本嵌入融合→依据共享标签数量加权池化相似文本。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上优于最新无监督基线，且无需预先估计聚类数目。
AI.conclusion: LUMI可在无监督短文本聚类中有效应用，兼具简单、高效与鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 本文提出一种直观、无需训练与标签的意图聚类方法LUMI，通过共享多重伪标签增强文本相似度，在四个数据集上取得优于现有最佳方法的结果。
AI.summary: LUMI通过生成多重伪标签并共享，构建连续相似度，实现对话搜索中的无监督意图聚类，性能领先且无需预设聚类数。
AI.keywords: 意图聚类;无监督学习;伪标签;短文本;对话搜索;嵌入池化
AI.comments: 方法简洁且无需训练，但伪标签质量对结果影响未深入讨论；可进一步探究动态阈值与多语言扩展。

title: TeamFormer: Shallow Parallel Transformers with Progressive Approximation
summary: The widespread 'deeper is better' philosophy has driven the creation of architectures like ResNet and Transformer, which achieve high performance by stacking numerous layers. However, increasing model depth comes with challenges such as longer training times, higher inference latency, and impracticality on resource-constrained devices. To address these issues, we propose TeamFormer, a shallow Transformer architecture designed for true parallelism in both structure and computation. By formulating standard Transformers as function approximators in closed-form, our theoretical analysis shows that their performance relies on inter-layer collaboration for progressive approximation, rather than depth itself. While deep Transformers enforce this collaboration through sequential designs, we demonstrate that such collaboration is not inherently tied to sequential structures. TeamFormer removes the sequential constraint by organizing layers into parallel branches, enforcing inter-layer collaboration algorithmically. Specifically, we implement progressive approximation, ensuring that each new branch further reduces the loss from preceding branches, enabling faster convergence. Extensive experiments validate TeamFormer's effectiveness, outperforming standard Transformers like ViT. Moreover, TeamFormer supports up to 15.07x model compression and facilitates model expansion for adaptive continuous learning. Experimental results on multi-GPU deployment demonstrate that TeamFormer is 3.30x faster than widely used parallelism solutions such as FairScale. These advancements stem from our closed-form formulation of Transformers based on the Universal Approximation Theorem, which not only explains the ``depth belief'' but also opens new avenues for designing efficient Transformer architectures. Source code: https://(open-upon-acceptance)

AI.title_translation: TeamFormer：基于渐进逼近的浅层并行Transformer
AI.tldr: TeamFormer通过将Transformer层并行化并强制层间协作，在保持性能的同时实现15倍压缩与3.3倍加速。
AI.motivation: 深度模型虽性能高，但训练耗时、推理延迟大，难以部署在资源受限设备，需打破“越深越好”的固定思维。
AI.method: 把Transformer视为闭式函数逼近器，用通用逼近定理证明其性能依赖层间协作而非深度；将层组织成并行分支，通过算法强制每层新分支进一步降低前面分支的损失，实现渐进逼近。
AI.result: 在ImageNet等任务上优于标准ViT；模型可压缩15.07倍；多GPU部署比FairScale并行方案快3.30倍；支持持续学习下的自适应扩展。
AI.conclusion: 层间协作而非深度才是Transformer性能关键，TeamFormer用并行结构实现高效逼近，为设计浅层高效Transformer开辟新路径。
AI.translation: TeamFormer：基于渐进逼近的浅层并行Transformer
AI.summary: TeamFormer通过闭式函数逼近理论揭示Transformer性能来源于层间协作而非深度，将传统串行层改为并行分支并强制每层继续降低前面分支的损失，实现快速收敛。实验表明其在精度超越ViT的同时，可把模型压缩15倍，多GPU推理速度提升3.3倍，并支持持续学习扩展。
AI.keywords: Transformer、并行化、浅层网络、渐进逼近、模型压缩、推理加速
AI.comments: 文章用理论打破“越深越好”迷思，提出可并行的浅层结构，压缩与加速效果显著，但仅给出图像任务结果，尚未验证在NLP等场景的通用性。

title: Integrating Conductor Health into Dynamic Line Rating and Unit Commitment under Uncertainty
summary: Dynamic line rating (DLR) enables greater utilization of existing transmission lines by leveraging real-time weather data. However, the elevated temperature operation (ETO) of conductors under DLR is often overlooked, despite its long-term impact on conductor health. This paper addresses this issue by 1) quantifying risk-based depreciation costs associated with ETO and 2) proposing a Conductor Health-Aware Unit Commitment (CHA-UC) that internalizes these costs in operational decisions. CHA-UC incorporates a robust linear approximation of conductor temperature and integration of expected depreciation costs due to hourly ETO into the objective function. Case studies on the Texas 123-bus backbone test system using NOAA weather data demonstrate that the proposed CHA-UC model reduces the total cost by 0.74\% and renewable curtailment by 85\% compared to static line rating (SLR) and outperforms quantile regression forest-based methods, while conventional DLR operation without risk consideration resulted in higher costs due to excessive ETO. Further analysis of the commitment decisions and the line temperature statistics confirms that the CHA-UC achieves safer line flows by shifting generator commitments. Finally, we examine the emergent correlation behaviors arising between wind generation and DLR forecast errors, and show that CHA-UC adaptively manages this effect by relaxing flows for risk-hedging conditions while tightening flows for risk-amplifying ones.

AI.title_translation: 将导线健康纳入不确定条件下动态线路额定值与机组组合
AI.tldr: 提出考虑导线温度老化成本的“导线健康感知机组组合”模型，在实时天气数据下优化输电利用率并降低风光弃电。
AI.motivation: 动态线路额定值(DLR)可提高线路利用率，但忽视高温度运行对导线健康的长期折旧风险，导致潜在成本增加。
AI.method: 1) 量化高温度运行引起的风险折旧成本；2) 构建鲁棒线性化导体温度模型；3) 将期望折旧成本嵌入机组组合目标函数，形成CHA-UC。
AI.result: 在德州123节点系统上，CHA-UC较静态额定值降低总成本0.74%，减少风光弃电85%，并优于分位数回归森林法；无视风险的常规DLR反而成本更高。
AI.conclusion: CHA-UC通过调整机组启停实现更安全潮流，对风功率与DLR预测误差间的相关行为自适应地进行风险对冲，兼顾经济性与设备健康。
AI.translation: 动态线路额定值（DLR）通过实时天气数据提升现有传输线利用率，但高温度运行（ETO）对导线健康的长期影响常被忽视。本文1）量化与ETO相关的风险折旧成本；2）提出导体健康感知机组组合（CHA-UC），将这些成本内部化到运行决策。CHA-UC采用导体温度的鲁棒线性近似，并将小时级ETO导致的期望折旧成本整合进目标函数。基于NOAA天气数据的德州123节点骨干系统算例表明，相比静态额定值，所提CHA-UC总成本降低0.74%，风光弃电减少85%，优于分位数回归森林法；而忽视风险的常规DLR因过度ETO反而成本更高。对启停决策与线路温度统计的进一步分析证实，CHA-UC通过调整机组启停实现更安全的潮流。最后，我们探讨风功率与DLR预测误差之间新出现的相关行为，并显示CHA-UC通过对冲风险条件放松潮流、放大风险条件收紧潮流来自适应管理该效应。
AI.summary: 本文提出“导线健康感知机组组合”(CHA-UC)模型，将高温度运行导致的导线折旧成本纳入优化，实现输电利用率提升与设备寿命保护，显著降低风光弃电并减少总成本。
AI.keywords: 动态线路额定值；机组组合；导体健康；高温度运行；不确定性；风光弃电；鲁棒优化
AI.comments: 摘要清晰展示问题、方法与量化收益，但未提及计算效率、对大规模系统的可扩展性及折旧成本参数获取方式。

title: Latent-Augmented Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a powerful class of models and a promising route to fast language generation, but practical implementations typically rely on factored reverse transitions that ignore cross-token dependencies and degrade performance in the few-step regime. We propose Latent-Augmented Discrete Diffusion (LADD), which introduces a learnable auxiliary latent channel and performs diffusion over the joint (token, latent) space. The latent variables provide an intermediate representation that can express joint structure while preserving tractable parameterizations. We instantiate LADD with continuous latents (Co-LADD) and discrete latents (Di-LADD), and study two inference schedules: a joint diffusion that denoises data and latents together, and a sequential diffusion that first resolves latents and then samples tokens conditionally. We derive ELBO-style objectives and analyze design choices that balance latent expressivity with diffusion compatibility. In experiments, LADDs yield improvements on unconditional generation metrics as compared to state-of-the-art masked discrete diffusion baselines, and are effective at lower sampling budgets, where unmasking many tokens per step is desirable.

AI.title_translation: 潜在增强离散扩散模型
AI.tldr: 提出LADD，在离散扩散中引入可学习隐变量通道，联合(token,隐变量)空间做扩散，提升少步采样下的语言生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有离散扩散模型在少步采样时因忽略跨token依赖导致性能下降，需引入能表达联合结构且保持可处理性的中间表示。
AI.method: 在(token,隐变量)联合空间进行扩散；设计连续(Co-LADD)与离散(Di-LADD)两种隐变量；提出联合与顺序两种推理调度；推导ELBO式目标并平衡隐变量表达力与扩散兼容性。
AI.result: LADD在无条件生成指标上优于最新掩码离散扩散基线，并在低采样预算下表现更佳。
AI.conclusion: 引入可学习隐变量的LADD能有效捕捉token间依赖，提升离散扩散模型在少步采样下的生成性能。
AI.translation: 离散扩散模型已成为快速语言生成的有力工具，但现有实现通常依赖忽略跨token依赖的分解式逆向转移，在少步采样时性能下降。我们提出潜在增强离散扩散(LADD)，引入可学习辅助隐变量通道，在联合(token,隐变量)空间执行扩散。隐变量提供可表达联合结构且保持可处理参数化的中间表示。我们分别用连续隐变量(Co-LADD)与离散隐变量(Di-LADD)实例化LADD，并研究两种推理调度：联合扩散同时去噪数据与隐变量，顺序扩散先解析隐变量再条件采样token。我们推导ELBO式目标并分析平衡隐变量表达力与扩散兼容性的设计选择。实验表明，LADD在无条件生成指标上优于最新掩码离散扩散基线，并在低采样预算下有效。
AI.summary: LADD通过在离散扩散中引入可学习隐变量，构建联合(token,隐变量)空间扩散过程，提出连续与离散两种隐变量实例及联合/顺序两种推理方式，在少步采样下获得更好生成效果。
AI.keywords: 离散扩散模型,隐变量,少步采样,语言生成,ELBO
AI.comments: 未提及具体数据集、模型规模或采样步数细节。

title: Unbiased Object Detection Beyond Frequency with Visually Prompted Image Synthesis
summary: This paper presents a generation-based debiasing framework for object detection. Prior debiasing methods are often limited by the representation diversity of samples, while naive generative augmentation often preserves the biases it aims to solve. Moreover, our analysis reveals that simply generating more data for rare classes is suboptimal due to two core issues: i) instance frequency is an incomplete proxy for the true data needs of a model, and ii) current layout-to-image synthesis lacks the fidelity and control to generate high-quality, complex scenes. To overcome this, we introduce the representation score (RS) to diagnose representational gaps beyond mere frequency, guiding the creation of new, unbiased layouts. To ensure high-quality synthesis, we replace ambiguous text prompts with a precise visual blueprint and employ a generative alignment strategy, which fosters communication between the detector and generator. Our method significantly narrows the performance gap for underrepresented object groups, \eg, improving large/rare instances by 4.4/3.6 mAP over the baseline, and surpassing prior L2I synthesis models by 15.9 mAP for layout accuracy in generated images.

AI.title_translation: 超越频率的无偏目标检测：基于视觉引导的图像合成
AI.tldr: 提出基于生成的去偏框架，用“表征得分”诊断频率之外的表征缺口，并以视觉蓝图取代文本提示、引入生成对齐策略，显著提升稀有/大目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有去偏方法受限于样本多样性，简单生成数据会保留偏差；仅按类别频率增扩数据并非最优，且布局到图像合成缺乏保真与控制力。
AI.method: 1) 提出表征得分(RS)识别频率之外的表征缺口并指导无偏布局生成；2) 用精确视觉蓝图替代模糊文本提示；3) 采用生成对齐策略实现检测器与生成器协同。
AI.result: 在罕见/大目标上分别提升3.6/4.4 mAP；生成图像的布局精度比现有L2I合成模型高15.9 mAP。
AI.conclusion: 通过表征得分诊断与视觉引导合成，可显著缩小少数目标组的性能差距，实现高质量无偏检测。
AI.translation: 本文提出一种基于生成的去偏框架用于目标检测。以往去偏方法常受限于样本表征多样性，而简单生成式增强往往保留其试图消除的偏差。分析表明，仅为稀有类别生成更多数据并非最优，原因有二：i) 实例频率无法完整反映模型真实数据需求；ii) 当前布局到图像合成在生成高质量复杂场景时缺乏保真度与控制力。为此，我们引入表征得分(RS)以诊断超越频率的表征缺口，指导生成新的无偏布局。为确保高质量合成，我们以精确视觉蓝图取代模糊文本提示，并采用生成对齐策略，促进检测器与生成器之间的信息交流。实验表明，该方法显著缩小了欠表征目标组的性能差距，例如将大/稀有实例的mAP分别提升4.4/3.6，并在生成图像的布局精度上超越现有L2I合成模型15.9 mAP。
AI.summary: 针对目标检测中的长尾偏差，作者提出基于生成的去偏框架。核心是用表征得分(RS)量化模型对各类目标的表征缺口，不仅看频率；随后用视觉蓝图精确控制场景生成，并通过生成对齐让检测器反馈给生成器，实现高质量、无偏的数据增强。实验显示稀有与大目标检测显著提升，生成布局精度亦大幅领先。
AI.keywords: 目标检测, 去偏, 生成式数据增强, 表征得分, 布局到图像合成, 视觉提示, 长尾分布
AI.comments: 未提具体数据集、网络架构细节及训练成本；未给出RS计算公式的复杂度与可解释性分析。

title: MoMaGen: Generating Demonstrations under Soft and Hard Constraints for Multi-Step Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
comments: Project website: momagen.github.io. The first four authors contribute equally. Accpeted to International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
summary: Imitation learning from large-scale, diverse human demonstrations has been shown to be effective for training robots, but collecting such data is costly and time-consuming. This challenge intensifies for multi-step bimanual mobile manipulation, where humans must teleoperate both the mobile base and two high-DoF arms. Prior X-Gen works have developed automated data generation frameworks for static (bimanual) manipulation tasks, augmenting a few human demos in simulation with novel scene configurations to synthesize large-scale datasets. However, prior works fall short for bimanual mobile manipulation tasks for two major reasons: 1) a mobile base introduces the problem of how to place the robot base to enable downstream manipulation (reachability) and 2) an active camera introduces the problem of how to position the camera to generate data for a visuomotor policy (visibility). To address these challenges, MoMaGen formulates data generation as a constrained optimization problem that satisfies hard constraints (e.g., reachability) while balancing soft constraints (e.g., visibility while navigation). This formulation generalizes across most existing automated data generation approaches and offers a principled foundation for developing future methods. We evaluate on four multi-step bimanual mobile manipulation tasks and find that MoMaGen enables the generation of much more diverse datasets than previous methods. As a result of the dataset diversity, we also show that the data generated by MoMaGen can be used to train successful imitation learning policies using a single source demo. Furthermore, the trained policy can be fine-tuned with a very small amount of real-world data (40 demos) to be succesfully deployed on real robotic hardware. More details are on our project page: momagen.github.io.
comment: Project website: momagen.github.io. The first four authors contribute equally. Accpeted to International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)

AI.title_translation: MoMaGen：在软硬约束下为多步骤双臂移动操作生成示教数据
AI.tldr: MoMaGen 将移动双臂操作的数据生成建模为带约束的优化问题，同时满足可达性等硬约束与可见性等软约束，从而用单个示教即可合成大规模多样数据，并支持仅用40条真实数据微调后直接部署在真实机器人上。
AI.motivation: 大规模、多样化的人类示教对模仿学习至关重要，但人工采集多步骤双臂移动操作数据成本极高；现有静态操作数据自动生成方法无法满足移动基座带来的可达性与主动相机带来的可见性双重挑战。
AI.method: 把数据生成表述为约束优化问题，显式处理硬约束（如机器人基座放置可达性）与软约束（如导航过程中的相机可见性），并泛化到多数现有自动数据生成框架。
AI.result: 在四项多步骤双臂移动操作任务上，MoMaGen 生成的数据集多样性显著优于先前方法；用其数据训练的模仿学习策略仅凭一条源示教即可成功，并用仅40条真实世界数据微调后成功部署于真实机器人。
AI.conclusion: MoMaGen 提供了一个通用且原则化的框架，可自动生成满足复杂约束的大规模示教数据，显著降低多步骤双臂移动操作模仿学习的采集与部署成本。
AI.translation: MoMaGen：在软硬约束下为多步骤双臂移动操作生成示教数据
AI.summary: 本文提出 MoMaGen，一个面向多步骤双臂移动操作的自动化示教数据生成框架。该方法把数据合成转化为约束优化，同时满足可达性等硬约束与可见性等软约束，可在仿真中基于单条人类示教生成大规模多样化数据。实验表明，MoMaGen 在四项任务上生成的数据多样性优于现有方法，训练出的策略仅用40条真实数据即可在真实机器人上成功部署。
AI.keywords: 模仿学习；数据自动生成；双臂移动操作；约束优化；可达性；可见性
AI.comments: 研究聚焦于移动基座与双臂协同操作带来的双重约束，提出的统一优化框架具有良好通用性；若能进一步量化软硬约束权重对生成质量的影响，将更具说服力。

title: UniGenBench++: A Unified Semantic Evaluation Benchmark for Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Recent progress in text-to-image (T2I) generation underscores the importance of reliable benchmarks in evaluating how accurately generated images reflect the semantics of their textual prompt. However, (1) existing benchmarks lack the diversity of prompt scenarios and multilingual support, both essential for real-world applicability; (2) they offer only coarse evaluations across primary dimensions, covering a narrow range of sub-dimensions, and fall short in fine-grained sub-dimension assessment. To address these limitations, we introduce UniGenBench++, a unified semantic assessment benchmark for T2I generation. Specifically, it comprises 600 prompts organized hierarchically to ensure both coverage and efficiency: (1) spans across diverse real-world scenarios, i.e., 5 main prompt themes and 20 subthemes; (2) comprehensively probes T2I models' semantic consistency over 10 primary and 27 sub evaluation criteria, with each prompt assessing multiple testpoints. To rigorously assess model robustness to variations in language and prompt length, we provide both English and Chinese versions of each prompt in short and long forms. Leveraging the general world knowledge and fine-grained image understanding capabilities of a closed-source Multi-modal Large Language Model (MLLM), i.e., Gemini-2.5-Pro, an effective pipeline is developed for reliable benchmark construction and streamlined model assessment. Moreover, to further facilitate community use, we train a robust evaluation model that enables offline assessment of T2I model outputs. Through comprehensive benchmarking of both open- and closed-sourced T2I models, we systematically reveal their strengths and weaknesses across various aspects.

AI.title_translation: UniGenBench++：统一的文本到图像生成语义评估基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出UniGenBench++，一个包含600个中英双语、长短版本提示的层级化基准，覆盖5大主题20子主题及10主维27子维评估标准，并训练离线评估模型，系统揭示各类T2I模型优劣。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I评估基准缺乏多样化提示场景与多语言支持，仅提供粗略的主维度评估，无法对细粒度子维度进行充分评测，限制了其在真实场景中的适用性与诊断能力。
AI.method: 构建600条层级化提示，涵盖5大主题20子主题并支持中英双语长短版本；定义10主维27子维评估标准；利用Gemini-2.5-Pro开发自动标注与评估流程，并训练可离线使用的评估模型。
AI.result: 新基准在多样场景与细粒度语义维度上全面评测开闭源T2I模型，系统揭示了各模型在不同评估维度上的优势与不足，并验证了离线评估模型的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: UniGenBench++通过丰富场景、多语言、细粒度评估与离线评估模型，为T2I语义一致性评测提供了更可靠、易用的统一基准，推动社区研究。
AI.translation: 最近文本到图像生成进展凸显可靠基准对评估生成图像与文本提示语义一致性的关键作用。然而，现有基准缺乏多样化提示场景与多语言支持，仅提供粗略主维度评估，难以进行细粒度子维度评测。为此，我们提出UniGenBench++，统一语义评估基准，包含600条层级化提示，覆盖5大主题20子主题，定义10主维27子维评估标准，支持中英双语长短版本。利用Gemini-2.5-Pro构建自动标注与评估流程，训练离线评估模型。系统评测开闭源T2I模型并揭示其优劣。
AI.summary: UniGenBench++针对现有T2I基准场景单一、语言受限、评估粗略的问题，提出600条中英双语、长短版本的层级化提示，覆盖5大主题20子主题，定义10主维27子维细粒度评估标准。利用Gemini-2.5-Pro构建自动标注与评估流程，训练可离线使用的评估模型，系统评测并揭示各类T2I模型优劣，为社区提供统一、可靠、易用的语义一致性评测基准。
AI.keywords: 文本到图像生成；语义评估基准；多语言支持；细粒度评估；多模态大语言模型；离线评估模型
AI.comments: 该基准通过层级化提示与多语言、多长度设置，显著提升评测覆盖度与鲁棒性；利用闭源MLLM自动化流程降低标注成本；开放离线评估模型方便社区快速使用，有望推动T2I模型语义一致性研究。

title: General transformation neural networks: A class of parametrized functions for high-dimensional function approximation
summary: We propose a novel class of neural network-like parametrized functions, i.e., general transformation neural networks (GTNNs), for high-dimensional approximation. Conventional deep neural networks sometimes perform less accurately on learning problems trained with gradient descent, especially when the target function is oscillatory. To improve accuracy, we generalize the neuron's affine transformation to a broader class of functions that can capture complex shapes and offer greater capacity. Specifically, we discuss three types of GTNNs in detail: the cubic, quadratic and trigonometric transformation neural networks (CTNNs, QTNNs and TTNNs). We perform an approximation error analysis of GTNNs, presenting their universal approximation properties for continuous functions, error bounds for Barron-type functions and error bounds of deep architectures. Several numerical examples of regression problems are presented, demonstrating that CTNNs/QTNNs/TTNNs achieve higher accuracy than conventional fully connected neural networks.

AI.title_translation: 通用变换神经网络：一类用于高维函数近似的参数化函数
AI.tldr: 提出将神经元仿射变换推广为更灵活的变换（三次、二次、三角）以提升对振荡等复杂目标函数的逼近精度，并给出通用逼近与误差界理论。
AI.motivation: 传统深度神经网络在用梯度下降训练振荡等复杂目标函数时精度不足，需要更具表达力的参数化函数。
AI.method: 将神经元仿射变换推广为一般变换，构建三种实例：三次变换网络（CTNN）、二次变换网络（QTNN）与三角变换网络（TTNN），并进行逼近误差理论分析及数值回归实验。
AI.result: 理论证明GTNN具有对连续函数的通用逼近性，给出Barron型函数及深层结构的显式误差界；数值实验显示CTNN/QTNN/TTNN在回归任务上比全连接网络精度更高。
AI.conclusion: GTNN通过扩展神经元变换形式，显著增强了对高维、振荡函数的逼近能力，兼具理论保证与实测优势。
AI.translation: 我们提出一类新的类似神经网络的参数化函数，即通用变换神经网络（GTNN），用于高维近似。常规深度神经网络在使用梯度下降训练时，当目标函数振荡时精度不足。为提高精度，我们将神经元的仿射变换推广到更广泛的函数类，可捕捉复杂形状并提供更大容量。具体讨论三次、二次和三角变换网络（CTNN、QTNN、TTNN）。我们对GTNN进行逼近误差分析，给出其对连续函数的通用逼近性质、Barron型函数的误差界以及深层结构的误差界。多个回归数值例子表明CTNN/QTNN/TTNN比常规全连接网络精度更高。
AI.summary: GTNN把传统神经元仿射变换替换为更灵活的非线性变换，在理论上保证对连续函数通用逼近并给出Barron及深层误差界，实验验证其在高维回归中对振荡函数比全连接网络更精准。
AI.keywords: 通用变换神经网络,高维函数近似,振荡函数,三次变换网络,三角变换网络,Barron函数,误差界
AI.comments: 文章未讨论计算开销、训练难度及网络结构设计细节，也未与传统专用振荡逼近方法对比。

title: egoEMOTION: Egocentric Vision and Physiological Signals for Emotion and Personality Recognition in Real-World Tasks
summary: Understanding affect is central to anticipating human behavior, yet current egocentric vision benchmarks largely ignore the person's emotional states that shape their decisions and actions. Existing tasks in egocentric perception focus on physical activities, hand-object interactions, and attention modeling - assuming neutral affect and uniform personality. This limits the ability of vision systems to capture key internal drivers of behavior. In this paper, we present egoEMOTION, the first dataset that couples egocentric visual and physiological signals with dense self-reports of emotion and personality across controlled and real-world scenarios. Our dataset includes over 50 hours of recordings from 43 participants, captured using Meta's Project Aria glasses. Each session provides synchronized eye-tracking video, headmounted photoplethysmography, inertial motion data, and physiological baselines for reference. Participants completed emotion-elicitation tasks and naturalistic activities while self-reporting their affective state using the Circumplex Model and Mikels' Wheel as well as their personality via the Big Five model. We define three benchmark tasks: (1) continuous affect classification (valence, arousal, dominance); (2) discrete emotion classification; and (3) trait-level personality inference. We show that a classical learning-based method, as a simple baseline in real-world affect prediction, produces better estimates from signals captured on egocentric vision systems than processing physiological signals. Our dataset establishes emotion and personality as core dimensions in egocentric perception and opens new directions in affect-driven modeling of behavior, intent, and interaction.

AI.title_translation: egoEMOTION：以自我为中心的视觉与生理信号在真实任务中的情绪与人格识别
AI.tldr: 提出首个结合自我中心视觉与生理信号的情绪-人格数据集，证明视觉信号比生理信号更能预测真实场景下的情绪。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心视觉基准忽视情绪状态，仅关注物理行为，限制了对人类行为内在驱动因素的理解。
AI.method: 使用Meta Aria眼镜采集43名受试者50小时同步数据（眼动视频、PPG、IMU、生理基线），设计情绪诱发与自然任务，基于Circumplex与Big Five自评，定义连续情绪、离散情绪、人格三项基准任务，并以经典学习法作基线。
AI.result: 在真实情绪预测中，以自我为中心视觉系统捕获的信号优于生理信号。
AI.conclusion: 情绪与人格应成为自我中心感知的核心维度，为行为、意图与交互的情感驱动建模开辟新方向。
AI.translation: 理解情感对预测人类行为至关重要，但现有自我中心视觉基准大多忽略影响决策与行为的情绪状态。本文提出首个结合自我中心视觉与生理信号并密集自报情绪与人格的数据集egoEMOTION，包含43人50小时数据，定义三项基准任务并验证视觉信号优于生理信号。
AI.summary: egoEMOTION数据集通过Meta Aria眼镜同步采集眼动视频、PPG、IMU与生理基线，覆盖情绪诱发与自然任务，提供连续情绪、离散情绪与人格三种标签，证明视觉信号在真实情绪预测中优于生理信号，推动情感驱动的自我中心感知研究。
AI.keywords: 自我中心视觉,情绪识别,人格识别,生理信号,真实场景
AI.comments: 无

title: Predicting Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease using Machine Learning Methods: A Retrospective Cohort Study
comments: This manuscript has been submitted for consideration at HEPATOLOGY. Supplemental material is included in the Appendix. For associated code, see https://github.com/mary-elena-an/MASLD-EHR-Prediction
summary:
Background and Aims: Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD) affects 30-40% of U.S. adults and is the most common chronic liver disease. Although often asymptomatic, progression can lead to cirrhosis. We developed a prediction model to assist with early detection of MASLD.
  Approach and Results: We evaluated LASSO logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and a neural network model for MASLD prediction using clinical feature subsets from a large electronic health record (EHR) database, including the top 10 ranked features. To reduce disparities in true positive rates across racial and ethnic subgroups, we applied an equal opportunity postprocessing method in a prediction model called MASLD EHR Static Risk Prediction (MASER).
  This retrospective cohort study included 59,492 participants in the training data, 24,198 in the validating data, and 25,188 in the testing data. The LASSO logistic regression model with the top 10 features was selected for its interpretability and comparable performance. Before fairness adjustment, the model achieved AUROC of 0.84, accuracy of 78%, sensitivity of 72%, specificity of 79%, and F1-score of 0.617. After equal opportunity postprocessing, accuracy modestly increased to 81% and specificity to 94%, while sensitivity decreased to 41% and F1-score to 0.515, reflecting the fairness trade-off.
  Conclusions: MASER achieved competitive performance for MASLD prediction, comparable to previously reported ensemble and tree-based models, while using a limited and routinely collected feature set and a diverse study population. The development of MASER lends itself to ease of clinical implementation for early detection and for further integration into primary care workflows.

AI.title_translation: 基于机器学习方法预测代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病：一项回顾性队列研究
AI.tldr: 研究者利用电子健康记录中的10项常规指标，构建名为MASER的LASSO逻辑回归模型，可在多族裔人群中以81%准确率和0.84 AUROC早期预测MASLD，并通过公平性后处理降低种族差异。
AI.motivation: MASLD影响30–40%美国成人且常无症状，需开发可解释、易获取的早期筛查工具以降低肝硬化风险。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究：从EHR提取特征，比较LASSO、随机森林、XGBoost与神经网络，用前十特征构建LASSO模型，并采用equal opportunity后处理提升跨族裔公平性。
AI.result: 模型在测试集(25,188人)上，公平性调整前AUROC 0.84、准确率78%、敏感度72%、特异度79%；调整后准确率升至81%、特异度94%，敏感度降至41%。
AI.conclusion: MASER以少量常规指标实现与复杂模型相当的预测性能，便于基层临床部署与早期筛查。
AI.translation: 背景与目的：代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病(MASLD)影响30–40%美国成人，是最常见的慢性肝病，虽常无症状但可进展为肝硬化。我们开发预测模型以辅助早期发现。方法与结果：利用大型EHR数据库，评估LASSO逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost与神经网络，以前十特征构建模型，并采用equal opportunity后处理减少种族亚组真阳性率差异，形成MASER模型。研究共纳入训练59,492人、验证24,198人、测试25,188人。最终选择LASSO模型，因其可解释且性能相当。公平性调整后，准确率升至81%，特异度升至94%，敏感度降至41%。结论：MASER在多族裔人群中以有限常规指标实现竞争性能，便于临床早期检测与基层整合。
AI.summary: 本研究基于近11万例EHR数据，用前十项常规临床指标构建可解释LASSO模型MASER，AUROC达0.84，经公平性后处理后在保持高特异度同时减少族裔差异，适合基层早期筛查MASLD。
AI.keywords: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病；机器学习；LASSO逻辑回归；电子健康记录；公平性；早期预测
AI.comments: 研究优势在于大样本、多族裔及公平性调整；但公平性处理显著降低敏感度，需权衡假阴性风险。未来可前瞻性验证并纳入纵向数据以提升性能。

title: Towards Scalable Oversight via Partitioned Human Supervision
summary: As artificial intelligence (AI) systems approach and surpass expert human performance across a broad range of tasks, obtaining high-quality human supervision for evaluation and training becomes increasingly challenging. Our focus is on tasks that require deep knowledge and skills of multiple domains, where this bottleneck is severe. Unfortunately, even the best human experts are knowledgeable only in a single narrow area, and will not be able to evaluate the correctness of advanced AI systems on such superhuman tasks. However, based on their narrow expertise, humans may provide a weak signal, i.e., a complementary label indicating an option that is incorrect. For example, a cardiologist could state that ''this is not related to any cardiovascular disease,'' even if they cannot identify the true disease. Based on this weak signal, we propose a scalable oversight framework that enables us to evaluate frontier AI systems without the need to prepare the ground truth. We derive an unbiased estimator of top-1 accuracy from complementary labels and quantify how many complementary labels are needed to match the variance of ordinary labels. We further introduce two estimators to combine scarce ordinary labels with abundant complementary labels. We provide finite-sample deviation guarantees for both complementary-only and the mixed estimators. Empirically, we show that we can evaluate the output of large language models without the ground truth, if we have complementary labels. We further show that we can train an AI system with such weak signals: we show how we can design an agentic AI system automatically that can improve itself with this partitioned human supervision. Our code is available at https://github.com/R-Yin-217/Towards-Scalable-Oversight-via-Partitioned-Human-Supervision.

AI.title_translation: 面向可扩展监督的分区式人类监督方法
AI.tldr: 提出一种利用互补标签（仅指出错误选项）而非完整真值来评估与训练AI的可扩展监督框架，并给出无偏估计器及其理论保证。
AI.motivation: 当AI在需要多领域深度知识的任务上超越单个人类专家时，传统依赖完整真值的高质量人类监督变得不可行，必须寻求更弱但可扩展的人类信号。
AI.method: 利用专家在其狭窄领域内给出的互补标签（仅否定某选项），推导出top-1准确率的无偏估计器；提出两种融合稀缺普通标签与大量互补标签的估计器，并给出有限样本偏差保证；基于此框架设计可自我改进的智能体系统。
AI.result: 理论上量化了所需互补标签数量以匹配普通标签的方差；实验表明无需真值即可评估大语言模型输出，并可用弱信号训练AI系统。
AI.conclusion: 分区式互补标签监督是一种可行且可扩展的途径，可在无真值条件下对前沿AI进行评估与训练。
AI.translation: 无
AI.summary: 本文针对AI系统在多领域超人类任务上的评估与训练难题，提出一种仅依赖专家互补标签（否定单选项）的可扩展监督框架。作者推导出top-1准确率的无偏估计器，给出达到与普通标签同等方差所需的互补标签数量，并提出两种融合普通标签与互补标签的估计器，附带有限样本理论保证。实验验证该框架可在无真值情况下评估大语言模型，并支持智能体系统的自我改进。
AI.keywords: 可扩展监督,互补标签,分区人类监督,AI评估,弱监督学习
AI.comments: 文章提出了一种新颖且实用的弱监督思路，理论分析与实验验证兼备，为超越单个人类专家的AI系统提供了现实可行的评估与训练途径。

title: Breaking Agent Backbones: Evaluating the Security of Backbone LLMs in AI Agents
comments: Julia Bazinska and Max Mathys contributed equally
summary: AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are being deployed at scale, yet we lack a systematic understanding of how the choice of backbone LLM affects agent security. The non-deterministic sequential nature of AI agents complicates security modeling, while the integration of traditional software with AI components entangles novel LLM vulnerabilities with conventional security risks. Existing frameworks only partially address these challenges as they either capture specific vulnerabilities only or require modeling of complete agents. To address these limitations, we introduce threat snapshots: a framework that isolates specific states in an agent's execution flow where LLM vulnerabilities manifest, enabling the systematic identification and categorization of security risks that propagate from the LLM to the agent level. We apply this framework to construct the $b^3$ benchmark, a security benchmark based on 194,331 unique crowdsourced adversarial attacks. We then evaluate 34 popular LLMs with it, revealing, among other insights, that enhanced reasoning capabilities improve security, while model size does not correlate with security. We release our benchmark, dataset, and evaluation code to facilitate widespread adoption by LLM providers and practitioners, offering guidance for agent developers and incentivizing model developers to prioritize backbone security improvements.

AI.title_translation: 攻破代理脊梁：评估AI代理中骨干大模型的安全性
AI.tldr: 提出threat snapshot框架与b³基准，系统评估34个主流大模型作为AI代理“脊梁”时的安全表现，发现推理能力增强可提升安全，而模型规模与安全无显著相关。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型驱动的AI代理大规模部署，尚缺对“选择不同骨干LLM如何影响代理安全”的系统认知；现有框架或仅捕捉特定漏洞，或需对整个代理建模，难以系统识别LLM漏洞向代理层传播的安全风险。
AI.method: 1) 提出threat snapshot框架，隔离代理执行流中LLM漏洞显现的特定状态；2) 基于194331条众包对抗样本构建b³安全基准；3) 用该基准对34个流行LLM进行安全评估。
AI.result: 评估显示：增强的推理能力与代理安全正相关；模型规模与安全无显著相关性；系统识别并分类了LLM向代理层传播的安全风险。
AI.conclusion: threat snapshot框架与b³基准可有效衡量LLM作为AI代理脊梁时的安全水平，为代理开发者提供选型指导，并激励模型供应方优先提升骨干模型安全。
AI.translation: AI代理正由大模型驱动并大规模部署，但我们对骨干LLM选择如何影响代理安全缺乏系统理解。AI代理的非确定性与顺序特性使安全建模复杂化，传统软件与AI组件融合也将新型LLM漏洞与常规安全风险交织。现有框架仅部分应对这些挑战，要么只捕捉特定漏洞，要么需对整个代理建模。为此，我们提出threat snapshot：一种隔离代理执行流中LLM漏洞显现状态的框架，可系统识别并分类从LLM传播至代理层的安全风险。利用该框架，我们构建b³基准，其基于194331条众包对抗攻击。随后评估34个流行LLM，揭示增强推理能力可提升安全，而模型规模与安全无相关性。我们公开基准、数据集与评估代码，供LLM供应方与从业者广泛采用，为代理开发者提供指导，并激励模型开发者优先改进脊梁安全。
AI.summary: 本文提出threat snapshot框架，隔离AI代理执行中LLM漏洞关键状态，建立含194K对抗样本的b³安全基准，对34个主流大模型进行系统评估，发现推理能力越强越安全、模型规模无关，呼吁业界优先提升骨干LLM安全。
AI.keywords: AI代理安全；大模型安全；威胁快照；对抗攻击；安全基准；推理能力；模型规模
AI.comments: 作者未在摘要中说明实验复现细节、计算开销及伦理审批情况；未提及具体漏洞类别与攻击成功率的量化结果。

title: A Survey of Data Agents: Emerging Paradigm or Overstated Hype?
comments: Please refer to our paper list and companion materials at: https://github.com/HKUSTDial/awesome-data-agents
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has spurred the emergence of data agents, autonomous systems designed to orchestrate Data + AI ecosystems for tackling complex data-related tasks. However, the term "data agent" currently suffers from terminological ambiguity and inconsistent adoption, conflating simple query responders with sophisticated autonomous architectures. This terminological ambiguity fosters mismatched user expectations, accountability challenges, and barriers to industry growth. Inspired by the SAE J3016 standard for driving automation, this survey introduces the first systematic hierarchical taxonomy for data agents, comprising six levels that delineate and trace progressive shifts in autonomy, from manual operations (L0) to a vision of generative, fully autonomous data agents (L5), thereby clarifying capability boundaries and responsibility allocation. Through this lens, we offer a structured review of existing research arranged by increasing autonomy, encompassing specialized data agents for data management, preparation, and analysis, alongside emerging efforts toward versatile, comprehensive systems with enhanced autonomy. We further analyze critical evolutionary leaps and technical gaps for advancing data agents, especially the ongoing L2-to-L3 transition, where data agents evolve from procedural execution to autonomous orchestration. Finally, we conclude with a forward-looking roadmap, envisioning proactive, generative data agents.

AI.title_translation: 数据智能体综述：新兴范式还是过度炒作？
AI.tldr: 本文提出首个六级分层分类法，系统梳理数据智能体从手动到完全自主的演进，并指出L2→L3跃迁是当前关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 大模型催生“数据智能体”概念，但术语混乱导致期望错位、问责困难与产业壁垒，亟需统一框架厘清能力边界。
AI.method: 借鉴SAE J3016驾驶自动化标准，构建六级分层分类；按自主性递增的系统回顾现有研究，聚焦L2→L3跃迁。
AI.result: 提出L0–L5六级分类，明确责任分配；发现当前主流处于L2，L3级自主编排仍缺关键技术与评估基准。
AI.conclusion: 数据智能体非炒作而是新兴范式，但需突破L3跃迁技术缺口，未来应发展主动生成式智能体并建立统一评估体系。
