AI.result: EoW场景下现有TSE模型性能下降，TTS增强显著提升听感，但语音识别准确率仍有差距。
AI.conclusion: EoW框架可实现无需预采集的无缝交互，TTS增强有效，但需进一步优化以缩小识别准确率差距。
AI.translation: 目标语音提取（TSE）通常依赖预录高质量注册语音，破坏用户体验并限制自然交互的可行性。本文提出“唤醒即注册”（EoW），利用人机交互中自然捕获的唤醒词片段自动作为注册参考，无需预采集即可实现无缝体验。我们首次系统研究EoW-TSE，在真实多样声学条件下评估先进判别与生成模型。针对唤醒词短且含噪，采用大模型TTS进行注册增强。结果显示，当前TSE模型在EoW-TSE中性能下降，TTS增强显著改善听感，但语音识别准确率仍有差距。
AI.summary: 本文提出EoW框架，用唤醒词替代预录注册，实现无需预采集的目标语音提取，首次系统评估其在真实嘈杂场景下的性能，发现TTS增强可提升听感但识别准确率仍不足。
AI.keywords: 目标语音提取；唤醒即注册；人机交互；嘈杂环境；TTS增强
AI.comments: 研究首次验证EoW可行性，为无缝交互提供新思路，但识别准确率瓶颈需后续算法优化解决。

title: AI-Driven Structure Refinement of X-ray Diffraction
summary: Artificial intelligence can rapidly propose candidate phases and structures from X-ray diffraction (XRD), but these hypotheses often fail in downstream refinement because peak intensities cannot be stably assigned under severe overlap and diffraction consistency is enforced only weakly. Here we introduce the whole-pattern expectation--maximization (WPEM) algorithm, a physics-constrained whole-pattern decomposition and refinement workflow that turns Bragg's law into an explicit constraint within a batch expectation--maximization framework. WPEM models the full profile as a probabilistic mixture density and iteratively infers component-resolved intensities while keeping peak centres Bragg-consistent, producing a continuous, physically admissible intensity representation that remains stable in heavily overlapped regions and in the presence of mixed radiation or multiple phases. We benchmark WPEM on standard reference patterns (PbSO$_4$ and Tb$_2$BaCoO$_5$), where it yields lower $R_p/R_{wp}$ than widely used packages (FullProf and TOPAS) under matched refinement conditions. We further demonstrate generality across realistic experimental scenarios, including phase-resolved decomposition in multiphase materials, quantitative recovery of mixture compositions, separation of crystalline peaks from amorphous backgrounds in semicrystalline systems, high-throughput operando lattice tracking, automated refinement of compositionally disordered solid solutions, and quantitative phase-resolved analysis of complex archaeological samples from synchrotron powder XRD. By providing Bragg-consistent, uncertainty-aware intensity partitioning as a refinement-ready interface, WPEM closes the gap between AI-generated hypotheses and diffraction-admissible structure refinement on challenging XRD data.

AI.title_translation: AI驱动的X射线衍射结构精修
AI.tldr: 提出WPEM算法，将布拉格定律嵌入期望最大化框架，实现重叠峰下仍物理一致的全谱精修，在标准与复杂实验数据上均优于传统软件。
AI.motivation: AI虽能快速给出候选相与结构，但其峰值强度在严重重叠时无法稳定分配，且衍射一致性约束弱，导致后续精修失败。
AI.method: 提出全谱期望–最大化(WPEM)算法：把全谱建模为概率混合密度，在批处理EM迭代中推断各组分强度，并显式保持峰位布拉格一致性，输出连续且物理可接受的强度分布。
AI.result: 在PbSO₄与Tb₂BaCoO₅标准谱图上，WPEM在相同精修条件下比FullProf与TOPAS获得更低的R_p/R_wp；在多相材料、半晶体系、operando晶格跟踪、固溶体自动精修及复杂考古样品等实验场景均展示广泛适用性。
AI.conclusion: WPEM通过提供布拉格一致且带不确定度的强度分配，可作为精修就绪接口，弥合AI假设与衍射可接受精修之间的差距。
AI.translation: 本文引入全谱期望–最大化(WPEM)算法，将布拉格定律显式嵌入批量EM框架，实现重叠峰下仍物理一致的全谱分解与精修。
AI.summary: WPEM算法把XRD全谱视为概率混合密度，在迭代中保持布拉格约束，稳定解析严重重叠峰，并在多种实验条件下取得优于传统软件的精修性能，为AI提出的结构假设提供可直接精修的强度分配。
AI.keywords: X射线衍射，结构精修，期望最大化算法，布拉格定律，峰重叠，人工智能
AI.comments: 摘要未提及代码或数据是否开源；未给出具体运行时间或计算成本；未讨论对仪器参数误差的鲁棒性。

title: Probability-Invariant Random Walk Learning on Gyral Folding-Based Cortical Similarity Networks for Alzheimer's and Lewy Body Dementia Diagnosis
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Lewy body dementia (LBD) present overlapping clinical features yet require distinct diagnostic strategies. While neuroimaging-based brain network analysis is promising, atlas-based representations may obscure individualized anatomy. Gyral folding-based networks using three-hinge gyri provide a biologically grounded alternative, but inter-individual variability in cortical folding results in inconsistent landmark correspondence and highly irregular network sizes, violating the fixed-topology and node-alignment assumptions of most existing graph learning methods, particularly in clinical datasets where pathological changes further amplify anatomical heterogeneity. We therefore propose a probability-invariant random-walk-based framework that classifies individualized gyral folding networks without explicit node alignment. Cortical similarity networks are built from local morphometric features and represented by distributions of anonymized random walks, with an anatomy-aware encoding that preserves permutation invariance. Experiments on a large clinical cohort of AD and LBD subjects show consistent improvements over existing gyral folding and atlas-based models, demonstrating robustness and potential for dementia diagnosis.

AI.title_translation: 基于脑回折叠的皮层相似性网络中概率不变随机游走学习的阿尔茨海默病与路易体痴呆诊断
AI.tldr: 提出一种概率不变随机游走框架，无需节点对齐即可对个体化脑回折叠网络进行分类，在AD与LBD诊断上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: AD与LBD临床表现重叠却需不同诊断策略，现有图谱网络忽视个体解剖差异，而脑回折叠网络因个体变异导致拓扑不一致，传统图学习方法难以适用。
AI.method: 构建个体皮层相似性网络，提取局部形态特征；用匿名随机游走分布表示网络，设计保留排列不变性的解剖感知编码；在随机游走特征上训练分类器。
AI.result: 在大规模AD与LBD临床队列上，该方法较现有脑回折叠模型与图谱模型取得一致性能提升，表现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 概率不变随机游走框架无需显式节点对齐即可有效利用个体化脑回折叠网络，为痴呆诊断提供新的个体化解剖基础工具。
AI.translation: 阿尔茨海默病与路易体痴呆临床表现重叠却需不同诊断策略。虽然基于神经影像的脑网络分析前景良好，但图谱表示可能掩盖个体解剖差异。基于三铰链脑回的脑回折叠网络提供生物学基础替代方案，然而个体间皮层折叠差异导致标志点对应不一致和网络规模高度不规则，违反大多数现有图学习方法对固定拓扑与节点对齐的假设，尤其在病理变化加剧解剖异质性的临床数据集中。我们提出一种概率不变随机游走框架，无需显式节点对齐即可对个体化脑回折叠网络进行分类。通过局部形态特征构建皮层相似性网络，并以匿名随机游走分布表示，配合保持排列不变性的解剖感知编码。在AD与LBD大型临床队列实验显示，该方法较现有脑回折叠与图谱模型取得一致提升，展现鲁棒性与痴呆诊断潜力。
AI.summary: 本文针对AD与LBD诊断需求，提出概率不变随机游走框架，解决个体化脑回折叠网络因拓扑不一致导致的分类难题，无需节点对齐即可实现鲁棒痴呆分类。
AI.keywords: 脑回折叠网络,概率不变随机游走,阿尔茨海默病,路易体痴呆,个体化解剖,皮层相似性网络
AI.comments: 摘要未提及随机游走长度、特征维度、样本量、具体评估指标及代码是否开源。

title: Targeted T2-FLAIR Dropout Training Improves Robustness of nnU-Net Glioblastoma Segmentation to Missing T2-FLAIR
summary: Purpose: To determine whether targeted T2 fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (T2-FLAIR) dropout training improves glioblastoma MRI tumor segmentation robustness to missing T2-FLAIR without degrading performance when T2-FLAIR is available. Materials and Methods: This retrospective multi-dataset study developed nnU-Net models on BraTS 2021 (n=848) and externally tested them on UPenn-GBM glioblastoma MRI (n=403; 2006-2018; age 18-89 years; 60% male). Models were trained with no dropout or targeted T2-FLAIR dropout (probability rate r=0.35 or 0.50) by replacing only the T2-FLAIR channel with zeros. Inference used T2-FLAIR-present and T2-FLAIR-absent scenarios (T2-FLAIR set to zero). The primary endpoint was Dice similarity coefficient (DSC); secondary endpoints were 95th percentile Hausdorff distance and Bland-Altman whole-tumor volume bias. Equivalence was assessed with two one-sided tests using +/-1.5 DSC percentage points, and noninferiority versus HD-GLIO used a -1.5-point margin. Results: With T2-FLAIR present, median overall DSC was 94.8% (interquartile range, 90.0%-97.1%) with dropout and 95.0% (interquartile range, 90.3%-97.1%) without dropout (equivalence supported, p<0.001). With T2-FLAIR absent, median overall DSC improved from 81.0% (interquartile range, 75.1%-86.4%) without dropout to 93.4% (interquartile range, 89.1%-96.2%) with dropout (r=0.35); edema DSC improved from 14.0% to 87.0%, edema 95th percentile Hausdorff distance improved from 22.44 mm to 2.45 mm, and whole-tumor volume bias improved from -45.6 mL to 0.83 mL. Dropout was noninferior to HD-GLIO under T2-FLAIR-present (all p<0.001). Conclusion: Targeted T2-FLAIR dropout preserved segmentation performance when T2-FLAIR was available and reduced segmentation error and whole-tumor volume bias when T2-FLAIR was absent.

AI.title_translation: 靶向T2-FLAIR随机失活训练提升nnU-Net胶质母细胞瘤分割对缺失T2-FLAIR的鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 通过在训练阶段随机“关闭”T2-FLAIR通道，nnU-Net在T2-FLAIR缺失时Dice从81.0%升至93.4%，且T2-FLAIR存在时性能不降。
AI.motivation: 临床常见T2-FLAIR序列缺失，现有模型一旦缺少该通道性能骤降，需一种不依赖额外数据、不降低原性能的提升鲁棒性方法。
AI.method: 回顾性多中心研究，用BraTS 2021（848例）训练nnU-Net，在UPenn-GBM（403例）外部验证；训练时以0.35或0.50概率将T2-FLAIR通道置零，其余通道保持；推理比较T2-FLAIR存在与缺失场景，主要指标Dice，次要指标95% Hausdorff距离与体积偏差。
AI.result: T2-FLAIR存在时，dropout组中位Dice 94.8%，非dropout组95.0%，等价性成立；T2-FLAIR缺失时，dropout组Dice升至93.4%，水肿Dice从14.0%升至87.0%，Hausdorff距离从22.44 mm降至2.45 mm，体积偏差从-45.6 mL降至0.83 mL；dropout在T2-FLAIR存在时非劣于HD-GLIO。
AI.conclusion: 靶向T2-FLAIR随机失活可在T2-FLAIR可用时保持性能，在T2-FLAIR缺失时显著降低分割误差与体积偏差，提升模型鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 本研究提出一种简单策略：训练时随机将T2-FLAIR通道置零，使nnU-Net学会在缺失该序列时仍能准确分割胶质母细胞瘤，且不影响序列完整时的表现。
AI.summary: 作者用BraTS 2021数据训练nnU-Net，在训练阶段以35%概率将T2-FLAIR通道清零，外部验证显示T2-FLAIR缺失时Dice从81%升至93%，水肿分割大幅改善，而T2-FLAIR存在时性能与无dropout等价，证明该方法可低成本提升临床鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 胶质母细胞瘤；nnU-Net；T2-FLAIR；随机失活；鲁棒性；MRI分割
AI.comments: 研究聚焦单序列缺失问题，方法简洁易落地；仅针对T2-FLAIR，未探讨其他序列缺失组合；外部验证数据跨度大，但未报告扫描参数差异影响；未来可扩展至多序列联合缺失及在线自适应策略。

title: Cooperative ISAC for Joint Localization and Velocity Estimation in Cell-Free MIMO Systems
summary: In this paper, we explore a cooperative integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework that utilizes orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) waveforms. Under the control of a central processing unit (CPU), multiple access points (APs) collaboratively perform multistatic sensing while providing communication service in a cell-free multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system. Achieving high sensing accuracy requires the collection of global sensing information at the CPU, which can lead to significant fronthaul signaling overhead due to the feedback of the sensing signals from each AP. To tackle this issue, we propose a collaborative processing scheme in which the APs locally compress and quantize the received sensing signals before forwarding them to the CPU. The CPU then aggregates the information from all APs to estimate the location and velocity of the targets. We develop a distributed vector-quantized variational autoencoder (D-VQVAE) to enable an end-to-end implementation of this scheme. D-VQVAE consists of distributed encoders at the APs to locally encode the received sensing signals, codebooks for quantizing the encoded results, and a decoder at the CPU for location and velocity estimation. It effectively reduces the amount of data transmitted from each AP to the CPU while maintaining a high sensing accuracy. We employ a collaborative learning-assisted scheme to train D-VQVAE in an end-to-end manner. Simulation results show that the proposed D-VQVAE network outperforms the baseline schemes in sensing accuracy and reduces fronthaul signaling overhead by 99% when compared with the centralized sensing approach.

AI.title_translation: 无蜂窝MIMO系统中联合定位与速度估计的协作式通感一体化
AI.tldr: 提出基于D-VQVAE的协作ISAC框架，AP本地压缩感知信号再回传CPU，实现99%前传开销压缩并保持高感知精度。
AI.motivation: 集中式感知需回传全部原始信号，前传开销巨大，亟需低反馈、高精度的分布式感知方案。
AI.method: AP本地压缩量化接收信号→CPU聚合→D-VQVAE端到端训练：分布式编码器+码本量化+中央解码器联合估计目标位置与速度。
AI.result: D-VQVAE在保持高感知精度的同时，将前传信令开销较集中式方案降低99%，并优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 协作压缩感知+D-VQVAE可在极低前传负载下实现高精度定位与速度估计，为无蜂窝MIMO ISAC提供可行方案。
AI.translation: 本文研究基于OFDM波形的协作通感一体化框架，无蜂窝MIMO多AP在CPU控制下协同多静态感知并提供通信服务。为降低全局感知信息回传带来的前传开销，提出AP本地压缩量化后回传的协作处理机制，CPU融合估计目标位置与速度。为此设计分布式矢量量化变分自编码器D-VQVAE，实现端到端压缩与估计，仿真表明其感知精度优于基线且前传开销较集中式降低99%。
AI.summary: 针对无蜂窝MIMO ISAC场景前传开销瓶颈，提出D-VQVAE协作压缩感知架构，AP以极低码率回传量化特征，CPU端重构并联合估计目标位置与速度，实现99%信令压缩且感知性能优于基线。
AI.keywords: 通感一体化；无蜂窝MIMO；协作感知；矢量量化变分自编码器；前传压缩；联合定位与速度估计
AI.comments: 摘要信息完整，但未提供复杂度分析、实际部署约束及与纯通信性能权衡的评估。

title: Waveform Design for Partial-Time Superimposed ISAC Systems
summary: Nowadays, waveforms of integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) are almost based on conventional communication and sensing signal, which bounds both the communication and sensing performance. To deal with this issue, in this paper, a novel waveform design is presented for the partial-time superimposed (PTS) ISAC system. At the base station (BS), a parameter-adjustable linear frequency modulation (LFM) pulse signal and a continuous communication orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) signal are employed to broadcast public information and perform sensing tasks, respectively, using a PTS scheme. Pulse compression gain enhances the system's long-range sensing capability, while OFDM ensures the system's high-speed data transmission capability. Meanwhile, the LFM signal is utilized as superimposed pilot for channel estimation, which has higher time-frequency resource utilization and stronger real-time performance compared to orthogonal pilots. We present an accurate parameter estimation method of multi-path sensing signal for reconstructing and interference cancellation in communication users. Additionally, a cyclic maximum likelihood method is introduced for channel estimation and the Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) of channel estimation is derived. Simulations demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the proposed parameter estimation algorithm as well as the improved channel estimation performance over traditional methods. The proposed waveform design method can achieve reliable data transmission and accurate target sensing.

AI.title_translation: 部分时间叠加ISAC系统的波形设计
AI.tldr: 提出一种部分时间叠加ISAC波形，用可调LFM脉冲提升探测距离，用连续OFDM保证高速通信，并以LFM作叠加导频进行信道估计，仿真验证其估计精度与鲁棒性优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 传统ISAC波形受限于既有通信与探测信号，导致通信与感知性能受限，需设计新波形同时提升两者性能。
AI.method: 在基站采用参数可调LFM脉冲与连续OFDM分别执行探测与通信，按部分时间叠加方式发射；LFM同时作为叠加导频，利用脉冲压缩增益提升远距探测能力；提出多径感知信号参数估计用于重构与干扰消除，并引入循环最大似然信道估计及推导其CRLB。
AI.result: 仿真表明所提参数估计算法精度高且鲁棒，信道估计性能优于传统方法，系统可实现可靠数据传输与精确目标感知。
AI.conclusion: 所提波形设计方法在部分时间叠加ISAC系统中同时实现可靠通信与精确感知，性能优于传统方案。
AI.translation: 本文针对部分时间叠加ISAC系统提出一种新型波形设计，利用可调LFM脉冲与连续OFDM分别完成感知与通信，并以LFM作叠加导频，通过提出的参数估计与循环最大似然信道估计方法，实现估计精度与系统性能的提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出部分时间叠加ISAC波形，将可调LFM脉冲与连续OFDM按时间叠加发射，LFM同时作为叠加导频，利用脉冲压缩增益提升远距探测，结合多径参数估计与循环最大似然信道估计，实现优于传统方法的通信与感知性能。
AI.keywords: ISAC波形设计,部分时间叠加,LFM脉冲,OFDM,叠加导频,信道估计,参数估计,CRLB
AI.comments: 摘要未给出具体复杂度分析与硬件实现细节，也未与其他最新ISAC波形进行直接对比。

title: Height-Dependent Spectrum Activity Measurements and Modeling: A Case Study with FM Radio Bands
summary: The increasing demand for wireless connectivity necessitates advanced spectrum modeling to enable efficient spectrum sharing for next-generation aerial communications. While traditional models often overlook vertical variations in signal behavior, this paper proposes a height-dependent propagation model using a helikite-mounted software-defined radio (SDR). We collected extensive measurement data across the 88 MHz to 6 GHz range in both urban and rural environments. As a case study to validate our methodology, we focus on the FM radio band, which allows us to use publicly available transmitter locations and transmit power levels to facilitate comparisons between analytical with measurement results. We identify a clear transition from non-line-of-sight (NLoS) to line-of-sight (LoS) regimes at a specific altitude threshold and propose an altitude-dependent path loss model that incorporates this transition. Our results demonstrate that the proposed model significantly outperforms the standard free space path loss (FSPL) model in complex urban topologies, providing a more accurate framework for altitude-aware spectrum prediction and management across emerging aerial wireless technologies and bands.

AI.title_translation: 高度依赖的频谱活动测量与建模：FM广播频段案例研究
AI.tldr: 本文利用氦气球搭载的软件定义无线电(SDR)，提出一种高度依赖的传播模型，通过对比FM广播频段实测与公开发射数据，发现NLoS到LoS转换高度阈值，所提模型在城市环境中显著优于自由空间路径损耗(FSPL)。
AI.motivation: 下一代空中通信亟需考虑垂直维度信号变化的先进频谱建模，以支持高效频谱共享。
AI.method: 使用氦气球挂载SDR，在88 MHz–6 GHz范围于城市与农村环境采集大量测量数据；以FM广播频段为案例，利用公开发射机位置与功率进行实测与分析对比；识别NLoS→LoS转换高度并构建高度依赖路径损耗模型。
AI.result: 明确观测到特定高度阈值处NLoS向LoS转换；所提高度依赖路径损耗模型在城市复杂地形下显著优于标准FSPL模型。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为面向新兴空中无线技术与频段的空域感知频谱预测与管理提供了更准确框架。
AI.translation: 本文提出并验证了一种高度依赖的传播模型，可提升城市空中通信频谱预测精度。
AI.summary: 针对空中通信对频谱建模的需求，作者用氦气球SDR在88 MHz–6 GHz采集城乡数据，以FM频段为例发现NLoS→LoS转换高度，提出高度依赖路径损耗模型，城市环境下精度优于FSPL。
AI.keywords: 高度依赖传播模型、频谱测量、FM广播、路径损耗、空中通信、软件定义无线电、氦气球
AI.comments: 研究聚焦高度维度对传播的影响，模型验证仅使用FM频段，未来可扩展至其他频段与密集城市多径环境。

title: Comparing Implicit Neural Representations and B-Splines for Continuous Function Fitting from Sparse Samples
summary: Continuous signal representations are naturally suited for inverse problems, such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and computed tomography, because the measurements depend on an underlying physically continuous signal. While classical methods rely on predefined analytical bases like B-splines, implicit neural representations (INRs) have emerged as a powerful alternative that use coordinate-based networks to parameterize continuous functions with implicitly defined bases. Despite their empirical success, direct comparisons of their intrinsic representation capabilities with conventional models remain limited. This preliminary empirical study compares a positional-encoded INR with a cubic B-spline model for continuous function fitting from sparse random samples, isolating the representation capacity difference by only using coefficient-domain Tikhonov regularization. Results demonstrate that, under oracle hyperparameter selection, the INR achieves a lower normalized root-mean-squared error, yielding sharper edge transitions and fewer oscillatory artifacts than the oracle-tuned B-spline model. Additionally, we show that a practical bilevel optimization framework for INR hyperparameter selection based on measurement data split effectively approximates oracle performance. These findings empirically support the superior representation capacity of INRs for sparse data fitting.

AI.title_translation: 基于稀疏采样连续函数拟合的隐式神经表示与B样条对比
AI.tldr: 在稀疏采样条件下，位置编码隐式神经表示（INR）比三次B样条具有更强的连续函数表示能力，边缘更锐利且振荡更少。
AI.motivation: 连续信号表示对MRI、CT等逆问题至关重要；尽管INR在经验上表现优异，但其与经典B样条在表示能力上的直接对比仍不足，需系统评估。
AI.method: 仅使用系数域Tikhonov正则化，将位置编码INR与三次B样条在稀疏随机采样下进行连续函数拟合，并通过双层优化框架从测量数据分裂中自动选择INR超参数。
AI.result: 在“神谕”超参数选择下，INR的归一化均方根误差更低，边缘过渡更锐利，振荡伪影更少；提出的双层优化框架可近似神谕性能。
AI.conclusion: 经验证据表明INR在稀疏数据拟合任务中具有优于B样条的表示能力，且可通过数据驱动的双层优化实现近神谕表现。
AI.translation: 连续信号表示天然适用于MRI与CT等逆问题，因测量依赖物理连续信号。经典方法依赖预定义解析基如B样条，而隐式神经表示（INR）以坐标网络参数化连续函数，基隐式定义。尽管INR经验成功，其与常规模型表示能力的直接对比仍有限。本初步实证研究比较位置编码INR与三次B样条在稀疏随机采样下的连续函数拟合，仅使用系数域Tikhonov正则化以隔离表示能力差异。结果表明，在神谕超参数选择下，INR获得更低归一化均方根误差，边缘过渡更锐利，振荡更少。此外，基于测量数据分裂的实用双层优化框架可有效近似神谕性能。这些发现经验支持INR在稀疏数据拟合中的优越表示能力。
AI.summary: 本文通过控制正则化条件，系统对比位置编码INR与三次B样条在稀疏采样下的连续函数拟合能力，证明INR在精度、边缘保持与伪影抑制上均占优，并提出数据驱动的双层优化策略实现自动超参数选择。
AI.keywords: 隐式神经表示，B样条，连续函数拟合，稀疏采样，逆问题，Tikhonov正则化，双层优化
AI.comments: 未提及网络结构细节、采样率范围、计算开销及更高维扩展；双层优化的收敛保证与计算成本亦未讨论。

title: Provable orbit recovery over SO(3) from the non-uniform second moment
summary: We study the recovery of an unknown three-dimensional band-limited signal from multiple noisy observations that are randomly rotated by latent elements of SO(3), where the rotations are drawn from an unknown, non-uniform distribution. Because the rotations are unobserved, only the signal orbit under the rotation group can be recovered. We show that the signal orbit and the rotation distribution are jointly identifiable from the first and second moments. This yields an improved high-noise sample complexity that scales quadratically with the noise variance, rather than cubically as in the uniform-rotation case. We further develop a provable, computationally efficient reconstruction algorithm that recovers the 3-D signal by successively solving a sequence of well-conditioned linear systems. The algorithm is validated through extensive numerical experiments. Our results provide a principled and tractable framework for high-noise 3-D orbit recovery, with potential relevance to cryo-electron microscopy and cryo-electron tomography modeling, where molecules are observed in unknown orientations.

AI.title_translation: 基于非均匀二阶矩的SO(3)可证轨道恢复
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可证明的高效算法，仅利用带噪观测的一阶和二阶矩即可在非均匀旋转分布下恢复三维信号的轨道，样本复杂度较均匀情形降低为二次。
AI.motivation: 在冷冻电镜等应用中，分子在未知三维旋转下被观测，噪声极高且旋转分布非均匀，传统方法样本复杂度高达噪声方差的三次方，亟需降低复杂度并给出可证保证。
AI.method: 证明信号轨道与旋转分布可由一阶和二阶矩联合辨识；设计级联求解良态线性方程组的可证高效算法，无需知道旋转分布先验。
AI.result: 在非均匀旋转下样本复杂度降为噪声方差的二次；数值实验验证算法在高噪声场景准确恢复三维信号。
AI.conclusion: 首次给出非均匀SO(3)旋转下可证的低样本复杂度轨道恢复框架，为冷冻电镜建模提供理论与实用工具。
AI.translation: 我们研究从多个带噪观测中恢复未知三维带限信号，观测被SO(3)的潜在随机旋转变换，旋转服从未知非均匀分布。由于旋转未观测，只能恢复信号在旋转群下的轨道。我们证明信号轨道和旋转分布可联合由一阶和二阶矩辨识，得到改进的高噪声样本复杂度，与噪声方差成二次而非均匀情形的三次关系。进一步提出可证的计算高效重建算法，通过依次求解一系列良态线性系统恢复三维信号。算法经大量数值实验验证。结果为高噪声三维轨道恢复提供有原则且可处理的框架，可能对冷冻电镜和冷冻电子断层成像建模具有意义。
AI.summary: 本文针对非均匀旋转下三维轨道恢复问题，提出基于一阶和二阶矩的可证辨识理论，样本复杂度降至噪声方差二次，并设计级联线性求解的高效算法，实验验证其在高噪声环境优势，适用于冷冻电镜。
AI.keywords: 轨道恢复，SO(3)，非均匀旋转，二阶矩，样本复杂度，冷冻电镜，线性系统
AI.comments: 未提及算法具体运行时间或内存消耗；未与现有均匀旋转方法进行定量比较；未讨论带限假设对真实分子密度的影响。

title: FGFRFT: Fast Graph Fractional FourierTransform via Fourier Series Approximation
summary: The graph fractional Fourier transform (GFRFT) generalizes the graph Fourier transform (GFT) but suffers from a significant computational bottleneck: determining the optimal transform order requires expensive eigendecomposition and matrix multiplication, leading to $O(N^3)$ complexity. To address this issue, we propose a fast GFRFT (FGFRFT) algorithm for unitary GFT matrices based on Fourier series approximation and an efficient caching strategy. FGFRFT reduces the complexity of generating transform matrices to $O(2LN^2)$ while preserving differentiability, thereby enabling adaptive order learning. We validate the algorithm through theoretical analysis, approximation accuracy tests, and order learning experiments. Furthermore, we demonstrate its practical efficacy for image and point cloud denoising and present the fractional specformer, which integrates the FGFRFT into the specformer architecture. This integration enables the model to overcome the limitations of a fixed GFT basis and learn optimal fractional orders for complex data. Experimental results confirm that the proposed algorithm significantly accelerates computation and achieves superior performance compared with the GFRFT.

AI.title_translation: 快速图分数阶傅里叶变换：基于傅里叶级数近似的FGFRFT
AI.tldr: 用傅里叶级数近似把图分数阶傅里叶变换的复杂度从O(N³)降到O(2LN²)，同时保留可微性，可自适应学习阶数并在图像/点云降噪与specformer架构中取得更好效果。
AI.motivation: 图分数阶傅里叶变换虽推广了图傅里叶变换，但需昂贵特征分解与矩阵乘法来确定最优变换阶数，计算瓶颈阻碍其在大规模数据中的应用。
AI.method: 提出基于酉图傅里叶矩阵的FGFRFT算法，用傅里叶级数近似变换核并配合高效缓存策略，将生成变换矩阵的复杂度降至O(2LN²)，保持可微性以支持自适应阶数学习；进一步把FGFRFT嵌入specformer得到fractional specformer。
AI.result: 理论分析、近似精度测试与阶数学习实验均验证算法有效性；在图像与点云降噪任务中，FGFRFT相比原GFRFT显著加速且性能更优；fractional specformer能学习最优分数阶，克服固定GFT基局限。
AI.conclusion: FGFRFT以低复杂度实现高精度近似，使图分数阶傅里叶变换可扩展至实际大规模应用，并为图神经网络提供新的可学习变换基础。
AI.translation: 图分数阶傅里叶变换（GFRFT）虽推广了图傅里叶变换（GFT），但存在显著计算瓶颈：确定最优变换阶数需昂贵特征分解与矩阵乘法，复杂度达O(N³)。为此，我们提出基于傅里叶级数近似与高效缓存策略的快速GFRFT（FGFRFT）算法，适用于酉GFT矩阵。FGFRFT将变换矩阵生成复杂度降至O(2LN²)并保持可微，从而支持自适应阶数学习。我们通过理论分析、近似精度测试与阶数学习实验验证算法，并在图像、点云降噪及fractional specformer架构中展示其实用性，实验表明其显著加速并优于GFRFT。
AI.summary: 本文提出FGFRFT，通过傅里叶级数近似把图分数阶傅里叶变换的复杂度从O(N³)降到O(2LN²)，保留可微性以支持阶数自适应学习，并在图像、点云降噪及改进的specformer中验证其高效与优越性能。
AI.keywords: 图信号处理，分数阶傅里叶变换，快速算法，傅里叶级数近似，自适应阶数学习，图像降噪，点云降噪，specformer
AI.comments: 作者未在摘要中公开代码或数据集；实际可扩展性与超参数L的选择策略需结合具体应用进一步评估。

title: Continuous-Time Analysis of AFDM: Fundamental Bounds, and Effects of Pulse-Shaping and Hardware Impairments
summary: Affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) has recently emerged as a resilient waveform candidate for high-mobility next-generation wireless systems. However, current literature mostly focuses on discrete time (DT) models, often overlooking effects and hardware non-idealities of actual continuous time (CT) signal generation. In this paper, we bridge this gap by developing a CT-analytical framework based on the affine Fourier series (AFS) representation, which allows us to demonstrate that strictly bandlimited pulses and subcarrier suppression strategies are essential to maintain the multicarrier structure of the signal. In addition, we derive the analytical power spectral density of AFDM and evaluate its spectral characteristics in comparison with other multicarrier schemes, considering the impact of realistic truncated pulse-shaping. Furthermore, we analyze the sensitivity of the CT model to phase noise, carrier frequency offset, and sampling jitter, providing a theoretical analysis of communication performance. Finally, we derive closed-form Cramér-Rao bounds for channel parameter estimation, showing that the chirped modulation peculiar of AFDM increases the estimation variance but enables the resolution of Doppler ambiguities. Our findings provide the necessary theoretical and practical foundations for the implementation of AFDM in realistic wireless transceivers.

AI.title_translation: 连续时间AFDM分析：基本界、脉冲成形与硬件损伤效应
AI.tldr: 本文首次建立AFDM的连续时间分析框架，揭示严格带限脉冲与载波抑制对保持多载波结构的必要性，给出功率谱密度闭合式，量化相位噪声、频偏、采样抖动对性能的影响，并导出信道参数估计的Cramér-Rao下界。
AI.motivation: 现有AFDM研究仅关注离散时间模型，忽略真实连续时间信号生成中的脉冲成形截断与硬件非理想效应，阻碍其在高移动性下一代无线系统中的实用化。
AI.method: 基于仿射傅里叶级数（AFS）构建连续时间分析框架；推导AFDM功率谱密度闭合表达式；理论分析相位噪声、载波频偏、采样抖动对系统性能的影响；导出信道参数估计的Cramér-Rao下界。
AI.result: 证明严格带限脉冲与载波抑制策略是维持AFDM多载波结构的关键；给出考虑截断脉冲成形的功率谱密度闭合式；量化连续时间模型对相位噪声、频偏、采样抖动的敏感度；揭示AFDM啁啾调制增大估计方差但可解决多普勒模糊。
AI.conclusion: 研究为AFDM在真实无线收发机中的实现提供了连续时间理论基础与实用设计准则。
AI.translation: 本文首次建立AFDM的连续时间分析框架，揭示严格带限脉冲与载波抑制对保持多载波结构的必要性，给出功率谱密度闭合式，量化相位噪声、频偏、采样抖动对性能的影响，并导出信道参数估计的Cramér-Rao下界。
AI.summary: 针对高移动性场景，本文建立AFDM连续时间分析框架，证明需采用严格带限脉冲与载波抑制以保持多载波特性；给出功率谱密度闭合式并比较其他多载波方案；理论分析相位噪声、频偏、采样抖动对性能影响；导出信道估计Cramér-Rao界，指出啁啾调制增大方差但可解多普勒模糊，为AFDM实用化奠定理论与设计基础。
AI.keywords: 仿射频分复用；连续时间分析；脉冲成形；硬件损伤；功率谱密度；Cramér-Rao下界

title: Synapse-Inspired Energy Networks: A Neuromorphic Approach to Microgrid Protection without Communication Links
comments: Accepted in principle at Communications Engineering (Nature Portfolio). Topical Collection: "Microgrids and Distributed Energy Systems". Final formatting revisions pending. 24 February 2026
summary: Traditional protection systems for microgrids, which rely on high fault currents and continuous communication, struggle to keep up with the changing dynamics and cybersecurity concerns of decentralized networks. In this study, we introduce a novel biologically inspired protection system based on neuromorphic principles, where each distributed energy resource (DER) functions as a simple neuron. These neurons process local changes in voltage, current signals, and converting them into spike patterns that represent the severity of disturbances. Just as neurons communicate via synapses in biological systems, we exploit transmission cables to coordinate between DERs, enabling them to share information and respond to faults collectively. Fault detection and circuit breaker activation are driven by a First-To-Spike (FTTS) mechanism, similar to the concept of traveling wave protection, but without needing GPS synchronization or communication links. A key innovation is the ability to use the timing of spikes to locally determine the nature of a fault, offering an intelligent, adaptive response to disturbances. Performance shows tripping latency of 10-58 ms, surpassing conventional relays and even traveling-wave methods (60 ms), while maintaining detection accuracy above 98% and spatial selectivity over 97%, enabling real-time, communication-free, scalable protection for plug-and-play microgrids.

AI.title_translation: 突触启发式能源网络：一种无需通信链路的神经形态微电网保护方法
AI.tldr: 借鉴神经元-突触机制，让微电网中每个DER像神经元一样把本地电压/电流变化转成脉冲，利用输电线路本身“突触”式协调，无需通信即可在10–58 ms内完成故障检测与隔离，精度>98%。
AI.motivation: 传统依赖大故障电流与持续通信的微电网保护难以适应去中心化带来的动态变化与网络安全威胁，亟需无通信、自适应的新保护范式。
AI.method: 将各DER建模为简单神经元，把本地电压/电流扰动转换为脉冲；利用输电线路充当突触实现DER间协调；采用“首脉冲触发”(FTTS)机制判定故障并驱动断路器跳闸，无需GPS或通信。
AI.result: 跳闸延迟10–58 ms，优于传统继电器及行波保护(60 ms)；检测准确率>98%，空间选择性>97%，可实现即插即用微电网的实时、无通信、可扩展保护。
AI.conclusion: 神经形态原理可实现无需通信的高可靠微电网保护，为去中心化电网提供低延迟、高选择性的自适应解决方案。
AI.translation: 传统微电网保护依赖大故障电流与持续通信，难以应对去中心化带来的动态变化与网络安全风险。本文提出一种生物启发的神经形态保护系统，每个分布式能源(DER)充当简单神经元，将本地电压、电流变化转换为表征扰动严重程度的脉冲序列。借鉴生物突触机制，利用输电线路实现DER间协调，无需通信即可集体响应故障。采用首脉冲触发(FTTS)机制实现故障检测与断路器动作，无需GPS同步。通过脉冲时序本地判别故障性质，实现智能自适应响应。实验结果显示跳闸延迟10–58 ms，优于传统继电器及行波方法(60 ms)，检测准确率>98%，空间选择性>97%，支持即插即用微电网的实时无通信可扩展保护。
AI.summary: 本文提出神经形态微电网保护：各DER像神经元把扰动转成脉冲，用输电线当突触协调，无需通信即可58 ms内精准隔离故障，为去中心化电网提供低延迟、高选择性保护。
AI.keywords: 神经形态保护；微电网；无通信；首脉冲触发；分布式能源；自适应保护
AI.comments: 摘要未提硬件实现细节、实验规模、成本及在复杂拓扑下的鲁棒性，也未讨论与现有标准的兼容性。

title: Timing Recovery and Sequence Detection for Integrate-and-Fire Time Encoding Receivers
comments: 6 pages, 3 figures, accepted in 2026 IEEE Wireless Communications and Networking Conference (WCNC 2026)
summary: Recent advances in neuromorphic signal processing have introduced time encoding machines as a promising alternative to conventional uniform sampling for low-power communication receivers. In this paradigm, analog signals are converted into event timings by an integrate-and-fire circuit, allowing information to be represented through spike times rather than amplitude samples. While event-driven sampling eliminates the need for a fixed-rate clock, receivers equipped with integrate-and-fire time encoding machines, called time encoding receivers, often assume perfect symbol synchronization, leaving the problem of symbol timing recovery unresolved. This paper presents a joint timing recovery and data detection framework for integrate-and-fire time encoding receivers. The log-likelihood function is derived to capture the dependence between firing times, symbol timing offset, and transmitted sequence, leading to a maximum likelihood formulation for joint timing estimation and sequence detection. A practical two-stage receiver is developed, consisting of a timing recovery algorithm followed by a zero-forcing detector. Simulation results demonstrate accurate symbol timing offset estimation and improved symbol error rate performance compared to existing time encoding receivers.

AI.title_translation: 用于积分-发放时间编码接收机的定时恢复与序列检测
AI.tldr: 提出一种联合定时恢复与数据检测框架，解决积分-发放时间编码接收机中的符号定时同步问题，并显著降低误码率。
AI.motivation: 积分-发放时间编码接收机虽具低功耗优势，但现有工作普遍假设符号完全同步，缺乏有效的符号定时恢复机制，限制了其实用性。
AI.method: 推导发射序列、符号定时偏移与发放时刻间依赖关系的对数似然函数，建立最大似然联合估计模型，并设计先定时恢复后零迫检测的两级接收机。
AI.result: 仿真表明所提算法可精确估计符号定时偏移，且符号误码率优于现有时间编码接收机。
AI.conclusion: 联合定时恢复与检测框架使积分-发放时间编码接收机无需固定速率时钟即可实现可靠符号同步，提升通信性能。
AI.translation: 神经形态信号处理的最新进展将时间编码机引入低功耗通信接收机，以替代传统均匀采样。在此范式下，积分-发放电路将模拟信号转换为事件时刻，信息由脉冲时刻而非幅度样本表示。事件驱动采样无需固定速率时钟，但配备积分-发放时间编码机的接收机（称时间编码接收机）通常假设符号完全同步，符号定时恢复问题尚未解决。本文提出联合定时恢复与数据检测框架，推导捕捉发放时刻、符号定时偏移与发射序列间依赖的对数似然函数，形成最大似然联合估计与检测。提出实用两级接收机：先定时恢复算法，后零迫检测器。仿真结果验证符号定时偏移估计准确，且符号误码率优于现有时间编码接收机。
AI.summary: 针对积分-发放时间编码接收机，提出基于最大似然的联合定时恢复与序列检测方案，通过两级结构实现低复杂度实现，显著改善符号同步精度与误码性能。
AI.keywords: 时间编码机,积分-发放,定时恢复,序列检测,最大似然,符号同步
AI.comments: 摘要未提及硬件实现复杂度与功耗对比，亦未讨论多径信道或非理想时钟下的鲁棒性。

title: Distributed Continuous Aperture Arrays for Multiuser SWIPT
comments: The paper has been accepted for presentation at IEEE International Conference on Communications (ICC), 24 to 28 May 2026
summary: This paper proposes a distributed continuous aperture array (D CAPA) to support simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) to multiple information users (IUs) and energy users (EUs). Each metasurface supports continuous surface currents that radiate electromagnetic (EM) waves for information and energy transmission to the users. These waves propagate through continuous EM channels characterized by the dyadic Green function. We formulate a system power consumption (PC) minimization problem subject to spectral efficiency and energy harvesting quality of service (QoS) requirements, where the QoS requirements are derived under the equal power allocation (EPA) scheme. An efficient two layer optimization algorithm is developed to solve this problem by optimizing the power allocation subject to the QoS violation penalties using augmented Lagrangian transformation. Our numerical results show that well optimized current distributions over each metasurface in the proposed D CAPA achieve up to 65% and 61% reductions in overall system PC compared to the EPA and colocated CAPA (C CAPA) cases, while maintaining the same total aperture size and transmission power.

AI.title_translation: 面向多用户SWIPT的分布式连续孔径阵列
AI.tldr: 提出分布式连续孔径阵列(D-CAPA)，通过联合优化连续表面电流分布，在满足通信与能量QoS约束下，系统功耗相比等功率分配与集中式CAPA分别降低65%与61%。
AI.motivation: 传统集中式阵列难以同时满足多用户信息传输与能量收集的高效需求，需探索利用连续表面电流与分布式架构提升SWIPT能效。
AI.method: 1) 建立D-CAPA连续表面电流辐射模型，采用并矢格林函数描述连续电磁信道；2) 在给定等功率分配下推导QoS约束；3) 构建以系统功耗最小化为目标、频谱效率与能量收集QoS为约束的优化问题；4) 提出双层优化算法，利用增广拉格朗日变换处理QoS违例惩罚，迭代优化电流分布与功率分配。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，在总孔径与发射功率不变条件下，优化后的D-CAPA使系统功耗比等功率分配方案降低65%，比集中式CAPA降低61%，同时满足QoS要求。
AI.conclusion: 分布式连续孔径阵列通过灵活优化连续表面电流分布，可显著提升多用户SWIPT系统的能量效率，为低功耗绿色通信提供新思路。
AI.translation: 本文提出一种分布式连续孔径阵列(D-CAPA)，用于对多信息用户(IUs)与能量用户(EUs)同时进行无线信息与功率传输(SWIPT)。每块超表面支持连续表面电流，通过并矢格林函数描述的连续电磁信道辐射电磁波。以等功率分配下的QoS约束为基准，构建系统功耗最小化问题，并开发双层优化算法，利用增广拉格朗日变换处理QoS违例惩罚。仿真显示，相比等功率分配与集中式CAPA，系统功耗分别降低65%与61%。

title: BRISC: A Dataset of Channel Measurements at 5 GHz With a Reflective Intelligent Surface
summary: We introduce the broadband reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) channel (BRISC) dataset. The dataset comprises measurements of channel state information (CSI) collected at 5.53 GHz using a 256-element RIS with binary states. In the measurement campaign, the transmitter and receiver are two software defined radios (SDRs), phase-synchronized via an OctoClock, where the transmitter (receiver) is equipped with one (two) antenna(s). To manage complexity, the RIS elements are grouped into blocks of different sizes, where all elements within a block share the same state. CSIs have been captured for multiple a) transmitter positions (and fixed receiver location), b) pilot block sizes, and c) state configurations. Furthermore, we calibrated the parameters of state-of-the-art RIS channel models to fit the measured CSI. With approximately 10000 configurations explored per transmitting position, BRISC serves as a robust benchmark in communication applications. We also show here an example of its use for physical-layer authentication.

title: Resilient Cell-Free Massive MIMO Networks
summary: This paper proposes a novel optimization framework for enhancing the security resilience of cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (CF-mMIMO) networks with multi-antenna access points (APs) and protective partial zero-forcing (PPZF) under active eavesdropping. Based on the main principles of absorption, adaptation, and recovery, we formulate a security-aware resilience metric to quantify the system performance during and after a security outage. A multi-user service priority-aware power allocation problem is formulated to minimize the mean squared error (MSE) between real-time and desired security efficiency, thereby enabling a trade-off between the target user's secrecy performance and multi-user quality of service (QoS). To solve this non-convex problem, a security-aware iterative algorithm based on the successive convex approximation (SCA) is employed. The proposed algorithm determines the optimal power allocation strategy by balancing solution quality against recovery time. At each iteration, it evaluates the overall resilience score and selects the strategy that achieves the highest value. Simulation results confirm that the proposed framework significantly improves the resilience of CF-mMIMO networks, allowing flexible adaptation between rapid recovery and high-quality recovery, depending on system requirements.

AI.title_translation: 具有韧性的无蜂窝大规模MIMO网络
AI.tldr: 提出基于吸收-适应-恢复原则的优化框架，通过安全感知迭代功率分配算法，在主动窃听下提升无蜂窝大规模MIMO网络的韧性。
AI.motivation: 无蜂窝大规模MIMO网络在主动窃下面临安全中断后缺乏量化与提升韧性的系统方法，需兼顾用户保密性能与多用户QoS。
AI.method: 建立安全感知韧性指标，构建以最小化实时与期望安全效率间MSE的多用户优先级功率分配非凸问题，采用基于SCA的安全感知迭代算法求解，每轮迭代评估韧性得分并选择最优策略。
AI.result: 仿真表明所提框架显著提升CF-mMIMO网络韧性，可根据需求在快速恢复与高质量恢复间灵活调整。
AI.conclusion: 通过安全感知的迭代功率优化，可在安全中断后有效平衡恢复速度与质量，实现系统韧性增强。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新颖的优化框架，用于在多天线接入点(AP)采用保护性部分零迫(PPZF)的无蜂窝大规模多输入多输出(CF-mMIMO)网络中，增强对主动窃听的安全韧性。基于吸收、适应与恢复的核心原则，我们制定了安全感知韧性指标，以在安全中断期间及之后量化系统性能。通过构建多用户服务优先级感知的功率分配问题，最小化实时与期望安全效率的均方误差(MSE)，从而在目标用户保密性能与多用户服务质量(QoS)之间取得平衡。为求解该非凸问题，采用基于连续凸近似(SCA)的安全感知迭代算法。该算法在每次迭代中评估整体韧性得分，并选择得分最高的策略，以平衡解质量与恢复时间。仿真结果证实，所提框架显著提升CF-mMIMO网络的韧性，可根据系统需求在快速恢复与高质量恢复之间灵活调整。
AI.summary: 针对无蜂窝大规模MIMO网络在主动窃听下的安全中断问题，论文提出以吸收-适应-恢复为核心的安全感知韧性框架，设计多用户优先级功率分配算法，用SCA迭代求解，实现保密性能与QoS权衡，仿真验证其韧性提升效果。
AI.keywords: 无蜂窝大规模MIMO；安全韧性；主动窃听；功率分配；连续凸近似；多用户QoS
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体AP数量、用户规模、信道模型及复杂度分析，也未给出韧性指标的数学表达式。

title: Vision-Inspired Image Quality Assessment for Radar-Based Human Activity Representations
summary: Radar-based human activity recognition has gained attention as a privacy-preserving alternative to vision and wearable sensors, especially in sensitive environments like long-term care facilities. Micro-Doppler spectrograms derived from FMCW radar signals are central to recognizing dynamic activities, but their effectiveness is limited by noise and clutter. In this work, we use a benchmark radar dataset to reimplement and assess three recent denoising and preprocessing techniques: adaptive preprocessing, adaptive thresholding, and entropy-based denoising. To illustrate the shortcomings of conventional metrics in low-SNR regimes, we evaluate performance using both perceptual image quality measures and standard error-based metrics. We additionally propose a novel framework for static activity recognition using range-angle feature maps to expand HAR beyond dynamic activities. We present two important contributions: a temporal tracking algorithm to enforce consistency and a no-reference quality scoring algorithm to assess RA-map fidelity. According to experimental findings, our suggested techniques enhance classification performance and interpretability for both dynamic and static activities, opening the door for more reliable radar-based HAR systems.

AI.title_translation: 面向雷达人体活动表征的视觉启发图像质量评估

title: A Light Fixture Color Temperature and Color Rendering Index Measuring Device
summary: The correlated color temperature (CCT) and color rendering index (CRI) of artificial light sources are important because they have implications for human biology and professional applications. Although CCT information is generally available for commercial lamps, CRI is commonly not reported. In addition, devices measuring these parameters are difficult to access as they require a spectrophotometer, a commonly expensive device. In this context, the present work designs and builds a meter in detail, from the structural part of the equipment, interface with sensors, and the calculation to the compensation algorithms implementation, aiming to build the dedicated functionalities of a spectrophotometer, which is designed without the use of optical lenses. In addition to simplifying the device, this approach allows measurements free from dispersions caused by chromatic aberrations typical of optical lenses. The prototype obtained proved to be effective, capturing the spectral power distributions of various light sources and calculating their CCT and CRI.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于测量灯具色温和显色指数的设备
AI.tldr: 作者设计并制造了一种无需光学透镜、可替代昂贵光谱仪的便携式设备，用于测量人工光源的相关色温(CCT)和显色指数(CRI)，并通过实验验证其有效性。

AI.result: 原型机成功采集多种光源的光谱功率分布并准确计算其CCT与CRI，验证设备有效性。

AI.summary: 本文提出一种低成本、无透镜的便携式设备，可替代昂贵光谱仪，快速测得人工光源的色温和显色指数，并通过实验验证其性能。

title: Superimposed Pilot-Based OTFS: Will It Work?
summary: Orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) modulation is a promising solution to handle doubly-selective fading, but its channel estimation is a nontrivial task in terms of maximizing spectral efficiency. Conventional pilot assignment approaches face challenges: the standard embedded pilot-based scheme suffers from low transmission rates, and the single superimposed pilot (SP)-based scheme experiences inevitable data-pilot interference, leading to coarse channel estimation. To cope with this issue, focusing on the SP-based OTFS system in channel coded scenarios, we propose a novel pilot assignment scheme and an iterative algorithm. The proposed scheme allocates multiple SPs per frame to estimate channel coefficients accurately. Furthermore, the proposed algorithm performs refined interference cancellation, utilizing a replica of data symbols generated from soft-decision outputs provided by a decoder. Assuming fair and unified conditions, we evaluate each pilot assignment scheme in terms of reliability, channel estimation accuracy, effective throughput, and computational complexity. Our numerical simulations demonstrate that the multiple SP-based scheme, which balances the transmission rate and the interference cancellation performance, has the best throughput at the expense of slightly increased complexity. In addition, we confirm that the multiple SP-based scheme achieves further improved throughput due to the proposed interference cancellation algorithm.

AI.title_translation: 基于叠加导频的OTFS：它是否可行？
AI.tldr: 针对叠加导频(SP)OTFS系统，提出每帧插入多个SP并配合迭代干扰消除的联合方案，在可接受复杂度下显著提升有效吞吐率。
AI.motivation: 传统嵌入导频方案速率低，单SP方案存在数据-导频干扰导致信道估计粗糙，需在保持高谱效的同时提升估计精度。
AI.method: 在每帧中插入多个叠加导频；利用译码器软输出生成数据符号副本，迭代执行精细干扰消除；在统一条件下比较可靠性、估计精度、有效吞吐与计算复杂度。
AI.result: 多SP方案在稍增复杂度下获得最高有效吞吐；所提干扰消除算法进一步提升了吞吐性能。
AI.conclusion: 多叠加导频配合迭代干扰消除可在编码OTFS系统中实现速率与估计精度的良好折中。
AI.translation: 正交时频空间(OTFS)调制是应对双选衰落的有效手段，但其信道估计在最大化频谱效率方面颇具挑战。常规导频分配面临困境：标准嵌入导频传输速率低，单叠加导频(SP)方案存在数据-导频干扰，导致信道估计粗糙。针对编码场景下的SP-OTFS系统，本文提出一种新导频分配方案及迭代算法：每帧分配多个SP以精确估计信道系数，并利用译码器软输出生成的数据副本进行精细干扰消除。在统一条件下评估可靠性、估计精度、有效吞吐与复杂度。仿真表明，多SP方案在稍增复杂度下获得最佳吞吐，且所提干扰消除算法进一步提升吞吐。
AI.summary: 本文针对OTFS在双选信道下的高效信道估计问题，提出多叠加导频配合迭代干扰消除的新方案，通过增加少量复杂度换取显著的有效吞吐提升，为高速可靠OTFS通信提供可行途径。
AI.keywords: OTFS；叠加导频；信道估计；干扰消除；有效吞吐
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体导频数量、干扰消除迭代次数及复杂度量化结果，也未给出信道模型细节。

title: Single-Satellite-Based Geolocation of Broadcast GNSS Spoofers from Low Earth Orbit
summary: This paper presents an analysis and experimental demonstration of single-satellite single-pass geolocation of a terrestrial broadcast Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) spoofer from Low Earth Orbit (LEO). The proliferation of LEO-based GNSS receivers offers the prospect of unprecedented spectrum awareness, enabling persistent GNSS interference detection and geolocation. Accurate LEO-based single-receiver emitter geolocation is possible when a range-rate time history can be extracted for the emitter. This paper presents a technique crafted specifically for indiscriminate broadcast-type GNSS spoofing signals. Furthermore, it explores how unmodeled oscillator instability and worst-case spoofer-introduced signal variations degrade the geolocation estimate. The proposed geolocation technique is validated by a controlled experiment, in partnership with Spire Global, in which a LEO-based receiver captures broadcast GNSS spoofing signals transmitted from a known ground station on a non-GNSS frequency band.

AI.title_translation: 单颗低轨卫星对广播式GNSS欺骗源的地基定位
AI.tldr: 提出并验证了一种仅利用一颗低轨卫星单次过境即可定位地面广播式GNSS欺骗源的方法，分析了振荡器不稳定与欺骗信号变化对定位精度的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着低轨卫星搭载GNSS接收机数量激增，期望利用其全球覆盖能力实现对GNSS干扰的持久探测与定位，而现有研究尚未解决单星单次过境对广播式欺骗源的高精度定位问题。
AI.method: 针对广播式GNSS欺骗信号设计提取距离-速率时间历程的算法；建立含振荡器不稳定与欺骗信号变化的误差模型；与Spire Global合作开展受控实验，将已知地面站发射的欺骗信号（非GNSS频段）由LEO接收机捕获并定位。
AI.result: 实验成功验证了单星单次过境即可实现欺骗源定位；振荡器不稳定与最坏情况下的信号变化会显著降低定位精度，但所提算法仍能提供可用估计。
AI.conclusion: 单颗低轨卫星可在单次过境中完成广播式GNSS欺骗源定位，为大规模LEO星座实现全球GNSS干扰监测与地理围栏奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 本文提出并实验验证了一种利用单颗低轨卫星单次过境即可定位地面广播式GNSS欺骗源的方法。低轨GNSS接收机的激增为持续监测与定位GNSS干扰提供了前所未有的频谱感知能力。当可提取发射源的距离-速率时间历程时，单接收机即可实现高精度定位。本文针对广播式GNSS欺骗信号设计专门算法，并分析振荡器不稳定与欺骗信号变化对定位误差的影响。与Spire Global合作的受控实验表明，LEO接收机成功捕获并定位了地面站发射的非GNSS频段广播欺骗信号。
AI.summary: 针对低轨卫星对GNSS欺骗源的单星定位空白，提出提取距离-速率时间历程的专用算法，通过Spire Global实测验证其有效性，并量化振荡器与信号变化对精度的影响，为LEO星座全球干扰监测提供技术支撑。
AI.keywords: 低轨卫星；GNSS欺骗；单星定位；距离-速率；广播信号；振荡器不稳定
AI.comments: 摘要未给出具体定位误差指标，也未说明算法对动态欺骗源的适应性；未来可扩展到多星协同提升精度与更新率。

title: MSR-Codec: A Low-Bitrate Multi-Stream Residual Codec for High-Fidelity Speech Generation with Information Disentanglement
summary: Audio codecs are a critical component of modern speech generation systems. This paper introduces a low-bitrate, multi-scale residual codec that encodes speech into four distinct streams: semantic, timbre, prosody, and residual. This architecture achieves high-fidelity speech reconstruction at competitive low bitrates while demonstrating an inherent ability for information disentanglement. We construct a two-stage language model for text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis using this codec, which, despite its lightweight design and minimal data requirements, achieves a state-of-the-art Word Error Rate (WER) and superior speaker similarity compared to several larger models. Furthermore, the codec's design proves highly effective for voice conversion, enabling independent manipulation of speaker timbre and prosody. Our inference code, pre-trained models, and audio samples are available at https://github.com/herbertLJY/MSRCodec.

AI.title_translation: MSR-Codec：一种用于高保真语音生成、具备信息解耦能力的低码率多流残差编解码器
AI.tldr: 提出四流残差语音编解码器，在极低码率下仍能高保真重建，并借助两阶段语言模型实现轻量TTS与灵活音色韵律独立操控。
AI.motivation: 现有语音生成系统依赖高码率编解码或大规模模型，难以兼顾低码率、高保真与信息解耦，亟需轻量高效方案。
AI.method: 将语音编码成语义、音色、韵律、残差四流；构建两阶段语言模型进行TTS；利用信息解耦实现音色与韵律独立控制与语音转换。
AI.result: 在极低码率下实现高保真重建；TTS取得SOTA词错误率与更高说话人相似度；语音转换可独立操控音色与韵律。
AI.conclusion: MSR-Codec以低码率、轻量数据与模型实现高保真语音生成及灵活信息解耦，对TTS与语音转换均有效。
AI.translation: 音频编解码器是现代语音生成系统的关键组件。本文提出一种低码率、多尺度残差编解码器，将语音编码为语义、音色、韵律与残差四个独立流。该架构在竞争性低码率下实现高保真语音重建，并表现出内在的信息解耦能力。我们利用该编解码器构建两阶段文本到语音（TTS）语言模型，尽管设计轻量且所需数据极少，却在词错误率（WER）上达到先进水平，并在说话人相似度上优于多个更大模型。此外，该编解码器设计在语音转换中极为有效，可独立操控说话人音色与韵律。推理代码、预训练模型与音频样例已开源：https://github.com/herbertLJY/MSRCodec
AI.summary: MSR-Codec通过四流残差结构在低码率下高保真压缩语音，并天然解耦语义、音色、韵律与残差；配合轻量两阶段语言模型，实现SOTA WER的TTS与可控语音转换。
AI.keywords: 语音编解码器；低码率；多流残差；信息解耦；文本到语音；语音转换；高保真重建；轻量模型
AI.comments: Not mentioned in abstract

title: Bistatic Passive Sensing via CSI Power
summary: Passive object sensing with communication signals is a key enabler of perceptive mobile networks and integrated sensing and communication. In practical bistatic deployments, transmitter-receiver asynchrony and hardware impairments introduce time-varying random phase offsets in Channel State Information (CSI). Together with limited bandwidth and small antenna arrays, these effects degrade sensing accuracy. This work proposes a lightweight bistatic passive tracking and sensing framework that operates in the CSI-power domain. CSI power suppresses these offsets without explicit phase calibration, while preserving target-induced sensing cues. We show that physically admissible constraints in the spatial-frequency domain induced by transmitter-receiver geometry can resolve the mirror ambiguity inherent to real-valued CSI power. Building on these properties, we develop a real-time 3D Fourier-domain processing pipeline that jointly recovers spectral (delay), spatial (angle), and temporal (Doppler) signatures. The resulting features are integrated into an online framework with adaptive motion detection, outlier suppression, and extended Kalman filter tracking with deterministic initialization, followed by position-refined micro-Doppler feature extraction for micro-motion sensing. Extensive experiments, including simulations, a real-world prototype using 3.1 GHz LTE signals, and an open-source gait recognition dataset, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed CSI-power-based framework for bistatic passive tracking and sensing.

AI.title_translation: 基于CSI功率的双基地被动感知
AI.tldr: 提出一种仅在CSI功率域工作的轻量双基地被动跟踪框架，无需相位校准即可抑制时变相位偏移，实现3D实时感知与微动识别。
AI.motivation: 实际双基地部署中，收发不同步与硬件损伤导致CSI出现时变随机相位偏移，加之带宽与天线有限，显著降低感知精度，亟需无需相位校准的鲁棒方案。
AI.method: 利用CSI功率抑制相位偏移；利用收发几何形成的空间-频率域物理约束消除实值CSI功率的镜像模糊；构建实时3D傅里叶域处理流水线，联合恢复谱、空、时特征；集成在线运动检测、异常剔除、扩展卡尔曼滤波跟踪及微多普勒特征提取。
AI.result: 仿真、3.1 GHz LTE实测原型与开源步态数据集的实验表明，CSI功率框架可实现有效双基地被动跟踪与感知。
AI.conclusion: CSI功率域方法能在无相位校准下实现高精度双基地被动感知，为感知移动网络与通感一体化提供轻量可行方案。
AI.translation: 基于CSI功率的双基地被动感知
AI.summary: 本文提出一种基于CSI功率的双基地被动跟踪与感知框架。通过仅使用CSI功率，抑制了收发不同步与硬件损伤引起的时变相位偏移，同时保留目标感知信息。利用收发几何带来的空间-频率域物理约束消除实值CSI功率的镜像模糊，并设计实时3D傅里叶域处理流水线，联合提取延迟、角度和多普勒特征。该特征被输入在线框架，实现自适应运动检测、异常剔除、扩展卡尔曼滤波跟踪及微多普勒特征提取。仿真、3.1 GHz LTE原型与步态数据实验验证了框架的有效性。
AI.keywords: 双基地感知,被动感知,CSI功率,相位偏移抑制,3D傅里叶处理,扩展卡尔曼滤波,微多普勒
AI.comments: 未提及具体定位精度、计算复杂度或与相位域方法的量化对比；未讨论多径干扰对CSI功率的影响。

title: Rethinking RSSI for WiFi Sensing
summary: The Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) is ubiquitously available on commodity WiFi devices but is commonly regarded as too coarse for fine-grained sensing. This paper revisits its sensing potential and presents WiRSSI, a bistatic WiFi sensing framework that enables RSSI-only passive human tracking and motion sensing. WiRSSI employs a transmitter and a receiver equipped with a three-antenna array (1Tx-3Rx), and is readily extensible to Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) deployments. We first show how Channel State Information (CSI) power implicitly preserves phase-related motion modulation and how this relationship carries over to RSSI, indicating that RSSI can retain exploitable Doppler, Angle-of-Arrival (AoA), and delay cues. WiRSSI extracts Doppler-AoA features via a lightweight 2D Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) pipeline and infers bistatic delay from amplitude-only information in the absence of subcarrier-level phase. The estimated AoA and delay are then mapped to Cartesian coordinates and denoised to recover motion trajectories. Experiments in practical environments show that WiRSSI achieves median XY localization errors of 0.905 m, 0.784 m, and 0.785 m for elliptical, linear, and rectangular trajectories, respectively, compared with 0.574 m, 0.599 m, and 0.514 m from a representative CSI-based method. We further demonstrate RSSI-only gesture recognition on the Widar3.0 dataset, where WiRSSI features provide meaningful discriminative performance. These results suggest that, despite lacking subcarrier-level information compared with CSI, RSSI can support practical WiFi sensing as a complementary and hardware-friendly option when CSI is restricted, unreliable, or privacy-sensitive.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考WiFi感知中的RSSI
AI.tldr: 本文提出WiRSSI框架，仅用RSSI即可实现被动人体追踪与运动感知，证明RSSI在无需CSI时也能提供实用且保护隐私的WiFi感知能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管RSSI在商用WiFi设备中普遍可用，但一直被认为过于粗糙，无法用于细粒度感知；作者希望重新审视其潜力，提供一种无需CSI、硬件友好且兼顾隐私的替代方案。
AI.method: 利用1发3收三天线阵列，通过CSI功率与RSSI的隐含相位关系，设计轻量2D FFT流水线提取多普勒-到达角特征，并从幅度信息推断双基地延迟，再将AoA与延迟映射到笛卡尔坐标并去噪以恢复轨迹；可扩展至MIMO部署。
AI.result: 实际环境实验显示，WiRSSI对椭圆、直线、矩形轨迹的中位XY定位误差分别为0.905米、0.784米、0.785米；在Widar3.0数据集上仅用RSSI也能实现有意义的手势识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 即使缺乏子载波级信息，RSSI仍可作为CSI受限、不可靠或涉及隐私场景下的实用且硬件友好的WiFi感知补充选项。
AI.translation: 接收信号强度指示器（RSSI）在商品化WiFi设备中无处不在，但通常被认为过于粗糙，难以用于细粒度感知。本文重新审视其感知潜力，提出WiRSSI——一种仅依赖RSSI的双基地WiFi感知框架，可实现被动人体追踪与运动感知。WiRSSI采用配备三天线阵列的一发三收系统（1Tx-3Rx），可轻松扩展至MIMO部署。我们首先揭示CSI功率如何隐含保留与相位相关的运动调制，以及这种关系如何延伸至RSSI，表明RSSI仍可保留可利用的多普勒、到达角（AoA）与延迟线索。WiRSSI通过轻量2D FFT流水线提取多普勒-AoA特征，并在没有子载波相位的情况下仅从幅度信息推断双基地延迟。估计的AoA与延迟随后映射到笛卡尔坐标并去噪，以恢复运动轨迹。实际环境实验表明，WiRSSI在椭圆、直线、矩形轨迹上的中位XY定位误差分别为0.905米、0.784米、0.785米，而代表性的CSI方法为0.574米、0.599米、0.514米。我们进一步在Widar3.0数据集上展示了仅使用RSSI的手势识别，WiRSSI特征提供了有意义的区分性能。这些结果表明，尽管相比CSI缺少子载波级信息，RSSI仍可在CSI受限、不可靠或隐私敏感时，作为实用且硬件友好的WiFi感知补充选项。
AI.summary: WiRSSI框架突破RSSI“粗糙”传统认知，利用1Tx-3Rx三天线阵列和轻量2D FFT，从仅幅度信息中提取多普勒与到达角，实现亚米级被动人体轨迹追踪与手势识别，为CSI不可用场景提供硬件友好、保护隐私的WiFi感知新思路。
AI.keywords: RSSI; WiFi感知; 被动追踪; 到达角; 多普勒; 双基地延迟; 2D FFT; 隐私保护
AI.comments: 研究巧妙挖掘RSSI中隐含的相位线索，突破“必须CSI”的惯性思维；实验设计充分，覆盖多种轨迹与公开数据集，结果虽略逊于CSI，但在隐私与硬件限制场景下极具实用价值。未来可进一步降低误差并拓展至更多日常应用。

title: A Corrected Welch Satterthwaite Equation. And: What You Always Wanted to Know About Kish's Effective Sample but Were Afraid to Ask
summary: This article presents a corrected version of the Satterthwaite (1941, 1946) approximation for the degrees of freedom of a weighted sum of independent variance components. The original formula is known to yield biased estimates when component degrees of freedom are small. The correction, derived from exact moment matching, adjusts for the bias by incorporating a factor that accounts for the estimation of fourth moments. We show that Kish's (1965) effective sample size formula emerges as a special case when all variance components are equal, and component degrees of freedom are ignored. Simulation studies demonstrate that the corrected estimator closely matches the expected degrees of freedom even for small component sizes, while the original Satterthwaite estimator exhibits substantial downward bias. Additional applications are discussed, including jackknife variance estimation, multiple imputation total variance, and the Welch test for unequal variances.

AI.title_translation: 修正的 Welch-Satterthwaite 自由度公式：兼论你一直想弄清却不敢问的 Kish 有效样本量
AI.tldr: 作者提出修正版 Satterthwaite 自由度近似公式，通过匹配四阶矩纠正小样本偏差，并揭示 Kish 有效样本量是其特例；模拟表明新公式显著优于原公式。
AI.motivation: 传统 Satterthwaite 公式在分量自由度较小时会低估自由度，导致置信区间与检验失效，需要更准确的修正。
AI.method: 用精确矩匹配推导修正因子，调整加权独立方差分量之和的自由度近似，并以模拟比较新旧估计。
AI.result: 修正估计量即使在小分量样本下也无偏，而原 Satterthwaite 估计显著偏低；Kish 有效样本量公式被证明为各分量方差相等且忽略自由度时的特例。
AI.conclusion: 修正公式简单有效，可推广至刀切法、多重插补及 Welch 方差不等检验等场景，应替代传统 Satterthwaite 公式。
AI.translation: 本文给出 Satterthwaite 自由度近似的修正公式，纠正小样本偏差，并阐明 Kish 有效样本量是其特例，模拟验证其优越性。
AI.summary: 研究针对加权独立方差分量的自由度估计，提出基于四阶矩匹配的修正 Satterthwaite 方程，消除小样本偏差，统一并推广了 Kish 有效样本量概念，适用于多种统计推断场景。
AI.keywords: Satterthwaite 自由度、有效样本量、Kish 公式、矩匹配、小样本修正、Welch 检验
AI.comments: 摘要信息充分，但未给出具体修正公式或软件实现；亦未讨论计算复杂度及高维推广。

title: On the non-uniformity of the 2026 FIFA World Cup draw
summary: The group stage of a sports tournament is often made more appealing by introducing additional constraints in the group draw that promote an attractive and balanced group composition. For example, the number of intra-regional group matches is minimised in several World Cups. However, under such constraints, the traditional draw procedure may become non-uniform, meaning that the feasible allocations of the teams into groups are not equally likely to occur. Our paper quantifies this non-uniformity of the 2026 FIFA World Cup draw for the official draw procedure, as well as for 47 reasonable alternatives implied by all permutations of the four pots and two group labelling policies. We show why simulating with a recursive backtracking algorithm is intractable, and propose a workable implementation using integer programming. The official draw mechanism is found to be optimal based on four measures of non-uniformity. Nonetheless, non-uniformity can be more than halved if the organiser aims to treat the best teams drawn from the first pot equally.

AI.title_translation: 论2026年世界杯抽签的非均匀性
AI.tldr: 通过整数规划评估2026年世界杯抽签机制及47种替代方案的非均匀性，发现官方方案最优，但若优先平等对待第一档强队可再降低一半以上非均匀性。
AI.motivation: 在引入平衡与区域回避等约束后，传统抽签可能导致各可行分组概率不均，需量化并改进2026年世界杯抽签的公平性。
AI.method: 用整数规划替代不可行的递归回溯模拟，对官方抽签程序及47种由四档排序与两组标签策略排列生成的合理替代方案进行非均匀性评估。
AI.result: 官方机制在四种非均匀性指标下均为最优；若额外要求第一档强队被平等对待，可将非均匀性降低一半以上。

title: Error-Controlled Borrowing from External Data Using Wasserstein Ambiguity Sets
summary: Incorporating external data can improve the efficiency of clinical trials, but distributional mismatches between current and external populations threaten the validity of inference. While numerous dynamic borrowing methods exist, the calibration of their borrowing parameters relies mainly on ad hoc, simulation-based tuning. To overcome this, we propose BOND (Borrowing under Optimal Nonparametric Distributional robustness), a framework that formalizes data noncommensurability through Wasserstein ambiguity sets centered at the current-trial distribution. By deriving sharp, closed-form bounds on the worst-case mean drift for both continuous and binary outcomes, we construct a distributionally robust, bias-corrected Wald statistic that ensures asymptotic type I error control uniformly over the ambiguity set. Importantly, BOND determines the optimal borrowing strength by maximizing a worst-case power proxy, converting heuristic parameter tuning into a transparent, analytically tractable optimization problem. Furthermore, we demonstrate that many prominent borrowing methods can be reparameterized via an effective borrowing weight, rendering our calibration framework broadly applicable. Simulation studies and a real-world clinical trial application confirm that BOND preserves the nominal size under unmeasured heterogeneity while achieving efficiency gains over standard borrowing methods.

AI.title_translation: 基于Wasserstein模糊集的外部数据误差控制借用

title: Detecting Where Effects Occur by Testing Hypotheses in Order
summary: Experimental evaluations of public policies often randomize a new intervention within many sites or blocks. After a report of an overall result -- statistically significant or not -- the natural question from a policy maker is: \emph{where} did any effects occur? Standard adjustments for multiple testing provide little power to answer this question. In simulations modeled after a 44-block education trial, the Hommel adjustment -- among the most powerful procedures controlling the family-wise error rate (FWER) -- detects effects in only 11\% of truly non-null blocks. We develop a procedure that tests hypotheses top-down through a tree: test the overall null at the root, then groups of blocks, then individual blocks, stopping any branch where the null is not rejected. In the same 44-block design, this approach detects effects in 44\% of non-null blocks -- roughly four times the detection rate. A stopping rule and valid tests at each node suffice for weak FWER control. We show that the strong-sense FWER depends on how rejection probabilities accumulate along paths through the tree. This yields a diagnostic: when power decays fast enough relative to branching, no adjustment is needed; otherwise, an adaptive $α$-adjustment restores control. We apply the method to 25 MDRC education trials and provide an R package, \texttt{manytestsr}.

AI.title_translation: 通过有序检验假设定位政策效应发生地
AI.tldr: 提出一种树状分层检验流程，先整体、再分组、后个体，在44区教育试验中把效应定位率从11%提升至44%，并给出弱/强族错误率控制条件与R包。
AI.motivation: 政策多区块随机化试验报告整体结果后，决策者需知道“效应具体在哪”。传统多重比较校正（如Hommel）对非零区块的检出率极低，难以满足需求。
AI.method: 构建树状检验顺序：根节点检验整体零假设→中间节点检验区块组→叶节点检验单个区块；任一节点不拒绝即停止该分支。证明仅需停止规则与每节点有效检验即可弱控制FWER；提出路径累积拒绝概率框架，给出强FWER控制条件：当功效随分支衰减足够快时无需校正，否则用自适应α调整恢复控制。
AI.result: 在模拟的44区块教育试验中，新方法对真实非零区块的检出率44%，约为Hommel调整（11%）的4倍；应用于25项MDRC教育试验并提供R包manytestsr。
AI.conclusion: 树状有序检验策略在保持FWER控制的同时，大幅提升了定位政策效应地点的能力；强控制取决于拒绝概率沿路径的累积速度，自适应α可灵活恢复控制。
AI.translation: 通过按顺序检验假设来检测效应发生的位置
AI.summary: 针对多区块政策评估的“效应在哪”问题，作者提出树状分层检验流程：自顶向下依次检验整体、区块组、单个区块，任一节点不拒绝即停止。该策略在44区块教育模拟中把非零区块检出率从Hommel的11%提至44%。只要满足停止规则与节点有效检验即可弱控制FWER；强控制取决于拒绝概率沿路径的累积速度，必要时用自适应α调整。已应用于25项MDRC教育试验并发布R包manytestsr。

title: Bayesian Perspective for Orientation Determination in Cryo-EM with Application to Structural Heterogeneity Analysis
summary:
Accurate orientation estimation is a crucial component of 3D molecular structure reconstruction, both in single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and in the increasingly popular field of cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET). The dominant approach, which involves searching for the orientation that maximizes cross-correlation relative to given templates, is sub-optimal, particularly under low signal-to-noise conditions. In this work, we propose a Bayesian framework for more accurate and flexible orientation estimation, with the minimum mean square error (MMSE) estimator serving as a key example. Through simulations, we demonstrate that the MMSE estimator consistently outperforms the cross-correlation-based method, especially in challenging low signal-to-noise scenarios, and we provide a theoretical framework that supports these improvements.
  When incorporated into iterative refinement algorithms in the 3D reconstruction pipeline, the MMSE estimator markedly improves reconstruction accuracy, reduces model bias, and enhances robustness to the ``Einstein from Noise'' artifact. Crucially, we demonstrate that orientation estimation accuracy has a decisive effect on downstream structural heterogeneity analysis. In particular, integrating the MMSE-based pose estimator into frameworks for continuous heterogeneity recovery yields accuracy improvements approaching those obtained with ground-truth poses, establishing MMSE-based pose estimation as a key enabler of high-fidelity conformational landscape reconstruction. These findings indicate that the proposed Bayesian framework could substantially advance cryo-EM and cryo-ET by enhancing the accuracy, robustness, and reliability of 3D molecular structure reconstruction, thereby facilitating deeper insights into complex biological systems.

AI.title_translation: 冷冻电镜取向确定的贝叶斯视角及其在结构异质性分析中的应用
AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯框架下的MMSE取向估计器，在信噪比极低时显著优于传统互相关法，并提升三维重构与构象异质性分析精度。
AI.motivation: 传统互相关最大化取向估计在低信噪比下性能次优，导致三维重构偏差并限制下游结构异质性分析，需要更准确且鲁棒的取向确定方法。
AI.method: 构建贝叶斯框架，以最小均方误差(MMSE)估计器为核心，通过模拟验证其优势，并将其集成到迭代精修与连续异质性恢复流程。

AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯MMSE取向估计可大幅增强冷冻电镜/断层成像的三维重构准确性与可靠性，为高保真构象景观重建提供关键支撑。

title: An Infinite-Dimensional Insider Trading Game
summary: We generalize the seminal framework of Kyle (1985) to a many-asset setting, bridging the gap between informed-trading theory and modern trading practices. Specifically, we formulate an infinite-dimensional Bayesian trading game in which the informed trader's private information may concern arbitrary aspects of the cross-sectional payoff structure across a continuum of traded assets. In this general setting, we obtain a parsimonious equilibrium characterized by a single scalar fixed point, yielding closed-form characterizations of equilibrium trading strategy, price impact within and across markets, and the informational efficiency of equilibrium prices.

AI.title_translation: 无限维内幕交易博弈
AI.tldr: 将Kyle(1985)的单资产模型推广到连续统多资产场景，构建无限维贝叶斯交易博弈，得到仅依赖一个标量不动点的均衡，给出交易策略、跨市场冲击与价格信息效率的闭式解。

title: Stochastic Control Problems with Infinite Horizon and Regime Switching Arising in Optimal Liquidation with Semimartingale Strategies
summary: We study an optimal control problem on infinite time horizon with semimartingale strategies, random coefficients and regime switching. The value function and the optimal strategy can be characterized in terms of three systems of backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs) with infinite horizon. One of them is a system of linear BSDEs with unbounded coefficients and infinite horizon, which seems to be new in literature. We establish the existence of the solutions to these BSDEs by BMO analysis and comparison theorem for multi-dimensional BSDEs. Next, we establish that the optimal control problem is well posed, in the sense that the value function is finite and the optimal strategy-when it exists-is unique. This is achieved by reformulating the cost functional as the sum of a quadratic functional and the candidate value function. The reformulation crucially relies on the well-established well-posedness results for systems of BSDEs. Finally, under additional assumptions, we obtain the unique optimal strategy.

AI.title_translation: 无限时域与机制切换的随机控制问题及其在半鞅策略最优清算中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文研究无限时域下半鞅策略、随机系数与机制切换的最优控制问题，通过三组无限时域倒向随机微分方程（BSDE）刻画值函数与最优策略，并证明其存在性、唯一性与最优性。
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺少对无限时域、机制切换及半鞅策略下最优清算问题的系统研究，尤其是带无界系数的线性BSDE系统，需要建立新的存在性与唯一性理论。
AI.method: 利用BMO分析与多维BSDE比较定理建立三类无限时域BSDE解的存在性；将成本泛函重写为二次泛函与候选值函数之和，从而证明控制问题良定性；在附加假设下得到唯一最优策略。
AI.result: 证明了带无界系数的线性无限时域BSDE系统解的存在性；验证了控制问题的值函数有限且最优策略（若存在）唯一；在额外条件下给出了显式唯一最优策略。
AI.conclusion: 通过BSDE框架完整解决了无限时域机制切换半鞅控制问题，填补了带无界系数线性BSDE的研究空白，为最优清算提供了可操作的策略依据。
AI.translation: 本文研究无限时域下半鞅策略、随机系数与机制切换的最优控制问题，通过三组无限时域BSDE刻画值函数与最优策略，并证明其存在性、唯一性与最优性。
AI.summary: 本文针对无限时域、机制切换及半鞅策略的最优清算问题，提出用三组无限时域BSDE刻画值函数与最优策略，其中一组为文献中新的带无界系数的线性BSDE。作者通过BMO分析与比较定理证明其解的存在性，并重构成本泛函证明问题良定，最终在附加假设下给出唯一最优策略。
AI.keywords: 无限时域;机制切换;半鞅策略;倒向随机微分方程;最优清算;BMO分析

title: Pricing energy spread options with variance gamma-driven Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics
summary: We consider the pricing of energy spread options for spot prices following an exponential Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process driven by a sum of independent multivariate variance gamma processes, which gives rise to mean-reverting, infinite activity price dynamics. Within this class of driving processes, the Esscher transform is used to obtain an equivalent martingale measure with a focus on the weak variance alpha-gamma process. By deriving an analytical formula for the cumulant generating function of the innovation term, we obtain a pricing formula for forwards and apply the FFT method of Hurd and Zhou to price spread options. Lastly, we demonstrate how the model should be both estimated on energy prices under the real world measure and calibrated on forward or call prices, and provide numerical results for the pricing of spread options.

AI.title_translation: 方差伽马驱动Ornstein-Uhlenbeck动态下的能源价差期权定价
AI.tldr: 在均值回归、无限活动跳跃的指数OU模型下，用Esscher变换获得鞅测度，推导累积量生成函数解析式，结合FFT求价差期权价格，并给出估计与校准步骤。
AI.motivation: 传统扩散或有限跳跃模型难以同时刻画能源价格的均值回归、高阶矩与无限活动跳跃特征，需建立更贴合市场微观结构的定价框架。
AI.method: 假设现货价格服从指数Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程，其驱动项为独立多元方差伽马过程之和；利用Esscher变换选取等价鞅测度，重点研究弱方差alpha-gamma过程；推导创新项累积量生成函数的解析表达式，获得远期定价公式；采用Hurd-Zhou快速傅里叶变换法计算价差期权价格；最后给出基于历史现货价格的参数估计与基于远期或看涨期权价格的模型校准流程。
AI.result: 得到了累积量生成函数的闭合解及远期价格公式；FFT数值实验表明模型能高效定价能源价差期权；校准结果与市场价格吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 该方差伽马驱动OU框架兼具均值回归与无限活动跳跃特性，可解析处理且数值高效，为能源衍生品定价与风险管理提供了实用工具。
AI.translation: 我们考虑现货价格服从指数Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程、并由独立多元方差伽马过程之和驱动的能源价差期权定价，该设定产生均值回归、无限活动的价格动态。在此类驱动过程中，利用Esscher变换获得等价鞅测度，并重点关注弱方差alpha-gamma过程。通过推导创新项累积量生成函数的解析式，我们得到远期定价公式，并应用Hurd和Zhou的FFT方法对价差期权定价。最后，我们说明如何在真实测度下基于能源价格估计模型并在远期或看涨期权价格下校准模型，并给出价差期权定价的数值结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出用多元方差伽马过程驱动指数Ornstein-Uhlenbeck模型，刻画能源价格的均值回归与无限活动跳跃。通过Esscher变换获得鞅测度，推导累积量生成函数解析式，结合FFT方法给出价差期权定价公式，并提供估计与校准步骤，数值实验验证模型有效性。
AI.keywords: 能源价差期权,方差伽马过程,Ornstein-Uhlenbeck,Esscher变换,快速傅里叶变换,累积量生成函数

title: Roughness Analysis of Realized Volatility and VIX through Randomized Kolmogorov-Smirnov Distribution
comments: The authors are withdrawing this manuscript in order to prepare a substantially revised and expanded version, including major structural changes and additional results that go beyond a standard replacement
summary: We introduce a novel distribution-based estimator for the Hurst parameter of log-volatility, leveraging the Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic to assess the scaling behavior of entire distributions rather than individual moments. To address the temporal dependence of financial volatility, we propose a random permutation procedure that effectively removes serial correlation while preserving marginal distributions, enabling the rigorous application of the KS framework to dependent data. We establish the asymptotic variance of the estimator, useful for inference and confidence interval construction. From a computational standpoint, we show that derivative-free optimization methods, particularly Brent's method and the Nelder-Mead simplex, achieve substantial efficiency gains relative to grid search while maintaining estimation accuracy. Empirical analysis of the CBOE VIX index and the 5-minute realized volatility of the S&P 500 reveals a statistically significant hierarchy of roughness, with implied volatility smoother than realized volatility. Both measures, however, exhibit Hurst exponents well below one-half, reinforcing the rough volatility paradigm and highlighting the open challenge of disentangling local roughness from long-memory effects in fractional modeling.

AI.title_translation: 基于随机化Kolmogorov-Smirnov分布的已实现波动率与VIX粗糙度分析
AI.tldr: 利用Kolmogorov-Smirnov统计量提出新的Hurst指数估计量，揭示隐含波动率比已实现波动率更平滑，两者均支持粗糙波动率范式。
AI.motivation: 传统基于矩的方法难以全面刻画波动率的标度行为，且金融波动率存在时间依赖性，需要一种能处理依赖数据并评估整体分布粗糙度的工具。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于KS统计量的Hurst参数估计量；2) 提出随机置换程序去除序列相关同时保持边际分布；3) 推导估计量的渐近方差；4) 采用Brent法与Nelder-Mead单纯形法进行无导数优化。
AI.result: 估计量具有可计算的渐近方差，计算效率显著优于网格搜索；实证显示VIX的Hurst指数高于5分钟S&P500已实现波动率，两者均显著低于0.5。
AI.conclusion: 隐含波动率确实比已实现波动率更平滑，二者均支持粗糙波动率范式；区分局部粗糙度与长记忆效应仍是未解难题。
AI.translation: 本文提出一种基于Kolmogorov-Smirnov统计量的新型分布型估计量，用于估计对数波动率的Hurst参数，通过随机置换去除序列相关，实证表明VIX比S&P500已实现波动率更光滑，二者均显著粗糙。
AI.summary: 作者以KS统计量构建Hurst指数估计量，配合随机置换处理依赖数据，证明其渐近性质并展示计算优势，发现VIX粗糙度显著低于5分钟S&P500已实现波动率，二者均远低于0.5，强化粗糙波动率范式。
